summary.zh-CN: 瘾君子必须在自杀计时结束前及时使用通风口，否则会死亡；每次钻出后还会经历短暂无敌和定身阶段。
summary.en: The Addict must vent before a suicide timer expires or die, then passes through brief invulnerability and immobilization after venting.

search.zh-CN: 瘾君子 瘾君子必须在自杀计时结束前及时使用通风口，否则会死亡；每次钻出后还会经历短暂无敌和定身阶段。 职业能力 瘾君子有一个自杀计时器；计时结束时会自杀。通风口冷却会显示计时进度：冷却归零后仍有一小段时间可以钻入通风口，成功使用会重置自杀计时，未能及时使用则会死亡。钻出通风口后，瘾君子会在一段时间内无敌；无敌结束后还会定身一段时间，期间不能报告尸体。 设置 数量上限 ：设置一局中瘾君子的最大人数。 通风口冷却 ：设置瘾君子再次使用通风口前的等待时间。 自杀倒计时 ：设置瘾君子距离自杀的时间。 无敌时间 ：设置瘾君子钻出通风口后的无敌时长。 无敌后的定身时间 ：设置无敌结束后瘾君子被定身多久。
search.en: Addict The Addict must vent before a suicide timer expires or die, then passes through brief invulnerability and immobilization after venting. Role The Addict has a suicide timer and dies when it expires. The vent cooldown indicates the timer's progress. When the cooldown reaches zero, the Addict still has a short window to vent; doing so resets the suicide timer, while failing to vent in time causes death. After venting, the Addict is invulnerable for a set period, then remains immobilized for another period and cannot report bodies. Settings Maximum count : Sets the maximum number of Addicts in a match. Vent cooldown : Sets how long the Addict must wait before venting again. Time until suicide : Sets how long the Addict has before they die. Invulnerability time : Sets how long the Addict is invulnerable after venting. Frozen time after invulnerability : Sets how long the Addict is immobilized after invulnerability ends.

summary.zh-CN: 由仰慕者转化获得，保留原主角色，但计入船员阵营并随船员获胜。
summary.en: Granted by Admirer; keeps the main role but counts as Crewmate and wins with the Crewmates.

search.zh-CN: 仰慕 由仰慕者转化获得，保留原主角色，但计入船员阵营并随船员获胜。 效果 仰慕者可以使用有限次数的能力，将符合条件的目标赋予「仰慕」附加身份。目标保留原主角色，但在胜负判断中计入船员阵营，并随船员获胜。此身份不会在开局独立随机分配。若仰慕者已转为叛徒、招募、魅魔小弟、感染或传染性，能力会改为赋予目标对应的转化身份。 相关设置 AdmirerSkillLimit（仰慕技能次数） ：设置仰慕者可赋予该附加身份的次数。 AdmireCooldown（仰慕冷却） ：设置仰慕者使用能力的冷却时间。 AdmirerKnowTargetRole（仰慕者知晓目标身份） ：控制仰慕者与被仰慕者是否能得知彼此身份。 随机分配 ：不会开局随机分配；由上述赋予者能力转化获得。
search.en: Admired Granted by Admirer; keeps the main role but counts as Crewmate and wins with the Crewmates. Effect Admirer can use a limited number of abilities to grant the Admired add-on to an eligible target. The target keeps their main role, but counts as a Crewmate for win checks and wins with the Crewmates. This identity is not independently assigned at random. If the Admirer has become a Madmate, Recruit, Charmed, Infected, or Contagious, the ability grants that matching converted identity instead. Related settings AdmirerSkillLimit : Number of times the Admirer can grant this add-on. AdmireCooldown : Cooldown between the Admirer's ability uses. AdmirerKnowTargetRole : Whether the Admirer and the Admired target learn each other's identity. Random assignment : Not assigned at random at game start; it is granted by the conversion ability described above.

summary.zh-CN: 仰慕者可将目标转为仰慕者身份；若自身已转化，会尝试让目标加入相同阵营。是否记录已仰慕的目标取决于“知道被仰慕者的职业”选项。
summary.en: The Admirer can convert a target to Admired; if the Admirer has been converted, they attempt to convert the target to the same faction. Whether targets are tracked depends on the role-knowledge setting.

search.zh-CN: 仰慕者 仰慕者可将目标转为仰慕者身份；若自身已转化，会尝试让目标加入相同阵营。是否记录已仰慕的目标取决于“知道被仰慕者的职业”选项。 职业能力 普通仰慕者会将目标转为仰慕者；若仰慕者已成为叛徒、招募者、魅惑者、感染者或传染者，则会尝试将目标转为相应身份。开启“知道被仰慕者的职业”时会记录目标并阻止重复选择；关闭时不记录已选择的目标。技能次数由设置决定。 设置 数量上限 ：设置一局中仰慕者的最大人数。 仰慕冷却 ：设置再次使用能力前的等待时间。 知道被仰慕者的职业 ：开启时仰慕者会得知并记录目标职业，也会阻止重复选择同一目标；关闭时不记录已选择的目标，因此可能再次选择同一目标。 技能次数上限 ：设置仰慕者可以使用技能的次数。
search.en: Admirer The Admirer can convert a target to Admired; if the Admirer has been converted, they attempt to convert the target to the same faction. Whether targets are tracked depends on the role-knowledge setting. Role An unconverted Admirer changes the target to Admired. If the Admirer has been converted to Madmate, Recruit, Charmed, Infected, or Contagious, they attempt to apply that same conversion to the target. When Know the admired player's role is enabled, targets are recorded and cannot be selected again; when it is off, previous targets are not recorded. Ability uses are configurable. Settings Maximum count : Sets the maximum number of Admirers in a match. Admire cooldown : Sets how long the Admirer must wait before using the ability. Know the admired player's role : ON reveals and records the target's role, which prevents selecting the same target again; OFF does not record previous targets, so they may be selected again. Skill limit : Sets how many times the Admirer can use the ability.

summary.zh-CN: 传递炸弹；持弹者会在会议、尸体报告或倒计时结束时死亡。无内鬼且煽动者是唯一存活的计数中立阵营时，人数达到船员人数即可获胜。
summary.en: Pass a bomb; its holder dies when a meeting is called, a body is reported, or the timer expires. With no Impostors, the Agitater wins at parity when it is the only surviving counted Neutral team.

search.zh-CN: 煽动者 传递炸弹；持弹者会在会议、尸体报告或倒计时结束时死亡。无内鬼且煽动者是唯一存活的计数中立阵营时，人数达到船员人数即可获胜。 煽动者 煽动者向玩家传出炸弹。持弹者靠近其他玩家时，会尝试将炸弹传给最近的一名玩家；每次传递都有冷却，且前一名持有者不能立即接回炸弹。系统先选择最近的玩家再检查能否传递；若该玩家不能接收，炸弹不会改传给更远的玩家。未传出的炸弹会在爆炸倒计时结束时杀死持有者。会议召开或有人报告尸体时，持弹者也会死亡。尝试把炸弹传给瘟疫会杀死当前持弹者。开启自动报告诱饵后，煽动者可以正常击杀诱饵，而不会给其传炸弹。 无内鬼且煽动者是唯一存活的计数中立阵营时，煽动者阵营人数达到船员人数即可获胜。 设置 人数上限 ：一局中可出现的煽动者数量上限。 炸弹冷却 ：煽动者再次投出炸弹前的等待时间。 炸弹传递冷却 ：当前持弹者再次传递前的等待时间。 炸弹爆炸冷却 ：炸弹爆炸前的等待时间。 煽动者可接收炸弹 ：设置煽动者能否接收他人传来的炸弹。 自动报告诱饵 ：开启后，煽动者可以正常击杀诱饵。 内鬼视野 ：设置煽动者是否拥有内鬼视野。
search.en: Agitator Pass a bomb; its holder dies when a meeting is called, a body is reported, or the timer expires. With no Impostors, the Agitater wins at parity when it is the only surviving counted Neutral team. Agitator The Agitator passes a bomb to another player. When the holder gets close to another player, the game checks the nearest player first; each pass has a cooldown, and the previous holder cannot immediately receive the bomb again. If the nearest player cannot receive it, the bomb does not skip to someone farther away. If the bomb is not passed before its timer expires, the holder dies. The holder also dies if a meeting is called or a body is reported. Trying to pass the bomb to Pestilence kills the current holder. When Auto Report Bait is enabled, the Agitator can kill a Bait normally instead of passing them the bomb. With no Impostors left, the Agitater team wins at parity when it is the only surviving counted Neutral team. Settings Maximum number: Maximum number of Agitators in a match. Agitator bomb cooldown: Time before the Agitator can send out another bomb. Bomb pass cooldown: Time before the current holder can pass the bomb again. Bomb explode cooldown: Time before the bomb kills its holder. Agitator can get bomb: Whether the Agitator can receive a bomb. Agitator Auto Report Bait: Whether the Agitator can kill Bait normally instead of passing them the bomb. Impostor vision: Whether the Agitator has Impostor vision.

summary.zh-CN: 炼金术士完成任务会获得随机药水，可用于护盾、传送、加速、修复破坏、嗜血、夜视、隐身或使自己中毒。
summary.en: The Alchemist gains a random potion for each completed task, with effects including a shield, teleport, speed, sabotage repair, bloodthirst, night vision, invisibility, or self-poisoning.

search.zh-CN: 炼金术士 炼金术士完成任务会获得随机药水，可用于护盾、传送、加速、修复破坏、嗜血、夜视、隐身或使自己中毒。 职业能力 炼金术士每完成一个任务都会获得一瓶随机药水，药水名称和说明显示在职业名称下方。钻通风口可使用当前药水。药水效果包括：获得临时护盾、在短暂延迟后自杀、传送到随机玩家、加速、立即修复下一次破坏、嗜血击杀目标、暂时增强视野，或暂时隐身。 设置 通风口冷却 ：设置炼金术士再次使用通风口前的等待时间。 抗性药水持续时间 ：设置抗性药水效果持续多久。 夜视药水视野 ：设置使用夜视药水时的视野。 停电期间夜视药水视野 ：设置停电破坏期间夜视药水的视野。 夜视药水持续时间 ：设置夜视效果持续多久。 速度药水加成 ：设置速度药水提高的移动速度。 隐身药水持续时间 ：设置隐身药水的持续时间。 自定义炼金术士任务 ：开启时可单独设置任务数量；关闭时炼金术士与船员使用相同的任务数量。自定义选项包括公共任务、长任务和短任务的设置。
search.en: Alchemist The Alchemist gains a random potion for each completed task, with effects including a shield, teleport, speed, sabotage repair, bloodthirst, night vision, invisibility, or self-poisoning. Role The Alchemist receives a random potion whenever they complete a task. The potion's name and description appear under the role name. Vent to use the current potion. Effects include a temporary shield, self-poisoning, teleporting to a random player, increased speed, instantly fixing the next sabotage, bloodthirst, temporary night vision, and temporary invisibility. Settings Vent cooldown : Sets how long the Alchemist must wait before venting again. Resistance Potion duration : Sets how long the Resistance Potion lasts. Night Vision : Sets the Alchemist's vision while the Night Vision Potion is active. Night Vision during lights sabotage : Sets vision from the potion during a lights sabotage. Night Vision Potion duration : Sets how long the Night Vision effect lasts. Speed Potion boost : Sets the speed increase from the Speed Potion. Invisibility Potion duration : Sets how long the Invisibility Potion lasts. Override Alchemist tasks : ON allows a separate task setup; OFF gives the Alchemist the same task count as a Crewmate. The custom setup includes common-task availability and the number of long and short tasks.

summary.zh-CN: 殉道者可切换报告模式与复活模式；在复活模式报告尸体会牺牲自己并复活死者。
summary.en: The Altruist can switch between normal reporting and revival mode; reporting a body in revival mode sacrifices themself to revive the dead player.

search.zh-CN: 殉道者 殉道者可切换报告模式与复活模式；在复活模式报告尸体会牺牲自己并复活死者。 职业能力 殉道者可以切换复活模式与普通报告模式。处于复活模式时报告尸体会牺牲自己并复活死者；若死者已经离开游戏，则按普通报告处理。复活的玩家不能报告自己的尸体。 设置 数量上限 ：设置一局中殉道者的最大人数。 复活者的尸体无法被报告 ：开启时，复活者的尸体不能再次报告；关闭时可以报告。 内鬼知道有人被复活 ：开启时内鬼收到提示；关闭时不收到。 内鬼看到复活者箭头 ：开启时内鬼看到指向复活者的箭头；关闭时不显示。 带刀中立知道有人被复活 ：开启时带刀中立收到提示；关闭时不收到。 带刀中立看到复活者箭头 ：开启时带刀中立看到指向复活者的箭头；关闭时不显示。
search.en: Altruist The Altruist can switch between normal reporting and revival mode; reporting a body in revival mode sacrifices themself to revive the dead player. Role The Altruist can switch between revival mode and normal reporting. In revival mode, reporting a body sacrifices the Altruist to revive that dead player. If the dead player has left the game, the report proceeds normally. A revived player cannot report their own dead body. Settings Maximum count : Sets the maximum number of Altruists in a match. Revived dead body cannot be reported : ON prevents the revived player's body from being reported again; OFF allows it to be reported. Impostors know a player was revived : ON sends Impostors an alert; OFF does not. Impostors get an arrow to the revived player : ON shows them an arrow; OFF hides it. Neutral Killers know a player was revived : ON sends Neutral Killers an alert; OFF does not. Neutral Killers get an arrow to the revived player : ON shows them an arrow; OFF hides it.

summary.zh-CN: 报告尸体并记住死者的身份；根据死者阵营与兼容性转变为相应职业。
summary.en: Report a body to remember the victim's role, then become a role determined by their team and compatibility.

search.zh-CN: 失忆者 报告尸体并记住死者的身份；根据死者阵营与兼容性转变为相应职业。 失忆者 失忆者可以报告尸体并记住死者的职业： 死者属于内鬼阵营，或拥有背叛者附加职业时，失忆者会变为逃亡者。 死者属于船员阵营时，若职业兼容，失忆者会变为该职业；否则会变为工程师。 对于代码列出的部分中立职业，失忆者会直接变为死者的职业；其他被标记为不兼容的中立职业会使用设置指定的替代职业。 不在这两类识别列表中的中立职业不会触发上述转变，失忆者仍保持原职业。 设置 人数上限 ：一局中可出现的失忆者数量上限。 中立职业不兼容时的转变职业 ：可选择失忆者、起诉人、赌徒、独行者或效仿者。 显示尸体箭头 ：设置失忆者是否会看到指向尸体的箭头。
search.en: Amnesiac Report a body to remember the victim's role, then become a role determined by their team and compatibility. Amnesiac The Amnesiac can report a body to remember the victim's role: If the victim was an Impostor or had the Madmate add-on, the Amnesiac becomes a Refugee. If the victim was a Crewmate, the Amnesiac becomes that role when compatible; otherwise, they become an Engineer. For certain Neutral roles listed by the implementation, the Amnesiac directly takes the victim's role. Other Neutral roles designated as incompatible use the fallback role selected in the settings. Neutral roles outside those recognized groups do not trigger either transformation, so the Amnesiac keeps their role. Settings Maximum number: Maximum number of Amnesiacs in a match. Role for an incompatible Neutral role: Choose Amnesiac, Pursuer, Follower, Maverick, or Imitator. Arrows to bodies: Whether the Amnesiac receives arrows pointing to dead bodies.

summary.zh-CN: 变形骇入合格目标，让其报告骇客共享的近期击杀尸体记录；没有记录时目标会报告自己。
summary.en: Shapeshifts to hack an eligible target into reporting a body from the shared list of recent Anonymous kills; if none is recorded, the target reports themself.

search.zh-CN: 骇客 变形骇入合格目标，让其报告骇客共享的近期击杀尸体记录；没有记录时目标会报告自己。 技能 变形骇入一名合格目标后，目标会立即召开会议，并从所有骇客共享的近期击杀尸体记录中报告一具尸体。若有记录尸体但无法确认骇入者是凶手，会从记录中随机选择；若自上次报告以来没有记录尸体，目标会报告自己。骇入不受尸体能否正常报告的限制。LazyGuy、带有懒惰（Lazy）附加职业的玩家，以及未成年好迷你船员（Nice Mini）不能成为骇入目标。 选项 数量上限（Max） ：设置本局最多可有多少名骇客。 击杀冷却 ：设置击杀冷却。 骇入次数上限 ：设置每局可用骇入的次数。
search.en: Anonymous Shapeshifts to hack an eligible target into reporting a body from the shared list of recent Anonymous kills; if none is recorded, the target reports themself. Ability Shapeshift into an eligible target to make them immediately call a meeting and report a body from the shared list of recent Anonymous kills. If bodies are recorded but the hacker cannot be confirmed as the killer, one of those bodies is chosen at random; if no body has been recorded since the last report, the target reports themself. Hacking ignores normal body-report checks. LazyGuy, players with the Lazy add-on, and a Nice Mini under 18 cannot be targeted. Options Max : Maximum number of Anonymous roles in a match. Kill Cooldown : The Anonymous kill cooldown. Ability Use Count : Maximum number of hacks per game.

summary.zh-CN: 侦测摄像头、管理室地图、生命体征仪和门禁记录等设备附近的船员或中立玩家，但无法确认对方正在使用设备。
summary.en: Detects Crewmates or Neutrals near cameras, Admin, vitals, DoorLog, and similar devices, but cannot tell whether they are using them.

search.zh-CN: 监管者 侦测摄像头、管理室地图、生命体征仪和门禁记录等设备附近的船员或中立玩家，但无法确认对方正在使用设备。 技能 可随时获知船员或中立玩家是否靠近摄像头、管理室地图、生命体征仪、门禁记录等设备。只能判断有人靠近，无法确认其是否正在使用设备。 选项 数量上限（Max） ：设置本局最多可有多少名监管者。 追踪摄像头附近玩家 ：开启时可收到有人靠近摄像头的提示；关闭时不提供此信息。
search.en: Anti Adminer Detects Crewmates or Neutrals near cameras, Admin, vitals, DoorLog, and similar devices, but cannot tell whether they are using them. Ability Can detect whether a Crewmate or Neutral is near cameras, the Admin table, vitals, DoorLog, or similar devices. The Anti Adminer can tell that someone is nearby, but cannot confirm that the person is using the device. Options Max : Maximum number of Anti Adminers in a match. Can Track Camera Usage : When enabled, the Anti Adminer is informed when players are near cameras; otherwise this information is not shown.

summary.zh-CN: 有人尝试对其使用击杀按钮时，对方的击杀冷却会缩短。
summary.en: When someone tries to kill it, that player's kill cooldown is reduced.

search.zh-CN: 健康者 有人尝试对其使用击杀按钮时，对方的击杀冷却会缩短。 效果 当其他玩家尝试对健康者使用击杀按钮时，攻击者的击杀冷却会缩短一段由主持人设置的时间。 设置 Max（最大数量） ：本局中该附加身份可出现的数量上限。 Spawn Chance（生成概率） ：玩家获得此附加身份的概率。 Eligibility（可分配阵营） ：主持人可分别设置内鬼、船员、中立者是否可以获得此附加身份。 Decrease the cooldown by（冷却缩短时间） ：攻击者的冷却缩短时长。 Cooldown returns to normal after a meeting（会议后冷却恢复正常） ：控制会议结束后攻击者的冷却是否恢复正常。
search.en: Antidote When someone tries to kill it, that player's kill cooldown is reduced. Effect When someone tries to use a kill button on Antidote, that player's kill cooldown is reduced by a configurable amount. Settings Max : Maximum number that can appear in one match. Spawn Chance : Chance for a player to receive this add-on. Eligibility : Separate settings control whether Impostors, Crewmates, Neutrals can receive this add-on. Decrease the cooldown by : Amount by which the killer's cooldown is reduced. Cooldown returns to normal after a meeting : Whether the killer's cooldown returns to normal after a meeting.

summary.zh-CN: 每次成功击杀都会缩短后续击杀冷却。
summary.en: Each successful kill reduces the cooldown before the next kill.

search.zh-CN: 狂妄杀手 每次成功击杀都会缩短后续击杀冷却。 技能 每次成功击杀都会缩短击杀冷却，缩短幅度受设置控制。 选项 数量上限（Max） ：设置本局最多可有多少名狂妄杀手。 初始击杀冷却 ：设置开局时的击杀冷却。 每次击杀减少的冷却 ：设置每次成功击杀后减少的秒数。 最低击杀冷却 ：设置击杀冷却可降到的最低值。 隐藏职业 在隐藏职业启用时，吟游诗人有一定概率替代狂妄杀手出现；概率由隐藏职业设置决定。
search.en: Arrogance Each successful kill reduces the cooldown before the next kill. Ability Each successful kill reduces the cooldown before the next kill by the configured amount. Options Max : Maximum number of Arrogance roles in a match. Starting Kill Cooldown : Initial kill cooldown. Reduce Kill Cooldown By : Cooldown reduction after each successful kill. Minimum Kill Cooldown : Lowest possible kill cooldown. Hidden Role When hidden roles are enabled, Bard has a chance to appear in place of Arrogance. The chance is controlled by the hidden-role settings.

summary.zh-CN: 跟随玩家为其涂油；除自己外的所有存活玩家都涂油后可点火获胜，开启随时点火后也可提前点燃已涂油玩家。
summary.en: Douse players by following them; ignite after dousing all other living players, or ignite doused players earlier when anytime ignition is enabled.

search.zh-CN: 纵火犯 跟随玩家为其涂油；除自己外的所有存活玩家都涂油后可点火获胜，开启随时点火后也可提前点燃已涂油玩家。 纵火犯 纵火犯使用击杀按钮开始为一名玩家涂油；需要持续待在目标附近直到计时结束，离开范围会取消当前涂油。名字旁显示「△」表示正在涂油，「▲」表示已完成涂油。 所有存活玩家都被涂油后，纵火犯可以进入通风口点燃他们并单独获胜。开启“可随时点火”后，达到最低涂油人数即可点燃所有已涂油的存活玩家；若仍有其他存活玩家，点火不会获胜。 设置 人数上限 ：一局中可出现的纵火犯数量上限。 涂油持续时间 ：跟随玩家多久才能完成涂油。 涂油冷却 ：再次涂油前的等待时间。 可随时点火 ：开启后，达到最低涂油人数即可点燃所有已涂油的存活玩家；最多人数选项限制可涂油人数。关闭后，需涂油所有其他存活玩家才能点火获胜。
search.en: Arsonist Douse players by following them; ignite after dousing all other living players, or ignite doused players earlier when anytime ignition is enabled. Arsonist The Arsonist uses the kill button to start dousing a player and must stay near them until the timer finishes; moving out of range cancels the douse. A triangle (△) beside a name means they are being doused; a filled triangle (▲) means they are fully doused. After dousing all other living players, the Arsonist can vent to ignite them and win alone. When “Can ignite anytime” is enabled, reaching the minimum doused count lets the Arsonist ignite all living doused players; if other players remain alive, that ignition does not win. Settings Maximum number: Maximum number of Arsonists in a match. Douse duration: Time the Arsonist must stay near a player to douse them. Cooldown: Time before dousing another player. Can ignite anytime: When enabled, the Arsonist can ignite all living doused players after reaching the minimum; the maximum limits how many players can be doused. When disabled, all other living players must be doused before the Arsonist can ignite and win.

summary.zh-CN: 查看尸体的死亡原因；与法医、寻迹者、科学家和阳光开朗大男孩不兼容。
summary.en: Reveals how players died; incompatible with Doctor, Tracefinder, ScientistTOHE, and Sunnyboy.

search.zh-CN: 尸检 查看尸体的死亡原因；与法医、寻迹者、科学家和阳光开朗大男孩不兼容。 效果 尸检可查看其他玩家的死亡原因。它与法医、寻迹者、科学家和阳光开朗大男孩不兼容；如果全局设置已让所有人都能看到死亡原因，则不会随机分配尸检。 设置 Max（最大数量） ：本局中该附加身份可出现的数量上限。 Spawn Chance（生成概率） ：玩家获得此附加身份的概率。 Eligibility（可分配阵营） ：主持人可分别设置内鬼、船员、中立者是否可以获得此附加身份。
search.en: Autopsy Reveals how players died; incompatible with Doctor, Tracefinder, ScientistTOHE, and Sunnyboy. Effect Autopsy can see how other players died. It is incompatible with Doctor, Tracefinder, ScientistTOHE, and Sunnyboy. If the global setting already shows death reasons to everyone, Autopsy is not assigned randomly. Settings Max : Maximum number that can appear in one match. Spawn Chance : Chance for a player to receive this add-on. Eligibility : Separate settings control whether Impostors, Crewmates, Neutrals can receive this add-on.

summary.zh-CN: 在会议外被非自杀击杀时，会随机向一名符合条件的存活玩家复仇。
summary.en: When killed outside a meeting other than by suicide, takes revenge on a random eligible living player.

search.zh-CN: 复仇者 在会议外被非自杀击杀时，会随机向一名符合条件的存活玩家复仇。 效果 主持人可设置内鬼能否获得复仇者。复仇者在会议外被杀且不是自杀时，会随机击杀一名符合条件的存活玩家；被投出或自杀不会触发复仇。 设置 Max（最大数量） ：本局中该附加身份可出现的数量上限。 Spawn Chance（生成概率） ：玩家获得此附加身份的概率。 Eligibility（可分配阵营） ：主持人可分别设置内鬼、船员、中立者是否可以获得此附加身份。
search.en: Avenger When killed outside a meeting other than by suicide, takes revenge on a random eligible living player. Effect The host can allow Impostors to receive Avenger. When Avenger is killed outside a meeting by a method other than suicide, it kills a random eligible living player. Exile and suicide do not trigger the ability. Settings Max : Maximum number that can appear in one match. Spawn Chance : Chance for a player to receive this add-on. Eligibility : Separate settings control whether Impostors, Crewmates, Neutrals can receive this add-on.

summary.zh-CN: 调查员或神谕者投票给它，或军师、预言家尝试击杀它后，会在会议收到通知。
summary.en: Receives a meeting notice if Fortune Teller or Oracle votes for it, or Consigliere or Overseer attempts to kill it.

search.zh-CN: 意识者 调查员或神谕者投票给它，或军师、预言家尝试击杀它后，会在会议收到通知。 效果 如果军师或预言家尝试击杀意识者，或调查员或神谕者在会议中投票给意识者，意识者会收到会议通知。主持人可设置通知是否显示互动者的角色。 设置 Max（最大数量） ：本局中该附加身份可出现的数量上限。 Spawn Chance（生成概率） ：玩家获得此附加身份的概率。 Eligibility（可分配阵营） ：主持人可分别设置内鬼、船员、中立者是否可以获得此附加身份。 Knows the role of player（得知互动者角色） ：控制意识者能否得知与其互动玩家的角色。
search.en: Aware Receives a meeting notice if Fortune Teller or Oracle votes for it, or Consigliere or Overseer attempts to kill it. Effect Aware receives a meeting notice if Consigliere or Overseer attempts to kill it, or if Fortune Teller or Oracle votes for it. The host can configure whether the notice also names the role that interacted with Aware. Settings Max : Maximum number that can appear in one match. Spawn Chance : Chance for a player to receive this add-on. Eligibility : Separate settings control whether Impostors, Crewmates, Neutrals can receive this add-on. Knows the role of player : Whether Aware learns the role of the player who interacted with it.

summary.zh-CN: 被击杀后会迫使击杀者延迟报告尸体；特定击杀者及通讯破坏设置可阻止触发。
summary.en: When killed, forces the killer to report the body after a delay; some killers and Comms settings suppress it.

search.zh-CN: 诱饵 被击杀后会迫使击杀者延迟报告尸体；特定击杀者及通讯破坏设置可阻止触发。 效果 诱饵被击杀后，若击杀者不是杀戮机器、隐匿者、魅影或清理工，击杀者会在设定延迟后被迫报告尸体。若通讯破坏与伪装同时生效，是否仍强制报告由设置决定；胆小鬼的免疫设置也可阻止自动报告。 设置 Max（最大数量） ：本局中该附加身份可出现的数量上限。 Spawn Chance（生成概率） ：玩家获得此附加身份的概率。 Eligibility（可分配阵营） ：主持人可分别设置内鬼、船员、中立者是否可以获得此附加身份。 BaitDelayMin（最短报告延迟） ：击杀者自动报告尸体前的最短延迟。 BaitDelayMax（最长报告延迟） ：击杀者自动报告尸体前的最长延迟。 BaitDelayNotify（自动报告前提醒击杀者） ：控制是否在自动报告前提醒击杀者。 BaitNotification（首次会议揭示诱饵） ：控制是否在第一次会议揭示存活的诱饵玩家。 BaitCanBeReportedUnderAllConditions（通讯破坏期间仍可强制报告） ：控制通讯破坏期间报告功能被禁用时，诱饵是否仍会强制报告。
search.en: Bait When killed, forces the killer to report the body after a delay; some killers and Comms settings suppress it. Effect When Bait is killed, the killer is forced to report the body after a configured delay unless the killer is KillingMachine, Swooper, Wraith, or Cleaner. During Comms sabotage combined with camouflage, a setting controls whether the report still happens. Oblivious's Bait immunity setting can also suppress the automatic report. Settings Max : Maximum number that can appear in one match. Spawn Chance : Chance for a player to receive this add-on. Eligibility : Separate settings control whether Impostors, Crewmates, Neutrals can receive this add-on. BaitDelayMin : Minimum delay before the killer automatically reports the body. BaitDelayMax : Maximum delay before the killer automatically reports the body. BaitDelayNotify : Whether the killer is warned about the upcoming self-report. BaitNotification : Whether living Bait players are revealed at the first meeting. BaitCanBeReportedUnderAllConditions : Whether Bait still forces a report during Comms sabotage when reporting is otherwise disabled.

summary.zh-CN: 每轮给一名非灾厄玩家面包；达到存活面包玩家门槛后转变为饥荒。
summary.en: Give one non-Apocalypse player bread each round; transform into Famine once enough breaded players are alive.

search.zh-CN: 面包师 每轮给一名非灾厄玩家面包；达到存活面包玩家门槛后转变为饥荒。 面包师 面包师每轮可以使用击杀按钮给一名玩家面包。不能给灾厄阵营成员面包。达到房主设定的存活面包玩家数量后，面包师会转变为饥荒。 若开启面包附加效果，面包师可以使用通风口切换发放的面包效果： 揭示 ：向面包师揭示目标职业，整局有效。 职业封锁 ：将目标击杀冷却设为 999，会议后恢复正常。 护盾 ：给目标一个只有面包师知道的护盾，会议后移除。 设置 饥荒所需面包数量 ：转变为饥荒所需的存活面包玩家数量。 饥荒饥饿冷却 ：饥荒再次使用饥饿能力前的等待时间。 面包具有额外效果 ：开启后可切换上述效果；关闭后面包不提供额外效果。
search.en: Baker Give one non-Apocalypse player bread each round; transform into Famine once enough breaded players are alive. Baker Once per round, the Baker can use the kill button to give one player bread. The Baker cannot give bread to another Apocalypse member. They transform into Famine when the configured number of breaded players are alive. If additional bread effects are enabled, the Baker can use vents to switch the effect granted by each loaf: Reveal: Shows the target's role to the Baker for the rest of the game. Roleblock: Sets the target's kill cooldown to 999 until the next meeting. Barrier: Gives the target a barrier known only to the Baker; it is removed after the meeting. Settings Bread required for Famine: Number of living breaded players needed for the transformation. Famine starve cooldown: Time Famine must wait before using Starve again. Bread gives additional effects: When enabled, bread has one of the effects above; when disabled, bread has no additional effect.

summary.zh-CN: 单击击杀按钮偷取附加职业，双击则会击杀目标。内鬼阵营消失后，若强盗是唯一存活的计数中立阵营且人数不少于船员，即可获胜。
summary.en: Use a single kill-button press to steal an addon; double-click to kill instead. After Impostors are gone, Bandits win when they are the only counted Neutral team and at least as numerous as Crew.

search.zh-CN: 强盗 单击击杀按钮偷取附加职业，双击则会击杀目标。内鬼阵营消失后，若强盗是唯一存活的计数中立阵营且人数不少于船员，即可获胜。 强盗 强盗使用击杀按钮偷取玩家的附加职业。单击会开始偷取；若没有在双击判定时间内再次点击，附加职业就会被偷取。双击同一目标则会正常击杀目标。根据设置，偷取立即生效，或在下一次会议开始时生效。达到偷取次数上限后，强盗可以正常击杀；目标没有可偷附加职业或带有顽固附加职业时也会被击杀。内鬼阵营消失后，若强盗是唯一存活的计数中立阵营且人数不少于船员，强盗即可获胜。 干净者、绝境者和恋人不能被偷取；开启通风口选项后，敏捷者也不能被偷取。 设置 人数上限 ：一局中可出现的强盗数量上限。 偷取次数上限 ：强盗可偷取附加职业的次数。 击杀冷却 ：再次使用击杀按钮前的等待时间。 偷取冷却 ：再次偷取附加职业前的等待时间。 偷取模式 ：立即偷取，或在会议开始时偷取。 可偷取背叛类附加职业 ：设置强盗能否偷取背叛类附加职业。 可偷取仅限内鬼的附加职业 ：设置强盗能否偷取仅限内鬼的附加职业。 可使用破坏 ：设置强盗能否发动破坏。 可使用通风口 ：设置强盗能否使用通风口。
search.en: Bandit Use a single kill-button press to steal an addon; double-click to kill instead. After Impostors are gone, Bandits win when they are the only counted Neutral team and at least as numerous as Crew. Bandit The Bandit uses the kill button to steal an addon. A single click starts a steal; if the Bandit does not click the same target again within the double-click window, the addon is stolen. Double-clicking the same target kills them instead. Depending on the selected mode, the addon is stolen immediately or when the next meeting starts. After reaching the steal limit, the Bandit can kill normally. A target with no stealable addon or a Stubborn addon is killed instead. After Impostors are gone, the Bandit wins when it is the only surviving counted Neutral team and is at least as numerous as Crew. Cleansed, Last Impostor, and Lovers cannot be stolen. If Bandit can vent is enabled, Nimble cannot be stolen either. Settings Maximum number: Maximum number of Bandits in a match. Maximum steals: Number of addons the Bandit can steal. Kill cooldown: Time before using the kill button again. Steal cooldown: Time before stealing an addon again. Steal mode: Steal immediately or when a meeting starts. Can steal Betrayal addons: Whether Betrayal addons can be stolen. Can steal Impostor-only addons: Whether Impostor-only addons can be stolen. Can sabotage: Whether the Bandit can sabotage. Can vent: Whether the Bandit can use vents.

summary.zh-CN: 存活时，放逐确认会显示吟游诗人创作的句子；每次会议放逐后击杀冷却永久减半。
summary.en: While alive, replaces ejection confirmation with a composed sentence; each ejection permanently halves its kill cooldown.

search.zh-CN: 吟游诗人 存活时，放逐确认会显示吟游诗人创作的句子；每次会议放逐后击杀冷却永久减半。 技能 吟游诗人存活时，放逐确认会显示由吟游诗人创作的句子，而不是普通确认内容。每次有玩家被放逐后，吟游诗人的击杀冷却会永久减半。 出现条件 必须关闭“禁用隐藏职业”，吟游诗人才有机会出现。
search.en: Bard While alive, replaces ejection confirmation with a composed sentence; each ejection permanently halves its kill cooldown. Ability While the Bard is alive, ejection confirmation displays a sentence composed by the Bard instead of the normal confirmation. Each time a player is ejected, the Bard’s kill cooldown is permanently halved. Appearance Condition “Disable Hidden Roles” must be turned off for the Bard to have a chance to appear.

summary.zh-CN: 埋雷兵可以在通风口放置炸弹以击杀内鬼和中立，但炸弹也可能炸死船员。
summary.en: The Bastion plants bombs in vents to kill Impostors and Neutrals, but the bombs can also kill Crewmates.

search.zh-CN: 埋雷兵 埋雷兵可以在通风口放置炸弹以击杀内鬼和中立，但炸弹也可能炸死船员。 职业能力 埋雷兵可以在通风口放置炸弹，用于击杀内鬼和中立玩家；炸弹也会炸死船员。开启“会议后清除炸弹”后，触发会议时会清除所有已放置的炸弹；该选项默认关闭。 设置 会议后清除炸弹 ：会议结束时清除埋雷兵放置的所有炸弹。 炸弹冷却 ：设置再次在通风口放置炸弹前的等待时间。 每完成一个任务获得的技能次数 ：设置每完成一个任务增加的炸弹使用次数，按 0.1 为步进。 初始炸弹上限 ：设置埋雷兵开局拥有的炸弹数量上限。
search.en: Bastion The Bastion plants bombs in vents to kill Impostors and Neutrals, but the bombs can also kill Crewmates. Role The Bastion plants bombs in vents to kill Impostors and Neutrals. Crewmates can also be killed by the bombs. When Bombs clear after meetings is enabled, all planted bombs are cleared when a meeting is reported; the option is off by default. Settings Bombs clear after meetings : Clears all bombs placed by the Bastion when a meeting ends. Bomb cooldown : Sets how long the Bastion must wait before planting another bomb. Ability uses gained per task : Sets the additional bomb uses gained for each completed task, in 0.1 increments. Initial maximum bombs : Sets the maximum number of bombs the Bastion starts with.

summary.zh-CN: 恩人完成任务后会标记该任务，其他玩家完成被标记的任务时会获得只能抵挡直接击杀的临时护盾。
summary.en: The Benefactor marks completed tasks so that another player finishing one receives a temporary shield against direct kills.

search.zh-CN: 恩人 恩人完成任务后会标记该任务，其他玩家完成被标记的任务时会获得只能抵挡直接击杀的临时护盾。 职业能力 恩人完成任务后会标记该任务。其他玩家完成被标记的任务时会获得临时护盾；护盾只能抵挡直接击杀。 设置 数量上限 ：设置一局中恩人的最大人数。 每轮可标记的任务数 ：设置恩人每轮可以标记多少个任务。 护盾持续时间 ：设置护盾持续多久。 护盾在一次击杀尝试后破碎 ：开启时，护盾承受一次击杀尝试后破碎；关闭时不会因此消耗。 自定义恩人任务 ：开启时可为恩人单独设置任务数量；关闭时恩人与其他玩家使用相同的任务数量。相关选项可设置恩人是否有公共任务，以及长任务、短任务数量。
search.en: Benefactor The Benefactor marks completed tasks so that another player finishing one receives a temporary shield against direct kills. Role The Benefactor marks each task they complete. When another player completes a marked task, that player receives a temporary shield. The shield protects only against direct kill attacks. Settings Maximum count : Sets the maximum number of Benefactors in a match. Tasks markable per round : Sets how many tasks the Benefactor can mark in one round. Shield duration : Sets how long the shield lasts. Shield breaks after one kill attempt : ON makes the shield break on the first contact; OFF prevents it from breaking on that first contact. Override Benefactor tasks : ON allows a separate task setup; OFF gives the Benefactor the same task count as everyone else. The custom setup includes whether the role gets common tasks and the number of long and short tasks.

summary.zh-CN: 通过击杀升级并逐步解锁能力；达到设定等级后可转变为战争者。
summary.en: Level up by killing to unlock abilities, and transform into War at the configured level.

search.zh-CN: 狂战士 通过击杀升级并逐步解锁能力；达到设定等级后可转变为战争者。 狂战士 狂战士每次击杀都会升级。达到房主设定的等级后，会解锁相应能力。 清道夫击杀 ：击杀后尸体会消失。 爆炸击杀 ：击杀会引发爆炸；范围内除狂战士和目标外的其他玩家也可能被炸死。 达到设定等级后，狂战士可以转变为战争者。 狂战士不能击杀灾厄阵营的玩家。 设置 击杀冷却 ：狂战士使用击杀的等待时间。 最高等级 ：狂战士可提升到的最高等级。 狂战士/战争者内鬼视野 ：分别设置狂战士和战争者是否拥有内鬼视野；关闭时使用船员视野。 狂战士/战争者可使用通风口 ：分别设置两种形态能否使用通风口。 解锁较短击杀冷却 ：开启后，达到等级要求可获得所设击杀冷却；关闭后不会解锁。 解锁清道夫击杀 ：开启后，达到等级要求可解锁清道夫击杀。 解锁爆炸击杀 ：开启后，达到等级要求可解锁爆炸击杀。 转变为战争者 ：开启后，达到等级要求会转变为战争者，并使用设定的战争者击杀冷却；关闭后不会转变。
search.en: Berserker Level up by killing to unlock abilities, and transform into War at the configured level. Berserker The Berserker gains a level with each kill. Reaching host-configured level thresholds unlocks abilities. Scavenged kills: The body disappears after the kill. Bombed kills: The kill causes an explosion that can also kill other nearby players besides the Berserker and the target. At the configured level, the Berserker can transform into War. The Berserker cannot kill players on the Apocalypse team. Settings Kill cooldown: Time between the Berserker's kills. Maximum level: Highest level the Berserker can reach. Berserker/War Impostor vision: Set vision for each form; when disabled, that form uses Crewmate vision. Berserker/War can vent: Set whether each form can use vents. Unlock lower kill cooldown: When enabled, reaching the required level grants the configured kill cooldown; when disabled, it cannot be unlocked. Unlock scavenged kills: When enabled, the required level unlocks scavenged kills. Unlock bombed kills: When enabled, the required level unlocks bombed kills. Become War: When enabled, reaching the required level transforms the Berserker into War, with the configured War kill cooldown; when disabled, the transformation is unavailable.

summary.zh-CN: 被击杀时会让击杀者获得与自己相同的视野；主持人可设定视野和分配阵营。
summary.en: When killed, gives its killer the same vision level; host settings control vision and eligible teams.

search.zh-CN: 迷幻者 被击杀时会让击杀者获得与自己相同的视野；主持人可设定视野和分配阵营。 效果 持有迷幻者时的视野由主持人设置，可以高于或低于其他玩家。迷幻者被击杀后，若启用相应选项，击杀者的视野会改为迷幻者当时的视野；Impostors 是否可获得此附加身份由阵营分配选项控制。 设置 Max（最大数量） ：本局中该附加身份可出现的数量上限。 Spawn Chance（生成概率） ：玩家获得此附加身份的概率。 Eligibility（可分配阵营） ：主持人可分别设置内鬼、船员、中立者是否可以获得此附加身份。 BewilderVision（迷幻者视野） ：分配给迷幻者的视野范围。 KillerGetBewilderVision（击杀者获得迷幻者视野） ：控制击杀者杀死迷幻者后是否获得其视野。
search.en: Bewilder When killed, gives its killer the same vision level; host settings control vision and eligible teams. Effect The host sets the vision level for Bewilder, which can be lower or higher than other players' vision. When Bewilder is killed, the killer receives Bewilder's vision if the related option is enabled. The team eligibility options control whether Impostors can receive this add-on. Settings Max : Maximum number that can appear in one match. Spawn Chance : Chance for a player to receive this add-on. Eligibility : Separate settings control whether Impostors, Crewmates, Neutrals can receive this add-on. BewilderVision : Vision level assigned to players with Bewilder. KillerGetBewilderVision : Whether the killer receives Bewilder's vision after killing them.

summary.zh-CN: 变形勒索一名玩家，使其在会议中无法发言；再次勒索会解除先前目标的勒索。
summary.en: Shapeshifts to blackmail one player and silence them during meetings; a new target is released from the previous blackmail.

search.zh-CN: 勒索者 变形勒索一名玩家，使其在会议中无法发言；再次勒索会解除先前目标的勒索。 技能 变形到目标身上即可勒索，使其在会议中无法发言。任一时刻只会有一名被勒索者；勒索新目标会解除前一名目标的勒索，会议结束后勒索也会解除。被勒索者的身份会在会议中标记。 选项 数量上限（Max） ：设置本局最多可有多少名勒索者。 勒索冷却 ：设置再次勒索前的等待时间。 显示变形动画 ：开启时显示变形动画；关闭时不显示。
search.en: Blackmailer Shapeshifts to blackmail one player and silence them during meetings; a new target is released from the previous blackmail. Ability Shapeshift into a player to blackmail them, preventing them from speaking during meetings. Only one player can be blackmailed at a time; blackmailing another target releases the previous one, and the blackmail ends after the meeting. The blackmailed player is marked during meetings. Options Max : Maximum number of Blackmailers in a match. Blackmail Cooldown : Time before the Blackmailer can blackmail again. Show Shapeshift Animations : When enabled, shapeshift animations are shown; otherwise they are hidden.

summary.zh-CN: 内鬼消失后，若嗜血骑士是唯一存活的计数中立杀手阵营且人数不少于船员，即可获胜；每次击杀后获得短暂无敌护盾。
summary.en: After Impostors are gone, win when Blood Knights are the only surviving counted Neutral team and at least as numerous as Crew; gain a brief invulnerability shield after each kill.

search.zh-CN: 嗜血骑士 内鬼消失后，若嗜血骑士是唯一存活的计数中立杀手阵营且人数不少于船员，即可获胜；每次击杀后获得短暂无敌护盾。 嗜血骑士 内鬼阵营消失后，若嗜血骑士是唯一存活的计数中立杀手阵营，且嗜血骑士人数不少于船员人数，嗜血骑士阵营即可获胜。每次击杀后，嗜血骑士都会获得一段时间的护盾，在此期间不会死亡。 设置 击杀冷却 ：再次击杀前的等待时间。 可使用通风口 ：设置嗜血骑士能否使用通风口。 内鬼视野 ：开启后拥有内鬼视野；关闭后使用默认视野。 保护持续时间 ：击杀后无敌护盾持续的时间。
search.en: Blood Knight After Impostors are gone, win when Blood Knights are the only surviving counted Neutral team and at least as numerous as Crew; gain a brief invulnerability shield after each kill. Blood Knight After Impostors are gone, the Blood Knight wins when it is the only surviving counted Neutral team and is at least as numerous as Crew. After each kill, the Blood Knight gains a temporary shield that makes them invulnerable for a few seconds. Settings Kill cooldown: Time before the Blood Knight can kill again. Can vent: Whether the Blood Knight can use vents. Impostor vision: When enabled, the Blood Knight has Impostor vision; otherwise, they have default vision. Protection duration: How long the post-kill shield lasts.

summary.zh-CN: 作为内鬼幽灵角色使用保护技能使目标流血；目标倒计时结束后死亡。
summary.en: As an Impostor ghost role, uses the protection ability to make a target bleed; they die when the timer expires.

search.zh-CN: 嗜血之魂 作为内鬼幽灵角色使用保护技能使目标流血；目标倒计时结束后死亡。 技能 嗜血之魂作为内鬼幽灵角色使用保护技能标记目标流血。目标会看到死亡倒计时，时间结束后死亡；若目标在倒计时结束前因其他原因死亡，流血会解除。每次使用消耗一次可用次数。嗜血之魂不能发动破坏。 选项 击杀冷却 ：设置再次使用技能前的等待时间。 流血目标数量上限 ：设置可造成的流血次数。 死亡倒计时 ：设置目标流血后多久死亡。
search.en: Bloodmoon As an Impostor ghost role, uses the protection ability to make a target bleed; they die when the timer expires. Ability As an Impostor ghost role, the Bloodmoon uses its protection ability to make a target bleed. The target sees a death timer and dies when it expires; if the target dies from another cause first, the bleeding effect is removed. Each use consumes one available charge. The Bloodmoon cannot sabotage. Options Kill Cooldown : Time before the ability can be used again. Max BloodLettings : Maximum number of bleeding effects the Bloodmoon can apply. Time Until Death : Delay before an affected target dies.

summary.zh-CN: 完成任务后获得一次接触击杀机会；只分配给有任务的船员。
summary.en: Completing a task grants a contact kill; assigned only to Crewmates with tasks.

search.zh-CN: 嗜血者 完成任务后获得一次接触击杀机会；只分配给有任务的船员。 效果 嗜血者只分配给有任务的船员。每完成一个任务，下一名与其接触的玩家会死亡。该状态会跨越会议保留；击杀后会清除，直到再次完成任务才重新获得，而且多个状态不会叠加。 设置 Max（最大数量） ：本局中该附加身份可出现的数量上限。 Spawn Chance（生成概率） ：玩家获得此附加身份的概率。
search.en: Bloodthirst Completing a task grants a contact kill; assigned only to Crewmates with tasks. Effect Bloodthirst is assigned only to Crewmates with tasks. Completing a task causes the next player they come into contact with to die. The effect persists through meetings, clears after a kill until another task is completed, and does not stack. Settings Max : Maximum number that can appear in one match. Spawn Chance : Chance for a player to receive this add-on.

summary.zh-CN: 附近玩家即将被击杀时，保镖会替其挡下攻击并牺牲自己。
summary.en: When a nearby player is about to be killed, the Bodyguard prevents the attack and sacrifices themself.

search.zh-CN: 保镖 附近玩家即将被击杀时，保镖会替其挡下攻击并牺牲自己。 职业能力 如果附近玩家即将被击杀，保镖会代替目标挡下攻击，并与凶手同归于尽。保镖可以保护任何阵营；成为叛徒时，若凶手是内鬼，保镖不会触发保护。该技能不拦截任务大师、十字军、老兵或捕快的击杀互动。 设置 数量上限 ：设置一局中保镖的最大人数。 保护范围 ：设置目标必须距离保镖多近，保镖才能触发保护。
search.en: Bodyguard When a nearby player is about to be killed, the Bodyguard prevents the attack and sacrifices themself. Role If a player near the Bodyguard is about to be killed, the Bodyguard prevents the attack and dies with the murderer. The Bodyguard can protect players of any team. As a Madmate, the Bodyguard does not activate the skill against an Impostor. The protection does not intercept interactions from Taskinator, Crusader, Veteran, or Deputy. Settings Maximum count : Sets the maximum number of Bodyguards in a match. Protect radius : Sets how close the Bodyguard must be to the target to trigger the protection.

summary.zh-CN: 变形会引爆周围区域并使范围内玩家死亡；可设置自爆兵和其他内鬼是否能在爆炸中存活。
summary.en: Shapeshifting detonates an area bomb; settings determine whether the Bomber and other Impostors survive the blast.

search.zh-CN: 自爆兵 变形会引爆周围区域并使范围内玩家死亡；可设置自爆兵和其他内鬼是否能在爆炸中存活。 技能 变形会引爆周围区域，范围内玩家会收到击杀闪光。根据选项，自爆兵本人和其他内鬼可以在爆炸中存活，也可以被炸死。 选项 数量上限（Max） ：设置本局最多可有多少名自爆兵。 爆炸半径 ：设置炸弹范围；源文档说明约 5 倍范围相当于半个食堂。 可以普通击杀 ：开启时可按设置使用普通击杀，并可设置击杀冷却；关闭时只能通过炸弹击杀。 炸弹冷却 ：设置再次引爆前的等待时间。 内鬼在爆炸中存活 ：开启时其他内鬼不会被炸死；关闭时会死亡。 自爆兵在自己的爆炸中存活 ：开启时自爆兵不会被炸死；关闭时会死亡。
search.en: Bomber Shapeshifting detonates an area bomb; settings determine whether the Bomber and other Impostors survive the blast. Ability Shapeshifting detonates a bomb around the Bomber. Players receive a kill flash when the Bomber self-destructs. Settings determine whether the Bomber and other Impostors survive the explosion. Options Max : Maximum number of Bombers in a match. Bomb Radius : Blast radius; the source notes that a value of about 5x covers roughly half of Cafeteria. Can Kill : When enabled, the Bomber can also make normal kills, with a configurable kill cooldown; when disabled, it can kill only by bombing. Bomb Cooldown : Time before the Bomber can use another bomb. Impostors Survive Bombs : When enabled, other Impostors survive; when disabled, they die in the blast. Bomber Dies in Their Explosion : When enabled, the Bomber survives; when disabled, the Bomber dies.

summary.zh-CN: 击杀当前悬赏目标可缩短下一次击杀冷却，击杀其他人则会延长冷却；目标会定时更换。
summary.en: Killing the assigned target shortens the next kill cooldown; killing someone else lengthens it, and the target changes over time.

search.zh-CN: 赏金猎人 击杀当前悬赏目标可缩短下一次击杀冷却，击杀其他人则会延长冷却；目标会定时更换。 技能 赏金猎人会获得一名悬赏目标。限时内击杀该目标会缩短下一次击杀冷却；击杀其他玩家会延长冷却。目标会在设定时间后更换；每次会议结束后，目标更换倒计时会重新开始。 选项 数量上限（Max） ：设置本局最多可有多少名赏金猎人。 目标更换时间 ：设置悬赏目标保持多久后更换。 击杀悬赏目标后的冷却 ：设置成功击杀当前目标后的击杀冷却。 击杀其他玩家后的冷却 ：设置未击杀当前目标时的击杀冷却。 显示目标箭头 ：开启时显示指向目标的箭头；关闭时不显示。
search.en: Bounty Hunter Killing the assigned target shortens the next kill cooldown; killing someone else lengthens it, and the target changes over time. Ability The Bounty Hunter receives an assigned target. Killing that target before the deadline shortens the next kill cooldown; killing someone else lengthens it. The target changes after the configured time, and its change timer restarts after each meeting. Options Max : Maximum number of Bounty Hunters in a match. Time Until Target Swaps : How long the current target remains assigned. Kill Cooldown After Killing Bounty : Cooldown after killing the assigned target. Kill Cooldown After Killing Others : Cooldown after killing someone who is not the assigned target. Show Arrow Pointing Towards Target : When enabled, an arrow points to the target; otherwise no arrow appears.

summary.zh-CN: 符合条件的击杀者会在延迟后爆炸；通风口、死亡、会议、杀戮机器和变身的启示录中立角色可使效果失效。
summary.en: An eligible killer explodes after a delay; venting, death, meetings, KillingMachine, or an Apocalypse-transformed killer can prevent it.

search.zh-CN: 爆破者 符合条件的击杀者会在延迟后爆炸；通风口、死亡、会议、杀戮机器和变身的启示录中立角色可使效果失效。 效果 爆破者在会议外被非自杀击杀后，若击杀者存活且不是杀戮机器或变身的启示录中立角色，击杀者会在设定延迟后爆炸并收到通知。若倒计时结束时击杀者在通风口内、已死亡或会议已经开始，爆炸不会造成死亡。 设置 Max（最大数量） ：本局中该附加身份可出现的数量上限。 Spawn Chance（生成概率） ：玩家获得此附加身份的概率。 Eligibility（可分配阵营） ：主持人可分别设置内鬼、船员、中立者是否可以获得此附加身份。 Burst Kill Delay（爆炸延迟） ：击杀爆破者后、击杀者爆炸前的延迟时间。
search.en: Burst An eligible killer explodes after a delay; venting, death, meetings, KillingMachine, or an Apocalypse-transformed killer can prevent it. Effect When Burst is killed outside a meeting by a method other than suicide, a living killer other than KillingMachine or an Apocalypse-transformed player is notified and explodes after a configured delay. The explosion does not kill them if they are in a vent, already dead, or a meeting has started when the delay ends. Settings Max : Maximum number that can appear in one match. Spawn Chance : Chance for a player to receive this add-on. Eligibility : Separate settings control whether Impostors, Crewmates, Neutrals can receive this add-on. Burst Kill Delay : Time between killing Burst and the killer exploding.

summary.zh-CN: 击杀会产生多个尸体干扰报告判断；被击杀者会重复播放击杀动画，并且击杀复仇者会触发其群体复仇。
summary.en: Kills create multiple bodies that confuse reports; victims repeat the kill animation, and killing an Avenger triggers their group revenge.

search.zh-CN: 肢解者 击杀会产生多个尸体干扰报告判断；被击杀者会重复播放击杀动画，并且击杀复仇者会触发其群体复仇。 技能 肢解者的击杀（包括被动击杀）会在目标处留下多个尸体，使报告者难以判断实际死者。目标会反复播放被击杀动画；动画期间无法跳过，也不能正常参加会议，会议开始时会中止剩余动画。若肢解者击杀复仇者，复仇者会愤怒地报复所有人。 选项 数量上限（Max） ：设置本局最多可有多少名肢解者。
search.en: Butcher Kills create multiple bodies that confuse reports; victims repeat the kill animation, and killing an Avenger triggers their group revenge. Ability Butcher kills, including passive kills, create multiple dead bodies at the target, making it difficult to identify the actual victim when reporting. The victim repeatedly plays the kill animation; it cannot be skipped, and the victim cannot participate in a meeting normally during this period. A meeting stops the remaining animations. If the Butcher kills an Avenger, the Avenger takes revenge on everyone. Options Max : Maximum number of Butchers in a match.

summary.zh-CN: 变形使所有人变成外观相同的小黑人；解除变形、死亡或会议开始会结束伪装。
summary.en: Shapeshifts to make everyone look like the same small black bean; unshifting, dying, or a meeting ends the camouflage.

search.zh-CN: 隐蔽者 变形使所有人变成外观相同的小黑人；解除变形、死亡或会议开始会结束伪装。 技能 变形后，所有玩家都会显示为外观相同的小黑人。解除变形、隐蔽者死亡或会议开始都会结束伪装。通讯破坏时的伪装效果可以与该技能叠加。 选项 数量上限（Max） ：设置本局最多可有多少名隐蔽者。 伪装冷却 ：设置再次伪装前的等待时间。 伪装持续时间 ：设置伪装持续多久。 可以破坏通讯 ：开启时可发动通讯破坏；关闭时不能。 伪装期间禁止报告尸体 ：开启时伪装期间不能报告尸体；关闭时可以报告。 显示变形动画 ：开启时显示变形动画；关闭时不显示。
search.en: Camouflager Shapeshifts to make everyone look like the same small black bean; unshifting, dying, or a meeting ends the camouflage. Ability Shapeshifting makes all players appear as identical small black beans. The camouflage ends when the Camouflager unshifts or dies, or when a meeting starts. Comms sabotage camouflage can stack with this ability. Options Max : Maximum number of Camouflagers in a match. Camouflage Cooldown : Time before the ability can be used again. Camouflage Duration : How long the camouflage lasts. Can Use Comms Sabotage : When enabled, the Camouflager can sabotage comms; otherwise it cannot. Disable Body Reporting When Camouflage Is Active : When enabled, bodies cannot be reported during camouflage; otherwise they can. Show Shapeshift Animations : When enabled, shapeshift animations are shown; otherwise they are hidden.

summary.zh-CN: 舰长每完成任务可减慢一名随机非船员玩家，船员可能看到其标记；投票驱逐舰长会失去附加职业。
summary.en: Each completed task lets the Captain slow a random non-Crew player; Crewmates may see a marker, and voting the Captain out costs an add-on.

search.zh-CN: 舰长 舰长每完成任务可减慢一名随机非船员玩家，船员可能看到其标记；投票驱逐舰长会失去附加职业。 职业能力 舰长每完成一个任务，就会获得减慢一名随机非船员玩家的能力。根据设置，船员会在舰长名字旁看到星形标记。投票驱逐舰长的玩家会失去一个附加职业。 设置 数量上限 ：设置一局中舰长的最大人数。 船员可以发现舰长 ：开启时船员可发现舰长；关闭时不能。此项开启后，可另行设置叛徒是否也能发现舰长。 降低后的速度 ：设置目标受到减速后的速度。 减速持续时间 ：设置目标保持减速多久。 减速目标所需任务数 ：设置完成多少任务后可减慢随机非船员目标。 公开舰长所需任务数 ：设置完成多少任务后舰长会向船员公开身份。 可以选择友善中立/混乱中立/邪恶中立/带刀中立/灾厄中立 ：分别设置舰长能否选中对应中立职业类别。 自定义舰长任务 ：开启时可单独设置任务；关闭时舰长与其他玩家任务相同。自定义内容包括是否有公共任务，以及长任务、短任务数量。
search.en: Captain Each completed task lets the Captain slow a random non-Crew player; Crewmates may see a marker, and voting the Captain out costs an add-on. Role For each task completed, the Captain gains the ability to slow a random non-Crew player. Depending on settings, Crewmates see a star beside the Captain's name. A player who votes the Captain out loses an add-on. Settings Maximum count : Sets the maximum number of Captains in a match. Crewmates can find Captain : ON lets Crewmates identify the Captain; OFF does not. When enabled, a separate setting controls whether Madmates can also find the Captain. Reduced speed : Sets the speed of a targeted player while slowed. Reduced-speed duration : Sets how long the slowdown lasts. Tasks required before reducing a target's speed : Sets how many tasks the Captain must complete to slow a random non-Crew target. Tasks required before revealing the Captain : Sets how many tasks must be completed before the Captain is revealed to the Crew. Captain can target Neutral Benign / Neutral Chaos / Neutral Evil / Neutral Killing / Neutral Apocalypse : Each option controls whether the Captain may target that Neutral category. Override Captain tasks : ON allows a separate task setup; OFF gives the Captain the same tasks as everyone else. The custom setup includes common-task availability and the number of long and short tasks.

summary.zh-CN: 网红死亡时，船员会看到击杀闪光并在下次会议收到提示，内鬼与中立是否获知可分别设置。
summary.en: When the Celebrity dies, Crewmates see a kill flash and receive a notice at the next meeting; alerts to Impostors and Neutrals are configurable.

search.zh-CN: 网红 网红死亡时，船员会看到击杀闪光并在下次会议收到提示，内鬼与中立是否获知可分别设置。 职业能力 网红死亡时，所有船员都会看到击杀闪光，并在下一次会议收到提示。默认情况下，内鬼和中立阵营不会得知网红死亡；房主可分别设置他们是否能看到击杀闪光。 设置 数量上限 ：设置一局中网红的最大人数。 内鬼知道网红死亡 ：开启时内鬼能看到网红死亡时的击杀闪光；关闭时无法判断网红被击杀。 中立知道网红死亡 ：开启时中立阵营能看到击杀闪光；关闭时无法判断网红被击杀。
search.en: Celebrity When the Celebrity dies, Crewmates see a kill flash and receive a notice at the next meeting; alerts to Impostors and Neutrals are configurable. Role When the Celebrity dies, all Crewmates see the kill flash and receive a notice at the next meeting. Impostors and Neutrals do not normally learn of the death, but the host can separately allow each team to see the kill flash. Settings Maximum count : Sets the maximum number of Celebrities in a match. Impostors know when the Celebrity dies : ON lets Impostors see the kill flash; OFF prevents them from knowing the Celebrity was killed. Neutrals know when the Celebrity dies : ON lets Neutrals see the kill flash; OFF prevents them from knowing the Celebrity was killed.

summary.zh-CN: 变色龙可通过通风口暂时隐身，技能次数有限并可通过完成任务补充。
summary.en: The Chameleon can vent to become temporarily invisible, with limited uses replenished by completing tasks.

search.zh-CN: 变色龙 变色龙可通过通风口暂时隐身，技能次数有限并可通过完成任务补充。 职业能力 变色龙可以钻通风口暂时隐身。变色龙在自己的屏幕上仍然可见；再次钻通风口会暴露自己。技能有次数限制，完成任务可补充次数。 设置 数量上限 ：设置一局中变色龙的最大人数。 隐身冷却 ：设置再次隐身前的等待时间。 隐身持续时间 ：设置每次隐身可以维持多久。 初始技能次数 ：设置开局拥有的隐身次数。 每完成一个任务获得的技能次数 ：设置每完成一个任务增加的技能次数，按 0.1 为步进。
search.en: Chameleon The Chameleon can vent to become temporarily invisible, with limited uses replenished by completing tasks. Role The Chameleon can vent to become temporarily invisible. They remain visible on their own screen, and venting again reveals them. Uses are limited and can be replenished by completing tasks. Settings Maximum count : Sets the maximum number of Chameleons in a match. Disguise cooldown : Sets how long the Chameleon must wait before disguising again. Disguise duration : Sets how long each disguise can last. Initial ability uses : Sets how many disguises the Chameleon starts with. Ability uses gained per task : Sets the number of uses gained for each completed task, in 0.1 increments.

summary.zh-CN: 由魅魔转化获得；会按魅魔阵营的设置计入胜负，并与魅魔一同获胜。
summary.en: Converted by Cultist; its team count follows Cultist settings and it wins with the Cultist.

search.zh-CN: 魅魔小弟 由魅魔转化获得；会按魅魔阵营的设置计入胜负，并与魅魔一同获胜。 效果 魅魔可将符合条件的船员或内鬼转化为魅魔小弟；主持人可允许中立者被转化。魅魔小弟会随魅魔一同获胜。胜负人数可设置为不计人数、计入魅魔阵营或保持原阵营。魅魔小弟始终能识别魅魔； CultistKnowTargetRole 控制魅魔是否能识别魅魔小弟，而魅魔小弟之间互相识别需要同时启用 CultistKnowTargetRole 和 CultistTargetKnowOtherTarget 。此身份不会开局随机分配。 相关设置 Cultist_CharmedCountMode（Charmed 计入阵营） ：设置魅魔小弟玩家不计人数、计入魅魔阵营，或保留原阵营。 CultistCanCharmNeutral（中立者可被魅惑） ：控制魅魔能否转化中立者。 CultistKnowTargetRole / CultistTargetKnowOtherTarget（魅魔与 Charmed 互相识别） ：前者控制魅魔是否能识别魅魔小弟；后者控制魅魔小弟之间能否互相识别，且只有启用前者后才生效。 随机分配 ：不会开局随机分配；由上述赋予者能力转化获得。
search.en: Charmed Converted by Cultist; its team count follows Cultist settings and it wins with the Cultist. Effect Cultist can convert eligible Crewmates or Impostors into Charmed; the host can allow Neutrals to be converted. Charmed wins with Cultist. Its game-counting mode can be set to count as nobody, count as Cultist, or keep its original team. Charmed players always recognize Cultist. CultistKnowTargetRole controls whether Cultist recognizes Charmed players; Charmed players recognize one another only when both CultistKnowTargetRole and CultistTargetKnowOtherTarget are enabled. This identity is not randomly assigned at game start. Related settings Cultist_CharmedCountMode : Set Charmed players to count as nobody, as Cultist, or as their original team. CultistCanCharmNeutral : Whether Cultist can convert Neutral players. CultistKnowTargetRole / CultistTargetKnowOtherTarget : The first option controls whether Cultist recognizes Charmed players. The second controls whether Charmed players recognize one another, and only takes effect when the first option is enabled. Random assignment : Not assigned at random at game start; it is granted by the conversion ability described above.

summary.zh-CN: 时间自动充能；充满后下一次击杀启动屠杀模式，击杀冷却极短并消耗充能，会议会重置充能。
summary.en: Automatically charges over time; the next kill at full charge starts a short-cooldown massacre that drains charge, and meetings reset it.

search.zh-CN: 天文学家 时间自动充能；充满后下一次击杀启动屠杀模式，击杀冷却极短并消耗充能，会议会重置充能。 技能 击杀按钮会随时间自动充能。充满后，下一次击杀会启动屠杀模式；此时击杀冷却降至极短，并持续消耗充能。充能耗尽后屠杀结束。召开会议会清空充能并结束屠杀。 选项 数量上限（Max） ：设置本局最多可有多少名天文学家。 技能充能时间 ：设置充满击杀能量所需时间。 屠杀充能消耗间隔 ：设置屠杀时充能减少的频率；间隔越短，屠杀持续时间越短。 屠杀期间的视野 ：设置屠杀模式下的视野倍率。
search.en: Chronomancer Automatically charges over time; the next kill at full charge starts a short-cooldown massacre that drains charge, and meetings reset it. Ability The kill ability charges automatically over time. Once fully charged, the next kill starts Massacre mode: kill cooldown becomes extremely short while charge drains. Massacre ends when the charge is empty. Calling a meeting clears the charge and ends Massacre. Options Max : Maximum number of Chronomancers in a match. Ability Charge Time : Time needed to fully charge. Slaughter Decrease Time : Interval at which charge drains during Massacre; a shorter interval ends it sooner. Vision When in Slaughter : Vision multiplier during Massacre.

summary.zh-CN: 仅内鬼可获得，但无法使用通风口。
summary.en: Assigned only to Impostors, but removes their vent access.

search.zh-CN: 规避者 仅内鬼可获得，但无法使用通风口。 效果 规避者会失去使用通风口的能力，只分配给内鬼。 设置 Max（最大数量） ：本局中该附加身份可出现的数量上限。 Spawn Chance（生成概率） ：玩家获得此附加身份的概率。
search.en: Circumvent Assigned only to Impostors, but removes their vent access. Effect Circumvent loses access to the vent ability and is assigned only to Impostors. Settings Max : Maximum number that can appear in one match. Spawn Chance : Chance for a player to receive this add-on.

summary.zh-CN: 按报告键清理尸体；成功后尸体无法再被报告，并出现护盾动画作为提示。
summary.en: Uses the Report button to clean a body; cleaned bodies cannot be reported, and a shield animation confirms success.

search.zh-CN: 清理工 按报告键清理尸体；成功后尸体无法再被报告，并出现护盾动画作为提示。 技能 看到尸体时按报告键即可清理。清理成功会出现护盾动画提示；被清理的尸体无法再被报告。 选项 数量上限（Max） ：设置本局最多可有多少名清理工。 击杀冷却 ：设置击杀冷却。 清理后的击杀冷却 ：设置清理尸体后适用的击杀冷却。
search.en: Cleaner Uses the Report button to clean a body; cleaned bodies cannot be reported, and a shield animation confirms success. Ability Press the Report button when near a dead body to clean it. A shield animation confirms a successful cleanup. A cleaned body cannot be reported. Options Max : Maximum number of Cleaners in a match. Kill Cooldown : The Cleaner’s kill cooldown. Kill Cooldown on Clean : Kill cooldown applied after cleaning a body.

summary.zh-CN: 清洗者在会议后移除目标的所有附加身份，并留下干净标记。
summary.en: Cleanser removes all of a target's add-ons after the meeting and leaves the Cleansed marker.

search.zh-CN: 干净 清洗者在会议后移除目标的所有附加身份，并留下干净标记。 效果 清洗者可在会议中选择目标；会议结束后会移除目标的所有附加身份，并赋予干净标记。此标记不会独立随机分配。默认情况下，带有干净的玩家不能获得新的附加身份；清洗者设置 CleansedCanGetAddon 可允许其之后获得附加身份。 相关设置 CleansedCanGetAddon（Cleansed 玩家可获得附加身份） ：清洗者设置，控制干净玩家被清洗后能否获得新的附加身份。 随机分配 ：不会开局随机分配；由上述赋予者能力转化获得。
search.en: Cleansed Cleanser removes all of a target's add-ons after the meeting and leaves the Cleansed marker. Effect Cleanser can select a target during a meeting. After the meeting, all of that player's add-ons are removed and the Cleansed marker is applied. This marker is not randomly assigned. By default, a Cleansed player cannot receive new add-ons; Cleanser's CleansedCanGetAddon setting can allow them to receive add-ons afterward. Related settings CleansedCanGetAddon : Cleanser setting that controls whether Cleansed players can receive new add-ons after being cleansed. Random assignment : Not assigned at random at game start; it is granted by the conversion ability described above.

summary.zh-CN: 清洗者在会议中投票指定一名存活的其他玩家（不能是固执者），会议结束后移除其附加职业；被清洗者之后能否获得附加职业可设置。
summary.en: The Cleanser votes for another living player, except a Stubborn, to remove their add-ons after the meeting; whether they can receive add-ons afterward is configurable.

search.zh-CN: 清洗者 清洗者在会议中投票指定一名存活的其他玩家（不能是固执者），会议结束后移除其附加职业；被清洗者之后能否获得附加职业可设置。 职业能力 清洗者可在会议中投票给一名存活的其他玩家，以清除目标的附加职业；不能选择自己或固执者。清除在会议结束后生效。根据设置，被清洗的玩家之后可能无法再获得附加职业。 设置 数量上限 ：设置一局中清洗者的最大人数。 清洗次数上限 ：设置清洗者最多能清除附加职业的次数。 被清洗者仍可获得附加职业 ：开启时，被清洗者之后仍可获得附加职业；关闭时不能再获得。
search.en: Cleanser The Cleanser votes for another living player, except a Stubborn, to remove their add-ons after the meeting; whether they can receive add-ons afterward is configurable. Role During a meeting, the Cleanser can vote for another living player to erase that player's add-ons; the Cleanser cannot target themself or a Stubborn. The erasure takes effect after the meeting. Depending on settings, a cleansed player may be unable to receive add-ons afterward. Settings Maximum count : Sets the maximum number of Cleansers in a match. Maximum cleanses : Sets how many times the Cleanser can cleanse a target. Cleansed player can get add-ons : ON allows the cleansed player to receive add-ons afterward; OFF prevents it.

summary.zh-CN: 有概率击杀失败；失败时目标不受影响且击杀冷却重置。
summary.en: May miss a kill; a miss leaves the target unharmed and resets the cooldown.

search.zh-CN: 笨蛋 有概率击杀失败；失败时目标不受影响且击杀冷却重置。 效果 笨蛋有概率无法成功击杀目标。击杀落空时，目标不受影响，且笨蛋的击杀冷却会重置。它只分配给内鬼阵营角色。 设置 Max（最大数量） ：本局中该附加身份可出现的数量上限。 Spawn Chance（生成概率） ：玩家获得此附加身份的概率。 Chance to miss a kill（击杀落空概率） ：笨蛋击杀落空的概率。
search.en: Clumsy May miss a kill; a miss leaves the target unharmed and resets the cooldown. Effect Clumsy has a chance to miss a kill. On a miss, the target remains untouched and the cooldown resets. It is assigned only to Impostor-team roles. Settings Max : Maximum number that can appear in one match. Spawn Chance : Chance for a player to receive this add-on. Chance to miss a kill : Chance for Clumsy to miss a kill.

summary.zh-CN: 每次会议投给一名玩家并收集该玩家本次收到的票数；分数会跨会议累积，存活且达到门槛时获胜。
summary.en: Vote for a player each meeting and collect all votes cast for them; the score accumulates across meetings, and the Collector wins if alive at the threshold.

search.zh-CN: 集票者 每次会议投给一名玩家并收集该玩家本次收到的票数；分数会跨会议累积，存活且达到门槛时获胜。 集票者 集票者在会议中投给目标后，会收集该目标本次收到的所有票数（包括集票者投给该目标的票）。分数跨会议累积；达到设定分数且仍存活时，集票者获胜。 设置 人数上限 ：一局中可出现的集票者数量上限。 获胜所需票数 ：集票者需要收集的票数。
search.en: Collector Vote for a player each meeting and collect all votes cast for them; the score accumulates across meetings, and the Collector wins if alive at the threshold. Collector During each meeting, the Collector votes for a player and collects the total number of votes that player received, including the Collector's vote if they voted for that player. The score accumulates across meetings. Reach the configured number while still alive to win. Settings Maximum number: Maximum number of Collectors in a match. Votes required: Number of votes the Collector must collect to win.

summary.zh-CN: 单击击杀键查明目标职业，双击可击杀；查明次数用尽后击杀键恢复普通功能。
summary.en: Single-clicks the kill button to reveal a target role and double-clicks to kill; after reveals run out, the button works normally.

search.zh-CN: 军师 单击击杀键查明目标职业，双击可击杀；查明次数用尽后击杀键恢复普通功能。 技能 单击击杀键查明目标职业，双击则普通击杀。查明次数用尽后，击杀键只执行普通击杀。 选项 数量上限（Max） ：设置本局最多可有多少名军师。 击杀冷却 ：设置击杀冷却。 最大查明次数 ：设置本局最多可以查明职业的次数。
search.en: Consigliere Single-clicks the kill button to reveal a target role and double-clicks to kill; after reveals run out, the button works normally. Ability Single-click the kill button to reveal a target’s role; double-click to make a normal kill. Once the reveal uses are exhausted, the kill button functions normally. Options Max : Maximum number of Consiglieres in a match. Kill Cooldown : The Consigliere’s kill cooldown. Maximum Reveals : Maximum number of role reveals in a match.

summary.zh-CN: 病毒击杀后，报告该尸体的合格玩家会被转化为传染性，或按设置在会议后死亡。
summary.en: After Virus kills someone, an eligible reporter can become Contagious or die after the meeting, depending on settings.

search.zh-CN: 传染性 病毒击杀后，报告该尸体的合格玩家会被转化为传染性，或按设置在会议后死亡。 效果 病毒击杀的玩家尸体被报告时，符合条件的报告者会被转化为传染性，并与病毒一同获胜。若开启 VirusKillInfectedPlayerAfterMeeting ，报告者不会获得该身份，而是在会议后死亡。传染性在胜负人数计算中可设置为不计人数、计入病毒阵营或保留原阵营。此身份不会独立随机分配。 相关设置 VirusKillInfectedPlayerAfterMeeting（报告者会议后死亡） ：开启后，报告病毒击杀尸体的合格玩家会在会议后死亡，而非转化为传染性。 Virus_ContagiousCountMode（Contagious 计入阵营） ：设置传染性玩家不计人数、计入病毒阵营，或保留原阵营。 随机分配 ：不会开局随机分配；由上述赋予者能力转化获得。
search.en: Contagious After Virus kills someone, an eligible reporter can become Contagious or die after the meeting, depending on settings. Effect When a body killed by Virus is reported, an eligible reporter becomes Contagious and wins with Virus. If VirusKillInfectedPlayerAfterMeeting is enabled, the reporter does not receive this identity and instead dies after the meeting. For win-count checks, Contagious can count as nobody, as Virus, or as its original team. This identity is not independently assigned at random. Related settings VirusKillInfectedPlayerAfterMeeting : When enabled, an eligible reporter of a Virus victim dies after the meeting instead of becoming Contagious. Virus_ContagiousCountMode : Set Contagious players to count as nobody, as Virus, or as their original team. Random assignment : Not assigned at random at game start; it is granted by the conversion ability described above.

summary.zh-CN: 模仿者使用击杀按钮复制部分船员职业；复制的职业在会议结束后重置，且模仿者不能参与职业猜测。
summary.en: The Copycat uses the kill button to copy selected Crewmate roles; the copied role resets after meetings, and the Copycat cannot guess roles.

search.zh-CN: 模仿者 模仿者使用击杀按钮复制部分船员职业；复制的职业在会议结束后重置，且模仿者不能参与职业猜测。 职业能力 模仿者使用击杀按钮复制目标职业，但只能复制部分船员职业；部分内鬼或中立职业可按对应船员变体被复制。复制成功后获得该职业，会议结束后通常恢复为模仿者。若复制的目标拥有叛徒、魅惑、感染、跟班等阵营转换附加职业，可按设置一并复制。模仿者不能参与职业猜测。 设置 数量上限 ：设置一局中模仿者的最大人数。 复制冷却 ：设置再次复制职业前的等待时间。 可以复制邪恶职业的船员变体 ：开启时可将部分内鬼职业按其船员变体复制；关闭时不复制这些变体。 可以复制阵营转换附加职业 ：开启时可复制目标的叛徒、魅惑、感染、跟班、传染或无魂等阵营转换附加职业；关闭时不复制这些附加职业。
search.en: Copycat The Copycat uses the kill button to copy selected Crewmate roles; the copied role resets after meetings, and the Copycat cannot guess roles. Role The Copycat uses the kill button to copy a target's role, but only selected Crewmate roles are copyable. Some Impostor or Neutral roles can be copied as their Crewmate variants. The copied role usually resets to Copycat after a meeting. A setting can also copy team-changing add-ons such as Madmate, Charmed, Infected, Recruit, Contagious, or Soulless. The Copycat cannot guess roles. Settings Maximum count : Sets the maximum number of Copycats in a match. Copy cooldown : Sets how long the Copycat must wait before copying again. Can copy Crewmate variants of Evil roles : ON allows selected Impostor roles to be copied as Crewmate variants; OFF does not. Can copy team-changing add-ons : ON copies supported team-changing add-ons from the target; OFF leaves them behind.

summary.zh-CN: 验尸官不能正常报告尸体，尝试报告时会追踪凶手，并可选择查看尸体箭头及阻止被处理的尸体再次报告。
summary.en: The Coroner cannot report bodies normally and instead tracks the killer when attempting to report, with configurable body arrows and report blocking.

search.zh-CN: 验尸官 验尸官不能正常报告尸体，尝试报告时会追踪凶手，并可选择查看尸体箭头及阻止被处理的尸体再次报告。 职业能力 验尸官无法正常报告尸体。尝试报告时会看到指向凶手的箭头；召开会议后箭头消失。 设置 数量上限 ：设置一局中验尸官的最大人数。 显示指向尸体的箭头 ：开启时，验尸官会像入殓师一样看到指向尸体的箭头；关闭时不显示。 验尸官处理过的尸体无法报告 ：开启时，验尸官互动过的尸体不能再被报告；关闭时仍可报告。 初始技能次数 ：设置验尸官开局拥有的技能次数。 每完成一个任务获得的技能次数 ：设置每完成一个任务增加的技能次数，按 0.1 为步进。 通知凶手自己被跟踪 ：开启时，与验尸官追踪的尸体相关的凶手会收到被跟踪提示；关闭时不会收到提示。
search.en: Coroner The Coroner cannot report bodies normally and instead tracks the killer when attempting to report, with configurable body arrows and report blocking. Role The Coroner cannot report bodies normally. When attempting to report, they instead see an arrow pointing toward the killer; the arrow disappears when a meeting is called. Settings Maximum count : Sets the maximum number of Coroners in a match. Arrows pointing to dead bodies : ON gives the Coroner arrows toward dead bodies, like the Mortician; OFF hides those arrows. Bodies used by the Coroner cannot be reported : ON prevents a body the Coroner has interacted with from being reported; OFF leaves it reportable. Initial ability uses : Sets the Coroner's starting uses. Ability uses gained per task : Sets the uses gained for each completed task, in 0.1 increments. Inform the killer they are tracked : ON alerts the killer associated with a body the Coroner tracks; OFF sends no alert.

summary.zh-CN: 会议中以审判方式击杀；目标阵营、每场次数、每次会议次数和误判内鬼队伍的后果均可设置。
summary.en: Trials players during meetings; settings control target teams, per-game and per-meeting limits, and consequences for judging the Impostor team.

search.zh-CN: 邪恶法官 会议中以审判方式击杀；目标阵营、每场次数、每次会议次数和误判内鬼队伍的后果均可设置。 技能 会议中使用 /tl [玩家编号] 审判目标；编号显示在玩家名字前，也可用 /id 查看。审判会显示为法官审判，或按设置显示为邪恶法官击杀。每次会议和整局游戏都有独立次数上限。 审判内鬼或叛徒阵营是否允许由设置决定。若不允许且开启误判自杀，邪恶法官会因审判队友而死亡；否则命令会被拒绝。完成任务的告密者也可由单独选项控制是否能被审判。被招募的邪恶法官可自由审判内鬼队伍。 选项 数量上限（Max） ：设置本局最多可有多少名邪恶法官。 击杀冷却 ：设置击杀冷却。 每次会议审判次数上限 ：设置每次会议可审判的次数。 每场游戏最大审判次数 ：设置整局可审判的次数。 显示审判为邪恶法官击杀 ：选择审判结果是否标为邪恶法官击杀。 可以审判叛徒阵营／内鬼阵营 ：分别控制能否审判这两个阵营。 可以审判完成任务的告密者 ：开启时可审判已完成任务的告密者；关闭时不能。 误判内鬼阵营时自杀 ：开启时，不能审判内鬼队伍的邪恶法官会自杀；关闭时拒绝该审判。 尝试隐藏邪恶法官命令 ：开启时尝试隐藏 /tl 命令。
search.en: Councillor Trials players during meetings; settings control target teams, per-game and per-meeting limits, and consequences for judging the Impostor team. Ability During meetings, enter /tl [player ID] to trial a target. IDs appear before player names; /id lists them. Trials appear as Judge trials, or as Councillor kills depending on the setting. The Councillor has separate per-meeting and per-game limits. Settings determine whether the Councillor can trial Impostors or Madmates. If the relevant team cannot be targeted and suicide on a mistaken Impostor-team judgment is enabled, the Councillor dies; otherwise the command is rejected. A separate setting controls whether a Snitch who has completed all tasks can be trialed. A recruited Councillor can trial the Impostor team freely. Options Max : Maximum number of Councillors in a match. Kill Cooldown : Councillor kill cooldown. Maximum Kills per Meeting : Maximum trials in one meeting. Maximum Kills per Game : Maximum trials in one game. Show Trial as Councillor Murder : Choose whether the result is shown as a Councillor kill. Can Murder Madmates / Can Murder Impostors : Separately allow or forbid trials against these teams. Can Murder Snitch with All Tasks Done : When enabled, a task-complete Snitch can be trialed; otherwise it cannot. Suicide When Judging the Impostor Team Wrongly : When enabled, an otherwise disallowed trial of an Impostor teammate kills the Councillor; otherwise the trial is rejected. Try to Hide Councillor Commands : When enabled, the mod attempts to hide the /tl command.

summary.zh-CN: 船员的目标是找出并驱逐内鬼；船员阵营可通过消灭所有杀手或完成全部任务获胜。
summary.en: The Crewmate's goal is to find and eject the Impostors; the Crew wins by eliminating all killers or completing all tasks.

search.zh-CN: 船员（TOHE） 船员的目标是找出并驱逐内鬼；船员阵营可通过消灭所有杀手或完成全部任务获胜。 职业目标 船员的目标是找出并驱逐内鬼。船员阵营通过消灭所有杀手或完成全部任务获胜。 设置 数量与生成率 ：由 TOHE 的角色生成选项控制。
search.en: Crewmate (TOHE) The Crewmate's goal is to find and eject the Impostors; the Crew wins by eliminating all killers or completing all tasks. Role objective The Crewmate's goal is to find and eject the Impostors. The Crew wins by getting rid of all killers or by finishing all tasks. Settings Count and spawn chance : Controlled by the TOHE role-spawn options.

summary.zh-CN: 不能主动使用击杀键；完成任务达到设定间隔时，会杀死最近的合格玩家。
summary.en: Cannot use the kill button; completing tasks at the configured interval kills the nearest eligible player.

search.zh-CN: 船鬼 不能主动使用击杀键；完成任务达到设定间隔时，会杀死最近的合格玩家。 技能 船鬼不能主动使用击杀键。每完成设定数量的任务，就会击杀最近的一名合格目标。内鬼阵营玩家是否可成为目标由设置决定；幼年迷你船员、邪恶迷你船员和 Solsticer 不会成为目标。若目标为无法被击杀的天启角色，击杀不会成功；攻击瘟疫之源会反噬船鬼。击杀时可选择是否触发冲刺动作。 选项 数量上限（Max） ：设置本局最多可有多少名船鬼。 可以击杀内鬼 ：开启时可将内鬼阵营玩家作为目标；关闭时排除内鬼阵营。 知道内鬼 ：开启时船鬼知道内鬼身份；关闭时不知道。 内鬼知道船鬼 ：开启时内鬼知道船鬼身份；关闭时不知道。 击杀时冲刺 ：开启时击杀会触发冲刺；关闭时不会。 每次击杀所需任务数 ：设置完成多少个任务触发一次击杀。 覆盖船鬼任务分配 ：开启后可单独设置船鬼的任务；关闭时使用与其他玩家相同的任务分配。 分配公共任务 ：开启时船鬼会获得公共任务；关闭时不会。 长任务数量 ：设置船鬼获得的长任务数量。 短任务数量 ：设置船鬼获得的短任务数量。
search.en: Crewpostor Cannot use the kill button; completing tasks at the configured interval kills the nearest eligible player. Ability The Crewpostor cannot use the kill button directly. Every configured number of completed tasks causes it to kill the nearest eligible target. Settings control whether Impostor-team players are eligible. Nice Mini, Evil Mini, and Solsticer are excluded. A transformed Apocalypse target is immune; attacking Pestilence can reflect the kill back onto the Crewpostor. The role can lunge when a kill occurs. Options Max : Maximum number of Crewpostors in a match. Can Kill Impostors : When enabled, Impostor-team players can be targeted; otherwise they are excluded. Knows Impostors : When enabled, the Crewpostor knows who the Impostors are; otherwise it does not. Known to Impostors : When enabled, the Impostors know who the Crewpostor is; otherwise they do not. Crewpostor Lunges on Kill : When enabled, the kill triggers a lunge; otherwise it does not. Number of Tasks Completed to Make One Kill : Number of completed tasks required for a kill. Override Crewpostor Tasks : When enabled, the Crewpostor can receive separate task settings; otherwise it has the same assignment as other players. Crewpostor Has Common Tasks : When enabled, the Crewpostor receives Common Tasks; otherwise it does not. Amount of Long Tasks : Number of Long Tasks assigned to the Crewpostor. Amount of Short Tasks : Number of Short Tasks assigned to the Crewpostor.

summary.zh-CN: 十字军用击杀按钮为玩家施加保护；多数攻击者会被反击击杀，但任务执行者、保镖、老兵和捕快例外，瘟疫会反杀十字军。
summary.en: The Crusader uses the kill button to protect a player and usually kills attackers, with exceptions for Taskinator, Bodyguard, Veteran, and Deputy; Pestilence kills the Crusader instead.

search.zh-CN: 十字军 十字军用击杀按钮为玩家施加保护；多数攻击者会被反击击杀，但任务执行者、保镖、老兵和捕快例外，瘟疫会反杀十字军。 职业能力 十字军使用击杀按钮为一名玩家施加保护。多数攻击者会被十字军击杀；任务执行者、保镖、老兵和捕快不会触发这次反击。若攻击者是瘟疫，十字军会死亡，受保护的玩家则挡下攻击。 设置 数量上限 ：设置一局中十字军的最大人数。 十字军冷却 ：设置再次使用技能前的等待时间。 十字军次数上限 ：设置一局中十字军最多可以使用技能的次数。
search.en: Crusader The Crusader uses the kill button to protect a player and usually kills attackers, with exceptions for Taskinator, Bodyguard, Veteran, and Deputy; Pestilence kills the Crusader instead. Role The Crusader uses the kill button to protect a player. Most attackers are killed by the Crusader, but attacks by Taskinator, Bodyguard, Veteran, or Deputy do not trigger retaliation. If the attacker is Pestilence, the Crusader dies and the protected player blocks the attack. Settings Maximum count : Sets the maximum number of Crusaders in a match. Crusade cooldown : Sets how long the Crusader must wait before using the ability again. Maximum crusades : Sets how many times the Crusader can use the ability in one game.

summary.zh-CN: 用击杀按钮魅惑玩家，使其保留技能并加入魅魔阵营；内鬼消失且魅魔人数不少于船员时可按中立阵营胜利条件获胜。
summary.en: Charm players with the kill button; they keep their abilities and join the Cultist team. After Impostors are gone, Cultists can win at parity if no other counted Neutral team remains.

search.zh-CN: 魅魔 用击杀按钮魅惑玩家，使其保留技能并加入魅魔阵营；内鬼消失且魅魔人数不少于船员时可按中立阵营胜利条件获胜。 魅魔 内鬼阵营消失后，若魅魔是唯一存活的计数中立阵营，且魅魔人数不少于船员人数，魅魔即可获胜。魅魔可以使用击杀按钮魅惑非中立玩家；开启选项后也能魅惑可转换的中立玩家。被魅惑者保留原有技能，但会计入魅魔阵营，并失去原本的胜利条件。 设置 魅惑冷却 ：再次魅惑前的等待时间。 每次魅惑增加的冷却 ：每成功魅惑一人，冷却增加的时长。 魅惑次数上限 ：魅魔可魅惑玩家的次数。 知道被魅惑玩家职业 ：开启后可看到被魅惑玩家的职业。 被魅惑者互相认识 ：开启后，被魅惑者能看到彼此。 被魅惑者计入 ：设置被魅惑者计为无阵营、魅魔阵营或其原阵营。 可魅惑中立职业 ：开启后可以魅惑中立玩家；关闭后尝试魅惑中立玩家会收到无法魅惑的提示。
search.en: Cultist Charm players with the kill button; they keep their abilities and join the Cultist team. After Impostors are gone, Cultists can win at parity if no other counted Neutral team remains. Cultist After Impostors are gone, the Cultist wins when it is the only surviving counted Neutral team and its count is at least the Crewmate count. The Cultist can use the kill button to charm a non-Neutral player; an option also allows charming eligible Neutrals. Charmed players keep their abilities, but their count follows the selected Charmed Count Mode and they lose their original win conditions. Settings Charm cooldown: Time before charming another player. Cooldown increase per charm: Additional cooldown after each charm. Maximum charms: Number of players the Cultist can charm. Know charmed players' roles: Whether the Cultist sees the roles of charmed players. Charmed players know each other: Whether charmed players can see other charmed players. Charmed players count as: Choose Nothing, Cultist, or their original team. Neutral roles can be charmed: When enabled, Neutrals can be charmed; otherwise, attempting to charm one displays “This player cannot be Charmed.”

summary.zh-CN: 存活到普通游戏结束时有机会夺取主要胜利；无魂玩家按死亡参与胜利检查。
summary.en: A living Cursed Soul can take the primary win at a normal game end; Soulless players count as dead for win checks.

search.zh-CN: 诅咒之人 存活到普通游戏结束时有机会夺取主要胜利；无魂玩家按死亡参与胜利检查。 诅咒之人 存活的诅咒之人可以在普通游戏结束时夺取主要胜利，包括原本属于小丑或处刑人的胜利；若诅咒之人已被转换，则胜利会按转换后的阵营结算。其他职业的胜利效果也可能影响最终结果。诅咒之人使用击杀按钮夺取目标的灵魂；无魂玩家在计算胜利条件时计为死亡。诅咒之人获胜时，无魂玩家会与其一同获胜。若船员、内鬼或灾厄阵营获胜，游戏结束处理也会把无魂玩家列入胜者。 设置 夺魂冷却 ：再次夺取灵魂前的等待时间。 每次夺魂增加的冷却 ：每次使用能力后，冷却增加的时长。 夺魂次数上限 ：整局可使用能力的最大次数。 知道无魂玩家的职业 ：当前源码中的职业显示逻辑没有读取此设置，诅咒之人可以查看无魂玩家的职业。 中立职业有灵魂 ：开启后可对中立玩家使用能力；关闭后无法对中立玩家夺魂。已有无魂、仰慕者和忠诚者的玩家，以及未满 18 岁的小不点不能被夺魂。
search.en: Cursed Soul A living Cursed Soul can take the primary win at a normal game end; Soulless players count as dead for win checks. Cursed Soul At a normal game end, a living Cursed Soul can take the primary win, including an ending that would otherwise belong to a Jester or Executioner. If the Cursed Soul has been converted, the end handler redirects the win to that converted team. Other roles' win effects can also affect the final result. The Cursed Soul uses the kill button to take a target's soul; Soulless players count as dead for parity checks. They win with a Cursed Soul, Crewmate, Impostor, or Apocalypse victory under the shared end handler. Settings Soul snatch cooldown: Time before taking another soul. Cooldown increase per snatch: Additional cooldown after each use. Maximum soul snatches: Maximum number of ability uses in a game. Know roles of soulless players: The current role-display logic does not read this setting; the Cursed Soul can see Soulless players' roles. Neutral roles have souls: When enabled, the ability can target Neutrals. Existing Soulless, Admired, and Loyal players, as well as Minis under age 18, cannot be targeted.

summary.zh-CN: 受到攻击时会消耗一次反击次数并阻止击杀；按设置可诅咒杀死攻击者。
summary.en: When attacked, spends a counter and blocks the kill; a setting determines whether the attacker is also killed by the curse.

search.zh-CN: 呪狼 受到攻击时会消耗一次反击次数并阻止击杀；按设置可诅咒杀死攻击者。 技能 受到攻击时，呪狼会消耗一次反击次数并阻止这次击杀。根据选项，呪狼还会诅咒并杀死攻击者；次数耗尽后不再能反击。 选项 数量上限（Max） ：设置本局最多可有多少只呪狼。 反击次数上限 ：设置可阻止攻击的次数。 剩余技能次数时击杀攻击者 ：开启时，反击会诅咒并杀死攻击者；关闭时只阻止攻击。
search.en: Cursed Wolf When attacked, spends a counter and blocks the kill; a setting determines whether the attacker is also killed by the curse. Ability When attacked, the Cursed Wolf spends one counter and blocks the kill. Depending on the setting, it also curses and kills the attacker. It cannot counter after its uses are depleted. Options Max : Maximum number of Cursed Wolves in a match. Amount of Cursed Shields : Number of attacks the Cursed Wolf can block. Kill Attacker When Ability Is Remaining : When enabled, a counter also kills the attacker; when disabled, it only blocks the attack.

summary.zh-CN: 附近有其他存活玩家时无法被击杀；死亡消息和身份标记可按设置公开。
summary.en: Cannot be killed while another player is nearby; death alerts and public identification are configurable.

search.zh-CN: 网络员 附近有其他存活玩家时无法被击杀；死亡消息和身份标记可按设置公开。 效果 网络员周围 2 个游戏单位内若有另一名存活玩家（不包括击杀者和网络员自己），则不能被击杀。网络员死亡时可向内鬼、船员和中立者分别发送提示；也可设置是否在名字旁公开显示星标。 设置 Max（最大数量） ：本局中该附加身份可出现的数量上限。 Spawn Chance（生成概率） ：玩家获得此附加身份的概率。 Eligibility（可分配阵营） ：主持人可分别设置内鬼、船员、中立者是否可以获得此附加身份。 ImpKnowCyberDead（内鬼得知 Cyber 死亡） ：控制网络员死亡时是否通知内鬼。 CrewKnowCyberDead（船员得知 Cyber 死亡） ：控制网络员死亡时是否通知船员。 NeutralKnowCyberDead（中立者得知 Cyber 死亡） ：控制网络员死亡时是否通知中立者。 CyberKnown（公开 Cyber 身份） ：控制是否向所有人公开显示网络员名字旁的星标。
search.en: Cyber Cannot be killed while another player is nearby; death alerts and public identification are configurable. Effect Cyber cannot be killed if another living player is within 2 game units, excluding the attacker and Cyber. When Cyber dies, the host can separately notify Impostors, Crewmates, and Neutrals. A separate setting controls whether a star publicly identifies Cyber by name. Settings Max : Maximum number that can appear in one match. Spawn Chance : Chance for a player to receive this add-on. Eligibility : Separate settings control whether Impostors, Crewmates, Neutrals can receive this add-on. ImpKnowCyberDead : Whether Impostors receive a death alert when Cyber dies. CrewKnowCyberDead : Whether Crewmates receive a death alert when Cyber dies. NeutralKnowCyberDead : Whether Neutrals receive a death alert when Cyber dies. CyberKnown : Whether a star appears next to Cyber's name for everyone.

summary.zh-CN: 变形降低目标视野；是否在眩晕者死亡或被放逐后恢复，由设置决定。
summary.en: Shapeshifts to reduce a target's vision; a setting controls whether the effect ends when the Dazzler dies or is ejected.

search.zh-CN: 眩晕者 变形降低目标视野；是否在眩晕者死亡或被放逐后恢复，由设置决定。 技能 变形到玩家身上会降低其视野。是否在眩晕者死亡或被放逐后恢复受影响玩家的视野，由选项控制。 选项 数量上限（Max） ：设置本局最多可有多少名眩晕者。 击杀冷却 ：设置击杀冷却。 眩晕冷却 ：设置再次降低视野前的等待时间。 视野降低量 ：设置目标视野倍率。 受影响人数上限 ：设置可同时降低视野的玩家数。 死亡／出局时恢复视野 ：开启时，眩晕者死亡或被放逐后恢复目标视野；关闭时效果仍保留。 显示变形动画 ：开启时显示变形动画；关闭时不显示。
search.en: Dazzler Shapeshifts to reduce a target's vision; a setting controls whether the effect ends when the Dazzler dies or is ejected. Ability Shapeshifting into a player reduces that player’s vision. A setting controls whether affected players return to normal vision when the Dazzler dies or is ejected. Options Max : Maximum number of Dazzlers in a match. Kill Cooldown : Dazzler kill cooldown. Dazzle Cooldown : Time before reducing vision again. Reduced Vision : Vision multiplier applied to the target. Max Number of Players Affected : Maximum number of players affected at once. Reset Vision of Dazzled Players on Death/Eject : When enabled, targets regain normal vision if the Dazzler dies or is ejected; otherwise the effect remains. Show Shapeshift Animations : When enabled, shapeshift animations are shown; otherwise they are hidden.

summary.zh-CN: 灵魂收集者收集足够灵魂后转变为死亡；若未在下一次会议中被投出，死亡会在会议结算时杀死非灾厄玩家。
summary.en: The Soul Collector transforms into Death after collecting enough souls; if not voted out at the next meeting, Death kills non-Apocalypse players when the meeting resolves.

search.zh-CN: 死亡 灵魂收集者收集足够灵魂后转变为死亡；若未在下一次会议中被投出，死亡会在会议结算时杀死非灾厄玩家。 死亡 灵魂收集者可以用击杀按钮标记一名玩家；若目标死亡，灵魂收集者获得一个灵魂。开启被动灵魂后，每次报告尸体也会获得一个灵魂。达到设置数量后，灵魂收集者转变为死亡。 若死亡未在转变后的下一次会议中被投出，它会在会议结算时安排所有存活的非灾厄玩家死亡；其他灾厄成员不受影响。死亡阵营按灾厄阵营的胜利条件结算。 死亡无敌。死亡存活期间，每次会议都会向所有玩家公布其存在；会议时间设置也会延长死亡存活期间的会议投票时间。 设置 转变为死亡所需灵魂数 ：达到此数量后，灵魂收集者转变为死亡。 被动获得灵魂 ：开启后，每次报告尸体都会获得一个灵魂。 灵魂收集者可使用通风口 ：设置灵魂收集者和死亡能否使用通风口。 死亡会议时间增加 ：死亡存活期间，每次会议增加的投票时间。
search.en: Death The Soul Collector transforms into Death after collecting enough souls; if not voted out at the next meeting, Death kills non-Apocalypse players when the meeting resolves. Death The Soul Collector can use the kill button to mark one target and gains a soul if that target dies. When passive souls are enabled, each reported body also grants a soul. Reaching the configured threshold transforms the Soul Collector into Death. If Death is not voted out at the next meeting, it schedules every living non-Apocalypse player to die when that meeting resolves; other Apocalypse members are unaffected. Death wins through the Apocalypse team's win condition. Death is invincible. Their presence is announced to everyone at every meeting while they are alive. The meeting-time option adds voting time to each meeting while Death is alive. Settings Souls required to transform: Number of souls needed for the Soul Collector to become Death. Gain passive souls: When enabled, each reported body grants a soul. Soul Collector can vent: Whether the Soul Collector and Death can use vents. Death meeting time increase: Additional voting time at each meeting while Death is alive.

summary.zh-CN: 变形标记玩家；达到人数后必须在限时内会合，否则契约玩家死亡，会议也可按设置触发死亡。
summary.en: Shapeshifts to mark players; once the pact is complete they must meet before the deadline or die, and meetings can trigger deaths by setting.

search.zh-CN: 死亡契约 变形标记玩家；达到人数后必须在限时内会合，否则契约玩家死亡，会议也可按设置触发死亡。 技能 变形标记目标进入死亡契约。达到设定人数后，契约玩家必须在时限内彼此靠近；若到期仍未会合，他们都会死亡。任何契约玩家在完成前死亡或断线都会使契约撤销。会议开始会解除所有当前契约，也可按设置杀死契约成员。契约成立期间，玩家可按设置获知其他契约成员并受到视野限制。 选项 数量上限（Max） ：设置本局最多可有多少名死亡契约者。 击杀冷却 ：设置击杀冷却。 契约分配冷却 ：设置再次变形标记前的等待时间。 契约持续时间 ：设置玩家完成会合前的时限。 契约所需人数 ：设置组成契约的玩家数量。 显示契约玩家箭头 ：开启时显示指向其他契约玩家的箭头。 降低契约玩家视野 ：开启时降低契约玩家视野，并可设置视野倍率；关闭时不降低。 会议开始时杀死契约玩家 ：开启时，会议开始会杀死当前契约玩家；关闭时会议只会解除契约。 契约玩家可以召开会议 ：开启时契约玩家可以报告尸体或召开会议；关闭时禁止这些操作。 显示变形动画 ：开启时显示变形动画；关闭时不显示。
search.en: Deathpact Shapeshifts to mark players; once the pact is complete they must meet before the deadline or die, and meetings can trigger deaths by setting. Ability Shapeshifting marks a target for a death pact. Once the configured number of players are marked, they must meet within the time limit. All pact members die if they fail to meet before it expires. If any member dies or disconnects before the pact is completed, it is cancelled. A meeting clears active pacts and can kill their members depending on the setting. Pact members can receive arrows to each other and have reduced vision according to the settings. Options Max : Maximum number of Deathpact roles in a match. Kill Cooldown : Kill cooldown. Death Pact Assign Cooldown : Time before another target can be marked.
