Death Pact Duration : Time allowed for pact members to meet. Number of Players in Death Pact : Number of players required to form a pact. Show Arrows to Other Players in Death Pact : When enabled, arrows point to other pact members. Reduce Vision for Players in Death Pact : When enabled, pact members have reduced vision, with a configurable multiplier. Kill Players in Death Pact on Meeting : When enabled, starting a meeting kills members of an active pact; otherwise the pact is only cleared. Players in Active Death Pact Can Call Meeting : When enabled, pact members can report or call a meeting; otherwise they cannot. Show Shapeshift Animations : When enabled, shapeshift animations are shown; otherwise they are hidden.

summary.zh-CN: 赝品商用击杀按钮把赝品交给玩家；没有击杀能力的目标会在会议后自杀，有击杀能力者则会在尝试击杀时自杀。
summary.en: The Deceiver passes a counterfeit with the kill button; a non-killer dies after the meeting, while a killer dies after attempting a kill.

search.zh-CN: 赝品商 赝品商用击杀按钮把赝品交给玩家；没有击杀能力的目标会在会议后自杀，有击杀能力者则会在尝试击杀时自杀。 职业能力 赝品商可以通过击杀按钮把赝品交给其他玩家。没有击杀能力的玩家收到赝品后会在会议结束后自杀；有击杀能力的玩家会在尝试击杀他人后自杀。 设置 数量上限 ：设置一局中赝品商的最大人数。 技能冷却 ：设置再次交出赝品前的等待时间。 使用次数上限 ：设置赝品商可以交出赝品的次数。 欺骗没有击杀按钮的玩家后失去技能 ：开启时，向没有击杀按钮的玩家交出赝品后会失去技能；关闭时仍保留技能。
search.en: Deceiver The Deceiver passes a counterfeit with the kill button; a non-killer dies after the meeting, while a killer dies after attempting a kill. Role The Deceiver can pass a counterfeit to another player through the kill button. A recipient without a kill button dies after the meeting. A recipient with a kill button dies after attempting to kill someone. Settings Maximum count : Sets the maximum number of Deceivers in a match. Ability cooldown : Sets how long the Deceiver must wait before passing another counterfeit. Maximum uses : Sets how many counterfeits the Deceiver can pass. Lose ability after deceiving a player without a kill button : ON removes the Deceiver's ability after targeting someone without a kill button; OFF does not.

summary.zh-CN: 以生命值互相消耗进行攻击；内鬼消失后，若玩家阵营是唯一存活的计数中立阵营且人数不少于船员，即可获胜。
summary.en: Drain health to attack and defend; after Impostors are gone, the Demon wins when it is the only surviving counted Neutral team and at least as numerous as Crew.

search.zh-CN: 玩家 以生命值互相消耗进行攻击；内鬼消失后，若玩家阵营是唯一存活的计数中立阵营且人数不少于船员，即可获胜。 玩家（Demon） 内鬼阵营消失后，若玩家（Demon）是唯一存活的计数中立阵营，且其人数不少于船员人数，玩家阵营即可获胜。玩家视角下，所有玩家名字旁都会显示当前/最大生命值。每次攻击都会消耗目标生命值，生命值归零后目标才会死亡；攻击玩家则会消耗玩家自身生命值。若攻击未能耗尽玩家的生命值，攻击者会看到护盾动画。 设置 攻击冷却 ：再次攻击前的等待时间。 可使用通风口 ：设置玩家能否使用通风口。 内鬼视野 ：设置玩家是否拥有内鬼视野。 玩家最大生命值 ：其他玩家的最大生命值。 攻击伤害 ：每次攻击造成的伤害。 玩家最大生命值（自身） ：该项固定为 100 点。 受到的伤害 ：他人试图击杀该角色时造成的生命值损失。
search.en: Demon Drain health to attack and defend; after Impostors are gone, the Demon wins when it is the only surviving counted Neutral team and at least as numerous as Crew. Demon After Impostors are gone, the Demon wins when it is the only surviving counted Neutral team and is at least as numerous as Crew. The Demon sees current/max health beside each player's name. Each attack drains the target's health; a target dies only when their health reaches zero. Attacks against a Demon drain the Demon's own health. If an attack does not deplete that health, the attacker sees a shield animation. Settings Attack cooldown: Time between attacks. Can vent: Whether the Demon can use vents. Impostor vision: Whether the Demon has Impostor vision. Player maximum health: Maximum health of other players. Damage: Damage dealt per attack. Demon maximum health: Fixed at 100 health. Demon damage received: Health the Demon loses when someone tries to kill them.

summary.zh-CN: 捕快用击杀按钮给有效目标戴上手铐并消耗一次技能次数；目标不需要有击杀按钮。
summary.en: The Deputy uses the kill button to handcuff a valid target and spend one use; the target does not need a kill button.

search.zh-CN: 捕快 捕快用击杀按钮给有效目标戴上手铐并消耗一次技能次数；目标不需要有击杀按钮。 职业能力 捕快对有效目标使用击杀按钮会为其戴上手铐并重置目标的击杀冷却，且消耗一次技能次数；目标不需要有击杀按钮。捕快不能以自己为目标，且无法铐住连续杀手。 设置 数量上限 ：设置一局中捕快的最大人数。 手铐冷却 ：设置捕快再次使用技能前的等待时间。 被铐玩家的击杀冷却 ：设置捕快互动后，被铐玩家所具有的击杀冷却时间。 手铐次数上限 ：设置捕快可使用的最大技能次数。
search.en: Deputy The Deputy uses the kill button to handcuff a valid target and spend one use; the target does not need a kill button. Role When the Deputy uses the kill button on a valid target, they handcuff that target and reset the target's kill cooldown, spending one use. The target does not need a kill button. The Deputy cannot target themself or a Serial Killer. Settings Maximum count : Sets the maximum number of Deputies in a match. Handcuff cooldown : Sets how long the Deputy must wait before using the ability again. Kill cooldown for handcuffed player : Sets the kill cooldown a handcuffed player has after the Deputy interacts with them. Maximum handcuffs : Sets the maximum number of ability uses the Deputy has.

summary.zh-CN: 侦探报告尸体后会收到被害者职业的线索，并可按设置获知凶手职业。
summary.en: After reporting a body, the Detective learns the victim's role and can also learn the killer's role when enabled.

search.zh-CN: 侦探 侦探报告尸体后会收到被害者职业的线索，并可按设置获知凶手职业。 职业能力 侦探报告尸体后会收到线索，得知死者的职业；根据设置，也可能得知凶手的职业。侦探不会成为 Oblivious。 设置 数量上限 ：设置一局中侦探的最大人数。 可以查出凶手职业 ：开启时，侦探可得知其报告的尸体对应凶手的职业；关闭时无法得知凶手的确切职业。
search.en: Detective After reporting a body, the Detective learns the victim's role and can also learn the killer's role when enabled. Role After reporting a body, the Detective receives a clue identifying the dead player's role and may learn the killer's role, depending on settings. The Detective cannot become Oblivious. Settings Maximum count : Sets the maximum number of Detectives in a match. Can find the killer's role : ON lets the Detective learn the role of the killer associated with a reported body; OFF withholds the killer's exact role.

summary.zh-CN: 原版侦探可调查线索，房主可以设置嫌疑人数上限；这是独立于模组自定义侦探的角色。
summary.en: The native Detective investigates clues with a configurable suspect limit and is separate from the custom Detective role.

search.zh-CN: 侦探（原版） 原版侦探可调查线索，房主可以设置嫌疑人数上限；这是独立于模组自定义侦探的角色。 职业能力 侦探（原版）使用游戏原生侦探技能调查线索，与模组自定义的侦探职业不同。 设置 数量与生成率 ：由 TOHE 的角色生成选项控制。 嫌疑人数上限 ：设置原版侦探技能可涉及的嫌疑人数上限。
search.en: Detective (Vanilla) The native Detective investigates clues with a configurable suspect limit and is separate from the custom Detective role. Role The native Detective uses the game's Detective ability to investigate clues. It is separate from the mod's custom Detective role. Settings Count and spawn chance : Controlled by the TOHE role-spawn options. Suspect limit : Sets the maximum number of suspects for the native Detective ability.

summary.zh-CN: 变形永久改变目标外观并按改变人数缩短击杀冷却；吞噬者死亡或出局后外观恢复。
summary.en: Shapeshifts to permanently change target appearances and reduce kill cooldown per changed player; effects revert if the Devourer dies or is ejected.

search.zh-CN: 吞噬者 变形永久改变目标外观并按改变人数缩短击杀冷却；吞噬者死亡或出局后外观恢复。 技能 变形会永久改变目标外观；每改变一名玩家都会缩短击杀冷却。吞噬者死亡或被放逐后，受影响玩家恢复原本外观。 选项 数量上限（Max） ：设置本局最多可有多少名吞噬者。 初始击杀冷却 ：设置初始击杀冷却。 每次吞噬减少的击杀冷却 ：设置每改变一名玩家外观后减少的冷却。 最低击杀冷却 ：设置击杀冷却的最低值。 吞噬冷却 ：设置再次改变外观前的等待时间。 隐藏被吞噬玩家名字 ：开启时隐藏受影响玩家名字；关闭时显示。 显示变形动画 ：开启时显示变形动画；关闭时不显示。
search.en: Devourer Shapeshifts to permanently change target appearances and reduce kill cooldown per changed player; effects revert if the Devourer dies or is ejected. Ability Shapeshifting permanently changes the target’s appearance. Each player whose appearance is changed reduces the kill cooldown. Affected players return to normal appearance if the Devourer dies or is ejected. Options Max : Maximum number of Devourers in a match. Starting Kill Cooldown : Initial kill cooldown. Reduce Kill Cooldown By : Cooldown reduction for each changed player. Minimum Kill Cooldown : Lowest possible kill cooldown. Devour Cooldown : Time before changing another player’s appearance. Hide the Names of Consumed Players : When enabled, affected players’ names are hidden; otherwise they remain visible. Show Shapeshift Animations : When enabled, shapeshift animations are shown; otherwise they are hidden.

summary.zh-CN: 独裁者投票后会立即结束会议并驱逐所投玩家，之后独裁者会自杀。
summary.en: When the Dictator votes, the meeting immediately ends and ejects that player; the Dictator then dies.

search.zh-CN: 独裁者 独裁者投票后会立即结束会议并驱逐所投玩家，之后独裁者会自杀。 职业能力 独裁者投票给一名玩家后，会议会忽略其他所有人的票并立即结束，将独裁者投票的目标驱逐。会议结束时独裁者会自杀。 设置 数量上限 ：设置一局中独裁者的最大人数。
search.en: Dictator When the Dictator votes, the meeting immediately ends and ejects that player; the Dictator then dies. Role When the Dictator votes for someone, the meeting ignores everyone else's votes and ends immediately, ejecting the Dictator's target. The Dictator dies as the meeting ends. Settings Maximum count : Sets the maximum number of Dictators in a match.

summary.zh-CN: 有人尝试对其使用击杀按钮时，对方的击杀冷却会延长。
summary.en: When someone tries to kill it, that player's kill cooldown is increased.

search.zh-CN: 患病者 有人尝试对其使用击杀按钮时，对方的击杀冷却会延长。 效果 当其他玩家尝试对患病者使用击杀按钮时，攻击者的击杀冷却会延长一段由主持人设置的时间。 设置 Max（最大数量） ：本局中该附加身份可出现的数量上限。 Spawn Chance（生成概率） ：玩家获得此附加身份的概率。 Eligibility（可分配阵营） ：主持人可分别设置内鬼、船员、中立者是否可以获得此附加身份。 Increase the cooldown by（冷却延长时间） ：攻击者的冷却延长时长。 Cooldown returns to normal after a meeting（会议后冷却恢复正常） ：控制会议结束后攻击者的冷却是否恢复正常。
search.en: Diseased When someone tries to kill it, that player's kill cooldown is increased. Effect When someone tries to use a kill button on Diseased, that player's kill cooldown is increased by a configurable amount. Settings Max : Maximum number that can appear in one match. Spawn Chance : Chance for a player to receive this add-on. Eligibility : Separate settings control whether Impostors, Crewmates, Neutrals can receive this add-on. Increase the cooldown by : Amount by which the killer's cooldown is increased. Cooldown returns to normal after a meeting : Whether the killer's cooldown returns to normal after a meeting.

summary.zh-CN: 使用幽灵技能将所有存活且可传送的玩家随机传送到通风口。
summary.en: Uses its Phantom ability to teleport all living players who can be teleported to random vents.

search.zh-CN: 分散者 使用幽灵技能将所有存活且可传送的玩家随机传送到通风口。 技能 使用幽灵技能后，会尝试把所有存活且可传送的玩家传送到随机通风口；当时无法传送的玩家会被跳过。 选项 数量上限（Max） ：设置本局最多可有多少名分散者。 变形冷却 ：设置再次发动能力前的等待时间。 变形持续时间 ：设置变形持续时间。
search.en: Disperser Uses its Phantom ability to teleport all living players who can be teleported to random vents. Ability Using the Phantom ability attempts to send every living player who can be teleported to a random vent. Players who cannot be teleported at that moment are skipped. Options Max : Maximum number of Dispersers in a match. Shapeshift Cooldown : Time before the ability can be used again. Shapeshift Duration : Duration of the shapeshift.

summary.zh-CN: 法医可以查看所有玩家的死亡原因，并使用便携生命监测仪；是否公开其身份可设置。
summary.en: The Doctor can inspect causes of death and use portable Vitals, with an option to reveal the Doctor's identity to everyone.

search.zh-CN: 法医 法医可以查看所有玩家的死亡原因，并使用便携生命监测仪；是否公开其身份可设置。 职业能力 法医可以查看所有玩家的死亡原因，并像科学家一样使用便携生命监测仪。 设置 数量上限 ：设置一局中法医的最大人数。 电池续航时间 ：设置法医每次打开生命监测仪可查看多久。 所有人都知道法医身份 ：开启时公开法医身份；关闭时不公开。
search.en: Doctor The Doctor can inspect causes of death and use portable Vitals, with an option to reveal the Doctor's identity to everyone. Role The Doctor can see the cause of death for all players and use portable Vitals like a Scientist. Settings Maximum count : Sets the maximum number of Doctors in a match. Battery duration : Sets how long the Doctor can keep Vitals open. Everyone knows who the Doctor is : ON reveals the Doctor; OFF keeps their role secret.

summary.zh-CN: 通过变形附身非内鬼玩家并操纵其行动；可设置本体是否能击杀以及解除附身时是否杀死目标。
summary.en: Shapeshifts to possess and control a non-Impostor; settings control main-body kills and whether the target dies when possession ends.

search.zh-CN: 玩偶师 通过变形附身非内鬼玩家并操纵其行动；可设置本体是否能击杀以及解除附身时是否杀死目标。 技能 使用变形附身一名可传送的非内鬼目标，暂时操纵其执行玩偶师的行动；附身会交换双方位置和外观。再次变形可解除附身并交换回位置。被附身目标不能自行报告尸体或召开会议；玩偶师可将这些操作转交给目标。会议开始会解除附身。若目标不在可传送状态（例如死亡、处于通风口或被吞），附身不会完成。 选项 击杀冷却 ：设置普通击杀冷却。 附身冷却 ：设置再次附身前的等待时间。 附身持续时间 ：设置附身效果持续多久。 本体可以击杀 ：开启时即使未附身也可击杀；关闭时只有附身期间可击杀。 解除附身后目标死亡 ：开启时解除附身会杀死目标；关闭时目标存活。
search.en: Dollmaster Shapeshifts to possess and control a non-Impostor; settings control main-body kills and whether the target dies when possession ends. Ability Shapeshift to possess a teleportable non-Impostor and control them to carry out the Dollmaster’s actions. Possession swaps the Dollmaster and target’s positions and appearances. Shapeshifting again ends the possession and swaps them back. The possessed player cannot report bodies or call meetings independently; the Dollmaster can redirect those actions through the target. A meeting ends the possession. Possession cannot complete if either player is in a state that prevents teleportation, such as being dead, vented, or swallowed. Options Kill Cooldown : Time before the Dollmaster can kill again. Possession Cooldown : Time before possessing another player. Possession Duration : How long possession lasts. Can Kill as the Main Body : When enabled, the Dollmaster can kill without possessing a player; when disabled, it can kill only while possessing. Target Dies After Possession : When enabled, the target dies when possession ends; otherwise the target survives.

summary.zh-CN: 在会议中猜测玩家职业，正确猜测达到设定数量后获胜；高级选项可调整误猜惩罚。
summary.en: Guess roles in meetings and win after enough correct guesses; advanced options configure misguess penalties.

search.zh-CN: 末日赌怪 在会议中猜测玩家职业，正确猜测达到设定数量后获胜；高级选项可调整误猜惩罚。 末日赌怪 常规职业分配中，末日赌怪的人数上限固定为一名。末日赌怪在会议中使用 /bt [玩家ID] [职业] 猜测玩家职业，达到设定的正确猜测数后获胜。玩家 ID 显示在名字前，也可以使用 /id 列出所有玩家编号。猜对目标是否死亡、猜错后是否自杀，以及猜错后是否暂时不能继续猜测，都由设置控制。 设置 获胜所需正确猜测数 ：获胜前必须正确猜中的次数。 可猜测的阵营与附加职业 ：分别设置能否猜测内鬼、船员、中立和附加职业。 高级设置 ：开启后可设置每次会议的猜测次数上限、猜对时是否击杀目标、猜错时是否避免自杀，以及猜错后是否禁止继续猜测直到下次会议。关闭后这些高级选项不生效。 内鬼视野 ：设置末日赌怪是否拥有内鬼视野。 隐藏末日赌怪指令 ：开启后，模组会尝试隐藏 /bt 指令。
search.en: Doomsayer Guess roles in meetings and win after enough correct guesses; advanced options configure misguess penalties. Doomsayer Normal role assignment has a fixed limit of one Doomsayer. During meetings, the Doomsayer guesses roles with /bt [player ID] [role] . Player IDs appear before names; use /id to list all IDs. Reach the configured number of correct guesses to win. Settings control whether correct guesses kill their targets and whether an incorrect guess causes suicide or temporarily prevents further guesses. Settings Correct guesses required to win: Number of correct guesses needed. Guessable teams and addons: Separately allow guesses on Impostors, Crewmates, Neutrals, and addons. Advanced settings: Configure the maximum guesses per meeting, whether correctly guessed players are killed, whether the Doomsayer does not suicide after a wrong guess, and whether a wrong guess prevents more guesses until the next meeting. Impostor vision: Whether the Doomsayer has Impostor vision. Hide Doomsayer commands: When enabled, the mod attempts to hide /bt commands.

summary.zh-CN: 窃取目标名字和外观并将其杀死；内鬼消失后，若替身者是唯一存活的计数中立阵营且人数不少于船员，即可获胜。
summary.en: Steal a target name and appearance, then kill them; after Impostors are gone, win when Doppelgangers are the only surviving counted Neutral team and at least as numerous as Crew.

search.zh-CN: 替身者 窃取目标名字和外观并将其杀死；内鬼消失后，若替身者是唯一存活的计数中立阵营且人数不少于船员，即可获胜。 替身者 常规职业分配中，替身者的人数上限固定为一名。替身者使用击杀按钮窃取目标的名字和外观，并击杀目标。目标正在变形、伪装或蘑菇混乱破坏生效时，以及窃取次数用尽后，击杀不会交换身份。内鬼阵营消失后，若替身者是唯一存活的计数中立阵营且人数不少于船员，即可获胜。 设置 最大身份窃取次数 ：替身者可窃取其他玩家身份的次数。 击杀冷却 ：再次击杀前的等待时间。 可使用通风口 ：设置替身者能否使用通风口。 内鬼视野 ：设置替身者是否拥有内鬼视野。
search.en: Doppelganger Steal a target name and appearance, then kill them; after Impostors are gone, win when Doppelgangers are the only surviving counted Neutral team and at least as numerous as Crew. Doppelganger Normal role assignment has a fixed limit of one Doppelganger. The Doppelganger uses the kill button to steal a target's name and appearance, then kills the target. They do not swap identities if the target is shapeshifting, Camouflage or Mushroom Mixup is active, or the steal limit has been reached. After Impostors are gone, Doppelgangers win when they are the only surviving counted Neutral team and at least as numerous as Crew. Settings Maximum steals: Number of player identities the Doppelganger can steal. Kill cooldown: Time before killing again. Can vent: Whether the Doppelganger can use vents. Impostor vision: Whether the Doppelganger has Impostor vision.

summary.zh-CN: 会议中将定时炸弹交给一名非内鬼玩家；成为最后一名内鬼时可按设置更换职业。
summary.en: Passes a timed bomb to one non-Impostor during a meeting; can change roles when becoming the last Impostor, depending on settings.

search.zh-CN: 双面特工 会议中将定时炸弹交给一名非内鬼玩家；成为最后一名内鬼时可按设置更换职业。 技能 双面特工没有击杀按钮。会议中可选择一名存活的非内鬼玩家交付炸弹，每次只能交给一人，之后仍可投票。会议结束后倒计时开始，爆炸范围内的玩家会死亡。进入通风口时，可按设置拆除埋雷兵或煽动者的炸弹。只有本局开始时有多名内鬼，双面特工成为最后一名内鬼时才会触发职业更换选项。 选项 可以拆除其他职业的炸弹 ：开启时可在通风口拆除埋雷兵或煽动者的炸弹。 会议开始时拆除活动炸弹 ：开启时，会议会取消已交付的炸弹；关闭时不会取消。 拆除后可在当前会议再次使用技能 ：若前一枚炸弹被会议取消，开启时可在同一会议再交付一枚；关闭时需等下一次会议。 爆炸时间 ：设置会议结束后到爆炸的时间。 爆炸半径 ：设置爆炸范围倍率。 成为最后一名内鬼时更换职业 ：可选择不更换、随机职业、崇拜者内鬼、叛徒或骗术师。
search.en: Double Agent Passes a timed bomb to one non-Impostor during a meeting; can change roles when becoming the last Impostor, depending on settings. Ability The Double Agent has no kill button. During a meeting, select one living non-Impostor to receive a bomb; only one player can be selected, and the Double Agent can still vote afterward. The countdown starts when the meeting ends, and players within the blast radius die. Depending on settings, entering a vent can defuse bombs from Bastion or Agitator. Role change is checked only if the game started with multiple Impostors and the Double Agent becomes the last one. Options Can Diffuse Bombs from Other Roles : When enabled, vents can defuse bombs from Bastion or Agitator. Diffuse Active Bomb on Meeting Call : When enabled, a meeting cancels a bomb already passed to a player; when disabled, it does not. If Diffused, Can Use Ability in Called Meeting : When enabled, the Double Agent can pass another bomb during that same meeting; otherwise it must wait for the next meeting. Explosion Time : Time from the end of the meeting until the bomb explodes. Explosion Radius : Blast-radius multiplier. Change Role on Last Impostor : Choose no change, a random role, Admired Impostor, Traitor, or Trickster.

summary.zh-CN: 赌怪第一次猜错后可再猜一次，第二次猜错会死亡；仅能分配给可猜测身份的玩家。
summary.en: A Guesser can survive one wrong guess and try again; the next wrong guess kills them.

search.zh-CN: 双重猜测 赌怪第一次猜错后可再猜一次，第二次猜错会死亡；仅能分配给可猜测身份的玩家。 效果 持有双重猜测的赌怪第一次猜错时不会死亡，可再猜一次；第二次猜错会死亡。只有具备角色猜测能力的玩家才符合分配条件。 设置 Max（最大数量） ：本局中该附加身份可出现的数量上限。 Spawn Chance（生成概率） ：玩家获得此附加身份的概率。 Eligibility（可分配阵营） ：主持人可分别设置内鬼、船员、中立者是否可以获得此附加身份。
search.en: Double Shot A Guesser can survive one wrong guess and try again; the next wrong guess kills them. Effect A Guesser with Double Shot survives their first incorrect guess and can guess again; a second incorrect guess kills them. Only players who can make role guesses are eligible. Settings Max : Maximum number that can appear in one match. Spawn Chance : Chance for a player to receive this add-on. Eligibility : Separate settings control whether Impostors, Crewmates, Neutrals can receive this add-on.

summary.zh-CN: 每次会议有概率看到一条发给特定玩家的随机消息。
summary.en: May see one random private message at each meeting.

search.zh-CN: 窃听者 每次会议有概率看到一条发给特定玩家的随机消息。 效果 每次会议开始时，窃听者都有独立概率看到一条发给特定玩家的随机消息，例如入殓师或侦察员收到的消息。 设置 Max（最大数量） ：本局中该附加身份可出现的数量上限。 Spawn Chance（生成概率） ：玩家获得此附加身份的概率。 Eligibility（可分配阵营） ：主持人可分别设置内鬼、船员、中立者是否可以获得此附加身份。 Chance to eavesdrop（窃听概率） ：看到其他信息类消息的概率。
search.en: Eavesdropper May see one random private message at each meeting. Effect At each meeting start, each Eavesdropper has a chance to see one random message sent privately to a player, such as a message received by Mortician or Sleuth. Settings Max : Maximum number that can appear in one match. Spawn Chance : Chance for a player to receive this add-on. Eligibility : Separate settings control whether Impostors, Crewmates, Neutrals can receive this add-on. Chance to eavesdrop : Chance to see other information-based messages.

summary.zh-CN: 仅船员或内鬼可获得；存活的利己主义者会在其队伍获胜时取代该队伍成为胜者。
summary.en: Only Crewmates or Impostors can receive it; a living Egoist replaces its team's win when that team wins.

search.zh-CN: 利己主义者 仅船员或内鬼可获得；存活的利己主义者会在其队伍获胜时取代该队伍成为胜者。 效果 利己主义者只能分配给船员或内鬼；中立者、叛徒和已转化玩家不能获得。若存活的利己主义者所属的船员或内鬼队伍获胜，胜利会转为利己主义者阵营获胜。 设置 Max（最大数量） ：本局中该附加身份可出现的数量上限。 Spawn Chance（生成概率） ：玩家获得此附加身份的概率。 Eligibility（可分配阵营） ：主持人可分别设置船员、内鬼是否可以获得此附加身份。 ImpEgoistVisibalToAllies（内鬼队友可识别 Egoist） ：控制内鬼能否将利己主义者内鬼识别为队友，反之亦然。 EgoistCountAsConverted（Egoist 视为已转化） ：控制利己主义者是否按已转化身份处理。
search.en: Egoist Only Crewmates or Impostors can receive it; a living Egoist replaces its team's win when that team wins. Effect Egoist can only be assigned to Crewmates or Impostors; Neutrals, Madmates, and converted players are ineligible. If a living Egoist's Crewmate or Impostor team wins, the win is changed to an Egoist victory. Settings Max : Maximum number that can appear in one match. Spawn Chance : Chance for a player to receive this add-on. Eligibility : Separate settings control whether Crewmates, Impostors can receive this add-on. ImpEgoistVisibalToAllies : Whether Impostors can see an Egoist Impostor as an ally, and vice versa. EgoistCountAsConverted : Whether Egoist is treated as a converted role for conversion-related rules.

summary.zh-CN: 工程师可以在通讯破坏未生效时使用通风口，通风冷却和单次停留时长可分别设置。
summary.en: The Engineer can use vents while communications are not sabotaged, with configurable vent cooldown and maximum time in a vent.

search.zh-CN: 工程师（TOHE） 工程师可以在通讯破坏未生效时使用通风口，通风冷却和单次停留时长可分别设置。 职业能力 通讯未被破坏时，工程师可以使用通风口。 设置 数量与生成率 ：由 TOHE 的角色生成选项控制。 通风冷却 ：设置再次使用通风口前的等待时间。 通风口停留时间上限 ：设置每次可在通风口中停留的最长时间。
search.en: Engineer (TOHE) The Engineer can use vents while communications are not sabotaged, with configurable vent cooldown and maximum time in a vent. Role The Engineer can access vents while communications are not sabotaged. Settings Count and spawn chance : Controlled by the TOHE role-spawn options. Vent cooldown : Sets how long the Engineer must wait before using a vent again. Maximum time in vent : Sets how long the Engineer may stay in a vent.

summary.zh-CN: 尸体被报告后，猜想者可获得关于击杀者的随机线索；完成任务可提高线索阶段，是否必须由自己报告可设置。
summary.en: After a body is reported, the Enigma can receive a random clue about its killer; task progress improves the clue stage, and whether the Enigma must report it is configurable.

search.zh-CN: 猜想者 尸体被报告后，猜想者可获得关于击杀者的随机线索；完成任务可提高线索阶段，是否必须由自己报告可设置。 职业能力 有尸体被报告时，猜想者会收到关于该尸体击杀者的随机线索。开启相应设置后，不必由猜想者本人报告尸体；紧急会议等没有报告尸体的会议不会触发线索。完成的任务越多，可获得的线索阶段越高。 设置 数量上限 ：设置一局中猜想者的最大人数。 查看第一、第二、第三阶段线索所需任务数 ：分别设置达到各线索阶段前必须完成的任务数。 第二、第三阶段线索概率 ：分别设置出现第二阶段和第三阶段线索的概率。 无需亲自报告也能获得线索 ：开启时，其他玩家报告尸体也会给猜想者线索；关闭时只有报告者本人是猜想者时才会收到线索。 自定义猜想者任务 ：开启时可单独设置任务；关闭时猜想者的任务数量与其他玩家相同。自定义选项可设置是否有公共任务，以及长任务、短任务数量。
search.en: Enigma After a body is reported, the Enigma can receive a random clue about its killer; task progress improves the clue stage, and whether the Enigma must report it is configurable. Role When a body is reported, the Enigma receives a random clue about its killer. With the corresponding setting enabled, the Enigma does not need to be the reporter; meetings without a body report, such as emergency meetings, do not trigger a clue. More completed tasks unlock higher clue stages. Settings Maximum count : Sets the maximum number of Enigmas in a match. Tasks required for Stage 1, Stage 2, and Stage 3 clues : Sets the task threshold for each clue stage. Stage 2 and Stage 3 clue probability : Sets the chance of receiving a clue from each of those stages. Can get clues without being the reporter : ON gives the Enigma a clue when another player reports a body; OFF gives a clue only when the Enigma is the reporter. Override Enigma tasks : ON allows a separate task setup; OFF gives the Enigma the same task count as everyone else. The custom setup includes whether the role gets common tasks and the number of long and short tasks.

summary.zh-CN: 会议中可抹除一名合格船员的主职业；会后转为对应原版职业，每名玩家整局只能被抹除一次。
summary.en: Can erase the main role of one eligible Crewmate during a meeting; afterward they become the matching vanilla role, and each player can be erased only once per game.

search.zh-CN: 抹除者 会议中可抹除一名合格船员的主职业；会后转为对应原版职业，每名玩家整局只能被抹除一次。 技能 会议中投票选择一名合格的船员目标，抹除其主职业；会议结束后目标会变为对应的原版职业。每名玩家整局只能被抹除一次。不能选择自己、抹除者、顽固者、中立、无任务船员和其他不合格主职业。拥有幽灵职业的目标可能被选中，但其抹除效果会被取消。 选项 数量上限（Max） ：设置本局最多可有多少名抹除者。 抹除次数上限 ：设置每场游戏最多可抹除多少次。
search.en: Eraser Can erase the main role of one eligible Crewmate during a meeting; afterward they become the matching vanilla role, and each player can be erased only once per game. Ability During a meeting, vote for an eligible Crewmate to erase their main role. After the meeting, the target becomes the corresponding vanilla role. Each player can be erased only once per game. The Eraser cannot target themself, another Eraser, a Stubborn player, Neutral roles, taskless Crewmates, or other ineligible main roles. A player with a ghost role may be selected, but the erasure is cancelled. Options Max : Maximum number of Erasers in a match. Max Erases : Maximum number of erasures per game.

summary.zh-CN: 用变形标记一个位置，之后再次变形即可传送回该处。
summary.en: Marks a location while shapeshifting, then returns there on a later shapeshift.

search.zh-CN: 逃逸者 用变形标记一个位置，之后再次变形即可传送回该处。 技能 变形时标记当前位置，随后可以解除变形。再次变形时，逃逸者会传送回已标记的位置。 选项 数量上限（Max） ：设置本局最多可有多少名逃逸者。 变形持续时间 ：设置每次变形可持续多久。 变形冷却 ：设置再次变形前的等待时间。
search.en: Escapist Marks a location while shapeshifting, then returns there on a later shapeshift. Ability Shapeshifting marks your current location. You can then unshift; on a later shapeshift, you return to the marked location. Options Max : Maximum number of Escapists in a match. Shapeshift Duration : How long a shapeshift can last. Shapeshift Cooldown : How long you must wait before shapeshifting again.

summary.zh-CN: 被投票出局时有概率免于被驱逐，机会次数和概率可设置。
summary.en: May escape exile when voted out, with configurable uses and chance.

search.zh-CN: 逃避者 被投票出局时有概率免于被驱逐，机会次数和概率可设置。 效果 逃避者被投票出局时，有概率不会被驱逐。 设置 Max（最大数量） ：本局中该附加身份可出现的数量上限。 Spawn Chance（生成概率） ：玩家获得此附加身份的概率。 Eligibility（可分配阵营） ：主持人可分别设置内鬼、船员、中立者是否可以获得此附加身份。 Max Ability Uses（能力使用次数上限） ：逃避者可逃脱驱逐的次数上限。 Chance to not be exiled（免于驱逐概率） ：逃避者逃脱驱逐的概率。
search.en: Evader May escape exile when voted out, with configurable uses and chance. Effect When Evader is voted out, there is a chance they will not be exiled. Settings Max : Maximum number that can appear in one match. Spawn Chance : Chance for a player to receive this add-on. Eligibility : Separate settings control whether Impostors, Crewmates, Neutrals can receive this add-on. Max Ability Uses : Maximum number of times Evader can escape exile. Chance to not be exiled : Chance for Evader to escape exile.

summary.zh-CN: 会议中猜测玩家职业；猜对击杀目标，猜错则自己死亡。
summary.en: Guesses player roles during meetings; a correct guess kills the target, while a wrong guess kills the Guesser.

search.zh-CN: 邪恶赌怪 会议中猜测玩家职业；猜对击杀目标，猜错则自己死亡。 技能 在会议中猜测一名玩家的职业。猜对时目标死亡；猜错时邪恶赌怪死亡。输入 /bt [玩家编号] [职业名] ；编号可在名字前查看，也可用 /id 查询。TOHE 模组客户端提供名牌猜测界面。 选项 数量上限（Max） ：设置本局最多可有多少名邪恶赌怪。 每次会议猜测次数上限 ：设置每次会议可猜测的次数。 可以猜测内鬼职业 ：开启时可猜测内鬼职业；关闭时不能。 可以猜测附加职业 ：开启时可猜测附加职业；关闭时不能。 尝试隐藏猜测命令 ：开启时尝试隐藏邪恶赌怪命令。
search.en: Evil Guesser Guesses player roles during meetings; a correct guess kills the target, while a wrong guess kills the Guesser. Ability During a meeting, guess a player’s role. A correct guess kills the target; a wrong guess kills the Evil Guesser. Enter /bt [player ID] [role] . The ID appears before the player’s name, or use /id to list IDs. The TOHE modded client also provides a guessing interface on player nameplates. Options Max : Maximum number of Evil Guessers in a match. Maximum Number of Guesses per Meeting : Maximum number of guesses the Evil Guesser can make in a meeting. Can Guess Impostor Roles : When enabled, Impostor roles can be guessed; otherwise they cannot. Can Guess Add-Ons : When enabled, add-ons can be guessed; otherwise they cannot. Try to Hide Guesser Command : When enabled, the mod attempts to hide the Evil Guesser command.

summary.zh-CN: 在每次会议开始时查看最后一刻的管理室信息，并可按选项查看尸体、内鬼位置和击杀闪光。
summary.en: Sees a last-moment Admin snapshot at meeting start, with optional body, Impostor, and kill-flash information.

search.zh-CN: 邪恶黑客 在每次会议开始时查看最后一刻的管理室信息，并可按选项查看尸体、内鬼位置和击杀闪光。 技能 每次会议开始时获得最后一刻的管理室信息。没有人的房间不会显示；带「★」的房间表示有内鬼，房间后面的数字表示尸体数量，例如「★餐厅：3（尸体×1）」。 选项 查看尸体位置 ：开启后可查看尸体所在位置。 查看其他内鬼位置 ：开启后可查看其他内鬼的位置。 查看击杀闪光 ：开启后可像灵媒一样看到击杀闪光；可进一步设置是否显示击杀地点。
search.en: Evil Hacker Sees a last-moment Admin snapshot at meeting start, with optional body, Impostor, and kill-flash information. Ability At the beginning of each meeting, the Evil Hacker receives the most recent Admin information. Unoccupied rooms are omitted. A 「★」 marks a room with an Impostor; the number after a room indicates its body count, for example, 「★Cafeteria: 3 (DEAD×1)」. Options Can See the Location of Dead Bodies : When enabled, shows where bodies are located. Can See the Location of Other Impostors : When enabled, shows where other Impostors are located. Can See Kill-Flash : When enabled, shows kill flashes like Seer; a nested option controls whether the murder location is also shown.

summary.zh-CN: 坏迷你船员在成年前无法被击杀或招募；成长期间击杀冷却会逐渐缩短。
summary.en: Cannot be killed or recruited before adulthood; its kill cooldown gradually decreases as it grows.

search.zh-CN: 坏迷你船员 坏迷你船员在成年前无法被击杀或招募；成长期间击杀冷却会逐渐缩短。 技能 坏迷你船员是迷你船员的内鬼变体。未满 18 岁时不会被击杀或招募；成长到成年后可以被击杀和招募。其击杀冷却会随年龄增长，从幼年时的较长冷却逐步降低到成年时的较短冷却。 选项 成长所需时间 ：设置迷你船员成长到成年所需时间。 所有人都能看到迷你船员 ：开启时所有玩家都能识别迷你船员。 迷你船员可以成为内鬼 ：开启时迷你船员可被分配为坏迷你船员。 坏迷你船员出现概率 ：设置迷你船员成为坏迷你船员的概率。 幼年击杀冷却 ：设置坏迷你船员未成年时的击杀冷却。 成年击杀冷却 ：设置成年后的击杀冷却。 实时更新年龄 ：开启时实时显示年龄变化。 会议期间继续成长 ：开启时会议时间也计入成长时间。
search.en: Evil Mini Cannot be killed or recruited before adulthood; its kill cooldown gradually decreases as it grows. Ability Evil Mini is the Impostor variant of Mini. Before age 18, it cannot be killed or recruited. Once grown up, it can be killed and recruited. Its kill cooldown decreases as it ages, from a longer cooldown while young to a shorter cooldown at adulthood. Options Time Required to Grow : Time for a Mini to reach adulthood. Everyone Can See the Mini : When enabled, all players can identify Mini. Mini Can Be an Impostor : When enabled, Mini can be assigned as Evil Mini. Probability of Mini Being an Impostor : Chance that Mini becomes Evil Mini. Kill Cooldown When Under 18 : Evil Mini kill cooldown while young. Kill Cooldown When Over 18 : Evil Mini kill cooldown after growing up. Display Age Change in Real Time : When enabled, age changes are shown as they happen. Meeting Time Can Continue to Grow : When enabled, meeting time counts toward growing up.

summary.zh-CN: 由灵魂召唤者赋予；成为恶灵后可使用守护天使能力冻结或降低目标视野。
summary.en: Granted by Spiritcaller; as an Evil Spirit, it can use Guardian Angel protection to freeze or reduce a target's vision.

search.zh-CN: 恶灵 由灵魂召唤者赋予；成为恶灵后可使用守护天使能力冻结或降低目标视野。 效果 灵魂召唤者可将符合条件的目标转化为恶灵。该身份不会随机分配。恶灵死亡时会变为守护天使；使用守护能力可短暂定身目标、阻止其报告尸体，或暂时降低其视野。若恶灵选择灵魂召唤者为守护目标，则会在设定时长内保护灵魂召唤者。灵魂召唤者获胜时，恶灵也会获胜。 相关设置 Spiritcaller ability settings（灵魂召唤者能力设置） ：灵魂召唤者设置控制恶灵数量、恶灵能力冷却、对灵魂召唤者的保护时间、定身时长以及视野降低幅度和持续时间。 随机分配 ：不会开局随机分配；由上述赋予者能力转化获得。
search.en: Evil Spirit Granted by Spiritcaller; as an Evil Spirit, it can use Guardian Angel protection to freeze or reduce a target's vision. Effect Spiritcaller can convert eligible targets into Evil Spirits. This identity is not randomly assigned. When an Evil Spirit dies, it becomes a Guardian Angel; using its protect ability can briefly freeze a target, prevent them from reporting bodies, or reduce their vision. If it protects Spiritcaller, it grants Spiritcaller temporary protection. Evil Spirits win when Spiritcaller wins. Related settings Spiritcaller ability settings : Spiritcaller settings control the number of Evil Spirits, their ability cooldown, Spiritcaller protection duration, freeze duration, and the amount and duration of vision reduction. Random assignment : Not assigned at random at game start; it is granted by the conversion ability described above.

summary.zh-CN: 追踪目标并通过变形更换目标；队友击杀时可显示击杀闪光。
summary.en: Tracks a target and changes targets by shapeshifting; can see a kill flash when a teammate kills.

search.zh-CN: 邪恶追踪者 追踪目标并通过变形更换目标；队友击杀时可显示击杀闪光。 技能 邪恶追踪者会追踪一名玩家；名字下方的箭头指向目标。变形到另一名玩家后会立即解除变形，并将追踪目标切换为该玩家。队友击杀时也可按设置显示击杀闪光。 选项 数量上限（Max） ：设置本局最多可有多少名邪恶追踪者。 查看击杀闪光 ：开启时，队友击杀会产生提示；关闭时不显示。 更换目标频率 ：可设为从不、每局一次、每次会议或随时更换。 会议中查看目标最后所在房间 ：开启时显示目标在会议前所在的房间；关闭时不显示。
search.en: Evil Tracker Tracks a target and changes targets by shapeshifting; can see a kill flash when a teammate kills. Ability The Evil Tracker follows a target; an arrow below the tracker’s name points toward them. Shapeshifting into another player immediately unshifts and changes the tracking target to that player. Depending on settings, the tracker also sees a kill flash when a teammate kills. Options Max : Maximum number of Evil Trackers in a match. Can See Kill-Flash : When enabled, a teammate’s kill produces a notification; otherwise no flash is shown. Can Set Target : Choose how often the target can be changed: never, once per game, every meeting, or at any time. Can See Target’s Last Room in Meeting : When enabled, shows the room the target was in immediately before the meeting; otherwise this information is hidden.

summary.zh-CN: 开局获得一名目标；目标被投票放逐时获胜，目标在此之前死亡时按设置转变职业。
summary.en: Receive a target at the start; win if they are voted out, or change roles as configured if they die first.

search.zh-CN: 处刑人 开局获得一名目标；目标被投票放逐时获胜，目标在此之前死亡时按设置转变职业。 处刑人 处刑人开局会获得一名处刑目标，目标名字旁显示菱形「♦」。目标在会议中被投票放逐时，处刑人获胜。若目标在被放逐前死亡，处刑人会变为设置指定的职业。小丑、处刑人和冤罪师可以同时获胜。 设置 人数上限 ：一局中可出现的处刑人数量上限。 可选目标阵营 ：分别设置能否选择内鬼、带刀中立、友好中立、邪恶中立、混沌中立或灾厄阵营的玩家；船员也可成为目标。 知道目标职业 ：开启后，处刑人能看到目标职业；关闭后目标显示为普通玩家。 目标死亡后的职业 ：可选择船员、名人、保镖、独裁者、市长、医生、小丑或投机者。 目标被放逐时公开身份 ：设置目标被放逐时是否公开其身份。
search.en: Executioner Receive a target at the start; win if they are voted out, or change roles as configured if they die first. Executioner At the start of the game, the Executioner receives a target marked with a diamond (♦) beside their name. The Executioner wins if the target is voted out. If the target dies before being voted out, the Executioner changes into the role selected in the settings. Jester, Executioner, and Innocent can win together. Settings Maximum number: Maximum number of Executioners in a match. Eligible target teams: Separately allow targets from the Impostor, Neutral Killing, Neutral Benign, Neutral Evil, Neutral Chaos, and Apocalypse teams. Crewmates can also be selected. Knows target's role: Whether the Executioner sees the target's role. Role after target dies: Choose Crewmate, Celebrity, Bodyguard, Dictator, Mayor, Doctor, Jester, or Opportunist. Reveal target upon ejection: Whether the target's role is revealed when they are voted out.

summary.zh-CN: 面包师达到存活面包玩家门槛后转变为饥荒；未被放逐时会使无面包的非灾厄玩家饿死，并标记其他非灾厄玩家在下次会议死亡。
summary.en: The Baker transforms into Famine after enough breaded players survive; if not voted out, Famine starves unbreaded non-Apocalypse players and marks the remaining non-Apocalypse players to die at the next meeting.

search.zh-CN: 饥荒 面包师达到存活面包玩家门槛后转变为饥荒；未被放逐时会使无面包的非灾厄玩家饿死，并标记其他非灾厄玩家在下次会议死亡。 饥荒 面包师达到设定数量的存活面包玩家后，会转变为饥荒。若饥荒在转变后的会议中没有被投出，所有没有面包的非灾厄玩家都会在会议结算时饿死。之后，饥荒可以使用击杀按钮标记剩余的非灾厄玩家；被标记者会在下一次会议开始时死亡。 饥荒无敌，转变后的下一次会议中会向所有人公布其存在。 设置 饥荒饥饿冷却 ：饥荒再次使用饥饿能力前的等待时间。
search.en: Famine The Baker transforms into Famine after enough breaded players survive; if not voted out, Famine starves unbreaded non-Apocalypse players and marks the remaining non-Apocalypse players to die at the next meeting. Famine The Baker transforms into Famine once the configured number of breaded players are alive. If Famine is not voted out at the transformation meeting, every living non-Apocalypse player without bread is queued to die when the meeting resolves. Afterward, Famine can use the kill button to mark the remaining non-Apocalypse players; marked players die when the next meeting is called. Famine is invincible, and their presence is announced to everyone at the meeting after the transformation. Settings Famine starve cooldown: Time before Famine can use Starve again.

summary.zh-CN: 变形可放置房主设定数量的烟花；全部放置且成为最后一名内鬼后，变形引爆所有烟花。
summary.en: Shapeshifts to plant the configured number of fireworks; once all are planted and it is the last Impostor, shapeshifting detonates them all.

search.zh-CN: 烟花爆破者 变形可放置房主设定数量的烟花；全部放置且成为最后一名内鬼后，变形引爆所有烟花。 技能 变形会在当前位置布置一枚烟花。烟花全部放置后，若烟花爆破者成为最后一名内鬼，再次变形即可引爆全部烟花，炸死爆炸范围内的玩家。若烟花爆破者也在范围内会自杀；若它是场上最后一名存活玩家则不会自杀。 选项 数量上限（Max） ：设置本局最多可有多少名烟花爆破者。 烟花数量 ：设置要布置的烟花总数。 烟花爆炸半径 ：设置爆炸范围倍率。 可以击杀 ：开启时，在布置等待阶段也可普通击杀；关闭时只在允许普通击杀的阶段可击杀。
search.en: Fireworker Shapeshifts to plant the configured number of fireworks; once all are planted and it is the last Impostor, shapeshifting detonates them all. Ability Shapeshifting plants a firework at the current location. After all fireworks are planted, the Fireworker can detonate them by shapeshifting again once it is the last Impostor. Players in the blast radius die. The Fireworker also dies if caught in the blast, unless it is the last living player. Options Max : Maximum number of Fireworkers in a match. Firework Count : Total number of fireworks to plant. Firework Explosion Radius : Blast-radius multiplier. Can Kill : When enabled, normal kills are available while waiting to detonate; when disabled, normal kills are limited to the setup and post-detonation states.

summary.zh-CN: 移动速度由主持人设置，可以调得比其他玩家快或慢。
summary.en: Uses a host-configured movement speed, which can be faster or slower than other players' speed.

search.zh-CN: 闪电侠 移动速度由主持人设置，可以调得比其他玩家快或慢。 效果 闪电侠使用主持人设置的移动速度；该速度可以高于或低于其他玩家。 设置 Eligibility（可分配阵营） ：主持人可分别设置内鬼、船员、中立者是否可以获得此附加身份。 Max（最大数量） ：本局中该附加身份可出现的数量上限。 Spawn Chance（生成概率） ：玩家获得此附加身份的概率。 Flash Speed（闪电侠速度） ：分配给闪电侠玩家的移动速度。
search.en: Flash Uses a host-configured movement speed, which can be faster or slower than other players' speed. Effect Flash uses a host-configured movement speed, which can be faster or slower than other players' speed. Settings Eligibility : Separate settings control whether Impostors, Crewmates, Neutrals can receive this add-on. Max : Maximum number that can appear in one match. Spawn Chance : Chance for a player to receive this add-on. Flash Speed : Movement speed assigned to players with Flash.

summary.zh-CN: 用击杀按钮选择目标；每次选择或更换都会消耗次数。目标获胜时，赌徒即使已死亡也能一同获胜。
summary.en: Choose a target with the kill button; each initial choice or change uses a charge. If the target wins, the Follower wins even after death.

search.zh-CN: 赌徒 用击杀按钮选择目标；每次选择或更换都会消耗次数。目标获胜时，赌徒即使已死亡也能一同获胜。 赌徒 赌徒可以使用击杀按钮选择一名目标，也可以再次使用来更换目标。首次选择目标也会消耗一次次数。赌徒会与目标一同获胜，而且死亡后仍可获胜。 设置 目标选择次数上限 ：可选择目标的总次数，包括首次选择和之后的更换。 下注冷却 ：再次选择目标前的基础等待时间。 每名死亡玩家增加的冷却 ：场上每多一名死亡玩家，下注冷却增加的时长。 最高下注冷却 ：下注冷却的上限。 知道目标职业 ：开启后，赌徒能看到目标职业；关闭后看不到。 目标知道自己被跟随 ：开启后，目标会知道赌徒是谁；关闭后目标不会知道。
search.en: Follower Choose a target with the kill button; each initial choice or change uses a charge. If the target wins, the Follower wins even after death. Follower The Follower can use the kill button to choose a target, then use it again to switch targets. Choosing the first target also uses one charge. The Follower wins with their target and can still win after death. Settings Maximum target selections: Total number of target choices, including the first target and later changes. Follow cooldown: Base cooldown before choosing or changing a target. Cooldown increase per dead player: The cooldown increases by this amount for each dead player in the game. Maximum follow cooldown: Upper limit for the increased cooldown. Knows target's role: When enabled, the Follower sees the target's role. Target knows who the Follower is: Whether the target is told who is following them.

summary.zh-CN: 会议外无法修复指定的破坏系统；与修理工、守护天使、炼金术士和暴君不兼容。
summary.en: Cannot fix specified sabotage systems outside meetings; incompatible with Mechanic, GuardianAngelTOHE, Alchemist, and Troller.

search.zh-CN: 蠢蛋 会议外无法修复指定的破坏系统；与修理工、守护天使、炼金术士和暴君不兼容。 效果 在会议外，蠢蛋无法修复反应堆、实验室、直升机、氧气、通讯或电气系统的破坏。它与修理工、守护天使、炼金术士和暴君不兼容。 设置 Max（最大数量） ：本局中该附加身份可出现的数量上限。 Spawn Chance（生成概率） ：玩家获得此附加身份的概率。 Eligibility（可分配阵营） ：主持人可分别设置内鬼、船员、中立者是否可以获得此附加身份。
search.en: Fool Cannot fix specified sabotage systems outside meetings; incompatible with Mechanic, GuardianAngelTOHE, Alchemist, and Troller. Effect Outside meetings, Fool cannot fix Reactor, Laboratory, Heli, Life Support, Comms, or Electrical sabotages. It is incompatible with Mechanic, GuardianAngelTOHE, Alchemist, and Troller. Settings Max : Maximum number that can appear in one match. Spawn Chance : Chance for a player to receive this add-on. Eligibility : Separate settings control whether Impostors, Crewmates, Neutrals can receive this add-on.

summary.zh-CN: 调查员会议投票后会获得目标职业线索，完成全部任务后可看到目标的确切职业。
summary.en: The Fortune Teller gets a role clue after voting for a player and can see the exact role after completing all tasks.

search.zh-CN: 调查员 调查员会议投票后会获得目标职业线索，完成全部任务后可看到目标的确切职业。 职业能力 调查员在会议中投票给玩家后，会收到关于该玩家职业的线索。完成全部任务后再投票，可以得知目标的确切职业。 设置 数量上限 ：设置一局中调查员的最大人数。 技能使用次数上限 ：设置调查员最多可以使用技能多少次。 随机显示已启用职业 ：开启时，提示会在目标真实职业与已启用职业间混合显示；此模式下不能重复调查同一目标。 未完成任务时可知道确切职业 ：开启时，即使任务未完成也可能看到玩家的确切职业；关闭时须完成任务才能看到。 完成任务后可知道确切职业 ：开启时，完成任务后可以看到玩家的确切职业；关闭时完成任务也不能看到确切职业。 每完成一个任务获得的技能次数 ：设置每完成一个任务增加的技能次数，按 0.1 为步进。 自定义调查员任务 ：开启时可为调查员设置不同的任务数量；关闭时与其他玩家的任务数量相同。另有公共任务开关以及长任务、短任务数量选项。
search.en: Fortune Teller The Fortune Teller gets a role clue after voting for a player and can see the exact role after completing all tasks. Role When the Fortune Teller votes for a player during a meeting, they receive a clue about that player's role. After completing all tasks, voting for a player reveals the target's exact role. Settings Maximum count : Sets the maximum number of Fortune Tellers in a match. Maximum ability uses : Sets how many times the Fortune Teller can use the ability. Show random active roles in hints : ON mixes the target's actual role with active roles in the hint, and prevents checking the same player multiple times; OFF does not. Can know exact roles before tasks are complete : ON permits exact-role results before completing tasks; OFF requires task completion. Know exact roles on task completion : ON allows exact-role results after completing tasks; OFF prevents exact-role results even after completion. Ability uses gained per task : Sets the uses gained for each completed task, in 0.1 increments. Override Fortune Teller tasks : ON permits a separate task count; OFF gives the role the same count as everyone else. The settings also include common-task availability and the number of long and short tasks.

summary.zh-CN: 可被击杀按钮直接击杀；是否触发及击杀者是否冲刺由阵营设置控制。
summary.en: Can be killed by a kill-button attempt; team settings control whether the kill works and whether the killer lunges.

search.zh-CN: 脆弱者 可被击杀按钮直接击杀；是否触发及击杀者是否冲刺由阵营设置控制。 效果 对脆弱者使用击杀按钮时，若击杀者所属阵营的设置允许，脆弱者会立即死亡，即使攻击者平时不能直接击杀。可分别设置内鬼、船员和中立者能否击杀脆弱者，并设置击杀时是否冲刺。 设置 Max（最大数量） ：本局中该附加身份可出现的数量上限。 Spawn Chance（生成概率） ：玩家获得此附加身份的概率。 Eligibility（可分配阵营） ：主持人可分别设置内鬼、船员、中立者是否可以获得此附加身份。 ImpCanKillFragile（内鬼可击杀 Fragile） ：控制内鬼能否击杀脆弱者。 CrewCanKillFragile（船员可击杀 Fragile） ：控制船员能否击杀脆弱者。 NeutralCanKillFragile（中立者可击杀 Fragile） ：控制中立者能否击杀脆弱者。 FragileKillerLunge（击杀 Fragile 时冲刺） ：控制成功击杀脆弱者时击杀者是否向目标冲刺。
search.en: Fragile Can be killed by a kill-button attempt; team settings control whether the kill works and whether the killer lunges. Effect A kill-button attempt kills Fragile if the attacker's team is allowed to kill it, even when that role normally cannot kill directly. The host can separately allow Impostors, Crewmates, and Neutrals to kill Fragile, and choose whether the killer lunges. Settings Max : Maximum number that can appear in one match. Spawn Chance : Chance for a player to receive this add-on. Eligibility : Separate settings control whether Impostors, Crewmates, Neutrals can receive this add-on. ImpCanKillFragile : Whether Impostors can kill Fragile. CrewCanKillFragile : Whether Crewmates can kill Fragile. NeutralCanKillFragile : Whether Neutrals can kill Fragile. FragileKillerLunge : Whether the killer lunges toward Fragile when the kill succeeds.

summary.zh-CN: 用击杀键尝试招募玩家；次数耗尽或目标不符合招募条件时，转入普通击杀判定。
summary.en: Uses the kill button to recruit players; exhausted uses or an ineligible target trigger the normal kill checks instead.

search.zh-CN: 歹徒 用击杀键尝试招募玩家；次数耗尽或目标不符合招募条件时，转入普通击杀判定。 技能 有招募次数时，使用击杀键尝试将合格目标转为叛徒（Madmate）；招募成功时双方会收到提示。招募次数耗尽后，击杀键恢复普通击杀；遇到不符合招募条件的目标时会转入普通击杀判定。未成年 Mini 不能被招募；针对其的普通击杀判定仍会被 Mini 的年龄免疫拦截。 选项 数量上限（Max） ：设置本局最多可有多少名歹徒。 招募冷却 ：设置招募期间击杀键的冷却；招募次数用尽后使用默认击杀冷却。 招募人数上限 ：设置可招募的玩家数。 警长可以成为叛徒 ：开启时可招募警长。 市长可以成为叛徒 ：开启时可招募市长。 正义赌怪可以成为叛徒 ：开启时可招募正义赌怪。 正义法官可以成为叛徒 ：开启时可招募正义法官。 展现者可以成为叛徒 ：开启时可招募展现者。 惩罚者可以成为叛徒 ：开启时可招募惩罚者。 预言家可以成为叛徒 ：开启时可招募预言家。
search.en: Gangster Uses the kill button to recruit players; exhausted uses or an ineligible target trigger the normal kill checks instead. Ability While recruitment uses remain, use the kill button to try to convert an eligible target into a Madmate. A successful conversion is confirmed to both players. Once recruit uses run out, the button returns to normal kills; an ineligible target falls back to the normal kill check. A Mini under 18 cannot be recruited, and Mini’s age immunity still blocks the ordinary kill check. Options Max : Maximum number of Gangsters in a match. Recruit Cooldown : Cooldown while recruitment uses remain; after they run out, the default kill cooldown applies. Recruit Limit : Number of players the Gangster can recruit. Sheriff Can Be Converted : When enabled, Sheriff can be recruited. Mayor Can Be Converted : When enabled, Mayor can be recruited. Nice Guesser Can Be Converted : When enabled, Nice Guesser can be recruited. Judge Can Be Converted : When enabled, Judge can be recruited. Marshall Can Be Converted : When enabled, Marshall can be recruited. Retributionist Can Be Converted : When enabled, Retributionist can be recruited. Overseer Can Be Converted : When enabled, Overseer can be recruited.

summary.zh-CN: 鬼怪附身一名玩家并为其指定目标，使其只能对该目标使用击杀或击杀类技能；更换附身、效果到期或附身者/指定目标死亡时，限制解除。
summary.en: The Ghastly possesses a player and assigns them a target, restricting their kill actions to that target until possession changes, expires, or either player dies.

search.zh-CN: 鬼怪 鬼怪附身一名玩家并为其指定目标，使其只能对该目标使用击杀或击杀类技能；更换附身、效果到期或附身者/指定目标死亡时，限制解除。 职业能力 鬼怪可以附身一名毫无防备的玩家，再为其选择一个目标。在附身期间，该玩家只能对指定目标使用击杀或击杀类技能；鬼怪改为附身其他玩家、效果到期，或附身者/指定目标死亡时，此限制解除。 设置 附身冷却 ：设置鬼怪再次附身前的等待时间。 附身次数上限 ：设置鬼怪最多可附身的次数。 附身持续时间 ：设置附身效果持续多久。 鬼怪速度 ：设置鬼怪的移动速度。 不能附身队友 ：开启时不能附身盟友；关闭时可以。
search.en: Ghastly The Ghastly possesses a player and assigns them a target, restricting their kill actions to that target until possession changes, expires, or either player dies. Role The Ghastly can possess an unsuspecting player and then choose a target for them. While possessed, that player can use their kill or kill ability only on the chosen target. The restriction ends when the Ghastly possesses someone else, the effect expires, or either the possessed player or chosen target dies. Settings Possess cooldown : Sets how long the Ghastly must wait before possessing again. Maximum possessions : Sets how many times the Ghastly can possess players. Possession duration : Sets how long each possession lasts. Ghastly speed : Sets how fast the Ghastly can move. Cannot possess allies : ON prevents possessing allies; OFF allows it.

summary.zh-CN: 完成全部任务时，存活的食尸鬼会自杀；死去的食尸鬼完成全部任务时，会击杀所有仍存活且曾击杀食尸鬼的玩家。
summary.en: After all tasks are complete, a living Ghoul dies by suicide; a dead Ghoul kills every living player marked as having killed a Ghoul.

search.zh-CN: 食尸鬼 完成全部任务时，存活的食尸鬼会自杀；死去的食尸鬼完成全部任务时，会击杀所有仍存活且曾击杀食尸鬼的玩家。 效果 食尸鬼只分配给船员，不分配给没有任务或以任务为基础的角色。完成全部任务时，若食尸鬼仍存活则会自杀；若死去的食尸鬼完成全部任务，会击杀所有仍存活且被标记为食尸鬼击杀者的玩家。 设置 Max（最大数量） ：本局中该附加身份可出现的数量上限。 Spawn Chance（生成概率） ：玩家获得此附加身份的概率。
search.en: Ghoul After all tasks are complete, a living Ghoul dies by suicide; a dead Ghoul kills every living player marked as having killed a Ghoul. Effect Ghoul is assigned only to Crewmates, not to Crewmates without tasks or task-based roles. After all tasks are complete, a living Ghoul dies by suicide. If a dead Ghoul completes all tasks, it kills every living player marked as having killed a Ghoul. Settings Max : Maximum number that can appear in one match. Spawn Chance : Chance for a player to receive this add-on.

summary.zh-CN: 通过黑入限制玩家行动并伪装成随机玩家；内鬼消失后，若缺点者是唯一存活的计数中立阵营且人数不少于船员，即可获胜。
summary.en: Hack players to restrict their actions and mimic a random player; after Impostors are gone, win when Glitch is the only surviving counted Neutral team and at least as numerous as Crew.

search.zh-CN: 缺点者 通过黑入限制玩家行动并伪装成随机玩家；内鬼消失后，若缺点者是唯一存活的计数中立阵营且人数不少于船员，即可获胜。 缺点者 缺点者可以黑入玩家，暂时阻止其击杀、使用通风口和报告尸体。单击使用黑入，双击使用击杀。 缺点者还可以使用破坏按钮，在有限时间内伪装成随机玩家。按下按钮会执行伪装，而不会真的触发破坏。 内鬼阵营消失后，若缺点者是唯一存活的计数中立阵营且人数不少于船员，缺点者即可获胜。 设置 击杀冷却 ：再次击杀前的等待时间。 黑入冷却 ：再次黑入玩家前的等待时间。 黑入持续时间 ：目标被黑入的时长。 伪装冷却 ：再次伪装前的等待时间。 伪装持续时间 ：伪装持续的时长。 可使用通风口 ：设置缺点者能否使用通风口。 内鬼视野 ：开启后拥有内鬼视野；关闭后不拥有内鬼视野。
search.en: Glitch Hack players to restrict their actions and mimic a random player; after Impostors are gone, win when Glitch is the only surviving counted Neutral team and at least as numerous as Crew. Glitch The Glitch can hack a player, temporarily preventing them from killing, venting, or reporting bodies. Single-click to hack and double-click to kill. The Glitch can also use the sabotage button to mimic a random player for a limited time. The button press triggers the mimic and the sabotage itself does not happen. After Impostors are gone, Glitch wins when it is the only surviving counted Neutral team and at least as numerous as Crew. Settings Kill cooldown: Time before the Glitch can kill again. Hack cooldown: Time before hacking another player. Hack duration: How long the target remains hacked. Mimic cooldown: Time before mimicking a player again. Mimic duration: How long the mimic lasts. Can vent: Whether the Glitch can use vents. Impostor vision: When enabled, the Glitch has Impostor vision.

summary.zh-CN: 停电期间，光辉和附近玩家获得额外视野。
summary.en: During Lights Out, Glow and nearby players receive a vision boost.

search.zh-CN: 光辉 停电期间，光辉和附近玩家获得额外视野。 效果 停电期间，光辉自身及其附近玩家都会获得视野加成。光辉不会在 The Fungle 地图随机分配。 设置 Max（最大数量） ：本局中该附加身份可出现的数量上限。 Spawn Chance（生成概率） ：玩家获得此附加身份的概率。 Eligibility（可分配阵营） ：主持人可分别设置内鬼、船员、中立者是否可以获得此附加身份。 Glow Radius（光辉范围） ：光辉对附近玩家生效的距离。 Vision Boost for nearby players（附近玩家视野加成） ：附近玩家获得的视野加成幅度。 Vision Boost for Glow（Glow 自身视野加成） ：光辉自身获得的视野加成幅度。
search.en: Glow During Lights Out, Glow and nearby players receive a vision boost. Effect During Lights Out, Glow and nearby players receive a vision boost. Glow is not randomly assigned on The Fungle. Settings Max : Maximum number that can be in one match. Spawn Chance : Chance for a player to receive this add-on. Eligibility : Separate settings control whether Impostors, Crewmates, Neutrals can receive this add-on. Glow Radius : Distance over which Glow affects nearby players. Vision Boost for nearby players : Strength of the vision boost for nearby players. Vision Boost for Glow : Strength of the vision boost for Glow itself.

summary.zh-CN: 从游戏开始就知道所有玩家的职业；普通游戏结束时若仍存活，神会夺取主要胜利。
summary.en: Know all roles from the start; if alive when a normal game end is resolved, God takes the primary win.

search.zh-CN: 神 从游戏开始就知道所有玩家的职业；普通游戏结束时若仍存活，神会夺取主要胜利。 神 神从游戏开始就知道所有玩家的职业。普通游戏结束时若神仍存活，神会取代主要获胜阵营；符合额外胜利条件的玩家仍可能一同获胜。神不会成为恋人。 设置 人数上限 ：一局中可出现的神的数量上限。 会议公布神仍存活 ：开启后，只要神存活，会议中就会公布神仍在场。 可在猜测模式或拥有猜测者附加职业时猜测 ：设置神能否参与猜测。
search.en: God Know all roles from the start; if alive when a normal game end is resolved, God takes the primary win. God God knows every player's role from the beginning. If alive when a normal game end is resolved, God takes the primary win; players who meet separate additional-win conditions may also win. God cannot become a Lover. Settings Maximum number: Maximum number of Gods in a match. Announce God is alive at meetings: When enabled, meetings announce that God is still alive. Can guess: Whether God can use role guessing.

summary.zh-CN: 会议投票指定目标；下一回合，击杀该目标的非内鬼玩家会按设置转为逃亡者或叛徒。
summary.en: Votes to select a target; next round, a non-Impostor who kills the target becomes a Refugee or Madmate, depending on settings.

search.zh-CN: 教父 会议投票指定目标；下一回合，击杀该目标的非内鬼玩家会按设置转为逃亡者或叛徒。 技能 会议中投票指定一名目标。下一回合若非内鬼或叛徒阵营玩家击杀了目标，该玩家会转变为房主设置的职业。击杀目标的内鬼或叛徒队友不会因此转变；再次召开会议会清除尚未处理的目标。 选项 数量上限（Max） ：设置本局最多可有多少名教父。 击杀目标者转变为 ：选择击杀目标的玩家成为逃亡者或叛徒（Madmate）。
search.en: Godfather Votes to select a target; next round, a non-Impostor who kills the target becomes a Refugee or Madmate, depending on settings. Ability Vote for a target during a meeting. In the next round, if a player outside the Impostor and Madmate teams kills the target, that killer changes into the role selected by the host. An Impostor or Madmate who kills the target does not change roles. Another meeting clears an unresolved target. Options Max : Maximum number of Godfathers in a match. Killer Turns Into : Choose whether the eligible killer becomes a Refugee or Madmate.

summary.zh-CN: 死亡时向所有人揭示其角色。
summary.en: Reveals its role to everyone when it dies.

search.zh-CN: 墓碑 死亡时向所有人揭示其角色。 效果 墓碑死亡时，其角色会向所有玩家揭示。 设置 Max（最大数量） ：本局中该附加身份可出现的数量上限。 Spawn Chance（生成概率） ：玩家获得此附加身份的概率。 Eligibility（可分配阵营） ：主持人可分别设置内鬼、船员、中立者是否可以获得此附加身份。
search.en: Gravestone Reveals its role to everyone when it dies. Effect When Gravestone dies, its role is revealed to everyone. Settings Max : Maximum number that can appear in one match. Spawn Chance : Chance for a player to receive this add-on. Eligibility : Separate settings control whether Impostors, Crewmates, Neutrals can receive this add-on.

summary.zh-CN: 奇数次和偶数次击杀使用不同冷却；每次会议后计数重置，下一次击杀重新按奇数计算。
summary.en: Uses separate cooldowns for odd- and even-numbered kills; the count resets at each meeting.

search.zh-CN: 贪婪者 奇数次和偶数次击杀使用不同冷却；每次会议后计数重置，下一次击杀重新按奇数计算。 技能 贪婪者的击杀冷却按击杀次数奇偶交替：第 1、3、5 次等使用奇数次冷却，第 2、4、6 次等使用偶数次冷却。每次会议后击杀计数重置，因此会后第一次击杀总是按奇数次计算。 选项 数量上限（Max） ：设置本局最多可有多少名贪婪者。 奇数次击杀冷却 ：设置第 1、3、5 次等击杀后的冷却。 偶数次击杀冷却 ：设置第 2、4、6 次等击杀后的冷却。
search.en: Greedy Uses separate cooldowns for odd- and even-numbered kills; the count resets at each meeting. Ability The Greedy alternates between cooldowns for odd- and even-numbered kills: kills 1, 3, 5, and so on use the odd cooldown; kills 2, 4, 6, and so on use the even cooldown. The count resets at each meeting, so the first kill afterward always uses the odd cooldown. Options Max : Maximum number of Greedy roles in a match. Odd-Numbered Kill Cooldown : Cooldown after kills 1, 3, 5, and so on. Even-Numbered Kill Cooldown : Cooldown after kills 2, 4, 6, and so on.

summary.zh-CN: 掷雷兵可通过通风口投掷闪光弹，降低受影响玩家的视野；成为叛徒时不会影响非船员。
summary.en: The Grenadier can flash players through vents to reduce their vision; as a Mad Grenadier, the effect does not hinder non-Crew.

search.zh-CN: 掷雷兵 掷雷兵可通过通风口投掷闪光弹，降低受影响玩家的视野；成为叛徒时不会影响非船员。 职业能力 掷雷兵可以通过通风口投掷闪光弹，降低受影响玩家的视野；掷雷兵会看到自己身上出现护盾动画作为提示。成为叛徒掷雷兵时，能力不会妨碍非船员的视野。 设置 数量上限 ：设置一局中掷雷兵的最大人数。 闪光弹冷却 ：设置再次投掷前的等待时间。 闪光弹持续时间 ：设置闪光效果持续多久。 受影响后的视野 ：设置受到闪光弹影响后的视野范围。 可以影响中立阵营 ：开启时中立玩家也会受影响；关闭时只有内鬼会受影响。 初始手雷数量上限 ：设置掷雷兵开局拥有的手雷数量。 每完成一个任务获得的手雷数 ：设置每完成一个任务增加的手雷数，按 0.1 为步进。
search.en: Grenadier The Grenadier can flash players through vents to reduce their vision; as a Mad Grenadier, the effect does not hinder non-Crew. Role The Grenadier can vent to throw a flashbang that reduces affected players' vision. The Grenadier sees a shield animation on themself as a reminder. As a Mad Grenadier, the ability does not hinder non-Crew vision. Settings Maximum count : Sets the maximum number of Grenadiers in a match. Grenade cooldown : Sets how long the Grenadier must wait before flashing players again. Grenade duration : Sets how long the flash effect lasts. Lowered vision : Sets the vision level for players affected by a flash. Can affect Neutrals : ON affects Neutral players; OFF affects only Impostors. Initial maximum grenades : Sets how many grenades the Grenadier starts with. Grenades gained per task : Sets the grenades gained for each completed task, in 0.1 increments.

summary.zh-CN: 守护者完成全部任务后不会被击杀或被猜测为该职业。
summary.en: After completing all tasks, the Guardian cannot be killed or guessed as this role.

search.zh-CN: 守护者 守护者完成全部任务后不会被击杀或被猜测为该职业。 职业能力 守护者完成全部任务后不会被击杀，也不能被猜测为守护者。该效果不阻止会议驱逐。 设置 数量上限 ：设置一局中守护者的最大人数。 自定义守护者任务 ：开启时可单独设置任务；关闭时守护者与其他玩家任务相同。自定义内容包括是否有公共任务，以及长任务、短任务数量。
search.en: Guardian After completing all tasks, the Guardian cannot be killed or guessed as this role. Role After completing all tasks, the Guardian cannot be killed or guessed as the Guardian. This does not prevent ejection. Settings Maximum count : Sets the maximum number of Guardians in a match. Override Guardian tasks : ON allows a separate task setup; OFF gives the Guardian the same tasks as everyone else. The custom setup includes common-task availability and the number of long and short tasks.

summary.zh-CN: 守护天使（TOHE）是可分配给符合条件的死亡玩家的幽灵职业，可为任意阵营目标施加临时护盾；护盾冷却、时长及内鬼能否看到护盾可设置。
summary.en: The Guardian Angel (TOHE) is a ghost role that can be assigned to eligible dead players and can shield a target of any team, with configurable cooldown, duration, and Impostor visibility.

search.zh-CN: 守护天使（TOHE） 守护天使（TOHE）是可分配给符合条件的死亡玩家的幽灵职业，可为任意阵营目标施加临时护盾；护盾冷却、时长及内鬼能否看到护盾可设置。 职业能力 守护天使（TOHE）通过幽灵职业分配规则授予符合条件的死亡玩家，可以为任意阵营的目标施加临时护盾。护盾会在持续时间结束或报告尸体时清除。 设置 数量与生成率 ：由 TOHE 的角色生成选项控制。 守护冷却 ：设置再次使用保护技能前的等待时间。 护盾持续时间 ：设置保护效果可持续多久。 内鬼可看到护盾 ：开启时内鬼能看到守护效果；关闭时看不到。
search.en: Guardian Angel (TOHE) The Guardian Angel (TOHE) is a ghost role that can be assigned to eligible dead players and can shield a target of any team, with configurable cooldown, duration, and Impostor visibility. Role The Guardian Angel (TOHE) is assigned to eligible dead players through the ghost-role assignment rules. It can give a temporary shield to a target of any team. A shield ends when its duration expires or when a body is reported. Settings Count and spawn chance : Controlled by the TOHE role-spawn options. Protect cooldown : Sets how long the Guardian Angel must wait before protecting again. Protection duration : Sets how long each shield lasts. Impostors can see protection : ON lets Impostors see the shield; OFF hides it from them.

summary.zh-CN: 会议中猜测玩家的角色以击杀对方；猜错则自己死亡。
summary.en: Guesses players' roles during meetings to kill them; an incorrect guess kills the Guesser.

search.zh-CN: 赌怪 会议中猜测玩家的角色以击杀对方；猜错则自己死亡。 效果 会议中可猜测玩家的角色并击杀目标；猜错会导致自己死亡。命令格式为 /bt [玩家编号] [角色] 。玩家编号显示在名字前，也可以使用 /id 查看所有玩家编号。 设置 Max（最大数量） ：本局中该附加身份可出现的数量上限。 Spawn Chance（生成概率） ：玩家获得此附加身份的概率。 Eligibility（可分配阵营） ：主持人可分别设置内鬼、船员、中立者是否可以获得此附加身份。 Can guess Add-ons（可猜测附加身份） ：控制玩家公开附加身份后，是否能被赌怪猜测该附加身份。 Can guess Snitch with All Tasks Done（告密者完成任务后仍可被猜） ：控制告密者完成全部任务后、暴露其他玩家前，是否仍能被猜测。 Try to hide guesser's command（尝试隐藏赌怪命令） ：控制模组是否尝试隐藏赌怪使用的命令，避免暴露身份。
search.en: Guesser Guesses players' roles during meetings to kill them; an incorrect guess kills the Guesser. Effect During meetings, guess a player's role to kill them. An incorrect guess kills the Guesser. Use /bt [player id] [role] . A player's ID appears before their name, or use /id to view all player IDs. Settings Max : Maximum number that can be in one match. Spawn Chance : Chance for a player to receive this add-on. Eligibility : Separate settings control whether Impostors, Crewmates, Neutrals can receive this add-on. Can guess Add-ons : Whether add-ons are guessable when a player reveals them. Can guess Snitch with All Tasks Done : Whether players can guess the Snitch after all tasks are completed, before the Snitch exposes them. Try to hide guesser's command : Whether the mod attempts to hide the Guesser's command to avoid revealing them.

summary.zh-CN: 竞猜大师会收到会议中每次职业猜测的信息，包括猜测者尝试猜的职业以及猜错提示。
summary.en: The Guess Master receives information about every role-guess attempt during a meeting, including the guessed role and whether the guess was wrong.

search.zh-CN: 竞猜大师 竞猜大师会收到会议中每次职业猜测的信息，包括猜测者尝试猜的职业以及猜错提示。 职业能力 竞猜大师会收到会议中每次职业猜测的信息，包括猜测者试图猜测的职业；若猜测错误，也会收到通知。 设置 数量上限 ：设置一局中竞猜大师的最大人数。
search.en: Guess Master The Guess Master receives information about every role-guess attempt during a meeting, including the guessed role and whether the guess was wrong. Role The Guess Master receives information about every attempted role guess during a meeting. They learn which role the guesser tried to guess and are notified if the guess was wrong. Settings Maximum count : Sets the maximum number of Guess Masters in a match.

summary.zh-CN: 变形期间可用绞杀击杀；该方式无视防护且不留尸体，也不会触发受害者技能或灵媒提示。
summary.en: While shapeshifted, strangling ignores protections, leaves no body, and does not trigger victim abilities or Seer alerts.

search.zh-CN: 刽子手 变形期间可用绞杀击杀；该方式无视防护且不留尸体，也不会触发受害者技能或灵媒提示。 技能 变形期间使用绞杀击杀。绞杀无视目标状态，例如医护的护盾、保镖或超级巨星的技能；不会留下尸体，也不会触发受害者技能（例如老兵反击、幸运儿存活），灵媒也不会收到提示。 选项 数量上限（Max） ：设置本局最多可有多少名刽子手。 变形冷却 ：设置再次变形并使用绞杀前的等待时间。 变形持续时间 ：设置刽子手保持变形多久。
search.en: Hangman While shapeshifted, strangling ignores protections, leaves no body, and does not trigger victim abilities or Seer alerts. Ability While shapeshifted, the Hangman kills by strangling. Strangling ignores target statuses such as a Medic shield, Bodyguard protection, or Superstar abilities. It leaves no body and does not trigger victim abilities (for example, Veteran retaliation or a Lucky player surviving); Seer receives no alert. Options Max : Maximum number of Hangmen in a match. Shapeshift Cooldown : Time before the Hangman can shapeshift to use the ability again. Shapeshift Duration : How long the Hangman remains shifted.

summary.zh-CN: 以 1 秒冷却击杀设置允许的恋人或转换职业；任一FFF团成功击杀后，所有FFF团玩家即使死亡也会随获胜阵营获胜。
summary.en: Kill eligible Lovers or converted roles with a 1-second cooldown; after any Hater makes a valid kill, all Haters can win with the winning team even if dead.

search.zh-CN: FFF团 以 1 秒冷却击杀设置允许的恋人或转换职业；任一FFF团成功击杀后，所有FFF团玩家即使死亡也会随获胜阵营获胜。 FFF团 FFF团的击杀冷却为 1 秒，只能击杀恋人及设置允许的招募职业或附加职业。击杀其他目标会导致FFF团自杀；开启误杀击杀目标后，误杀时目标也会死亡。任一FFF团成功击杀符合条件的目标后，所有FFF团玩家都会在游戏结束时随获胜阵营获胜，无论自己是否存活。FFF团不会成为恋人。 设置 误杀时击杀目标 ：开启后，误杀时也会击杀目标；关闭后只会使FFF团自杀。 指定可击杀的转换职业 ：开启后，可选择可击杀的类别：叛徒类、魅惑类、恋人、豺狼阵营、利己主义者、感染者阵营、病毒阵营和仰慕者。关闭后允许击杀所有符合条件的转换/招募职业。
search.en: Hater Kill eligible Lovers or converted roles with a 1-second cooldown; after any Hater makes a valid kill, all Haters can win with the winning team even if dead. Hater The Hater has a 1-second kill cooldown and can kill Lovers and the recruited roles or addons allowed by the settings. Killing an invalid target makes the Hater suicide; when the misfire option is enabled, the target also dies. After any Hater makes a valid kill, all Hater players join the winning team at game end, whether alive or dead. The Hater cannot become a Lover. Settings Kill target on misfire: When enabled, also kill the target on a misfire; otherwise, only the Hater dies. Select converted roles Hater can kill: When enabled, choose Madmate, Charmed, Lovers, Jackal team, Egoist, Infected team, Virus team, and Admirer. When disabled, all eligible recruited or converted roles can be killed.

summary.zh-CN: 猎鹰可以有限次数地尝试击杀玩家，但有概率失手；对同一目标多次出手会提高成功率。
summary.en: The Hawk can attempt a limited number of kills but may miss; repeated attacks against the same target increase the chance of success.

search.zh-CN: 猎鹰 猎鹰可以有限次数地尝试击杀玩家，但有概率失手；对同一目标多次出手会提高成功率。 职业能力 猎鹰可以击杀有限数量的玩家，但每次都有概率失手；对同一玩家多次出手会提高成功率。 设置 击杀冷却 ：设置猎鹰再次尝试击杀前的等待时间。 切击次数上限 ：设置猎鹰最多可进行的切击（击杀）次数。 失手机率 ：设置猎鹰击杀失手的概率。 击杀所需的存活人数下限 ：设置猎鹰能够尝试击杀时场上至少需要存活多少人。 船员被转换时增加击杀次数 ：开启时，报告尸体时若转换人数增加，猎鹰会尝试提高切击次数上限；当前源码先更新计数再计算增量，可能少加一次，不能保证每名新转换的船员都增加一次；关闭时不增加。
search.en: Hawk The Hawk can attempt a limited number of kills but may miss; repeated attacks against the same target increase the chance of success. Role The Hawk can kill a limited number of players, but each attempt may miss. Repeatedly attacking the same player increases the chance of success. Settings Kill cooldown : Sets how long the Hawk must wait before trying to kill again. Maximum slices : Sets the maximum number of slices (kill attempts) the Hawk can make. Chance to miss : Sets the chance that a kill attempt misses. Minimum players alive to kill : Sets how many players must be alive for the Hawk to attempt a kill. Increase kill count when a Crewmate is converted : ON attempts to raise the maximum slices when a body is reported and the converted-player count has increased. The current source updates its counter before calculating the bonus, so it can undercount and does not reliably add one use per newly converted Crewmate; OFF does not add uses.

summary.zh-CN: 可切换击杀与下咒模式；会议结束时，若巫师存活，被下咒的玩家会死亡。
summary.en: Switch between killing and hexing; hexed players die after a meeting if the Hex Master is still alive.

search.zh-CN: 巫师 可切换击杀与下咒模式；会议结束时，若巫师存活，被下咒的玩家会死亡。 巫师 巫师可以切换击杀与下咒模式。下咒效果与女巫的法术相同；会议期间，下咒目标会显示标记。会议结束时，若巫师仍存活，被下咒的玩家会死亡。每次会议后，下咒目标会清除。 设置 切换模式方式 ：设置切换击杀/下咒模式的操作方式。 下咒显示为法术 ：开启后，下咒标记显示为法术样式；关闭后显示巫师专属标记。 内鬼视野 ：设置巫师是否拥有内鬼视野。
search.en: Hex Master Switch between killing and hexing; hexed players die after a meeting if the Hex Master is still alive. Hex Master The Hex Master can switch between killing and hexing. Hexing works like a Witch's spell; hexed players are marked during meetings and die at the end of a meeting if the Hex Master is still alive. Hex marks are cleared after each meeting. Settings Switch action via: Choose how to switch between kill and hex modes. Hexes look like spells: When enabled, hex marks use the spell appearance; otherwise, they use the Hex Master's mark. Impostor vision: Whether the Hex Master has Impostor vision.

summary.zh-CN: 击杀目标会永久缩短击杀冷却，击杀其他玩家则会永久延长冷却。
summary.en: Killing a target permanently reduces the kill cooldown; killing someone else permanently increases it.

search.zh-CN: 猎人 击杀目标会永久缩短击杀冷却，击杀其他玩家则会永久延长冷却。 猎人 猎人会获得一组目标，目标名字以彩色显示，并在每次会议后重置。猎人击杀目标会永久缩短击杀冷却；击杀非目标玩家则会永久延长冷却。 设置 初始击杀冷却 ：猎人的基础击杀冷却。 击杀目标后减少冷却 ：击杀目标后，击杀冷却减少的时长。 击杀其他玩家后增加冷却 ：击杀非目标后，击杀冷却增加的时长。 可使用通风口 ：设置猎人能否使用通风口。 内鬼视野 ：开启后拥有内鬼视野；关闭后使用默认视野。 目标数量 ：猎人每轮获得的目标数量。 最高击杀冷却 ：猎人击杀冷却的上限。 最低击杀冷却 ：猎人击杀冷却的下限。
search.en: Huntsman Killing a target permanently reduces the kill cooldown; killing someone else permanently increases it. Huntsman The Huntsman receives a set of targets. Their names appear in color, and the target list resets after each meeting. Killing a target permanently reduces the kill cooldown; killing someone who is not a target permanently increases it. Settings Kill cooldown: The Huntsman's base kill cooldown. Cooldown decrease for killing a target: Amount the cooldown decreases after killing a target. Cooldown increase for killing others: Amount the cooldown increases after killing someone who is not a target. Can vent: Whether the Huntsman can use vents. Impostor vision: When enabled, the Huntsman has Impostor vision; otherwise, they have default vision. Number of targets: Number of targets assigned to the Huntsman. Maximum kill cooldown: Upper limit for the Huntsman's kill cooldown. Minimum kill cooldown: Lower limit for the Huntsman's kill cooldown.

summary.zh-CN: 必须完成全部任务才能随队伍获胜，未完成则落败；设置可控制其开局分配与招募。
summary.en: Must complete all tasks to win with its team or loses; settings govern assignment and recruitment.

search.zh-CN: 焦急者 必须完成全部任务才能随队伍获胜，未完成则落败；设置可控制其开局分配与招募。 效果 焦急者必须完成全部任务才能随所属队伍获胜；如果没有完成任务则会输掉游戏。该附加身份会尽可能避免玩家先被转化为叛徒、魅魔小弟等身份。 设置 Max（最大数量） ：本局中该附加身份可出现的数量上限。 Spawn Chance（生成概率） ：玩家获得此附加身份的概率。 Madmate can be Hurried on game start（Madmate 可在开局获得 Hurried） ：控制叛徒能否在游戏开始时获得焦急者。 Task based Crewmates can be Hurried（任务型 Crewmate 可获得 Hurried） ：控制能力通过执行或完成任务触发的船员角色能否获得焦急者。 Hurried can be recruited in game (excludes madmate)（游戏中可招募 Hurried（不含 Madmate）） ：控制焦急者船员能否被魅魔、豺狼等招募型角色在游戏中招募；不包括叛徒。
search.en: Hurried Must complete all tasks to win with its team or loses; settings govern assignment and recruitment. Effect A player with Hurried must finish all tasks to win with their team; otherwise they lose. Hurried also tries to ensure the player is not converted to a Madmate, Charmed, or similar role first. Settings Max : Maximum number that can appear in one match. Spawn Chance : Chance for a player to receive this add-on. Madmate can be Hurried on game start : Whether Madmates can receive Hurried at game start. Task based Crewmates can be Hurried : Whether Crewmate roles whose abilities activate through doing or completing tasks can receive Hurried. Hurried can be recruited in game (excludes madmate) : Whether Hurried Crewmates can be recruited by Cultist, Jackal, and other recruiting roles; this excludes Madmates.

summary.zh-CN: 每局可用一次击杀按钮效仿玩家；根据目标职业转变为警长、逃亡者、指定职业或不兼容中立职业的替代职业。
summary.en: Use the kill button once to imitate a player; depending on the target, become a Sheriff, Refugee, a supported copied role, or the fallback for a designated incompatible Neutral role.

search.zh-CN: 效仿者 每局可用一次击杀按钮效仿玩家；根据目标职业转变为警长、逃亡者、指定职业或不兼容中立职业的替代职业。 效仿者 效仿者每局只有一次效仿机会。使用击杀按钮后，若目标是船员会变为警长，若目标是内鬼会变为逃亡者。效仿者还可以直接变为代码支持的职业（豺狼、巫师、毒师、主宰、嗜血骑士或警长）。代码列出的另一组中立职业会使用设置指定的替代职业；不在处理列表中的职业不会触发转变，效仿机会也不会消耗。 设置 人数上限 ：一局中可出现的效仿者数量上限。 效仿冷却 ：再次效仿玩家前的等待时间。 不兼容中立职业的替代职业 ：目标职业与效仿者不兼容时，选择效仿者转变为失忆者、效仿者、起诉人、赌徒或独行者。
search.en: Imitator Use the kill button once to imitate a player; depending on the target, become a Sheriff, Refugee, a supported copied role, or the fallback for a designated incompatible Neutral role. Imitator The Imitator has one use per game. Using the kill button on a Crewmate changes the Imitator into a Sheriff; using it on an Impostor changes them into a Refugee. The Imitator can also copy supported roles directly (Jackal, Hex Master, Poisoner, Juggernaut, Blood Knight, or Sheriff). A separate listed group of Neutral roles uses the fallback selected in the settings. Roles outside the handled lists do not trigger a transformation or consume the use. Settings Maximum number: Maximum number of Imitators in a match. Imitate cooldown: Time before imitating another player. Role for an incompatible Neutral: If the target's role is incompatible, choose whether the Imitator becomes an Amnesiac, Imitator, Pursuer, Follower, or Maverick.

summary.zh-CN: 击杀所有船员；可以发动破坏并使用通风口。
summary.en: Kills the Crewmates and can sabotage and use vents.

search.zh-CN: 内鬼 击杀所有船员；可以发动破坏并使用通风口。 技能 内鬼的目标是击杀所有船员，可以发动破坏并使用通风口。 选项 数量上限（Max） ：设置本局最多可有多少名内鬼。
search.en: Impostor Kills the Crewmates and can sabotage and use vents. Ability The Impostor’s goal is to kill the Crewmates. It can sabotage and use vents. Options Max : Maximum number of Impostors in a match.

summary.zh-CN: 由感染者转化获得；感染者被驱逐时，存活的感染会全部死亡。
summary.en: Converted by Infectious; all living Infected players die if Infectious is exiled.

search.zh-CN: 感染 由感染者转化获得；感染者被驱逐时，存活的感染会全部死亡。 效果 感染者可将符合条件的船员、内鬼或中立击杀者转化为感染。感染与感染者同属感染阵营并一同获胜；若感染者被投出，所有存活的感染都会死亡。此身份不会独立随机分配。 相关设置 Infectious bite settings（感染者咬合设置） ：感染者设置控制咬合次数、阵营成员的互相识别、通风口与视野，以及是否启用双击击杀。 随机分配 ：不会开局随机分配；由上述赋予者能力转化获得。
search.en: Infected Converted by Infectious; all living Infected players die if Infectious is exiled. Effect Infectious can convert eligible Crewmates, Impostors, or Neutral Killers into Infected. Infected players share Infectious's team and win together; if Infectious is exiled, all living Infected players die. This identity is not independently assigned at random. Related settings Infectious bite settings : Infectious settings control bite uses, who knows the infected players, ventilation and vision, and whether double-click killing is enabled. Random assignment : Not assigned at random at game start; it is granted by the conversion ability described above.

summary.zh-CN: 感染可转换的船员、内鬼和中立杀手以扩大感染阵营；内鬼消失后，若感染者阵营是唯一计数中立阵营且人数不少于船员，即可获胜。
summary.en: Infect eligible Crewmates, Impostors, and Neutral Killers to build an infected team; after Impostors are gone, win at parity when it is the only counted Neutral team.

search.zh-CN: 感染者 感染可转换的船员、内鬼和中立杀手以扩大感染阵营；内鬼消失后，若感染者阵营是唯一计数中立阵营且人数不少于船员，即可获胜。 感染者 感染者使用击杀按钮感染符合条件的船员、内鬼或中立杀手，感染次数有限。不能被感染的目标会被正常击杀（已感染者除外）。内鬼阵营消失后，若感染者是唯一存活的计数中立阵营且人数不少于船员，即可获胜。如果感染者死亡，所有被感染者会在下一次会议后死亡；若感染者在此之前已满足获胜条件，仍可获胜。启用双击击杀后，可双击击杀目标。 设置 感染冷却 ：再次感染玩家前的等待时间。 感染次数上限 ：感染者可感染玩家的次数。 知道被感染玩家职业 ：开启后，感染者可以看到被感染玩家的职业。 被感染者互相认识 ：开启后，被感染者可以看到彼此。 内鬼视野 ：开启后拥有内鬼视野；关闭后不拥有内鬼视野。 可使用通风口 ：设置感染者能否使用通风口。 双击击杀目标 ：开启后，双击可击杀目标。
search.en: Infectious Infect eligible Crewmates, Impostors, and Neutral Killers to build an infected team; after Impostors are gone, win at parity when it is the only counted Neutral team. Infectious The Infectious uses the kill button to infect eligible Crewmates, Impostors, and Neutral Killers, with a limited number of infections. A target who cannot be infected is killed normally, except for a player who is already Infected. After Impostors are gone, the Infectious wins when it is the only surviving counted Neutral team and its count is at least the Crewmate count. If the Infectious dies, Infected players die after the next meeting; the Infectious can still win if the parity condition is reached before then. When double-click killing is enabled, double-clicking kills the target. Settings Infect cooldown: Time before infecting another player. Maximum infections: Number of players the Infectious can infect. Know infected players' roles: Whether the Infectious sees the roles of infected players. Infected players know each other: Whether infected players can see other infected players. Impostor vision: Whether the Infectious has Impostor vision. Can vent: Whether the Infectious can use vents. Double click to kill: When enabled, double-clicking can kill the target.

summary.zh-CN: 有明确领先者时，投票会改投给该玩家，会议界面也会显示改投后的目标。
summary.en: When there is a clear leader, its vote is redirected to that player and the meeting display shows the redirected target.

search.zh-CN: 影响者 有明确领先者时，投票会改投给该玩家，会议界面也会显示改投后的目标。 效果 系统会先计算不含影响者投票的票数；若有唯一领先者，影响者会改投给该玩家，会议界面也会显示改投后的目标。若最高票平票，或所有存活玩家都是影响者，则不会改投。 设置 Max（最大数量） ：本局中该附加身份可出现的数量上限。 Spawn Chance（生成概率） ：玩家获得此附加身份的概率。 Eligibility（可分配阵营） ：主持人可分别设置内鬼、船员、中立者是否可以获得此附加身份。
search.en: Influenced When there is a clear leader, its vote is redirected to that player and the meeting display shows the redirected target. Effect The game first calculates votes without the Influenced players' votes. If one player has the most votes, Influenced votes are redirected to that player and the meeting display shows the redirected target. A tied lead or a lobby where every living player is Influenced prevents redirection. Settings Max : Maximum number that can appear in one match. Spawn Chance : Chance for a player to receive this add-on. Eligibility : Separate settings control whether Impostors, Crewmates, Neutrals can receive this add-on.

summary.zh-CN: 重大破坏进行期间不能击杀，其他时间可以击杀。
summary.en: Cannot kill during a critical sabotage; can kill at other times.

search.zh-CN: 抑郁者 重大破坏进行期间不能击杀，其他时间可以击杀。 技能 重大破坏进行期间不能使用击杀键，例如反应堆、实验室、生命维持系统或直升机破坏；破坏解除后可正常击杀。 选项 数量上限（Max） ：设置本局最多可有多少名抑郁者。 击杀冷却 ：设置击杀冷却。
search.en: Inhibitor Cannot kill during a critical sabotage; can kill at other times. Ability The Inhibitor cannot use the kill button while a critical sabotage is active, such as Reactor, Laboratory, Life Support, or Helicopter sabotage. It can kill normally after the sabotage is resolved. Options Max : Maximum number of Inhibitors in a match. Kill Cooldown : Time before the Inhibitor can kill again.

summary.zh-CN: 用击杀按钮栽赃玩家，目标会立即杀死冤罪师；目标被投票放逐时获胜。
summary.en: Frame a player with the kill button, causing them to kill the Innocent; win if the target is voted out.

search.zh-CN: 冤罪师 用击杀按钮栽赃玩家，目标会立即杀死冤罪师；目标被投票放逐时获胜。 冤罪师 冤罪师可以使用击杀按钮栽赃任意玩家。被栽赃的目标会立即杀死冤罪师。若目标在会议中被投票放逐，冤罪师获胜；若目标是内鬼，只有开启对应选项后冤罪师才会获胜。 小丑、处刑人和冤罪师可以同时获胜。 设置 人数上限 ：一局中可出现的冤罪师数量上限。 栽赃内鬼后与其一同获胜 ：开启后，冤罪师栽赃内鬼时可以与该内鬼一起获胜；关闭后不会与内鬼共同获胜。
search.en: Innocent Frame a player with the kill button, causing them to kill the Innocent; win if the target is voted out. Innocent The Innocent can use the kill button to frame any player. The framed target immediately kills the Innocent. The Innocent wins if the target is voted out in a meeting; if the target is an Impostor, this win requires the corresponding setting. The Jester, Executioner, and Innocent can win together. Settings Maximum number: Maximum number of Innocents in a match. Win with framed Impostor: When enabled, the Innocent and an Impostor win together if the Innocent framed that Impostor.

summary.zh-CN: 检查员可用 /cmp 比较两名玩家是否属于同一阵营，中立和转换阵营角色按规则归类。
summary.en: The Inspector compares two players' team alignment with /cmp, using special rules for Neutrals and converted roles.

search.zh-CN: 检查员 检查员可用 /cmp 比较两名玩家是否属于同一阵营，中立和转换阵营角色按规则归类。 职业能力 检查员可检查两名玩家是否属于同一阵营，并收到肯定或否定结果。所有中立玩家和已转换阵营的玩家按同一阵营计算；骗术师算作船员，流氓算作内鬼。 检查指令：/cmp [玩家 ID 1] [玩家 ID 2] 设置 数量上限 ：设置一局中检查员的最大人数。 隐藏检查员指令 ：开启时，模组会尝试隐藏检查员的检查指令；关闭时指令会对其他玩家可见。 每局检查次数上限 ：设置每局可使用的最大检查次数。 每次会议检查次数上限 ：设置每次会议可使用的最大检查次数。 诱饵首次会议揭示职业计为已揭示 ：开启时，诱饵在第一次会议揭示职业会按已揭示处理；关闭时不计为揭示。 目标知道自己受检 ：开启时两名目标会知道自己受到检查；关闭时不会。 目标知道自己与谁一起受检 ：开启时目标会知道另一名受检者；关闭时不会。 完成任务后目标知道另一名目标的阵营 ：开启时任务完成后目标会收到另一名受检者的阵营；关闭时不提供此信息。 每完成一个任务获得的检查次数 ：设置每完成一个任务增加的次数，按 0.1 为步进。 自定义检查员任务 ：开启时可为检查员单独设置任务数量，包含公共任务、长任务和短任务选项；关闭时任务数量与其他玩家相同。
search.en: Inspector The Inspector compares two players' team alignment with /cmp, using special rules for Neutrals and converted roles. Role The Inspector checks whether two players are on the same team and receives an affirmative or negative result. All Neutrals and converted players count as the same team. Trickster counts as Crew, and Rascal counts as Impostor. Check command: /cmp [player ID 1] [player ID 2] Settings Maximum count : Sets the maximum number of Inspectors in a match. Hide Inspector commands : ON makes the mod attempt to hide the Inspector's check commands; OFF leaves them visible to other players. Maximum inspections per game : Sets the total number of checks allowed per game. Maximum inspections per meeting : Sets how many checks are allowed in each meeting. Bait reveal on first meeting counts as revealed role : ON counts Bait's first-meeting reveal as a role reveal; OFF does not. Targets know they were checked : ON notifies both checked targets; OFF keeps the check hidden from them. Targets know who they were checked with : ON reveals the other checked target; OFF does not. Reveal the other target's team after tasks : ON reveals the other target's team after task completion; OFF does not. Ability uses gained per task : Sets additional checks per completed task, in 0.1 increments. Override Inspector tasks : ON allows a separate task setup, including common-task availability and long and short task counts; OFF gives the Inspector the same task count as everyone else.

summary.zh-CN: 只要教唆者存活，投票放逐无辜船员后，投票给该玩家的额外船员会在会后死亡。
summary.en: While alive, causes additional Crewmates who voted for an innocent player to die after that player is voted out.

search.zh-CN: 教唆者 只要教唆者存活，投票放逐无辜船员后，投票给该玩家的额外船员会在会后死亡。 技能 只要教唆者仍存活，每当会议投票放逐一名无辜船员，投票给该玩家的额外船员会在会议结束后死亡。额外死亡人数由房主设置。 选项 数量上限（Max） ：设置本局最多可有多少名教唆者。 击杀冷却 ：设置击杀冷却。 技能使用次数 ：设置可使用技能的次数。 每次技能击杀人数 ：设置每次技能使用可造成的击杀人数。
search.en: Instigator While alive, causes additional Crewmates who voted for an innocent player to die after that player is voted out. Ability While the Instigator is alive, whenever an innocent Crewmate is voted out, additional Crewmates who voted for that player die after the meeting. The host sets how many additional players die. Options Max : Maximum number of Instigators in a match. Kill Cooldown : Time before the Instigator can kill again. Ability Use Count : Number of times the ability can be used. Kills per Ability Use : Number of kills caused by each use.

summary.zh-CN: 研究者用击杀按钮调查目标，目标是否拥有击杀按钮会分别显示为红名或浅蓝名。
summary.en: The Investigator uses the kill button to inspect a target, whose name appears red or light blue depending on whether they have a kill button.

search.zh-CN: 研究者 研究者用击杀按钮调查目标，目标是否拥有击杀按钮会分别显示为红名或浅蓝名。 职业能力 研究者对玩家使用击杀按钮调查目标。拥有击杀按钮的目标会显示红名；没有击杀按钮的目标会显示浅蓝名。名字颜色会在会议召开时恢复正常。 设置 调查冷却 ：设置研究者再次调查前的等待时间。 调查次数上限 ：设置研究者最多可调查的次数。 每局调查次数上限 ：设置一局中最多可调查的次数。 每轮调查次数上限 ：设置两次会议之间最多可调查的次数；会议后本轮次数重置。
search.en: Investigator The Investigator uses the kill button to inspect a target, whose name appears red or light blue depending on whether they have a kill button. Role The Investigator uses the kill button on a player to investigate them. A target with a kill button appears red; a target without one appears light blue. Name colors return to normal when a meeting is called. Settings Investigation cooldown : Sets how long the Investigator must wait before investigating again. Maximum investigations : Sets the total number of investigations per game. Maximum investigations per round : Sets how many investigations can be made between meetings; the round limit resets after a meeting.

summary.zh-CN: 可击杀并招募跟班；仅剩豺狼与船员阵营且豺狼人数不少于船员时获胜。
