summary.en: Kill and recruit Sidekicks; win when only the Jackal and Crew remain and the Jackal team is at least as large as Crew.

search.zh-CN: 豺狼 可击杀并招募跟班；仅剩豺狼与船员阵营且豺狼人数不少于船员时获胜。 豺狼 豺狼可以击杀玩家。仅剩豺狼阵营与船员阵营，且豺狼阵营人数不少于船员时，豺狼获胜。豺狼可使用击杀按钮招募玩家；根据招募模式，目标会成为跟班或获得招募附加职业。若没有可招募目标或次数用尽，击杀按钮会正常击杀。豺狼可按设置使用破坏、通风口和内鬼视野。 设置 击杀冷却 ：再次击杀前的等待时间。 可使用通风口 / 破坏 / 内鬼视野 ：分别设置豺狼是否能使用通风口、发动破坏或拥有内鬼视野。 内鬼全部死亡后可通过破坏获胜 ：开启后，内鬼全部死亡时以破坏结束游戏可使豺狼获胜。 其他玩家被击杀时重置冷却 ：开启后，其他玩家击杀第三方目标时重置豺狼冷却；可设置重置后的冷却时间。 豺狼可击杀跟班 ：设置豺狼能否击杀自己的跟班。 可招募跟班 ：开启后可设置招募人数上限、招募分配模式（跟班与招募附加职业、仅跟班、仅招募附加职业），以及跟班的击杀冷却、通风口和破坏权限。 跟班可击杀豺狼 / 其他跟班 ：分别设置跟班能否击杀豺狼和其他跟班。 跟班计入阵营 ：设置跟班计为豺狼阵营、不计入人数或计为原阵营。
search.en: Jackal Kill and recruit Sidekicks; win when only the Jackal and Crew remain and the Jackal team is at least as large as Crew. Jackal The Jackal can kill players. The Jackal team wins when only it and Crew remain and the Jackal team is at least as large as the Crew. The Jackal can use the kill button to recruit players. Depending on the assignment mode, a target becomes a Sidekick or receives the Recruit addon. If no eligible target is available or recruit uses are exhausted, the button kills normally. Settings can also allow sabotage, venting, and Impostor vision. Settings Kill cooldown: Time before the Jackal can kill again. Can vent / sabotage / Impostor vision: Whether the Jackal can use vents, sabotage, or have Impostor vision. Can win by sabotage when no Impostors are alive: When enabled, ending the game with sabotage after all Impostors are dead gives the Jackal the win. Reset kill cooldown when another player gets killed: When enabled, a third-party kill resets the Jackal's cooldown; configure the cooldown applied on reset. Jackal can kill Sidekick: Whether the Jackal can kill their Sidekicks. Can recruit Sidekicks: When enabled, configure the recruit limit, assignment mode (Sidekick and Recruit addon, Sidekick only, or Recruit addon only), and Sidekick kill cooldown, vent access, and sabotage access. Sidekick can kill Jackal / other Sidekicks: Separately allow Sidekicks to kill the Jackal and other Sidekicks. Sidekick count mode: Count Sidekicks as Jackal, as no team, or as their original team.

summary.zh-CN: 狱警用击杀按钮监禁玩家，使其下一次会议无法投票或被投票；狱警可投票处决囚犯。处决不属于已启用类别或内鬼阵营的目标后，会失去剩余处决次数。
summary.en: The Jailer confines a player so they cannot vote or be voted in the next meeting, and can execute prisoners. Executing a target outside the enabled categories and Impostor team consumes all remaining execution uses.

search.zh-CN: 狱警 狱警用击杀按钮监禁玩家，使其下一次会议无法投票或被投票；狱警可投票处决囚犯。处决不属于已启用类别或内鬼阵营的目标后，会失去剩余处决次数。 职业能力 狱警使用击杀按钮将玩家关进监狱。被监禁者在下一次会议中不能投票，也不能被其他人投票（其票数为 0）。狱警可以投票处决囚犯；若处决无辜玩家，狱警在本局剩余时间内会失去处决能力。狱警的处决次数有限。 被监禁者不能被职业猜测或法官审判；若被监禁者能进行猜测，则只能猜测狱警。狱警在有剩余次数时投票给囚犯，就会在会议后处决目标；类别设置不会阻止这次处决，只决定目标类别是否能保留剩余次数。不属于已启用类别或内鬼阵营的目标仍会被处决，但狱警的剩余次数会全部清零。 设置 数量上限 ：设置一局中狱警的最大人数。 监禁冷却 ：设置再次监禁玩家前的等待时间。 处决次数上限 ：设置狱警最多可以处决的次数。 处决后保留友善中立/混乱中立/邪恶中立/带刀中立/灾厄中立次数 ：分别设置处决对应中立类别后是否保留剩余次数；未启用的类别仍会被处决，但会清空剩余次数。 处决后保留带刀船员次数 ：处决带刀船员后是否保留剩余次数；未启用时目标仍会被处决，但会清空剩余次数。 会议开始时通知被监禁者 ：开启时会议开始会通知囚犯；关闭时不通知。
search.en: Jailer The Jailer confines a player so they cannot vote or be voted in the next meeting, and can execute prisoners. Executing a target outside the enabled categories and Impostor team consumes all remaining execution uses. Role The Jailer uses the kill button to put a player in jail. During the next meeting, the jailed player cannot vote or be voted for, and their vote count is zero. The Jailer may execute a prisoner by voting for them. If they execute an innocent player, they lose the ability to execute for the rest of the game. Executions are limited. Jailed players cannot be guessed or judged. If a jailed player can guess, they can guess only the Jailer. If the Jailer has an execution use and votes for the prisoner, the target is executed after the meeting. Category settings do not block that execution; they determine whether uses remain afterward. A target outside the enabled categories and Impostor team is still executed, but the Jailer loses all remaining uses. Settings Maximum count : Sets the maximum number of Jailers in a match. Jail cooldown : Sets how long the Jailer must wait before jailing someone again. Maximum executions : Sets how many times the Jailer can execute. Preserve executions after Neutral Benign / Neutral Chaos / Neutral Evil / Neutral Killing / Neutral Apocalypse : Each setting controls whether uses remain after executing that Neutral category; a disabled category is still executed but clears the remaining uses. Preserve executions after Crew Killing : Controls whether uses remain after executing a Killing Crewmate; a disabled category is still executed but clears the remaining uses. Notify jailed player when meeting starts : ON notifies jailed players when the meeting begins; OFF does not.

summary.zh-CN: 满足会议数要求后被投票放逐即可获胜；可与某些目标相关职业同时获胜。
summary.en: Win when voted out after the required meetings; can share the result with certain target-related roles.

search.zh-CN: 小丑 满足会议数要求后被投票放逐即可获胜；可与某些目标相关职业同时获胜。 小丑 小丑达到房主设置的会议数要求后被投票放逐时获胜；游戏结束时仍存活则不会获得小丑胜利。若处刑人正在追逐被放逐的小丑，处刑人也可同时获胜；无辜者若被该小丑放逐，也可同时获胜。 设置 人数上限 ：一局中可出现的小丑数量上限。 可召开紧急会议 ：设置小丑能否召开会议。 可使用通风口 ：设置小丑能否使用通风口。 进入通风口后不能移动 ：开启后，小丑在通风口中不能移动；该选项在Dleks地图不稳定。 内鬼视野 ：设置小丑是否拥有内鬼视野。 隐藏投票 ：设置小丑的投票是否对其他玩家隐藏。 获胜所需会议数 ：小丑获胜前必须经过的会议数。 放逐时公开身份 ：设置小丑被放逐时是否公开职业。 阳光开朗大男孩替换概率 ：设置隐藏角色阳光开朗大男孩替换小丑的概率。
search.en: Jester Win when voted out after the required meetings; can share the result with certain target-related roles. Jester The Jester wins when voted out after the configured number of meetings; surviving to the end does not grant a Jester win. An Executioner targeting the exiled Jester can also win, and an Innocent whose target is the exiled Jester can share that result. Settings Maximum number: Maximum number of Jesters in a match. Can call emergency meetings: Whether the Jester can call a meeting. Can vent: Whether the Jester can use vents. Cannot move on vents: When enabled, the Jester cannot move while in a vent; this is unstable on the Dleks map. Impostor vision: Whether the Jester has Impostor vision. Hide vote: Whether the Jester's vote is hidden from other players. Meetings needed for win: Number of meetings required before the Jester can win by ejection. Reveal upon eject: Whether the Jester's role is revealed when ejected. Sunnyboy chance: Probability that the hidden role Sunnyboy replaces the Jester.

summary.zh-CN: 受到攻击时可用有限次数的厄运反击；内鬼阵营消灭后按中立平衡条件获胜。
summary.en: Counter eligible attacks with limited jinxes; win under the neutral parity rule after the Impostors are gone.

search.zh-CN: 扫把星 受到攻击时可用有限次数的厄运反击；内鬼阵营消灭后按中立平衡条件获胜。 扫把星 扫把星受到符合条件的击杀攻击时，会消耗一次厄运次数并取消这次攻击。开启对应选项后，攻击者也会被反杀；变为瘟疫等天启职业的攻击者不会触发反击。扫把星不必成为最后的幸存者：内鬼全部死亡后，若存活的计数中立玩家属于同一计数类型，且计数中立人数不少于船员，中立阵营即可获胜。 设置 击杀冷却 ：扫把星再次击杀前的等待时间。 可使用通风口 ：设置扫把星能否使用通风口。 内鬼视野 ：设置扫把星是否拥有内鬼视野。 厄运次数 ：扫把星可反击的次数。 能力尚有次数时击杀攻击者 ：设置扫把星能否在能力次数未耗尽时击杀攻击者。
search.en: Jinx Counter eligible attacks with limited jinxes; win under the neutral parity rule after the Impostors are gone. Jinx An eligible kill attempt against the Jinx consumes one limited jinx charge and is canceled. When the corresponding option is enabled, the attacker is also killed. Attacks from transformed Apocalypse roles bypass the counter. The Jinx does not need to be the last player alive: after all Impostors are gone, the standard neutral end check awards the win when all living counted neutrals share one count type and their total is at least the Crew count. Settings Kill cooldown: Time before the Jinx can kill again. Can vent: Whether the Jinx can use vents. Impostor vision: Whether the Jinx has Impostor vision. Jinx spell count: Number of jinxes available. Kill attacker while ability remains: Whether the Jinx kills the attacker while ability uses remain.

summary.zh-CN: 正义法官在会议中审判玩家，若目标符合邪恶条件则将其击杀，否则法官自杀。
summary.en: During a meeting, the Judge trials a player and kills them if they meet the configured Evil criteria; otherwise the Judge dies.

search.zh-CN: 正义法官 正义法官在会议中审判玩家，若目标符合邪恶条件则将其击杀，否则法官自杀。 职业能力 正义法官可在会议中审判一名玩家。若目标符合房主设置的邪恶条件，目标会被击杀；否则正义法官会自杀。使用指令：/tl [玩家 ID]。玩家 ID 显示在名字旁，也可输入 /id 查看。 设置 数量上限 ：设置一局中正义法官的最大人数。 每次会议审判次数上限 ：设置正义法官每次会议最多能审判多少人。 每局审判次数上限 ：设置正义法官一局中最多能审判多少人。 可审判的附加职业 ：分别设置是否可审判叛徒、魅惑者、跟班、感染者和传染者；对每一种，开启允许审判，关闭时若尝试审判该目标，正义法官会自杀。 可审判的职业类别 ：分别设置是否可审判带刀船员、友善中立、邪恶中立、混乱中立、带刀中立和灾厄中立；对每一类，关闭时若尝试审判该类别，正义法官会自杀。 隐藏正义法官指令 ：开启时模组会尝试隐藏 /tl 指令；关闭时不尝试隐藏。
search.en: Judge During a meeting, the Judge trials a player and kills them if they meet the configured Evil criteria; otherwise the Judge dies. Role During a meeting, the Judge can trial a player. If the target meets the host-configured Evil criteria, the target is killed; otherwise the Judge dies. Use /tl [player ID] to trial. IDs appear next to player names or can be listed with /id. Settings Maximum count : Sets the maximum number of Judges in a match. Maximum trials per meeting : Sets how many players the Judge can trial in each meeting. Maximum trials per game : Sets how many trials the Judge can make in the entire game. Can trial add-ons : Separate toggles control Madmates, Charmed, Sidekicks, Infected, and Contagious. ON allows that target to be tried; OFF makes the Judge die if they attempt it. Can trial role categories : Separate toggles control Crewmate Killing, Neutral Benign, Neutral Evil, Neutral Chaos, Neutral Killing, and Neutral Apocalypse. ON allows that category to be tried; OFF makes the Judge die if they attempt it. Hide Judge commands : ON makes the mod attempt to hide /tl commands; OFF does not.

summary.zh-CN: 每次击杀都会缩短击杀冷却；内鬼阵营消灭后按中立平衡条件获胜。
summary.en: Each kill reduces the kill cooldown; win under the neutral parity rule after the Impostors are gone.

search.zh-CN: 天启 每次击杀都会缩短击杀冷却；内鬼阵营消灭后按中立平衡条件获胜。 天启 天启的击杀冷却会随着每次击杀逐步缩短。天启不必成为最后的幸存者：内鬼全部死亡后，若存活的计数中立玩家属于同一计数类型，且计数中立人数不少于船员，中立阵营即可获胜。 设置 初始击杀冷却 ：天启开始时的击杀冷却。 每次击杀减少的冷却 ：每次击杀后冷却减少的时长。 最低击杀冷却 ：击杀冷却可缩短到的下限。 内鬼视野 ：开启后拥有内鬼视野；关闭后使用默认视野。 可使用通风口 ：设置天启能否使用通风口。
search.en: Juggernaut Each kill reduces the kill cooldown; win under the neutral parity rule after the Impostors are gone. Juggernaut The Juggernaut's kill cooldown decreases with each kill. It does not need to be the last player alive: after all Impostors are gone, the standard neutral end check awards the win when all living counted neutrals share one count type and their total is at least the Crew count. Settings Default kill cooldown: The Juggernaut's starting kill cooldown. Cooldown reduction per kill: Amount the cooldown decreases after each kill. Minimum kill cooldown: Lowest cooldown the Juggernaut can reach. Impostor vision: When enabled, the Juggernaut has Impostor vision; otherwise, they have default vision. Can vent: Whether the Juggernaut can use vents.

summary.zh-CN: 单击标记、双击普通击杀；神风特攻队死亡时，所有标记目标都会死亡。
summary.en: Single-clicks to mark and double-clicks to kill; all marked targets die when the Kamikaze dies.

search.zh-CN: 神风特攻队 单击标记、双击普通击杀；神风特攻队死亡时，所有标记目标都会死亡。 技能 单击击杀键标记目标，双击则正常击杀。神风特攻队死亡时，所有标记者也会死亡，死亡原因为「目标」。 选项 数量上限（Max） ：设置本局最多可有多少名神风特攻队。 击杀冷却 ：设置普通击杀冷却。 最大标记次数 ：设置可标记目标的次数上限。
search.en: Kamikaze Single-clicks to mark and double-clicks to kill; all marked targets die when the Kamikaze dies. Ability Single-click the kill button to mark a target and double-click to make a normal kill. When the Kamikaze dies, every marked target also dies with the death reason “Targeted.” Options Max : Maximum number of Kamikaze roles in a match. Kill Cooldown : Cooldown for normal kills. Max Marked : Maximum number of targets the Kamikaze can mark.

summary.zh-CN: 守卫者在会议中投票给一名玩家以保护其免遭驱逐，使用次数由设置限定。
summary.en: During a meeting, the Keeper votes for a player to protect them from ejection, with a limited number of uses.

search.zh-CN: 守卫者 守卫者在会议中投票给一名玩家以保护其免遭驱逐，使用次数由设置限定。 职业能力 守卫者可以在会议中投票给一名玩家，保护该玩家免遭驱逐。可使用的次数由设置限制。 设置 数量上限 ：设置一局中守卫者的最大人数。 保护次数上限 ：设置守卫者的技能使用次数。
search.en: Keeper During a meeting, the Keeper votes for a player to protect them from ejection, with a limited number of uses. Role During a meeting, the Keeper can vote for a player to protect them from being ejected. The number of uses is configurable. Settings Maximum count : Sets the maximum number of Keepers in a match. Maximum protections : Sets how many times the Keeper can use the ability.

summary.zh-CN: 击杀冷却极短、视野与船员相同，但不能通风、破坏、报告或召开紧急会议，并会无视所有护盾。
summary.en: Has a very short kill cooldown and Crewmate vision, but cannot vent, sabotage, report, or call meetings, and bypasses all shields.

search.zh-CN: 杀戮机器 击杀冷却极短、视野与船员相同，但不能通风、破坏、报告或召开紧急会议，并会无视所有护盾。 技能 杀戮机器的击杀冷却很短，视野与船员相同。它不能使用通风口、发动破坏、报告尸体或召开紧急会议。击杀会无视所有护盾；击杀诱饵或诡雷不会触发这些角色的特殊效果。 选项 数量上限（Max） ：设置本局最多可有多少台杀戮机器。 击杀冷却 ：设置击杀冷却。
search.en: Killing Machine Has a very short kill cooldown and Crewmate vision, but cannot vent, sabotage, report, or call meetings, and bypasses all shields. Ability The Killing Machine has a very short kill cooldown and the same vision as Crewmates. It cannot vent, sabotage, report bodies, or call emergency meetings. Its kills bypass all shields. Killing a Bait or Trapster does not trigger those roles’ special effects. Options Max : Maximum number of Killing Machines in a match. Kill Cooldown : The Killing Machine’s kill cooldown.

summary.zh-CN: 侠客没有任务，整局只有一次对任意玩家发动击杀的机会；是否可以使用通风口可设置。
summary.en: The Knight has no tasks and can kill any player once per game, with vent access controlled by a setting.

search.zh-CN: 侠客 侠客没有任务，整局只有一次对任意玩家发动击杀的机会；是否可以使用通风口可设置。 职业能力 侠客没有任务，整局只能击杀一名玩家。 设置 数量上限 ：设置一局中侠客的最大人数。 击杀冷却 ：设置侠客等待多久后才能击杀。 可以使用通风口 ：开启时侠客可以使用通风口；关闭时不能。
search.en: Knight The Knight has no tasks and can kill any player once per game, with vent access controlled by a setting. Role The Knight has no tasks and can kill any player only once for the entire game. Settings Maximum count : Sets the maximum number of Knights in a match. Kill cooldown : Sets how long the Knight must wait to kill. Can vent : ON lets the Knight use vents; OFF prevents venting.

summary.zh-CN: 由君主授勋；会议中额外增加一票，是否显示额外票数可设置。
summary.en: Granted by Monarch; adds an extra meeting vote, which can be hidden by a setting.

search.zh-CN: 骑士 由君主授勋；会议中额外增加一票，是否显示额外票数可设置。 效果 君主可将符合条件的玩家授勋为骑士。骑士保留原主角色和阵营，在会议中额外增加一票。此身份不会随机分配；君主可设置授勋次数、能力冷却，以及是否隐藏骑士的额外票数。 相关设置 MonarchKnightMax（骑士数量上限） ：设置君主可授勋的骑士数量上限。 MonarchKnightCooldown（骑士冷却） ：设置君主授勋能力的冷却时间。 HideAdditionalVotesForKnighted（隐藏 Knighted 额外票数） ：君主设置，控制是否隐藏骑士的额外投票。 随机分配 ：不会开局随机分配；由上述赋予者能力转化获得。
search.en: Knighted Granted by Monarch; adds an extra meeting vote, which can be hidden by a setting. Effect Monarch can knight eligible players, granting them Knighted. Knighted keeps its main role and team and receives one extra vote in meetings. This identity is not randomly assigned. Monarch settings control the number of knighting uses, ability cooldown, and whether Knighted's extra vote is hidden. Related settings MonarchKnightMax : Maximum number of players the Monarch can knight. MonarchKnightCooldown : Cooldown between the Monarch's knighting uses. HideAdditionalVotesForKnighted : Monarch setting that controls whether Knighted's additional vote is hidden. Random assignment : Not assigned at random at game start; it is granted by the conversion ability described above.

summary.zh-CN: 给予最后一名存活的内鬼，并缩短其击杀冷却。
summary.en: Given to the last surviving Impostor and reduces their kill cooldown.

search.zh-CN: 绝境者 给予最后一名存活的内鬼，并缩短其击杀冷却。 效果 最后一名存活的内鬼会获得绝境者效果，其击杀冷却会缩短。 设置 Kill Cooldown Reduction（击杀冷却缩短比例） ：绝境者的击杀冷却缩短百分比。
search.en: Last Impostor Given to the last surviving Impostor and reduces their kill cooldown. Effect The last surviving Impostor receives this effect, which reduces their kill cooldown. Settings Kill Cooldown Reduction : Percentage by which the Last Impostor's kill cooldown is reduced.

summary.zh-CN: 开局获得一名以菱形标记的目标；目标获胜则律师获胜，目标失败则律师失败。
summary.en: Receive a diamond-marked target at the start; win if the target wins and lose if they lose.

search.zh-CN: 律师 开局获得一名以菱形标记的目标；目标获胜则律师获胜，目标失败则律师失败。 律师 律师开局会获得一名以菱形「♦」标记的目标。目标获胜时律师获胜；目标失败时律师也失败。律师死亡后仍可随目标获胜。目标死亡时，律师可按设置转变为其他职业；若开局时没有合适目标，律师会转为所选职业，或在关闭转变选项时转为投机者。 设置 人数上限 ：一局中可出现的律师数量上限。 可选目标 ：分别设置能否选择内鬼、带刀中立、灾厄阵营、船员或小丑为目标。 知道目标职业 ：开启后律师能看到目标职业；关闭后只知道目标是谁。 目标知道律师身份 ：设置目标是否会知道律师是谁。 目标死亡后转换职业 ：设置目标死亡后是否改变职业；开启后可选择船员、小丑、投机者、名人、保镖、独裁者、市长或医生。关闭后律师仍保持律师；若开局时没有合适目标，则会转为投机者。
search.en: Lawyer Receive a diamond-marked target at the start; win if the target wins and lose if they lose. Lawyer The Lawyer receives a target marked with a diamond (♦) at the start. The Lawyer wins if the target wins and loses if the target loses. The Lawyer can still win after death. If the target dies, the Lawyer can change into a role selected in the settings. If no eligible target exists at the start, the Lawyer becomes the selected role, or an Opportunist when role changing is disabled. Settings Maximum number: Maximum number of Lawyers in a match. Eligible targets: Separately allow targets from the Impostor, Neutral Killing, Apocalypse, Crewmate, and Jester roles. Knows target's role: Whether the Lawyer sees the target's role. Target knows their Lawyer: Whether the target is told who their Lawyer is. Change role after target dies: Whether the Lawyer changes role; choose Crewmate, Jester, Opportunist, Celebrity, Bodyguard, Dictator, Mayor, or Doctor. When disabled, the Lawyer remains a Lawyer after the target dies. If no eligible target exists at the start, they become an Opportunist.

summary.zh-CN: 只分配给船员；不会获得任务，术士和傀儡师无法对其使用控制能力。
summary.en: Assigned only to Crewmates; receives no tasks and cannot be targeted by Warlock or Puppeteer control abilities.

search.zh-CN: 懒人 只分配给船员；不会获得任务，术士和傀儡师无法对其使用控制能力。 效果 懒人只分配给船员，并且不会被分配任务。术士和傀儡师不能对懒人使用各自的控制能力。是否允许无任务的 taskless 船员或任务型船员获得该附加身份分别由设置控制。 设置 Max（最大数量） ：本局中该附加身份可出现的数量上限。 Spawn Chance（生成概率） ：玩家获得此附加身份的概率。 TasklessCrewCanBeLazy（无任务型船员可获得） ：控制无任务型船员角色能否获得懒人。 TaskBasedCrewCanBeLazy（任务型船员可获得） ：控制任务型船员角色能否获得懒人。
search.en: Lazy Assigned only to Crewmates; receives no tasks and cannot be targeted by Warlock or Puppeteer control abilities. Effect Lazy is assigned only to Crewmates and receives no tasks. Warlock and Puppeteer cannot use their control abilities on Lazy. Separate settings control whether taskless Crewmate roles and task-based Crewmate roles can receive it. Settings Max : Maximum number that can appear in one match. Spawn Chance : Chance for a player to receive this add-on. TasklessCrewCanBeLazy : Whether taskless Crewmate roles can receive Lazy. TaskBasedCrewCanBeLazy : Whether task-based Crewmate roles can receive Lazy.

summary.zh-CN: 摆烂人只有一个任务，不能被他人作为傀儡或随从使用（被女巫控制除外），也不能获得附加职业。
summary.en: The Lazy Guy has one task, cannot be used as another player's minion except when Witched, and cannot receive add-ons.

search.zh-CN: 摆烂人 摆烂人只有一个任务，不能被他人作为傀儡或随从使用（被女巫控制除外），也不能获得附加职业。 职业能力 摆烂人只有一个任务，若干内鬼技能不能影响摆烂人，例如傀儡师或术士的控制、匿名者的替罪羊效果。被女巫控制是例外。摆烂人也不能获得附加职业。 设置 数量上限 ：设置一局中摆烂人的最大人数。
search.en: Lazy Guy The Lazy Guy has one task, cannot be used as another player's minion except when Witched, and cannot receive add-ons. Role The Lazy Guy has one task and is unaffected by certain Impostor abilities, including Puppeteer or Warlock control and Anonymous's scapegoat effect. Being Witched is the exception. The Lazy Guy cannot receive add-ons. Settings Maximum count : Sets the maximum number of Lazy Guys in a match.

summary.zh-CN: 执灯人钻通风口后可暂时提高视野，正常照明和停电时的视野增强值可分别设置。
summary.en: The Lighter can vent to temporarily increase their vision, with separate vision settings for normal conditions and lights sabotage.

search.zh-CN: 执灯人 执灯人钻通风口后可暂时提高视野，正常照明和停电时的视野增强值可分别设置。 职业能力 执灯人可以通过钻通风口暂时提高自己的视野。正常照明和停电时都会获得增强视野。 设置 点灯冷却 ：设置再次使用技能前的等待时间。 点灯持续时间 ：设置视野增强持续多久。 正常照明时的视野增强 ：设置普通情况下增加的视野。 停电时的视野增强 ：设置停电期间增加的视野。 初始技能次数 ：设置执灯人开局拥有的技能次数。 每完成一个任务获得的技能次数 ：设置每完成一个任务增加的次数，按 0.1 为步进。
search.en: Lighter The Lighter can vent to temporarily increase their vision, with separate vision settings for normal conditions and lights sabotage. Role The Lighter can vent to temporarily increase their vision. The increased vision applies both when lights are on and when lights are out. Settings Light cooldown : Sets how long the Lighter must wait before using the ability again. Light duration : Sets how long the vision increase lasts. Increased vision : Sets the vision increase under normal lighting. Increased vision during lights out : Sets the vision increase during a lights sabotage. Initial ability uses : Sets how many uses the Lighter starts with. Ability uses gained per task : Sets the uses gained for each completed task, in 0.1 increments.

summary.zh-CN: 击中目标后延迟将其变成量子幽灵；幽灵会在被碰触或会议结束后死亡。
summary.en: Turns a target into a quantum ghost after a delay; the ghost dies if touched or after a meeting.

search.zh-CN: 球状闪电 击中目标后延迟将其变成量子幽灵；幽灵会在被碰触或会议结束后死亡。 技能 球状闪电不能普通击杀。使用击杀键命中目标后，目标会在设定延迟后汽化为量子幽灵，名字旁会显示「■」。若非球状闪电且非量子幽灵的玩家碰到量子幽灵，它会立即死亡；若量子幽灵存活到会议，则会在会议结束后死亡。对量子幽灵再次使用击杀键无效。根据房主设置，击杀球状闪电的凶手也可能汽化为量子幽灵。 选项 数量上限（Max） ：设置本局最多可有多少名球状闪电。 汽化冷却 ：设置两次汽化技能之间的等待时间。 汽化延迟 ：设置目标从被命中到变成量子幽灵所需的时间。 凶手汽化为量子幽灵 ：开启时，击杀球状闪电的玩家也会变成量子幽灵；关闭时不会。
search.en: Lightning Turns a target into a quantum ghost after a delay; the ghost dies if touched or after a meeting. Ability Lightning cannot make ordinary kills. A successful kill-button attack turns its target into a quantum ghost after the configured delay; a 「■」 appears beside the ghost's name. The ghost dies immediately if touched by a player who is neither Lightning nor a quantum ghost. If it survives until a meeting, it dies when the meeting ends. Using the kill button on a quantum ghost has no effect. Depending on the setting, a player who kills Lightning may also become a quantum ghost. Options Max : Maximum number of Lightnings in a match. Lightning Cooldown : Wait between uses of the quantizing ability. Duration of the Transformation to Quantum Ghost : Delay before the target becomes a quantum ghost. Killer Can Transform into Quantum Ghost : When enabled, the player who kills Lightning also becomes a quantum ghost; otherwise they do not.

summary.zh-CN: 瞭望员存活时可以看到其他存活玩家的 ID，借此辨认变形或伪装。
summary.en: While alive, the Lookout can see the IDs of other living players, which can help identify shapeshifts or camouflage.

search.zh-CN: 瞭望员 瞭望员存活时可以看到其他存活玩家的 ID，借此辨认变形或伪装。 职业能力 瞭望员存活时，其他仍存活玩家的 ID 会显示在名称旁；瞭望员死亡后或目标死亡后不再显示。若模组的玩家 ID 功能负责显示，则改由该功能处理。 设置 数量上限 ：设置一局中瞭望员的最大人数。
search.en: Lookout While alive, the Lookout can see the IDs of other living players, which can help identify shapeshifts or camouflage. Role While the Lookout is alive, IDs appear beside the names of other living players. They are not shown for a dead Lookout or a dead target; if the mod's Player Identifiers feature manages IDs for the seer, that feature handles the display instead. Settings Maximum count : Sets the maximum number of Lookouts in a match.

summary.zh-CN: 开局随机配成两名恋人；按设置彼此知晓身份、一方死亡时殉情，并可共同取胜。
summary.en: Randomly pairs two Lovers at the start; settings govern role knowledge, shared death, and their joint win.

search.zh-CN: 恋人 开局随机配成两名恋人；按设置彼此知晓身份、一方死亡时殉情，并可共同取胜。 效果 恋人会在开局组成一对，人数固定为两人。主持人可设置恋人是否知道彼此角色，以及一人死亡时另一人是否殉情。游戏结束时，恋人可能取代船员、内鬼、豺狼或鹈鹕的获胜队伍，或作为额外获胜者跟随原队伍获胜；是否殉情会影响结算。 设置 Spawn Chance（生成概率） ：玩家获得此附加身份的概率。 Eligibility（可分配阵营） ：主持人可分别设置内鬼、船员、中立者是否可以获得此附加身份。 LoverKnowRoles（恋人互知角色） ：控制恋人能否查看彼此角色。 LoverSuicide（恋人殉情） ：控制一名恋人死亡时，另一名存活恋人是否殉情。
search.en: Lovers Randomly pairs two Lovers at the start; settings govern role knowledge, shared death, and their joint win. Effect Lovers are assigned as a pair of exactly two players at the start. Settings control whether they know each other's roles and whether one dies when the other dies. At game end, Lovers can replace a Crewmate, Impostor, Jackal, or Pelican win, or follow the original winning team as additional winners; the suicide setting affects the result. Settings Spawn Chance : Chance for a player to receive this add-on. Eligibility : Separate settings control whether Impostors, Crewmates, Neutrals can receive this add-on. LoverKnowRoles : Whether Lovers can see each other's roles. LoverSuicide : Whether a living Lover dies when the other Lover dies.

summary.zh-CN: 仅船员或内鬼可获得，不能被转化阵营的角色招募。
summary.en: Only Crewmates or Impostors can receive it and cannot be recruited by converting roles.

search.zh-CN: 忠诚 仅船员或内鬼可获得，不能被转化阵营的角色招募。 效果 忠诚只能分配给船员或内鬼，不会分配给中立者。它阻止招募型身份将持有者转化；具体可分配阵营由内鬼和船员两个选项分别控制。 设置 Max（最大数量） ：本局中该附加身份可出现的数量上限。 Spawn Chance（生成概率） ：玩家获得此附加身份的概率。 Eligibility（可分配阵营） ：主持人可分别设置内鬼、船员是否可以获得此附加身份。
search.en: Loyal Only Crewmates or Impostors can receive it and cannot be recruited by converting roles. Effect Loyal can only be assigned to Crewmates or Impostors, not Neutrals. It prevents conversion by recruiting roles. Separate settings control whether Impostors and Crewmates can receive it. Settings Max : Maximum number that can appear in one match. Spawn Chance : Chance for a player to receive this add-on. Eligibility : Separate settings control whether Impostors, Crewmates can receive this add-on.

summary.zh-CN: 有概率躲过击杀；触发时击杀者会看到护盾动画，但幸运加持自身不会收到提示。
summary.en: May evade a kill; the killer sees a shield animation, but Lucky is not notified.

search.zh-CN: 幸运加持 有概率躲过击杀；触发时击杀者会看到护盾动画，但幸运加持自身不会收到提示。 效果 幸运加持有一定概率躲过击杀，具体概率由主持人设置。成功躲避时，击杀者会看到护盾动画，但幸运加持自身不会收到提示。 设置 Max（最大数量） ：本局中该附加身份可出现的数量上限。 Spawn Chance（生成概率） ：玩家获得此附加身份的概率。 Eligibility（可分配阵营） ：主持人可分别设置内鬼、船员、中立者是否可以获得此附加身份。 Probability of surviving a kill（击杀存活概率） ：幸运加持躲过击杀的概率。
search.en: Lucky May evade a kill; the killer sees a shield animation, but Lucky is not notified. Effect Lucky has a configurable chance to evade a kill. When it works, the killer sees a shield animation, but Lucky is not notified. Settings Max : Maximum number that can appear in one match. Spawn Chance : Chance for a player to receive this add-on. Eligibility : Separate settings control whether Impostors, Crewmates, Neutrals can receive this add-on. Probability of surviving a kill : Chance for Lucky to escape a kill.

summary.zh-CN: 每次击杀后，击杀冷却会在 1 秒至“最大击杀冷却”上限间随机变化（上限值不计入）。
summary.en: After each kill, the cooldown is randomized from 1 second up to, but not including, the configured maximum.

search.zh-CN: 速度者 每次击杀后，击杀冷却会在 1 秒至“最大击杀冷却”上限间随机变化（上限值不计入）。 技能 每次击杀后，击杀冷却会随机设为 1 秒至所设“最大击杀冷却”上限；随机结果不包含上限值。若上限为 1 秒，冷却固定为 1 秒。 选项 数量上限（Max） ：设置本局最多可有多少名速度者。 最大击杀冷却 ：设置随机冷却时间的上限。
search.en: Ludopath After each kill, the cooldown is randomized from 1 second up to, but not including, the configured maximum. Ability After each kill, the cooldown is randomized from 1 second up to, but not including, the configured maximum. If that maximum is 1 second, the cooldown is fixed at 1 second. Options Max : Maximum number of Ludopaths in a match. Maximum Kill Cooldown : Upper bound for the randomized cooldown.

summary.zh-CN: 进入通风口可缩短击杀冷却；击杀后冷却恢复到初始值。
summary.en: Entering a vent reduces kill cooldown; after a kill, it resets to its starting value.

search.zh-CN: 潜伏者 进入通风口可缩短击杀冷却；击杀后冷却恢复到初始值。 技能 进入通风口会按设定减少击杀冷却。完成击杀后，冷却会重置为初始值。 选项 数量上限（Max） ：设置本局最多可有多少名潜伏者。 初始击杀冷却 ：设置潜伏者的基础击杀冷却。 每次进入通风口减少的击杀冷却 ：设置通风口带来的冷却缩短量。
search.en: Lurker Entering a vent reduces kill cooldown; after a kill, it resets to its starting value. Ability Entering a vent reduces the kill cooldown by the configured amount. After a kill, the cooldown resets to its starting value. Options Max : Maximum number of Lurkers in a match. Starting Kill Cooldown : The Lurker’s base kill cooldown. Reduce Kill Cooldown By : How much entering a vent reduces the cooldown.

summary.zh-CN: 以指定方式由船员转化为内鬼盟友；转化资格、阵营计数、视野、互相识别和击杀行为均可设置。
summary.en: Converts eligible Crewmates into Impostor allies using a selected method; team count, vision, recognition, and kill rules are configurable.

search.zh-CN: 叛徒 以指定方式由船员转化为内鬼盟友；转化资格、阵营计数、视野、互相识别和击杀行为均可设置。 效果 叛徒通常从船员中产生。内鬼获胜时，叛徒会随队获胜；若 MadmateCountMode 设为保留原阵营，叛徒也可能随原阵营获胜。该设置还决定叛徒是否影响胜负人数判定，因此标准内鬼全部出局后的结果也取决于该设置。叛徒的生成方式可设为随机分配、内鬼首次尝试击杀时转化目标，或转化会议中投自己票的船员。角色的允许转化名单由设置控制；摆烂人、懒人、忠诚、大明星、网红、任务管理者、利己主义者、双重人格、义务警员、成年迷你船员等不能成为叛徒。达到任务转换限制的焦急者也不能转化。还可设置内鬼和叛徒之间是否互相识别、能否互相击杀，以及叛徒是否拥有内鬼视野。 设置 Max（最大数量） ：本局中该附加身份可出现的数量上限。 Madmate spawning mode（Madmate 生成方式） ：可选 Assign、First Kill 或 Self Vote。First Kill 会将符合条件的击杀目标转化而非杀死；Self Vote 会转化投给自己的船员。 Madmates count as（Madmate 计入人数） ：设置叛徒不计人数、计为内鬼或计入原阵营。 SheriffCanBeMadmate / MayorCanBeMadmate / NGuesserCanBeMadmate / MarshallCanBeMadmate / OverseerCanBeMadmate / RetributionistCanBeMadmate / SnitchCanBeMadmate / JudgeCanBeMadmate（可转化角色开关） ：分别设置警长、市长、正义赌怪、展现者、预言家、惩罚者、告密者和正义法官能否转化为叛徒；Mad 告密者的任务数由 MadSnitchTasks 设置。 Impostor/Madmate visibility, friendly fire, and vision options（内鬼与 Madmate 阵营设置） ：主持人可设置两方是否互相识别、能否互相击杀，以及叛徒是否拥有内鬼视野。
search.en: Madmate Converts eligible Crewmates into Impostor allies using a selected method; team count, vision, recognition, and kill rules are configurable. Effect Madmates normally come from eligible Crewmates. They win with the Impostors if that team wins; when MadmateCountMode keeps their original team, they may also win with that team. The same setting controls whether Madmates contribute to parity, so an endgame after the regular Impostors die depends on the selected mode. The host chooses how Madmates are created: random assignment, converting a Crewmate when an Impostor first tries to kill them, or converting Crewmates who vote for themselves in a meeting. Settings control which roles may convert; Lazy Guy, Lazy, Loyal, SuperStar, Celebrity, Task Manager, Egoist, Paranoia, Vigilante, and adult Mini cannot become Madmates. Hurried players who cannot be converted are also excluded. Settings control whether Madmates count toward player totals, whether Impostors and Madmates know each other, whether Impostors can kill Madmates, whether Madmates can kill Impostors, and whether Madmates have Impostor vision. Settings Max : Maximum number that can appear in one match. Madmate spawning mode : Choose Assign, First Kill, or Self Vote. First Kill converts an eligible target instead of killing them; Self Vote converts self-voting Crewmates. Madmates count as : Choose whether Madmates count as nobody, Impostors, or their original team. SheriffCanBeMadmate / MayorCanBeMadmate / NGuesserCanBeMadmate / MarshallCanBeMadmate / OverseerCanBeMadmate / RetributionistCanBeMadmate / SnitchCanBeMadmate / JudgeCanBeMadmate : Separate toggles control whether these roles can become Madmates; Mad Snitch task count is set with MadSnitchTasks . Impostor/Madmate visibility, friendly fire, and vision options : Host options control whether the two groups identify each other, whether either side can kill the other, and whether Madmates have Impostor vision.

summary.zh-CN: 仅内鬼可获得；灯光破坏期间获得额外速度、缩短击杀冷却，并显示阵营颜色。
summary.en: Only Impostors can receive it; during Lights Out, gains speed, has a shorter kill cooldown, and shows its team color.

search.zh-CN: 梦魇 仅内鬼可获得；灯光破坏期间获得额外速度、缩短击杀冷却，并显示阵营颜色。 效果 梦魇只分配给内鬼。灯光破坏生效时，梦魇获得额外移动速度和更短的击杀冷却，并会以阵营颜色显示名字；灯光恢复后，击杀按钮不可用。梦魇不会在 The Fungle 地图随机分配。 设置 Max（最大数量） ：本局中该附加身份可出现的数量上限。 Spawn Chance（生成概率） ：玩家获得此附加身份的概率。 MareAddSpeedInLightsOut（灯光破坏期间额外速度） ：灯光破坏期间增加的移动速度。 MareKillCooldownInLightsOut（灯光破坏期间击杀冷却） ：灯光破坏期间的击杀冷却。
search.en: Mare Only Impostors can receive it; during Lights Out, gains speed, has a shorter kill cooldown, and shows its team color. Effect Mare is assigned only to Impostors. During Lights Out, it gains additional movement speed and a shorter kill cooldown, and its name is shown in its team color. Its kill button is unavailable outside Lights Out. Mare is not randomly assigned on The Fungle. Settings Max : Maximum number that can appear in one match. Spawn Chance : Chance for a player to receive this add-on. MareAddSpeedInLightsOut : Additional movement speed during Lights Out. MareKillCooldownInLightsOut : Kill cooldown during Lights Out.

summary.zh-CN: 展现者完成全部任务后会向船员公开身份，非船员阵营无法看到其身份。
summary.en: After finishing all tasks, the Marshall reveals their identity to the Crew; non-Crew teams cannot see the reveal.

search.zh-CN: 展现者 展现者完成全部任务后会向船员公开身份，非船员阵营无法看到其身份。 职业能力 展现者完成全部任务后会向船员公开身份，包括叛徒等特殊船员阵营。非船员阵营无法看到展现者。 设置 数量上限 ：设置一局中展现者的最大人数。 自定义展现者任务 ：开启时可单独设置任务；关闭时与其他玩家任务相同。自定义内容包括是否有公共任务，以及长任务、短任务数量。
search.en: Marshall After finishing all tasks, the Marshall reveals their identity to the Crew; non-Crew teams cannot see the reveal. Role After completing all tasks, the Marshall is revealed to the Crew, including special Crewmates such as Madmates. Non-Crew teams cannot see the Marshall. Settings Maximum count : Sets the maximum number of Marshalls in a match. Override Marshall tasks : ON allows a separate task setup; OFF gives the Marshall the same tasks as everyone else. The custom setup includes common-task availability and the number of long and short tasks.

summary.zh-CN: 操纵拥有击杀按钮的目标，限时内若未击杀或先召开会议就会死亡；双击可普通击杀。
summary.en: Manipulates targets with a kill button; they die if they fail to kill before the deadline or a meeting is called first. Double-clicks kill normally.

search.zh-CN: 策划者 操纵拥有击杀按钮的目标，限时内若未击杀或先召开会议就会死亡；双击可普通击杀。 技能 使用击杀键操纵目标；若目标没有击杀按钮，操纵无效。被操纵者会在延迟后得知情况，并必须在时限内击杀一人才能存活。超时或在击杀前召开会议，目标都会死亡。双击可普通击杀。 选项 击杀冷却 ：设置策划者的击杀冷却。 目标击杀时限 ：设置目标必须在多久内完成击杀，否则死亡。 操纵通知延迟 ：设置目标收到被操纵提示前的延迟。
search.en: Mastermind Manipulates targets with a kill button; they die if they fail to kill before the deadline or a meeting is called first. Double-clicks kill normally. Ability Use the kill button to manipulate a target; this has no effect if they have no kill button. The target is notified after a delay and must kill someone before the deadline to survive. The target dies if the timer expires or a meeting is called before they kill. Double-click to make a normal kill. Options Kill Cooldown : The Mastermind’s kill cooldown. Time Limit to Kill Someone : How long the target has to make a kill before dying. Manipulation Notification Delay : Delay before the target is notified.

summary.zh-CN: 击杀并存活到游戏结束，达到最低击杀数后随获胜阵营获胜。
summary.en: Kill and survive to the end; meet the minimum kill count to win with the winning team.

search.zh-CN: 独行者 击杀并存活到游戏结束，达到最低击杀数后随获胜阵营获胜。 独行者 独行者可以像连环杀手一样击杀玩家，但会随最终获胜阵营获胜。独行者存活到游戏结束且达到最低击杀数后，才会获得额外胜利；死亡则不能获胜。 设置 击杀冷却 ：再次击杀前的等待时间。 可使用通风口 ：设置独行者能否使用通风口。 内鬼视野 ：开启后拥有内鬼视野；关闭后使用默认视野。 获胜所需最低击杀数 ：独行者获得额外胜利所需的击杀数；设为 0 时不要求击杀数。
search.en: Maverick Kill and survive to the end; meet the minimum kill count to win with the winning team. Maverick The Maverick can kill like a Serial Killer and wins with the winning team. To receive the Maverick win, they must survive until the end and meet the minimum kill count. They cannot win if they die. Settings Kill cooldown: Time before the Maverick can kill again. Can vent: Whether the Maverick can use vents. Impostor vision: When enabled, the Maverick has Impostor vision; otherwise, they have default vision. Minimum kills to win: Number of kills needed for the Maverick win; zero disables the requirement.

summary.zh-CN: 市长拥有额外投票，并可按设置使用便携紧急会议按钮；公开身份及额外票显示方式也可调整。
summary.en: The Mayor has extra votes and may use a portable emergency-meeting button, with settings for vote display and identity reveal.

search.zh-CN: 市长 市长拥有额外投票，并可按设置使用便携紧急会议按钮；公开身份及额外票显示方式也可调整。 职业能力 市长拥有额外投票。根据设置，市长还可以通过通风口使用便携紧急会议按钮。 设置 数量上限 ：设置一局中市长的最大人数。 额外票数 ：设置市长获得的额外投票数。 市长拥有便携紧急按钮 ：开启时市长可通过通风口召开紧急会议；关闭时只能按普通方式召开会议。 便携紧急按钮次数上限 ：设置市长最多可通过通风口召开多少次紧急会议。 隐藏额外投票 ：开启时额外票不显示；关闭时按普通投票显示。 完成任务后向所有人公开市长 ：开启时完成任务后公开身份；关闭时不公开。公开后市长不能被职业猜测。 自定义市长任务 ：开启时可单独设置任务数量；关闭时与其他玩家任务相同。自定义内容包括公共任务、长任务和短任务。
search.en: Mayor The Mayor has extra votes and may use a portable emergency-meeting button, with settings for vote display and identity reveal. Role The Mayor receives extra votes. Depending on settings, the Mayor may also have a portable emergency button that can be used through vents. Settings Maximum count : Sets the maximum number of Mayors in a match. Additional votes count : Sets how many extra votes the Mayor receives. Mayor has a mobile emergency button : ON lets the Mayor call a meeting by venting; OFF requires the normal meeting button. Maximum mobile emergency buttons : Sets how many emergency meetings the Mayor can call by venting. Hide additional votes : ON makes the Mayor's extra votes appear as nothing; OFF displays them as normal votes. Mayor is revealed to everyone on task completion : ON reveals the Mayor after task completion, and the revealed Mayor cannot be guessed; OFF does not reveal them. Override Mayor tasks : ON allows a separate task setup; OFF gives the Mayor the same task count as everyone else. The custom setup includes common-task availability and the number of long and short tasks.

summary.zh-CN: 修理工可随时使用通风口，并能按设置独自处理特定破坏。
summary.en: The Mechanic can vent at any time and can handle selected sabotages alone, depending on settings.

search.zh-CN: 修理工 修理工可随时使用通风口，并能按设置独自处理特定破坏。 职业能力 修理工可随时使用通风口，也可根据设置独自修复特定破坏。 设置 数量上限 ：设置一局中修理工的最大人数。 初始修理次数上限 ：设置修理工开局拥有的修理技能次数。 可一次打开一组门 ：开启时，在 Polus 与 Airship 的门禁破坏中，一次操作会打开同一门禁组内的所有门；不会打开全地图所有门。关闭时不能。 可独自修复双反应堆 ：开启时可独自完成需要两处操作的反应堆修复；关闭时不能。 可独自修复双氧气点 ：开启时可独自完成需要两处操作的氧气修复；关闭时不能。 可独自修复通讯破坏 ：开启时可独自修复通讯破坏，当前实现支持米拉总部和蘑菇岛（Fungle）；关闭时不能。 可用一个开关修复照明 ：开启时可通过一个开关修复照明破坏；关闭时不能。 每完成一个任务获得的技能次数 ：设置每完成一个任务增加的次数，按 0.1 为步进。 修复反应堆/氧气所需次数 ：设置修复反应堆或氧气破坏消耗的技能次数，按 0.1 为步进。 修复照明/通讯所需次数 ：设置修复照明或通讯破坏消耗的技能次数，按 0.1 为步进。
search.en: Mechanic The Mechanic can vent at any time and can handle selected sabotages alone, depending on settings. Role The Mechanic can use vents at any time and can fix selected sabotages alone, depending on settings. Settings Maximum count : Sets the maximum number of Mechanics in a match. Initial repair use limit : Sets the Mechanic's starting number of repair uses. Can open a door group at once : ON lets one interaction open all doors in the same group during door sabotages on Polus and Airship; it does not open every door on the map. OFF disables this. Can fix both reactors alone : ON lets the Mechanic complete the two-point reactor repair alone; OFF does not. Can fix both O2 points alone : ON lets the Mechanic complete the two-point O2 repair alone; OFF does not. Can fix Communications alone : ON lets the Mechanic fix communications sabotage alone; the current implementation supports MIRA HQ and Fungle. OFF does not. Can fix lights with one switch : ON lets the Mechanic fix the lights sabotage with one switch; OFF does not. Ability uses gained per task : Sets additional repair uses per completed task, in 0.1 increments. Uses required for Reactor/O2 : Sets the repair uses consumed for Reactor or O2, in 0.1 increments. Uses required for Lights/Comms : Sets the repair uses consumed for Lights or Comms, in 0.1 increments.

summary.zh-CN: 医生用击杀按钮给一名玩家施加护盾，护盾与击杀尝试的提示、死亡后失效和职业猜测交互均可配置。
summary.en: The Medic uses the kill button to shield one player, with configurable shield visibility, kill-attempt alerts, death behavior, and guessing interaction.

search.zh-CN: 医生 医生用击杀按钮给一名玩家施加护盾，护盾与击杀尝试的提示、死亡后失效和职业猜测交互均可配置。 职业能力 医生可对目标使用击杀按钮施加护盾，一整局只能施加一个护盾。根据房主设置，医生或被保护者可看到护盾提示；医生也可以得知有人试图击破护盾。医生死亡后护盾是否失效取决于设置。 设置 数量上限 ：设置一局中医生的最大人数。 谁能看到护盾 ：可选无人、医生与被保护者都能看到、仅医生能看到，或仅被保护者能看到。 谁能看到击杀尝试 ：可选无人、医生与被保护者都能看到、仅医生能看到，或仅被保护者能看到。 医生死亡时护盾失效 ：开启时医生死亡会使护盾失效；关闭时护盾在医生死亡后仍保留。 护盾失效提示可见 ：在护盾会因医生死亡而失效时，可设置是否显示失效提示。提示可立即显示、在下一次会议后显示，或关闭提示显示。 击杀尝试后重置凶手冷却 ：设置护盾遭遇击杀尝试后，攻击者的击杀冷却重置为多少。 猜测时忽略医生护盾 ：开启时护盾不会阻止对被保护者进行职业猜测；关闭时护盾会保护其免遭猜测。
search.en: Medic The Medic uses the kill button to shield one player, with configurable shield visibility, kill-attempt alerts, death behavior, and guessing interaction. Role The Medic uses the kill button to place a shield on a target and can give only one shield for the entire game. Depending on settings, the Medic or the shielded player can see the shield indicator. The Medic can also learn when someone tries to break the shield. Whether the shield ends when the Medic dies is configurable. Settings Maximum count : Sets the maximum number of Medics in a match. Who can see the shield : Choose no one, Medic and shielded player, Medic only, or shielded player only. Who can see a kill attempt : Choose no one, Medic and shielded player, Medic only, or shielded player only. Shield deactivates when the Medic dies : ON removes the shield when the Medic dies; OFF leaves it in place after their death. Shield deactivation is visible : When the shield deactivates on the Medic's death, choose whether to show the deactivation immediately, after the next meeting, or not at all. Reset murderer's cooldown on kill attempt : Sets the attacker's kill cooldown after an attempt to break the shield. Guessing ignores Medic shield : ON lets players guess the shielded target despite the shield; OFF lets the shield protect the target from being guessed.

summary.zh-CN: 尸体被报告后，通灵师可以联系该死者；死者需在会议中用指定指令回答，通灵师才能看到回复。
summary.en: After a body is reported, the Medium can contact its ghost, which must answer with the specified command during the meeting for the reply to appear.

search.zh-CN: 通灵师 尸体被报告后，通灵师可以联系该死者；死者需在会议中用指定指令回答，通灵师才能看到回复。 职业能力 尸体被报告后，通灵师可以与对应的死者建立联系；报告者不必是通灵师。死者必须在会议中使用 /ms YES 或 /ms NO 作答，否则通灵师无法看到死者的消息。 设置 数量上限 ：设置一局中通灵师的最大人数。 联系次数上限 ：设置通灵师可联系鬼魂的次数。 只接收船员阵营的消息 ：开启时只接收船员阵营玩家的消息，包括叛徒、魅惑、感染等特殊船员；关闭时也能接收内鬼和中立阵营的消息。 每完成一个任务获得的联系次数 ：设置每完成一个任务增加的技能次数，按 0.1 为步进。
search.en: Medium After a body is reported, the Medium can contact its ghost, which must answer with the specified command during the meeting for the reply to appear. Role After a dead body is reported, the Medium can contact the ghost of that player; the reporter does not have to be the Medium. During the meeting, the ghost must answer with /ms YES or /ms NO, or the Medium cannot see the ghost's message. Settings Maximum count : Sets the maximum number of Mediums in a match. Maximum contacts : Sets how many times the Medium can contact ghosts. Receive messages only from Crewmates : ON restricts messages to Crewmates, including special Crewmates such as Mad, Charmed, or Infected; OFF also allows messages from Impostors and Neutrals. Ability uses gained per task : Sets the contacts gained for each completed task, in 0.1 increments.

summary.zh-CN: 通过报告按钮石化尸体，使尸体无法再次被报告；内鬼阵营消灭后按中立平衡条件获胜。
summary.en: Stone bodies with the report button so they cannot be reported again; win under the neutral parity rule after the Impostors are gone.

search.zh-CN: 美杜莎 通过报告按钮石化尸体，使尸体无法再次被报告；内鬼阵营消灭后按中立平衡条件获胜。 美杜莎 美杜莎可以用报告按钮石化尸体。石化后，尸体无法被报告。美杜莎不必成为最后的幸存者：内鬼全部死亡后，若存活的计数中立玩家属于同一计数类型，且计数中立人数不少于船员，中立阵营即可获胜。 设置 击杀冷却 ：再次击杀前的等待时间。 石化尸体后的击杀冷却 ：石化尸体后应用的冷却时间。 可使用通风口 ：设置美杜莎能否使用通风口。 内鬼视野 ：设置美杜莎是否拥有内鬼视野。
search.en: Medusa Stone bodies with the report button so they cannot be reported again; win under the neutral parity rule after the Impostors are gone. Medusa The Medusa can stone a body with the report button. A stoned body cannot be reported. The Medusa does not need to be the last player alive: after all Impostors are gone, the standard neutral end check awards the win when all living counted neutrals share one count type and their total is at least the Crew count. Settings Kill cooldown: Time before killing again. Kill cooldown after stone gaze: Cooldown applied after stoning a body. Can vent: Whether Medusa can use vents. Impostor vision: Whether Medusa has Impostor vision.

summary.zh-CN: 首次击杀后必须在规定时限内再次击杀，否则会自杀；击杀冷却由房主设置。
summary.en: After its first kill, must kill again before the configured deadline or die by suicide; the host sets its kill cooldown.

search.zh-CN: 嗜血杀手 首次击杀后必须在规定时限内再次击杀，否则会自杀；击杀冷却由房主设置。 技能 首次击杀后，嗜血杀手必须在规定时限内再次击杀，否则会自杀；每次击杀都会重置倒计时，会议结束后倒计时也会重置。击杀冷却由房主设置。 选项 数量上限（Max） ：设置本局最多可有多少名嗜血杀手。 击杀冷却 ：设置嗜血杀手的击杀冷却。 自杀倒计时 ：设置必须在多久内完成击杀，否则自杀。
search.en: Mercenary After its first kill, must kill again before the configured deadline or die by suicide; the host sets its kill cooldown. Ability After its first kill, the Mercenary must make another kill before the configured deadline or it dies by suicide. Each kill resets the timer, and the timer resets again after a meeting. The host sets its kill cooldown. Options Max : Maximum number of Mercenaries in a match. Kill Cooldown : Time before the Mercenary can kill again. Time Until Suicide : How long the Mercenary has to make a kill before dying.

summary.zh-CN: 商人每完成任务会向随机玩家出售随机附加职业并获得金钱；达到门槛后可贿赂攻击者，使其本局后续无法击杀商人。
summary.en: The Merchant sells a random add-on to a random player per task and earns money; after reaching the threshold, they can bribe an attacker to block that player's later kill attempts against them for the rest of the game.

search.zh-CN: 商人 商人每完成任务会向随机玩家出售随机附加职业并获得金钱；达到门槛后可贿赂攻击者，使其本局后续无法击杀商人。 职业能力 商人每完成一个任务会向随机玩家出售随机附加职业并获得金钱。金钱达到门槛后，针对商人的击杀会贿赂该攻击者；同一攻击者本局之后针对商人的击杀也会被挡下。商人可用积累的金钱贿赂其他攻击者，不会得知攻击者身份。 设置 数量上限 ：设置一局中商人的最大人数。 可出售附加职业数量上限 ：设置商人最多出售多少个附加职业。 每次出售获得的金钱 ：设置每售出一个附加职业商人获得的金额。 贿赂杀手所需金钱 ：设置商人需要攒够多少金钱才能贿赂杀手。 杀手被贿赂时通知商人 ：开启时，商人会收到其贿赂触发的提示；关闭时不显示此提示。 可出售给船员阵营/内鬼阵营/中立阵营 ：分别设置商人是否可以向对应阵营出售附加职业。 可出售帮助类/有害类/混合类附加职业 ：分别设置是否允许出售对应类型。 有害类仅售给邪恶阵营 ：当前实现中，开启此项会将帮助类附加职业限定为售给船员阵营，与选项名称相反。 帮助类仅售给船员阵营 ：当前实现中，开启此项会将有害类附加职业限定为售给内鬼或中立阵营，与选项名称相反。 只出售已启用的附加职业 ：开启时只会出售已启用的附加职业；关闭时不受此限制。 自定义商人任务 ：开启时可单独设置任务数量；关闭时商人与其他玩家任务数量相同。自定义选项包括公共任务、长任务和短任务的设置。
search.en: Merchant The Merchant sells a random add-on to a random player per task and earns money; after reaching the threshold, they can bribe an attacker to block that player's later kill attempts against them for the rest of the game. Role For each task completed, the Merchant sells a random add-on to a random player and earns money. Once the required amount is available, an attack against the Merchant bribes that attacker; their later kill attempts against the Merchant are also blocked for the rest of the game. The Merchant can spend more earned money to bribe other attackers but does not learn their identities. Settings Maximum count : Sets the maximum number of Merchants in a match. Maximum add-ons to sell : Sets how many add-ons the Merchant can sell. Money earned per sale : Sets how much money the Merchant receives for each add-on sold. Money required to bribe a killer : Sets how much money the Merchant must have to bribe a killer. Inform Merchant when a killer is bribed : ON notifies the Merchant when their bribe takes effect; OFF suppresses that notice. Can sell to Crewmates, Impostors, and Neutrals : Each setting controls whether the Merchant may sell add-ons to that team. Can sell Helpful, Harmful, and Mixed add-ons : Each setting controls whether add-ons of that type may be sold. Sell Harmful add-ons only to Evil : In the current implementation, ON restricts Helpful add-ons to Crewmates, opposite to the option label. Sell Helpful add-ons only to Crew : In the current implementation, ON restricts Harmful add-ons to Impostors or Neutrals, opposite to the option label. Sell only enabled add-ons : ON restricts sales to enabled add-ons; OFF does not. Override Merchant tasks : ON allows a separate task setup; OFF gives the Merchant the same task count as everyone else. The custom setup includes common-task availability and the number of long and short tasks.

summary.zh-CN: 仅内鬼可获得；死亡后的下一次会议会向内鬼通报其击杀且目前仍存活的玩家角色。
summary.en: Only Impostors can receive it; at the next meeting after it dies, Impostors learn the roles of living players it killed.

search.zh-CN: 宝箱怪 仅内鬼可获得；死亡后的下一次会议会向内鬼通报其击杀且目前仍存活的玩家角色。 效果 只有内鬼可以成为宝箱怪。宝箱怪死亡后，在下一次会议中，内鬼队伍会收到它所击杀且目前仍存活的玩家角色信息。存活的宝箱怪还可按设置查看已死亡玩家的角色。 设置 Max（最大数量） ：本局中该附加身份可出现的数量上限。 Spawn Chance（生成概率） ：玩家获得此附加身份的概率。 Mimic can see the roles of dead players（Mimic 可查看死者角色） ：控制存活的宝箱怪能否在角色可见后查看死者身份。
search.en: Mimic Only Impostors can receive it; at the next meeting after it dies, Impostors learn the roles of living players it killed. Effect Only Impostors can become Mimic. At the next meeting after Mimic dies, the Impostor team receives the roles of players it killed who are still alive. While alive, Mimic can also see dead players' roles if the setting allows it. Settings Max : Maximum number that can appear in one match. Spawn Chance : Chance for a player to receive this add-on. Mimic can see the roles of dead players : Whether a living Mimic can see dead players' roles when roles are visible.

summary.zh-CN: 变形可传送回自己最近一次进入的通风口。
summary.en: Shapeshifting returns the Miner to the last vent they entered.

search.zh-CN: 矿工 变形可传送回自己最近一次进入的通风口。 技能 变形时传送到自己最近一次进入的通风口。 选项 数量上限（Max） ：设置本局最多可有多少名矿工。 变形持续时间 ：设置变形可持续多久。 变形冷却 ：设置再次变形前的等待时间。
search.en: Miner Shapeshifting returns the Miner to the last vent they entered. Ability Shapeshifting returns the Miner to the last vent they entered. Options Max : Maximum number of Miners in a match. Shapeshift Duration : How long a shapeshift can last. Shapeshift Cooldown : How long you must wait before shapeshifting again.

summary.zh-CN: 迷你船员会随时间长大，并可能成为好迷你或坏迷你；成长速度、阵营概率、年龄显示和击杀冷却可设置。
summary.en: The Mini grows over time and may be a Nice Mini or Evil Mini, with configurable growth, variant chance, age display, and kill cooldowns.

search.zh-CN: 迷你船员 迷你船员会随时间长大，并可能成为好迷你或坏迷你；成长速度、阵营概率、年龄显示和击杀冷却可设置。 职业能力 迷你船员有好迷你和坏迷你两种变体。详情见 坏迷你船员 和 好迷你船员 。 设置 成长所需时间 ：设置迷你船员完全长大的秒数。 所有人都能看到迷你船员 ：开启此项时所有玩家都会知道谁是迷你船员。 迷你船员可以是内鬼 ：开启时迷你船员可能成为坏迷你船员；关闭时不能成为坏迷你船员。开启后还可设置坏迷你船员的出现概率，以及其未满 18 岁和满 18 岁后的击杀冷却。 实时显示年龄变化 ：开启时实时显示年龄；关闭时不实时显示。 会议时间计入成长 ：开启时会议期间也会成长；关闭时会议期间暂停成长。
search.en: Mini The Mini grows over time and may be a Nice Mini or Evil Mini, with configurable growth, variant chance, age display, and kill cooldowns. Role The Mini has two variants, Nice Mini and Evil Mini. See Evil Mini and Nice Mini for those rules. Settings Time required to grow : Sets how many seconds it takes the Mini to fully grow up. Everyone can see the Mini : When enabled, all players know who the Mini is. Mini can be an Impostor : ON allows an Evil Mini; OFF prevents it. When enabled, settings include the chance of spawning as an Evil Mini and the Evil Mini's kill cooldown while under 18 and over 18. Display age change in real time : ON displays the Mini's age continuously; OFF does not. Count meeting time toward growth : ON lets the Mini grow during meetings; OFF pauses growth during meetings.

summary.zh-CN: 作为内鬼幽灵角色暂时致盲非内鬼玩家，不能发动破坏。
summary.en: As an Impostor ghost role, temporarily blinds non-Impostors and cannot sabotage.

search.zh-CN: 爪牙 作为内鬼幽灵角色暂时致盲非内鬼玩家，不能发动破坏。 技能 爪牙使用保护技能使非内鬼玩家暂时失明；持续时间结束后视野恢复。爪牙不能发动破坏。 选项 技能冷却 ：设置再次致盲前的等待时间。 技能持续时间 ：设置目标失明多久。
search.en: Minion As an Impostor ghost role, temporarily blinds non-Impostors and cannot sabotage. Ability The Minion uses its protection ability to temporarily blind a non-Impostor. The target’s vision returns when the effect expires. The Minion cannot sabotage. Options Ability Cooldown : Time before the ability can be used again. Ability Duration : How long the target remains blind.

summary.zh-CN: 鼹鼠使用通风口后会停留一秒，再从地图上另一个随机通风口出现。
summary.en: The Mole stays in a vent for one second, then emerges from a random different vent on the map.

search.zh-CN: 鼹鼠 鼹鼠使用通风口后会停留一秒，再从地图上另一个随机通风口出现。 职业能力 鼹鼠钻入通风口后会在其中停留一秒。离开时会出现在地图上另一个随机通风口旁，不会回到刚使用的那个通风口。 设置 数量上限 ：设置一局中鼹鼠的最大人数。 挖掘冷却 ：设置鼹鼠再次使用能力前的等待时间。
search.en: Mole The Mole stays in a vent for one second, then emerges from a random different vent on the map. Role When the Mole vents, they stay in the vent for one second. When they come out, they appear near a random vent on the map other than the one they just used. Settings Maximum count : Sets the maximum number of Moles in a match. Dig cooldown : Sets how long the Mole must wait before using the ability again.

summary.zh-CN: 君主可以册封玩家为骑士并给予额外投票；只要场上存在骑士，君主就不能被猜测或击杀。
summary.en: The Monarch knights players to give them an extra vote; while any knighted player exists, the Monarch cannot be guessed or killed.

search.zh-CN: 君主 君主可以册封玩家为骑士并给予额外投票；只要场上存在骑士，君主就不能被猜测或击杀。 职业能力 每局最多会有一名君主。君主可以册封玩家为骑士，使其获得额外投票。已有多个投票的玩家不能再次受封；金色名字只有君主可见。只要场上存在骑士，君主就不能被猜测或击杀。 设置 册封冷却 ：设置君主再次册封前的等待时间。 骑士人数上限 ：设置君主最多可以册封多少名玩家。 隐藏骑士的额外票数 ：设置是否隐藏已受封骑士的额外投票。
search.en: Monarch The Monarch knights players to give them an extra vote; while any knighted player exists, the Monarch cannot be guessed or killed. Role Only one Monarch can spawn in a match. The Monarch can knight players to give them an extra vote. A player who already has multiple votes cannot be knighted; the golden name is visible only to the Monarch. While any knighted player exists, the Monarch cannot be guessed or killed. Settings Knight cooldown : Sets how long the Monarch must wait before knighting another player. Maximum knights : Sets how many players the Monarch can knight. Hide additional votes for knighted players : Controls whether a knight's extra vote is hidden.

summary.zh-CN: 只能在变形状态下击杀。
summary.en: Can make kills only while shapeshifted.

search.zh-CN: 化形者 只能在变形状态下击杀。 技能 化形者只有在变形状态下才能使用击杀键。 选项 数量上限（Max） ：设置本局最多可有多少名化形者。 击杀冷却 ：设置击杀冷却。 变形冷却 ：设置再次变形前的等待时间。 变形持续时间 ：设置每次变形可持续多久。
search.en: Morphling Can make kills only while shapeshifted. Ability The Morphling can use the kill button only while shapeshifted. Options Max : Maximum number of Morphlings in a match. Kill Cooldown : Time before the Morphling can kill again. Shapeshift Cooldown : Time before the Morphling can shapeshift again. Shapeshift Duration : How long each shapeshift lasts.

summary.zh-CN: 入殓师可查看指向尸体的箭头；当前源码未实现可靠的最后接触线索，报告提示存在错误。
summary.en: The Mortician can see arrows to bodies; the current source does not provide a reliable last-contact clue and has an error in the report notification path.

search.zh-CN: 入殓师 入殓师可查看指向尸体的箭头；当前源码未实现可靠的最后接触线索，报告提示存在错误。 职业能力 入殓师可以按设置查看指向尸体的箭头。当前版本的报告提示存在实现错误，无法可靠提供死者的最后接触者或凶手信息，请勿将该提示作为有效线索。 设置 数量上限 ：设置一局中入殓师的最大人数。 显示指向尸体的箭头 ：开启时显示指向所有尸体的箭头；关闭时不显示。
search.en: Mortician The Mortician can see arrows to bodies; the current source does not provide a reliable last-contact clue and has an error in the report notification path. Role The Mortician can see arrows pointing to bodies when enabled. The current version has an implementation error in its report notice and cannot reliably identify the victim's last contact or killer. Do not treat that notice as a reliable clue. Settings Maximum count : Sets the maximum number of Morticians in a match. Arrows pointing to bodies : ON shows arrows pointing to all dead bodies; OFF hides them.

summary.zh-CN: 只有完成任务且具备猜测能力时才能猜测角色；仅可配置船员和中立者获得。
summary.en: Can guess only after finishing tasks and only if it has a role-guessing ability; can be assigned to Crewmates or Neutrals.

search.zh-CN: 平凡者 只有完成任务且具备猜测能力时才能猜测角色；仅可配置船员和中立者获得。 效果 平凡者只能分配给能够猜测角色的玩家；完成全部任务后才可进行猜测。可分别设置船员和中立者是否能获得此附加身份。 设置 Max（最大数量） ：本局中该附加身份可出现的数量上限。 Spawn Chance（生成概率） ：玩家获得此附加身份的概率。 Eligibility（可分配阵营） ：主持人可分别设置船员、中立者是否可以获得此附加身份。
search.en: Mundane Can guess only after finishing tasks and only if it has a role-guessing ability; can be assigned to Crewmates or Neutrals. Effect Mundane can only be assigned to players who can guess roles, and they may guess only after completing all tasks. Separate settings control whether Crewmates and Neutrals can receive it. Settings Max : Maximum number that can appear in one match. Spawn Chance : Chance for a player to receive this add-on. Eligibility : Separate settings control whether Crewmates, Neutrals can receive this add-on.

summary.zh-CN: 受到击杀时会传送到随机通风口，并限时反杀凶手；错杀、超时或会议开始都会死亡。
summary.en: When attacked, teleport to a random vent and kill the attacker before time runs out; a wrong kill, timeout, or meeting means death.

search.zh-CN: 亡灵巫师 受到击杀时会传送到随机通风口，并限时反杀凶手；错杀、超时或会议开始都会死亡。 亡灵巫师 有人试图击杀亡灵巫师时，这次击杀会被阻止，亡灵巫师会被传送到随机通风口，并获得限时复仇机会。亡灵巫师必须在时限内击杀凶手才能存活；超时、会议开始，或在复仇期间击杀凶手以外的玩家，都会使亡灵巫师死亡。亡灵巫师不必成为最后的幸存者：内鬼全部死亡后，若存活的计数中立玩家属于同一计数类型，且计数中立人数不少于船员，中立阵营即可获胜。 设置 击杀冷却 ：再次击杀前的等待时间。 复仇时限 ：击杀凶手前可用的时间。 可使用通风口 ：设置亡灵巫师能否使用通风口。 内鬼视野 ：设置亡灵巫师是否拥有内鬼视野。
search.en: Necromancer When attacked, teleport to a random vent and kill the attacker before time runs out; a wrong kill, timeout, or meeting means death. Necromancer When someone tries to kill the Necromancer, the kill is blocked and the Necromancer teleports to a random vent. They have a limited time to kill their attacker. If they succeed, they survive; if time runs out or a meeting begins, they die. Killing anyone other than the attacker during this revenge window also kills the Necromancer. They do not need to be the last player alive: after all Impostors are gone, the standard neutral end check awards the win when all living counted neutrals share one count type and their total is at least the Crew count. Settings Kill cooldown: Time before killing again. Necromancy time: Time allowed to kill the attacker. Can vent: Whether the Necromancer can use vents. Impostor vision: Whether the Necromancer has Impostor vision.

summary.zh-CN: 存活的死神可在会议期间通过死者名字颜色辨别其所属阵营类别。
summary.en: While alive, Necroview can identify dead players' team categories by their name colors during meetings.

search.zh-CN: 死神 存活的死神可在会议期间通过死者名字颜色辨别其所属阵营类别。 效果 存活的死神在会议期间可通过死者名字颜色辨别其阵营类别：红色代表内鬼阵营（包括叛徒），青色代表船员，灰色代表中立者和转化身份。 设置 Max（最大数量） ：本局中该附加身份可出现的数量上限。 Spawn Chance（生成概率） ：玩家获得此附加身份的概率。 Eligibility（可分配阵营） ：主持人可分别设置内鬼、船员、中立者是否可以获得此附加身份。
search.en: Necroview While alive, Necroview can identify dead players' team categories by their name colors during meetings. Effect During meetings, a living Necroview can identify dead players' team categories by name color: red for the Impostor team, including Madmates; cyan for Crewmates; and gray for Neutrals and converted identities. Settings Max : Maximum number that can appear in one match. Spawn Chance : Chance for a player to receive this add-on. Eligibility : Separate settings control whether Impostors, Crewmates, Neutrals can receive this add-on.

summary.zh-CN: 其他内鬼存活时不能击杀；死亡后可按 `/rv [玩家编号]` 复仇，且独自成为存活内鬼时可以正常击杀。
summary.en: Cannot kill while another Impostor is alive; after death can use `/rv [player ID]` to take revenge, and can kill normally when the last living Impostor.

search.zh-CN: 黑手党 其他内鬼存活时不能击杀；死亡后可按 `/rv [玩家编号]` 复仇，且独自成为存活内鬼时可以正常击杀。 技能 黑手党在其他内鬼存活时不能使用击杀键；当没有其他存活内鬼时，才可像内鬼一样击杀。死亡后可输入 /rv [玩家编号] 复仇击杀一名存活玩家，会议中的玩家名牌也会提供目标按钮。复仇次数有限。 选项 数量上限（Max） ：设置本局最多可有多少名黑手党。 复仇人数上限 ：设置黑手党死后最多可复仇击杀多少名玩家。 使用旧版本 ：开启旧版模式；此模式使用变形者基础职业，并启用下列变形选项。 变形冷却 ：设置旧版模式下的变形冷却。 变形持续时间 ：设置旧版模式下的变形持续时间。
search.en: Nemesis Cannot kill while another Impostor is alive; after death can use `/rv [player ID]` to take revenge, and can kill normally when the last living Impostor. Ability The Nemesis cannot use the kill button while another Impostor is alive. It can kill normally once it is the only living Impostor. After the Nemesis dies, it can enter /rv [player ID] to kill a living target as revenge; dead Nemesis players also get target buttons during meetings. The number of revenge kills is limited. Options Max : Maximum number of Nemeses in a match. Max Number of Revenges : Maximum number of revenge kills after death. Use Legacy Version : Enables the legacy mode, which uses the Shapeshifter base role and the following shapeshift settings. Shapeshift Cooldown : Cooldown in legacy mode. Shapeshift Duration : Duration in legacy mode.

summary.zh-CN: 正义赌怪在会议中猜测玩家职业，猜对会击杀目标，猜错则自己死亡。
summary.en: During a meeting, the Nice Guesser guesses a player's role; a correct guess kills the target, while a wrong guess kills the Guesser.

search.zh-CN: 正义赌怪 正义赌怪在会议中猜测玩家职业，猜对会击杀目标，猜错则自己死亡。 职业能力 正义赌怪可在会议中猜测一名玩家的职业。猜对会击杀目标；猜错则正义赌怪死亡。成为叛徒后可以猜测船员职业。指令：/bt [玩家 ID] [职业名]。玩家 ID 显示在名字旁，也可输入 /id 查看。 设置 数量上限 ：设置一局中正义赌怪的最大人数。 猜测次数上限 ：设置正义赌怪最多能猜测的次数。 可以猜测船员职业 ：开启时可以猜测船员职业；关闭时不能。 可以猜测附加职业 ：开启时可以猜测玩家的附加职业；关闭时不能。 尝试隐藏猜测指令 ：开启时模组会尝试隐藏正义赌怪的指令；关闭时不尝试隐藏。
search.en: Nice Guesser During a meeting, the Nice Guesser guesses a player's role; a correct guess kills the target, while a wrong guess kills the Guesser. Role During a meeting, the Nice Guesser can guess a player's role. A correct guess kills the target; a wrong guess kills the Nice Guesser. As a Madmate, the Nice Guesser can guess Crewmate roles. Use /bt [player ID] [role]. IDs appear next to player names or can be listed with /id. Settings Maximum count : Sets the maximum number of Nice Guessers in a match. Maximum guesses : Sets how many guesses the Nice Guesser can make. Can guess Crewmate roles : ON allows guesses of Crewmate roles; OFF disables them. Can guess add-ons : ON allows guessing a player's add-ons; OFF disables add-on guesses. Try to hide Guesser command : ON makes the mod attempt to hide the Nice Guesser's commands; OFF does not.

summary.zh-CN: 好迷你船员长大前不能被击杀；若在长大前死亡或被会议驱逐，会以好迷你为胜者结束游戏。
summary.en: The Nice Mini cannot be killed before growing up; if they die or are ejected before then, the game ends with the Nice Mini as the winner.

search.zh-CN: 好迷你船员 好迷你船员长大前不能被击杀；若在长大前死亡或被会议驱逐，会以好迷你为胜者结束游戏。 职业能力 好迷你船员长大前不会被击杀。如果其在长大前死亡或在会议中被驱逐，游戏会以好迷你为胜者结束。
search.en: Nice Mini The Nice Mini cannot be killed before growing up; if they die or are ejected before then, the game ends with the Nice Mini as the winner. Role The Nice Mini cannot be killed until they grow up. If they die or are ejected from a meeting before growing up, the game ends with the Nice Mini as the winner.

summary.zh-CN: 仅分配给具有内鬼基础阵营的船员，并使其获得使用通风口的能力。
summary.en: Assigned only to Crewmates with an Impostor basis, granting vent access.

search.zh-CN: 敏捷 仅分配给具有内鬼基础阵营的船员，并使其获得使用通风口的能力。 效果 敏捷会让玩家获得使用通风口的能力。它只分配给具有内鬼基础阵营的船员。 设置 Max（最大数量） ：本局中该附加身份可出现的数量上限。 Spawn Chance（生成概率） ：玩家获得此附加身份的概率。
search.en: Nimble Assigned only to Crewmates with an Impostor basis, granting vent access. Effect Nimble grants access to the vent ability and is assigned only to Crewmates with an Impostor basis. Settings Max : Maximum number that can appear in one match. Spawn Chance : Chance for a player to receive this add-on.

summary.zh-CN: 单击标记目标，双击普通击杀；标记后变形会传送至目标并将其击杀。
summary.en: Single-clicks to mark a target and double-clicks to kill normally; after marking, shapeshifting teleports to and kills the target.

search.zh-CN: 刺客 单击标记目标，双击普通击杀；标记后变形会传送至目标并将其击杀。 技能 击杀键单击可标记目标，标记成功会出现护盾动画；双击则普通击杀。标记后使用变形会传送至目标并将其刺杀。幼年 Mini 不可被刺杀。 选项 数量上限（Max） ：设置本局最多可有多少名刺客。 标记冷却 ：设置再次标记前的等待时间。 刺杀冷却 ：设置再次发动刺杀前的等待时间。 变形持续时间 ：设置刺客的变形持续时间。
search.en: Ninja Single-clicks to mark a target and double-clicks to kill normally; after marking, shapeshifting teleports to and kills the target. Ability Single-click the kill button to mark a target; a shield animation confirms the mark. Double-click to make a normal kill. After marking a target, shapeshifting teleports to and kills that target. A Mini who has not grown up cannot be assassinated. Options Max : Maximum number of Ninjas in a match. Mark Cooldown : Time before marking another target. Assassinate Cooldown : Time before another assassination. Shapeshift Duration : How long the shapeshift lasts.

summary.zh-CN: 大嗓门死亡时会发出声音并显示死亡提示，船员可据此赶到现场；内鬼提示和持续时间可设置。
summary.en: When the Noisemaker dies, a sound and visual alert mark the death for Crewmates; Impostor alerts and alert duration are configurable.

search.zh-CN: 大嗓门（TOHE） 大嗓门死亡时会发出声音并显示死亡提示，船员可据此赶到现场；内鬼提示和持续时间可设置。 职业能力 大嗓门死亡时会发出声音，屏幕上也会出现死亡提示，帮助船员赶到现场追查凶手。 设置 数量与生成率 ：由 TOHE 的角色生成选项控制。 内鬼可收到提示 ：开启时内鬼能看到大嗓门的死亡提示；关闭时不显示给内鬼。 提示持续时间 ：设置死亡提示显示多久。
search.en: Noisemaker (TOHE) When the Noisemaker dies, a sound and visual alert mark the death for Crewmates; Impostor alerts and alert duration are configurable. Role When the Noisemaker dies, they make a sound and a visual death alert appears on screen so Crewmates can reach the scene. Settings Count and spawn chance : Controlled by the TOHE role-spawn options. Impostor alert : ON lets Impostors see the Noisemaker's alert; OFF hides it from them. Alert duration : Sets how long the alert lasts.

summary.zh-CN: 无法报告尸体；可设置诱饵强制报告对胆小鬼的影响，且与多种调查或报告角色不兼容。
summary.en: Cannot report bodies; settings govern Bait's forced report, and the add-on is incompatible with several investigation or reporting roles.

search.zh-CN: 胆小鬼 无法报告尸体；可设置诱饵强制报告对胆小鬼的影响，且与多种调查或报告角色不兼容。 效果 胆小鬼无法报告尸体。它与侦探（Detective）、秃鹫（Vulture）、侦察员（Sleuth）、清理工（Cleaner）、失忆者（Amnesiac）、验尸官（Coroner）、美杜莎（Medusa）、入殓师（Mortician）、灵媒（Medium）、击杀机器（KillingMachine）、GuardianAngelTOHE 和利他者（Altruist）不兼容。启用诱饵免疫后，击杀诱饵不会触发强制自动报告，但胆小鬼也不能手动报告该尸体；关闭时按诱饵的正常报告机制处理。 设置 Max（最大数量） ：本局中该附加身份可出现的数量上限。 Spawn Chance（生成概率） ：玩家获得此附加身份的概率。 Eligibility（可分配阵营） ：主持人可分别设置内鬼、船员和中立者是否可以获得此附加身份。 ObliviousBaitImmune（免疫诱饵自动报告） ：控制是否对胆小鬼击杀诱饵后的强制报告免疫；开启后，胆小鬼也不能手动报告该诱饵尸体。
search.en: Oblivious Cannot report bodies; settings govern Bait's forced report, and the add-on is incompatible with several investigation or reporting roles. Effect Oblivious cannot report bodies. It is incompatible with Detective, Vulture, Sleuth, Cleaner, Amnesiac, Coroner, Medusa, Mortician, Medium, KillingMachine, GuardianAngelTOHE, and Altruist. With Bait immunity enabled, killing Bait does not force an automatic report, and Oblivious also cannot report that body manually. With immunity disabled, Bait's normal report behavior applies. Settings Max : Maximum number that can appear in one match. Spawn Chance : Chance for a player to receive this add-on. Eligibility : Separate settings control whether Impostors, Crewmates, and Neutrals can receive this add-on. ObliviousBaitImmune : Whether Bait's forced report is suppressed for an Oblivious killer; enabled immunity also prevents them from manually reporting that Bait body.

summary.zh-CN: 首次会议后，观察者可以看到其他玩家触发的护盾动画。
summary.en: After the first meeting, the Observer can see shield animations caused by other players.

search.zh-CN: 观察者 首次会议后，观察者可以看到其他玩家触发的护盾动画。 职业能力 首次会议后，观察者可以看到其他玩家触发的护盾动画。 设置 数量上限 ：设置一局中观察者的最大人数。
search.en: Observer After the first meeting, the Observer can see shield animations caused by other players. Role After the first meeting, the Observer can see shield animations caused by other players. Settings Maximum count : Sets the maximum number of Observers in a match.

summary.zh-CN: 被合格玩家击杀时会尝试抹除其主角色；是否传递 OIIAI 及中立击杀者的处理方式可设置。
summary.en: When killed by an eligible player, attempts to erase their main role; OIIAI transfer and Neutral-killer handling are configurable.

search.zh-CN: OIIAI 被合格玩家击杀时会尝试抹除其主角色；是否传递 OIIAI 及中立击杀者的处理方式可设置。 效果 非杀戮机器击杀 OIIAI 时，击杀者可能获得 OIIAI，且其主角色会尝试被抹除；同一击杀者的主角色最多抹除一次，部分角色不能被抹除。中立击杀者选择“保持原角色”时，整个 OIIAI 效果不会触发；选择失忆者或效仿者时，有击杀按钮的中立者会转为所选角色，没有击杀按钮的中立者会转为机会主义者。 设置 Max（最大数量） ：本局中该附加身份可出现的数量上限。 Spawn Chance（生成概率） ：玩家获得此附加身份的概率。 Eligibility（可分配阵营） ：主持人可分别设置内鬼、船员、中立者是否可以获得此附加身份。 OIIAI can pass onto the killer（OIIAI 可传给击杀者） ：控制 OIIAI 的击杀者是否会获得 OIIAI 附加身份。 Neutrals turn to（Neutral 击杀者转变为） ：设置击杀 OIIAI 的中立者如何处理；选择保持原角色时不会触发 OIIAI 效果。选择失忆者或效仿者时，无击杀按钮的中立者实际会转为机会主义者。
search.en: OIIAI When killed by an eligible player, attempts to erase their main role; OIIAI transfer and Neutral-killer handling are configurable. Effect When a player other than KillingMachine kills OIIAI, the killer may receive OIIAI and their main role is checked for erasure. Each killer's role can be erased at most once, and some roles cannot be erased. For a Neutral killer, choosing No Change prevents the OIIAI effect entirely; choosing Amnesiac or Imitator changes a Neutral with a kill button to that role, while a Neutral without one becomes Opportunist. Settings Max : Maximum number that can appear in one match. Spawn Chance : Chance for a player to receive this add-on. Eligibility : Separate settings control whether Impostors, Crewmates, Neutrals can receive this add-on. OIIAI can pass onto the killer : Whether OIIAI's killer receives the OIIAI add-on. Neutrals turn to : Choose how a Neutral killer is handled. No Change prevents the OIIAI effect; when Amnesiac or Imitator is selected, a Neutral without a kill button becomes Opportunist.

summary.zh-CN: 会议中无法被赌怪猜中。
summary.en: Cannot be guessed by Guessers during meetings.

search.zh-CN: 不可被赌 会议中无法被赌怪猜中。 效果 持有不可被赌的玩家在会议中无法被猜测。 设置 Max（最大数量） ：本局中该附加身份可出现的数量上限。 Spawn Chance（生成概率） ：玩家获得此附加身份的概率。 Eligibility（可分配阵营） ：主持人可分别设置内鬼、船员、中立者是否可以获得此附加身份。
search.en: Onbound Cannot be guessed by Guessers during meetings. Effect A player with Onbound cannot be guessed during meetings. Settings Max : Maximum number that can be in one match. Spawn Chance : Chance for a player to receive this add-on. Eligibility : Separate settings control whether Impostors, Crewmates, Neutrals can receive this add-on.

summary.zh-CN: 存活到游戏结束即可随获胜阵营获胜；死亡则失败。
summary.en: Survive until the end to win with the winning team; dying means losing.

search.zh-CN: 投机者 存活到游戏结束即可随获胜阵营获胜；死亡则失败。 投机者 投机者存活到游戏结束时，会随获胜阵营获胜；死亡则失败。 设置 人数上限 ：一局中可出现的投机者数量上限。 完成任务后免疫攻击 ：开启后，完成任务的投机者免疫攻击；关闭后不获得该免疫。 覆盖投机者任务数 ：开启后，可单独设置投机者的任务数；关闭后使用与其他玩家相同的任务数。单独设置时可配置是否有普通任务，以及长任务和短任务数量。
search.en: Opportunist Survive until the end to win with the winning team; dying means losing. Opportunist The Opportunist wins with the winning team if they survive until the end of the game. They lose if they die. Settings Maximum number: Maximum number of Opportunists in a match. Immune to attacks on task completion: When enabled, an Opportunist who completes their tasks is immune to attacks. Override tasks: When enabled, configure the Opportunist's tasks separately, including whether they have common tasks and the number of long and short tasks. When disabled, they have the same task count as other players.

summary.zh-CN: 神谕在会议中投票给玩家后会查看其船员、内鬼或中立阵营结果；开启附加职业选项时，分类也会考虑附加职业的阵营倾向，结果可能出错。
summary.en: After voting for a player in a meeting, the Oracle learns whether they are Crew, Impostor, or Neutral; when enabled, the add-on option also factors add-on team alignment into classification, which may be wrong.

search.zh-CN: 神谕 神谕在会议中投票给玩家后会查看其船员、内鬼或中立阵营结果；开启附加职业选项时，分类也会考虑附加职业的阵营倾向，结果可能出错。 职业能力 神谕在会议中投票给玩家后，会得知目标属于船员、内鬼还是中立阵营；结果可能不准确。开启“检查附加职业阵营”时，分类还会检查目标的附加职业阵营倾向，不只是显示目标是否有附加职业。 设置 数量上限 ：设置一局中神谕的最大人数。 使用次数上限 ：设置神谕可使用技能的次数。 显示错误结果的概率 ：设置神谕给出错误阵营结果的概率。 每完成一个任务获得的技能次数 ：设置每完成一个任务增加的次数，按 0.1 为步进。 按附加职业阵营分类 ：开启时分类会把目标附加职业的阵营倾向纳入船员/内鬼/中立结果；关闭时按目标主职业分类。
search.en: Oracle After voting for a player in a meeting, the Oracle learns whether they are Crew, Impostor, or Neutral; when enabled, the add-on option also factors add-on team alignment into classification, which may be wrong. Role After voting for a player in a meeting, the Oracle learns whether the target is Crew, Impostor, or Neutral. The result can be incorrect. When the add-on option is enabled, the classification also considers the team's alignment of the target's add-ons; it does not simply report whether add-ons are present. Settings Maximum count : Sets the maximum number of Oracles in a match. Maximum uses : Sets how many times the Oracle can use the ability. Chance of an incorrect result : Sets the chance that the Oracle receives an incorrect team result. Ability uses gained per task : Sets the uses gained for each completed task, in 0.1 increments. Classify using add-on alignment : ON includes the target's add-on team alignment when deciding Crew, Impostor, or Neutral; OFF classifies by the target's main role.

summary.zh-CN: 仅分配给有击杀按钮的角色，并按设定比例缩短击杀冷却。
summary.en: Assigned only to roles with a kill button and reduces their kill cooldown by a configured percentage.

search.zh-CN: 超频波 仅分配给有击杀按钮的角色，并按设定比例缩短击杀冷却。 效果 超频波会按设定比例缩短玩家的击杀冷却时间，只分配给拥有击杀按钮的角色。 设置 Max（最大数量） ：本局中该附加身份可出现的数量上限。 Spawn Chance（生成概率） ：玩家获得此附加身份的概率。 Kill Cooldown Reduction（击杀冷却缩短比例） ：玩家击杀冷却缩短的百分比。
search.en: Overclocked Assigned only to roles with a kill button and reduces their kill cooldown by a configured percentage. Effect Overclocked reduces a player's kill cooldown by a configured percentage and is assigned only to roles with a kill button. Settings Max : Maximum number that can appear in one match. Spawn Chance : Chance for a player to receive this add-on. Kill Cooldown Reduction : Percentage by which the player's kill cooldown is reduced.

summary.zh-CN: 预言家使用击杀按钮揭示附近最近玩家的职业，但必须在有限视野内靠近目标一段时间。
summary.en: The Overseer uses the kill button to reveal the nearest player's role, but must stay close to the target for a set time and has limited vision.

search.zh-CN: 预言家 预言家使用击杀按钮揭示附近最近玩家的职业，但必须在有限视野内靠近目标一段时间。 职业能力 预言家的视野有限。使用击杀按钮扫描最近玩家时，目标旁会显示标记，只有预言家能看到；预言家必须在有限视野内靠近目标一段时间才能揭示其职业，离得太远会取消扫描。 设置 数量上限 ：设置一局中预言家的最大人数。 揭示冷却 ：设置再次发动揭示前的等待时间。 揭示时间 ：设置必须靠近目标多久才能查看其职业。 预言家视野 ：设置预言家的视野范围。
search.en: Overseer The Overseer uses the kill button to reveal the nearest player's role, but must stay close to the target for a set time and has limited vision. Role The Overseer has limited vision. Using the kill button starts a scan on the nearest player and places a marker by the target that only the Overseer sees. The Overseer must stay close for the configured time to reveal the role; moving too far away cancels the scan. Settings Maximum count : Sets the maximum number of Overseers in a match. Reveal cooldown : Sets how long the Overseer must wait before using the ability again. Reveal time : Sets how long the Overseer must stay near the target to reveal their role. Overseer vision : Sets how far the Overseer can see.

summary.zh-CN: 和平之鸽钻通风口后会重置所有拥有击杀按钮玩家的击杀冷却，成为叛徒时仅影响船员。
summary.en: The Pacifist can vent to reset kill cooldowns for everyone with a kill button; as a Mad Pacifist, the effect applies only to Crew.

search.zh-CN: 和平之鸽 和平之鸽钻通风口后会重置所有拥有击杀按钮玩家的击杀冷却，成为叛徒时仅影响船员。 职业能力 和平之鸽钻通风口后，会重置所有拥有击杀按钮玩家的击杀冷却，即使其技能实际上不能击杀目标（例如医生）。成为叛徒和平之鸽时，能力只影响船员阵营。 设置 数量上限 ：设置一局中和平之鸽的最大人数。 技能冷却 ：设置再次使用能力前的等待时间。 技能使用次数上限 ：设置最多可重置冷却的次数。 每完成一个任务获得的技能次数 ：设置每完成一个任务增加的次数，按 0.1 为步进。
search.en: Pacifist The Pacifist can vent to reset kill cooldowns for everyone with a kill button; as a Mad Pacifist, the effect applies only to Crew. Role When the Pacifist vents, they reset the kill cooldown for everyone with a kill button, even if that player cannot actually kill, such as the Medic. As a Mad Pacifist, the ability affects only Crewmates. Settings Maximum count : Sets the maximum number of Pacifists in a match. Ability cooldown : Sets how long the Pacifist must wait before resetting cooldowns again. Maximum ability uses : Sets how many times the Pacifist can reset cooldowns. Ability uses gained per task : Sets the uses gained for each completed task, in 0.1 increments.

summary.zh-CN: 仅船员或内鬼可获得；胜负人数判定时计作两人，并可在会议中追加一票。
summary.en: Only Crewmates or Impostors can receive it; counts as two for parity checks and can cast an extra meeting vote.

search.zh-CN: 双重人格 仅船员或内鬼可获得；胜负人数判定时计作两人，并可在会议中追加一票。 效果 叛徒和中立者不能获得双重人格。胜负人数判定时，双重人格会额外计作一人；开启 DualVotes 后，它在会议中也会产生一张额外投票。该能力可单独关闭，额外投票是否显示也可设置。 设置 Max（最大数量） ：本局中该附加身份可出现的数量上限。 Spawn Chance（生成概率） ：玩家获得此附加身份的概率。 Eligibility（可分配阵营） ：主持人可分别设置内鬼、船员是否可以获得此附加身份。 DualVotes（追加投票） ：控制双重人格是否在会议中追加一票。 HideAdditionalVotes（隐藏追加投票） ：控制会议界面是否隐藏追加投票。
search.en: Paranoia Only Crewmates or Impostors can receive it; counts as two for parity checks and can cast an extra meeting vote. Effect Madmates and Neutrals cannot receive Paranoia. It counts as one additional player for parity checks. When DualVotes is enabled, it also contributes an extra vote during meetings; the ability and visibility of that extra vote are configurable. Settings Max : Maximum number that can appear in one match. Spawn Chance : Chance for a player to receive this add-on. Eligibility : Separate settings control whether Impostors, Crewmates can receive this add-on. DualVotes : Whether Paranoia contributes an extra vote during meetings. HideAdditionalVotes : Whether the additional vote is hidden in the meeting display.

summary.zh-CN: 寄生虫与内鬼互不相认，但按普通内鬼方式行动并与内鬼一同获胜。
summary.en: The Parasite and Impostors do not know each other, but it acts like a normal Impostor and wins with them.

search.zh-CN: 寄生虫 寄生虫与内鬼互不相认，但按普通内鬼方式行动并与内鬼一同获胜。 技能 寄生虫不知道其他内鬼是谁，内鬼也不知道寄生虫的身份。寄生虫仍与内鬼阵营共同获胜，并可正常击杀、使用通风口和发动破坏。 选项 击杀冷却 ：设置寄生虫的击杀冷却。
search.en: Parasite The Parasite and Impostors do not know each other, but it acts like a normal Impostor and wins with them. Ability The Parasite does not know who the other Impostors are, and they do not know the Parasite. It wins with the Impostors and can kill, vent, and sabotage like a normal Impostor. Options Kill Cooldown : The Parasite’s kill cooldown.

summary.zh-CN: 使用击杀按钮活吞玩家并将其移出地图；会议或报告尸体会使被吞者立即死亡。
summary.en: Swallow players alive and remove them from the map; a meeting or body report immediately kills swallowed players.

search.zh-CN: 鹈鹕 使用击杀按钮活吞玩家并将其移出地图；会议或报告尸体会使被吞者立即死亡。 鹈鹕 鹈鹕使用击杀按钮活吞玩家。被吞者会被传送到地图外，无法与游戏互动。召开紧急会议或报告尸体时，所有被吞玩家都会立即死亡；若鹈鹕死亡或断线，被吞者会返回鹈鹕死亡的位置。吞人不是普通击杀，因此保镖、老兵等职业技能不会生效。 仅剩鹈鹕与船员阵营，且鹈鹕人数不少于船员时，鹈鹕获胜。 设置 吞食冷却 ：再次吞食玩家前的等待时间。 可使用通风口 ：设置鹈鹕能否使用通风口。 内鬼视野 ：设置鹈鹕是否拥有内鬼视野。
search.en: Pelican Swallow players alive and remove them from the map; a meeting or body report immediately kills swallowed players. Pelican The Pelican uses the kill button to swallow a player alive. The swallowed player is teleported off the map and cannot interact with the game. An emergency meeting or a body report immediately kills swallowed players. If the Pelican dies or disconnects, swallowed players return to the Pelican's death location. Swallowing is not a normal kill, so abilities such as Bodyguard and Veteran do not trigger. The Pelican team wins after all Impostors are gone when all living counted neutrals share one count type and Pelicans are at least as numerous as Crewmates. Settings Eat cooldown: Time before the Pelican can swallow another player. Can vent: Whether the Pelican can use vents. Impostor vision: Whether the Pelican has Impostor vision.

summary.zh-CN: 单击束缚并拖拽目标，再次击杀或拖拽时间结束时将其杀死；双击可直接击杀。
summary.en: Restrains and drags a target; a second kill-button press or the drag timer kills them. Double-clicking kills directly.

search.zh-CN: 企鹅 单击束缚并拖拽目标，再次击杀或拖拽时间结束时将其杀死；双击可直接击杀。 技能 单击击杀键束缚并拖拽目标。拖拽期间再次按击杀键可杀死目标；到达拖拽时限后目标也会死亡。双击可直接击杀。拖拽期间开始会议时，目标是否死亡由选项决定；若拖拽时限已到，会议开始时仍会杀死目标。 选项 拖拽时间 ：设置企鹅可拖拽目标多久。 拖拽期间开始会议时杀死目标 ：开启时，报告尸体或召开紧急会议会杀死正在被拖拽的目标；关闭时，会议本身不会杀死目标，但已到期的拖拽仍会将其杀死。
search.en: Penguin Restrains and drags a target; a second kill-button press or the drag timer kills them. Double-clicking kills directly. Ability Press the kill button once to restrain and drag a target. Press it again while dragging to kill the target; the target also dies when the drag timer expires. Double-click to kill directly. If a meeting starts during a drag, the setting determines whether the target is killed; if the drag timer has already expired, the target is killed when the meeting starts regardless. Options Dragging Time : How long the Penguin can drag a player. Kill the Target if a Meeting Starts During Dragging : When enabled, reporting a body or calling an emergency meeting kills the dragged target. When disabled, a meeting alone does not kill the target, but an already-expired drag timer still does.

summary.zh-CN: 感染所有其他存活玩家后转变为瘟疫；常规击杀会反弹，猜测其职业会使猜测者死亡。
summary.en: Infect every other living player to become Pestilence; standard kill attempts are reflected, and guessing Pestilence kills the guesser.

search.zh-CN: 瘟疫 感染所有其他存活玩家后转变为瘟疫；常规击杀会反弹，猜测其职业会使猜测者死亡。 瘟疫 瘟疫使者感染所有其他存活玩家后会转变为瘟疫。常规击杀检查中，非天启职业攻击瘟疫会被反弹，攻击者死亡；其他天启职业的攻击会被阻止，但不会反伤。猜测瘟疫职业会使猜测者自杀，而不是杀死瘟疫；投票放逐可以将瘟疫杀死。强制或间接击杀可能绕过常规击杀反弹。瘟疫不必成为最后的幸存者：内鬼全部死亡后，若所有存活的计数中立玩家属于同一计数类型且人数不少于船员，中立阵营即可获胜。 瘟疫转变后的下一次会议中，所有玩家都会得知其存在。
search.en: Pestilence Infect every other living player to become Pestilence; standard kill attempts are reflected, and guessing Pestilence kills the guesser. Pestilence After the Plaguebearer infects every other living player, they transform into Pestilence. In a standard kill check, an attack by a non-Apocalypse role is reflected and kills the attacker; attacks from other Apocalypse roles are blocked without reflection. Guessing Pestilence's role kills the guesser instead; voting Pestilence out can kill it. Forced or indirect deaths can bypass the standard kill reflection. Pestilence does not need to be the last player alive: after all Impostors are gone, the standard neutral end check awards the win when all living counted neutrals share one count type and their total is at least the Crew count. Pestilence's presence is announced to everyone at the meeting after the transformation.

summary.zh-CN: 使用消失按钮隐身以躲避击杀，并可在倒计时结束前主动显形；隐身和显形都会产生烟雾。
summary.en: Uses the vanish button to turn invisible and avoid a kill; can reappear early, and both transitions create smoke.

search.zh-CN: 幻象师 使用消失按钮隐身以躲避击杀，并可在倒计时结束前主动显形；隐身和显形都会产生烟雾。 技能 使用消失按钮进入隐身状态以躲避击杀；可在持续时间结束前按显形按钮恢复可见。进入和退出隐身都会产生烟雾。 选项 数量上限（Max） ：设置本局最多可有多少名幻象师。 隐身冷却 ：设置再次隐身前的等待时间。 隐身持续时间 ：设置隐身状态持续多久。
search.en: Phantom Uses the vanish button to turn invisible and avoid a kill; can reappear early, and both transitions create smoke. Ability Press the vanish button to become invisible and escape a kill. The Phantom can press the appear button to become visible before the timer ends. A smoke cloud appears both when it vanishes and when it reappears. Options Max : Maximum number of Phantoms in a match. Invis Cooldown : Time before the Phantom can turn invisible again. Invis Duration : How long the Phantom stays invisible.
