summary.zh-CN: 每次击杀都会增加额外投票权，且可对其他玩家隐藏；内鬼阵营消灭后按中立平衡条件获胜。
summary.en: Gain extra voting power for kills and optionally hide it; win under the neutral parity rule after the Impostors are gone.

search.zh-CN: 小偷 每次击杀都会增加额外投票权，且可对其他玩家隐藏；内鬼阵营消灭后按中立平衡条件获胜。 小偷 小偷会根据自己造成的击杀获得额外投票权；这些额外票数不会从目标身上扣除。根据设置，额外票数会对其他玩家隐藏。小偷不必成为最后的幸存者：内鬼全部死亡后，若存活的计数中立玩家属于同一计数类型，且计数中立人数不少于船员，中立阵营即可获胜。 设置 击杀冷却 ：再次击杀并偷取投票权前的等待时间。 可使用通风口 ：设置小偷能否使用通风口。 内鬼视野 ：开启后拥有内鬼视野；关闭后使用船员视野。 每次击杀获得的票数 ：设置每次击杀增加的投票权，按 0.1 递增；累计结果会截为整数票。 隐藏额外票数 ：设置偷来的票数是否对其他玩家隐藏。
search.en: Pickpocket Gain extra voting power for kills and optionally hide it; win under the neutral parity rule after the Impostors are gone. Pickpocket The Pickpocket gains extra voting power for kills; these votes are added rather than taken from the killed player. A setting controls whether the extra votes are hidden. The Pickpocket does not need to be the last player alive: after all Impostors are gone, the standard neutral end check awards the win when all living counted neutrals share one count type and their total is at least the Crew count. Settings Kill cooldown: Time before the Pickpocket can kill and steal votes again. Can vent: Whether the Pickpocket can use vents. Impostor vision: Whether the Pickpocket has Impostor vision. Votes gained per kill: Extra voting power added per kill, in increments of 0.1; the total is truncated to whole votes. Hide additional votes: Whether the stolen votes are hidden from other players.

summary.zh-CN: 每轮选择一名玩家数字决斗；相同数字得分并击杀目标，目标未提交也会被击杀但不得分。
summary.en: Choose a player for a number duel each round; matching numbers score and kill the target, while a nonresponsive target dies without scoring.

search.zh-CN: 决斗者 每轮选择一名玩家数字决斗；相同数字得分并击杀目标，目标未提交也会被击杀但不得分。 决斗者（Pirate） 决斗者每轮可以使用击杀按钮选择一名目标，并在下一次会议与目标决斗。双方都提交数字且相同时，决斗者赢得该次决斗并增加一分；若目标仍存活，也会被击杀。数字不同则不会得分或击杀。目标没有提交数字时会被击杀，但决斗者不得分；决斗者没有提交数字则不会结算。对未满18岁的友善小不点使用按钮会进入普通击杀流程，而不会开始决斗；攻击瘟疫会触发瘟疫的反击。 决斗指令为 /duel X ，其中 X 可以是 0 、 1 或 2 。赢得房主设置数量的决斗后，决斗者获胜。 设置 决斗冷却 ：再次使用能力前的等待时间。 隐藏决斗指令 ：开启后，模组会尝试隐藏 /duel 指令；关闭后不会尝试隐藏。 获胜所需成功决斗数 ：决斗者获胜前需要赢得的决斗次数。
search.en: Pirate Choose a player for a number duel each round; matching numbers score and kill the target, while a nonresponsive target dies without scoring. Pirate Each round, the Pirate can use the kill button to select a target, then duel that target at the next meeting. If both players submit the same number, the Pirate scores one point and kills the target if they are still alive; different numbers give no point and kill neither player. If the target does not submit, they are killed if still alive, without giving the Pirate a point. If the Pirate does not submit, nothing is resolved. Using the button on a Nice Mini under 18 follows normal kill processing instead of starting a duel; attacking Pestilence triggers its retaliation. Use /duel X to choose a number, where X is 0 , 1 , or 2 . Win the host-configured number of duels to win the game. Settings Duel cooldown: Time before using the ability again. Hide Pirate commands: When enabled, the mod attempts to hide /duel commands. Successful duels required to win: Number of duels the Pirate must win.

summary.zh-CN: 用变形在周围布置陷阱；进入陷阱的玩家会被冻结并受到视野影响。
summary.en: Shapeshifts to place traps that freeze players who enter and affect their vision.

search.zh-CN: 设陷者 用变形在周围布置陷阱；进入陷阱的玩家会被冻结并受到视野影响。 技能 变形会在周围区域设置陷阱。进入陷阱的玩家会短暂无法移动，视野也会受到影响。 选项 数量上限（Max） ：设置本局最多可有多少名设陷者。 陷阱冷却 ：设置再次布置陷阱前的等待时间。 陷阱数量 ：设置可同时布置的陷阱数量。 每个陷阱可捕获人数 ：设置单个陷阱最多可困住多少名玩家。 陷阱持续时间 ：设置陷阱保持有效多久。 陷阱半径 ：设置陷阱范围大小。 冻结时间 ：设置被困玩家无法移动多久。 视野影响程度 ：设置陷阱对玩家视野的影响。 视野影响时间 ：设置视野影响持续多久。
search.en: Pitfall Shapeshifts to place traps that freeze players who enter and affect their vision. Ability Shapeshifting places a trap in the surrounding area. Players who enter it are immobilized briefly and have their vision affected. Options Max : Maximum number of Pitfalls in a match. Trap Cooldown : Time before the Pitfall can place another trap. Number of Traps : Maximum number of traps that can be placed. Players Caught per Trap : Maximum number of players a single trap can catch. Trap Active Time : How long a trap remains active. Trap Radius : Size of the trap area. Trap Freeze Time : How long caught players are immobilized. Trap Vision Effect : Amount of vision impairment caused by the trap. Trap Vision Duration : How long the vision effect lasts.

summary.zh-CN: 每轮标记目标，并在会议中促成至少一名目标被放逐以得分；达到分数后随胜利阵营获胜。
summary.en: Mark targets each round and get at least one voted out at the meeting to score; reach the required score to win with the winning team.

search.zh-CN: 小精灵 每轮标记目标，并在会议中促成至少一名目标被放逐以得分；达到分数后随胜利阵营获胜。 小精灵 小精灵每轮可以使用击杀按钮标记至多设定数量的目标，目标会以彩色名字显示。会议放逐一名标记目标时，小精灵获得一分。若实际有人被放逐，但放逐的不是标记目标，且仍有标记目标存活，开启自杀选项后小精灵会自杀；跳过会议、没有标记目标或所有标记目标都已死亡时不会因此自杀。通常在会议放逐后会清空本轮目标；达到获胜分数后，目标列表可能不会清空。 达到房主设置的分数后，小精灵会随获胜阵营获胜。 设置 人数上限 ：一局中可出现的小精灵数量上限。 获胜所需分数 ：小精灵获胜需要的分数。 每轮目标上限 ：每轮可标记的玩家数量。 标记冷却 ：标记下一名玩家前的等待时间。 目标未被放逐时自杀 ：默认关闭。开启后，只有在有人被放逐、放逐者不是标记目标且仍有标记目标存活时，小精灵才会自杀；跳过会议不会触发自杀，也不会重置目标名单。
search.en: Pixie Mark targets each round and get at least one voted out at the meeting to score; reach the required score to win with the winning team. Pixie Each round, the Pixie can use the kill button to mark up to the configured number of targets. Their names appear in color. When a marked target is voted out, the Pixie earns one point. If someone else is voted out while at least one marked target is still alive, the Pixie suicides only when the suicide option is enabled. Skipping the meeting, marking nobody, or having all marked targets already dead does not trigger this suicide. The target list normally clears after an ejection; once the Pixie has reached the required score, the list may remain uncleared. The Pixie wins with the winning team after reaching the host-configured score. Settings Maximum number: Maximum number of Pixies in a match. Points required to win: Score needed for victory. Maximum targets per round: Number of players the Pixie can mark each round. Mark cooldown: Time before marking another player. Suicide if no target is voted out: Off by default. When enabled, the Pixie suicides only if someone is voted out, that player was not a marked target, and at least one marked target is still alive. Skipping the meeting does not trigger the suicide or reset the target list.

summary.zh-CN: 感染所有其他存活玩家后转变为瘟疫；转化后按天启阵营的中立平衡条件获胜。
summary.en: Infect every other living player to become Pestilence; win under the Apocalypse neutral parity rule after transforming.

search.zh-CN: 瘟疫使者 感染所有其他存活玩家后转变为瘟疫；转化后按天启阵营的中立平衡条件获胜。 瘟疫使者 瘟疫使者使用击杀按钮标记感染者。所有其他存活玩家都被感染后，瘟疫使者会转变为瘟疫。玩家击杀他人或报告尸体时，感染会在未感染的参与者之间传播。 转变为瘟疫后，常规击杀检查中，非天启职业对瘟疫的攻击会反弹并杀死攻击者；其他天启职业的攻击会被阻止但不会反伤。瘟疫可以击杀非天启玩家，且会在之后的会议上向所有玩家公布。内鬼全部死亡后，若存活的计数中立玩家属于同一计数类型，且计数中立人数不少于船员，天启阵营即可获胜；瘟疫不必成为最后的幸存者。 设置 感染冷却 ：瘟疫使者再次感染玩家前的等待时间。 瘟疫击杀冷却 ：瘟疫再次击杀前的等待时间。 瘟疫可使用通风口 ：设置瘟疫能否使用通风口。 瘟疫拥有内鬼视野 ：开启后拥有内鬼视野；关闭后使用船员视野。
search.en: Plaguebearer Infect every other living player to become Pestilence; win under the Apocalypse neutral parity rule after transforming. Plaguebearer The Plaguebearer uses the kill button to infect players and transforms into Pestilence after every other living player is infected. Infection also spreads between infected and uninfected players when one kills the other or reports their body. After transforming, a standard kill attempt by a non-Apocalypse role is reflected and kills the attacker; an attack from another Apocalypse role is blocked without reflection. Pestilence can kill non-Apocalypse players, and the transformation is announced to everyone at a meeting. After all Impostors are gone, the standard neutral end check awards the Apocalypse team the win when all living counted neutrals share one count type and their total is at least the Crew count. Pestilence does not need to be the last player alive. Settings Plague cooldown: Time before the Plaguebearer can infect another player. Pestilence kill cooldown: Time before Pestilence can kill again. Pestilence can vent: Whether Pestilence can use vents. Pestilence has Impostor vision: Whether Pestilence has Impostor vision.

summary.zh-CN: 直接感染玩家并通过近距离接触继续传播；感染所有存活玩家后获胜。
summary.en: Directly infect a player and spread through proximity; infect every living player to win.

search.zh-CN: 瘟疫学家 直接感染玩家并通过近距离接触继续传播；感染所有存活玩家后获胜。 瘟疫学家 瘟疫学家的目标是感染所有符合设置的存活玩家。可以使用击杀按钮直接感染一名玩家；之后，感染者附近的玩家停留达到设定时间也会被感染。开启自我感染后，瘟疫学家本人也可成为感染目标。感染进度会累积，不会因距离拉远或召开会议而重置。会议结束后会暂停传播一段时间，但开局时不会应用此延迟。所有符合设置的存活玩家都被感染后，瘟疫学家获胜。直接感染上限设为大于1时，实际仍只有第一次直接感染；该操作会耗尽全部剩余次数。 设置 直接感染上限 ：设置界面显示的次数；实际只有第一次直接感染，该操作会耗尽全部次数，因此设为大于1不会增加直接感染次数。 被击杀时感染凶手 ：开启后，如果瘟疫学家仍有直接感染次数，击杀者会被感染。 感染所需时间 ：玩家在感染者附近停留多久才会被感染。 感染距离 ：感染传播所需的距离范围。 会议后感染延迟 ：会议结束后暂停感染传播的时间；开局时不会应用此延迟。 可以感染自己 ：设置瘟疫学家能否感染自己。 可在通风口中感染 ：设置处于通风口内外的玩家能否相互传播感染。
search.en: Plague Scientist Directly infect a player and spread through proximity; infect every living player to win. Plague Scientist The Plague Scientist's goal is to infect every living player eligible under the settings. They can directly infect a player with the kill button, then infection spreads to players who stay within range of an infected player for the configured time. When self-infection is enabled, the Plague Scientist can also become an infection target. Progress is cumulative and does not reset when players move apart or after meetings. Spread pauses for the configured delay after each meeting, but not at game start. The Plague Scientist wins once all eligible living players are infected. The direct-infection limit setting can display multiple charges, but only one direct infection is available; using it consumes all remaining charges. Settings Direct infection limit: The displayed number of charges. Only one direct infection is available; using it consumes all remaining charges, so a value above one does not provide more direct infections. Infect killer when killed: When enabled, the player who kills the Plague Scientist becomes infected if a direct infection remains. Infection time: Time a player must spend near an infected player to become infected. Infection distance: Range for infection spread. Delay after meetings: Time before infection spreads after a meeting ends. The delay does not apply at game start. Can infect self: Whether the Plague Scientist can infect themself. Can infect while in vent: Whether players inside and outside vents can infect one another.

summary.zh-CN: 对目标下毒，目标在延迟结束或会议开始时死亡；内鬼阵营消灭后按中立平衡条件获胜。
summary.en: Poison a target so they die after a delay or when a meeting starts; win under the neutral parity rule after the Impostors are gone.

search.zh-CN: 投毒者 对目标下毒，目标在延迟结束或会议开始时死亡；内鬼阵营消灭后按中立平衡条件获胜。 投毒者 投毒者的击杀会延迟生效。使用能力给目标下毒后，目标会在设定延迟结束时死亡；若会议开始或有人报告尸体，尚未结算的中毒目标会立即结算。投毒者不必成为最后的幸存者：内鬼全部死亡后，若存活的计数中立玩家属于同一计数类型，且计数中立人数不少于船员，中立阵营即可获胜。 设置 投毒冷却 ：再次下毒前的等待时间。 毒杀延迟 ：目标中毒后死亡前的时间。 可使用通风口 ：设置投毒者能否使用通风口。 内鬼视野 ：设置投毒者是否拥有内鬼视野。
search.en: Poisoner Poison a target so they die after a delay or when a meeting starts; win under the neutral parity rule after the Impostors are gone. Poisoner The Poisoner's kills are delayed. Poison a target, and they die when the configured delay expires. If a meeting starts or a body is reported first, pending poison kills are resolved immediately. The Poisoner does not need to be the last player alive: after all Impostors are gone, the standard neutral end check awards the win when all living counted neutrals share one count type and their total is at least the Crew count. Settings Poison cooldown: Time before poisoning another player. Poison kill delay: Delay before a poisoned target dies. Can vent: Whether the Poisoner can use vents. Impostor vision: Whether the Poisoner has Impostor vision.

summary.zh-CN: 在警戒范围内无人靠近时附身并拖慢目标；若结束时焦点范围内无人，目标会死亡。
summary.en: Possesses and slows a target when no one is within alert range; the target dies if no one is within focus range when possession ends.

search.zh-CN: 附身者 在警戒范围内无人靠近时附身并拖慢目标；若结束时焦点范围内无人，目标会死亡。 技能 使用保护技能附身非内鬼目标。若目标周围的警戒范围内有其他玩家，附身会失败。附身期间目标移动速度会降低，附身者会跟随目标；其他玩家进入警戒范围时附身立即结束。持续时间结束后，若焦点范围内没有其他玩家，目标会死亡；否则目标存活。附身者不能发动破坏。 选项 附身冷却 ：设置再次附身前的等待时间。 附身持续时间 ：设置控制目标多久。 警戒范围 ：目标附近此范围内有玩家时无法开始附身；附身期间有人进入此范围也会解除附身。 焦点范围 ：附身结束时，若附近没有其他玩家处于此范围内，目标会死亡。
search.en: Possessor Possesses and slows a target when no one is within alert range; the target dies if no one is within focus range when possession ends. Ability Use the protection ability to possess a non-Impostor target. Possession fails if another player is within the Alert Range of the target. While possessed, the target is slowed and the Possessor follows them. Another player entering the Alert Range ends possession immediately. When the duration ends, the target dies if no other player is within the Focus Range; otherwise the target survives. The Possessor cannot sabotage. Options Possession Cooldown : Time before the ability can be used again. Possession Duration : How long possession lasts. Alert Range : Possession cannot start if anyone is in this range around the target; anyone entering it during possession ends the effect. Focus Range : The target dies at the end of possession if no one else is within this range.

summary.zh-CN: 使用揭示药水查看目标职业，双击击杀，或打开地图发动破坏；内鬼阵营消灭后按中立平衡条件获胜。
summary.en: Reveal a target's role, double-click to kill, or use the map to sabotage; win under the neutral parity rule after the Impostors are gone.

search.zh-CN: 药剂师 使用揭示药水查看目标职业，双击击杀，或打开地图发动破坏；内鬼阵营消灭后按中立平衡条件获胜。 药剂师 药剂师有三种药水操作：单击目标揭示其职业，双击目标进行击杀，打开破坏地图则发动破坏。揭示药水有使用次数上限；次数用尽后，击杀按钮会默认执行击杀。药剂师不必成为最后的幸存者：内鬼全部死亡后，若存活的计数中立玩家属于同一计数类型，且计数中立人数不少于船员，中立阵营即可获胜。 设置 击杀冷却 ：再次击杀前的等待时间。 揭示次数上限 ：药剂师可揭示职业的次数。 可使用通风口 ：设置药剂师能否使用通风口。 内鬼视野 ：设置药剂师是否拥有内鬼视野。
search.en: Potion Master Reveal a target's role, double-click to kill, or use the map to sabotage; win under the neutral parity rule after the Impostors are gone. Potion Master The Potion Master has three potion actions: single-click a target to reveal their role, double-click to kill, or open the sabotage map to sabotage. Role reveals are limited. After the reveal potions run out, the kill button defaults to killing. The Potion Master does not need to be the last player alive: after all Impostors are gone, the standard neutral end check awards the win when all living counted neutrals share one count type and their total is at least the Crew count. Settings Kill cooldown: Time before killing again. Maximum reveals: Number of role reveals available. Can vent: Whether the Potion Master can use vents. Impostor vision: Whether the Potion Master has Impostor vision.

summary.zh-CN: 总统可用 /finish 立即结束会议，并用 /reveal 公开身份；公开后是否仍可被猜测及哪些阵营能看见可设置。
summary.en: The President can end a meeting with /finish and reveal their identity with /reveal; guessability and which teams see the reveal are configurable.

search.zh-CN: 总统 总统可用 /finish 立即结束会议，并用 /reveal 公开身份；公开后是否仍可被猜测及哪些阵营能看见可设置。 职业能力 总统有两种会议能力：输入 /finish 可立即结束会议；输入 /reveal 可公开自己的总统身份。只有房主设置允许看到公开消息的阵营会收到提示；默认情况下总统不能被猜测。总统公开身份后，击杀总统的玩家下一次击杀冷却会缩短。 设置 数量上限 ：设置一局中总统的最大人数。 结束会议次数上限 ：设置总统最多可使用 /finish 结束会议的次数；/reveal 每局固定只能使用一次。 公开后仍可猜测总统 ：开启时公开身份后仍能猜测总统；关闭时不能。 中立阵营可看到公开的总统 ：开启时允许中立阵营看到；关闭时不显示给他们。 叛徒可看到公开的总统 ：开启时允许叛徒看到；关闭时不显示给他们。 内鬼可看到公开的总统 ：开启时允许内鬼看到；关闭时不显示给他们。 隐藏总统指令 ：开启时模组会隐藏总统的指令；关闭时不隐藏。
search.en: President The President can end a meeting with /finish and reveal their identity with /reveal; guessability and which teams see the reveal are configurable. Role The President has two meeting abilities. Type /finish to end the meeting immediately, or /reveal to reveal the President's identity. Only teams allowed by the host settings receive the reveal notice. The President is normally unguessable after revealing. Whoever kills the revealed President has their next kill cooldown reduced. Settings Maximum count : Sets the maximum number of Presidents in a match. Maximum meeting ends : Sets how many times the President can use /finish; /reveal is available once per game. President can be guessed after revealing : ON allows guesses after the reveal; OFF prevents them. Neutrals can see revealed President : ON lets Neutrals see the reveal; OFF hides it from them. Madmates can see revealed President : ON lets Madmates see the reveal; OFF hides it from them. Impostors can see revealed President : ON lets Impostors see the reveal; OFF hides it from them. Hide President commands : ON hides the President's commands; OFF leaves them visible.

summary.zh-CN: 部分通风口会被封锁，封锁数量可按地图设置。
summary.en: Some vents are blocked, with the number configurable for each map.

search.zh-CN: 受限者 部分通风口会被封锁，封锁数量可按地图设置。 效果 持有受限者的玩家会遇到部分被封锁、无法使用的通风口。 设置 Max（最大数量） ：本局中该附加身份可出现的数量上限。 Spawn Chance（生成概率） ：玩家获得此附加身份的概率。 Eligibility（可分配阵营） ：主持人可分别设置内鬼、船员、中立者是否可以获得此附加身份。 Override Blocked Vents After Meeting（会议后重设被封锁通风口） ：控制会议结束后是否重设被封锁的通风口。 Count Blocked Vents in The Skeld（The Skeld 被封锁通风口数量） ：The Skeld 地图上封锁的通风口数量。 Count Blocked Vents in MIRA HQ（MIRA HQ 被封锁通风口数量） ：MIRA HQ 地图上封锁的通风口数量。 Count Blocked Vents in Polus（Polus 被封锁通风口数量） ：Polus 地图上封锁的通风口数量。 Count Blocked Vents in Dleks（Dleks 被封锁通风口数量） ：Dleks 地图上封锁的通风口数量。 Count Blocked Vents in Airship（Airship 被封锁通风口数量） ：Airship 地图上封锁的通风口数量。 Count Blocked Vents in The Fungle（The Fungle 被封锁通风口数量） ：The Fungle 地图上封锁的通风口数量。
search.en: Prohibited Some vents are blocked, with the number configurable for each map. Effect Some vents are blocked from use for a player with Prohibited. Settings Max : Maximum number that can appear in one match. Spawn Chance : Chance for a player to receive this add-on. Eligibility : Separate settings control whether Impostors, Crewmates, Neutrals can receive this add-on. Override Blocked Vents After Meeting : Whether blocked vents are overridden after a meeting. Count Blocked Vents in The Skeld : Number of vents blocked on The Skeld. Count Blocked Vents in MIRA HQ : Number of vents blocked on MIRA HQ. Count Blocked Vents in Polus : Number of vents blocked on Polus. Count Blocked Vents in Dleks : Number of vents blocked on Dleks. Count Blocked Vents in Airship : Number of vents blocked on Airship. Count Blocked Vents in The Fungle : Number of vents blocked on The Fungle.

summary.zh-CN: 使用击杀按钮与符合条件的目标同归于尽；若目标最终失败，自爆卡车也获胜。
summary.en: Use the kill button to take out an eligible target and yourself; win if the target loses.

search.zh-CN: 自爆卡车 使用击杀按钮与符合条件的目标同归于尽；若目标最终失败，自爆卡车也获胜。 自爆卡车 自爆卡车使用击杀按钮会同时杀死目标和自己；未满18岁的迷你船员或迷你内鬼不能作为目标。若目标在游戏结束时不属于获胜者，自爆卡车也会获胜。 设置 人数上限 ：一局中可出现的自爆卡车数量上限。 击杀冷却 ：再次使用击杀按钮前的等待时间。
search.en: Provocateur Use the kill button to take out an eligible target and yourself; win if the target loses. Provocateur Using the kill button kills both the target and the Provocateur. A Nice Mini or Evil Mini under 18 cannot be targeted. If the target is not a winner at the end of the game, the Provocateur also wins. Settings Maximum number: Maximum number of Provocateurs in a match. Kill cooldown: Time before using the kill button again.

summary.zh-CN: 愚者会议期间会看到若干红名，其中至少一名从邪恶候选池中抽取；其他红名从其余存活玩家中抽取。成为叛徒后可看到带刀中立、邪恶中立和带刀船员红名。
summary.en: The Psychic sees several red names in meetings, including one drawn from an Evil candidate pool; the remaining red names come from other living players. As a Madmate, they see Neutral Killing, Neutral Evil, and Killing Crewmates in red.

search.zh-CN: 愚者 愚者会议期间会看到若干红名，其中至少一名从邪恶候选池中抽取；其他红名从其余存活玩家中抽取。成为叛徒后可看到带刀中立、邪恶中立和带刀船员红名。 职业能力 愚者在会议中会看到若干玩家的名字显示为红色，其中至少一名从邪恶候选池中抽取；其他红名从其余存活玩家中抽取。成为叛徒时会看到带刀中立、邪恶中立和带刀船员显示为红名。 设置 数量上限 ：设置一局中愚者的最大人数。 每次会议红名数 ：设置每次会议显示的红名人数；至少一名红名玩家是坏人。 每次会议刷新红名 ：开启时每次会议都会重新抽取红名；关闭时复用现有名单，名单为空时才重新抽取。 下列阵营开关只影响至少一名邪恶红名的候选池；其余红名仍从其他存活玩家中抽取，因此关闭某类别不代表该类别永远不会显示为红名。 带刀船员可进入邪恶候选池 ：开启时带刀船员可作为必定红名的候选；关闭时不会进入该候选池。 友善中立可进入邪恶候选池 ：开启时友善中立可作为必定红名的候选；关闭时不会进入该候选池。 邪恶中立可进入邪恶候选池 ：开启时邪恶中立可作为必定红名的候选；关闭时不会进入该候选池。 混乱中立可进入邪恶候选池 ：开启时混乱中立可作为必定红名的候选；关闭时不会进入该候选池。 灾厄中立可进入邪恶候选池 ：开启时灾厄中立可作为必定红名的候选；关闭时不会进入该候选池。 带刀中立可进入邪恶候选池 ：开启时带刀中立可作为必定红名的候选；关闭时不会进入该候选池。
search.en: Psychic The Psychic sees several red names in meetings, including one drawn from an Evil candidate pool; the remaining red names come from other living players. As a Madmate, they see Neutral Killing, Neutral Evil, and Killing Crewmates in red. Role During meetings, the Psychic sees several players' names in red, including one drawn from an Evil candidate pool; the remaining red names are drawn from other living players. As a Madmate, the Psychic sees Neutral Killing, Neutral Evil, and Killing Crewmates as red. Settings Maximum count : Sets the maximum number of Psychics in a match. Maximum red names : Sets how many red names can appear each meeting; at least one red-named player is Bad. New red names every meeting : ON triggers another red-name draw each meeting; OFF reuses the current selection and draws again only when the list is empty. The following team switches affect only the pool for the guaranteed Evil red name. The remaining red names are still drawn from other living players, so OFF does not guarantee a category will never appear red. Killing Crewmates can fill the Evil slot : ON adds them to the guaranteed Evil candidate pool; OFF removes them from that pool. Neutral Benign can fill the Evil slot : ON adds them to the guaranteed Evil candidate pool; OFF removes them from that pool. Neutral Evil can fill the Evil slot : ON adds them to the guaranteed Evil candidate pool; OFF removes them from that pool. Neutral Chaos can fill the Evil slot : ON adds them to the guaranteed Evil candidate pool; OFF removes them from that pool. Neutral Apocalypse can fill the Evil slot : ON adds them to the guaranteed Evil candidate pool; OFF removes them from that pool. Neutral Killing can fill the Evil slot : ON adds them to the guaranteed Evil candidate pool; OFF removes them from that pool.

summary.zh-CN: 承受足够次数的攻击即可获胜；猜测受虐狂会被阻止，但每位猜测者的首次尝试会计为一次攻击。
summary.en: Win after enough attacks; guesses at the role are blocked, but each guesser's first attempt counts as an attack.

search.zh-CN: 受虐狂 承受足够次数的攻击即可获胜；猜测受虐狂会被阻止，但每位猜测者的首次尝试会计为一次攻击。 受虐狂 普通击杀攻击受虐狂时，攻击会被取消并增加一次受攻击次数。猜测受虐狂职业也会被阻止，但每位猜测者的首次尝试会增加一次受攻击次数；同一猜测者再次尝试不会重复计数。受虐狂不能猜测自己。 设置 人数上限 ：一局中可出现的受虐狂数量上限。 获胜所需攻击次数 ：受虐狂必须承受的攻击次数。
search.en: Punching Bag Win after enough attacks; guesses at the role are blocked, but each guesser's first attempt counts as an attack. Punching Bag An ordinary kill attempt against the Punching Bag is canceled and adds one attack to its count. Guessing the role is also blocked, but each guesser's first attempt adds one attack; later attempts from the same guesser do not count again. The Punching Bag cannot guess its own role. Settings Maximum number: Maximum number of Punching Bags in a match. Attacks required to win: Number of attacks the Punching Bag must receive.

summary.zh-CN: 单击操纵目标；傀儡会自动攻击范围内最近的非内鬼玩家，双击则普通击杀。
summary.en: Single-clicks to puppeteer a target; the puppet automatically attacks the nearest non-Impostor in range, while double-clicking kills normally.

search.zh-CN: 傀儡师 单击操纵目标；傀儡会自动攻击范围内最近的非内鬼玩家，双击则普通击杀。 技能 单击击杀键操纵目标；双击则普通击杀。被操纵者会自动攻击击杀范围内最近的非内鬼目标，攻击成功后解除操纵。会议开始会解除所有尚未结束的操纵。懒惰者以及幼年 Mini 不会执行操纵。根据选项，傀儡击杀目标后也会死亡；瘟疫之源不会因该选项死亡。 选项 数量上限（Max） ：设置本局最多可有多少名傀儡师。 傀儡与受害者同归于尽 ：开启时，傀儡击杀受害者后也会死亡；关闭时傀儡存活。
search.en: Puppeteer Single-clicks to puppeteer a target; the puppet automatically attacks the nearest non-Impostor in range, while double-clicking kills normally. Ability Single-click the kill button to puppeteer a target; double-click to make a normal kill. The puppet automatically attacks the nearest non-Impostor within kill range and is released after a successful attack. A meeting ends any active puppeteering. Lazy players and a Mini who has not grown up will not obey. Depending on the setting, the puppet also dies after its victim is killed; Pestilence is exempt from that death. Options Max : Maximum number of Puppeteers in a match. Puppet Dies Alongside Victim : When enabled, the puppet also dies after killing its victim; otherwise the puppet survives.

summary.zh-CN: 存活到游戏结束时通常可获胜；标记一名玩家后，对方若尝试击杀任何人都会走火自杀。
summary.en: Usually win by surviving to the end; after marking a player, any attempt they make to kill someone causes a fatal misfire.

search.zh-CN: 起诉人 存活到游戏结束时通常可获胜；标记一名玩家后，对方若尝试击杀任何人都会走火自杀。 起诉人 起诉人存活到游戏结束时通常会获得额外胜利，但若结局是小丑、恋人、恐怖分子、处刑人、收藏家、无辜者或油管主播胜利，则不会获胜。起诉人可以使用击杀按钮标记一名符合条件的存活玩家；该玩家之后无论试图击杀谁，都会因走火而自杀。瘟疫和连环杀手不能被标记；对杀戮机器使用能力会消耗次数，但不会标记它。 设置 人数上限 ：一局中可出现的起诉人数量上限。 能力冷却 ：再次使用能力前的等待时间。 能力使用次数上限 ：整局可使用能力的最大次数。
search.en: Pursuer Usually win by surviving to the end; after marking a player, any attempt they make to kill someone causes a fatal misfire. Pursuer An alive Pursuer usually receives an additional win at the end of the game, except when the result is a Jester, Lovers, Terrorist, Executioner, Collector, Innocent, or Youtuber win. The kill button marks an eligible living player as a client. If that player later attempts to kill anyone, the attempt causes them to misfire and die. Pestilence and Serial Killer cannot be marked; using the ability on a Killing Machine consumes a use but does not mark it. Settings Maximum number: Maximum number of Pursuers in a match. Ability cooldown: Time before using the ability again. Maximum uses: Maximum number of ability uses during the game.

summary.zh-CN: 涂油后可直接击杀目标；内鬼阵营消灭后按中立平衡条件获胜。
summary.en: Douse and directly kill targets; win under the neutral parity rule after the Impostors are gone.

search.zh-CN: 焚烧狂 涂油后可直接击杀目标；内鬼阵营消灭后按中立平衡条件获胜。 焚烧狂 对未涂油的目标，单击击杀按钮会在触发等待结束后涂油；双击则正常击杀。已涂油的目标会被单次点击直接击杀，并应用专用的焚烧冷却。焚烧狂不必成为最后的幸存者：内鬼全部死亡后，若存活的计数中立玩家属于同一计数类型，且计数中立人数不少于船员，中立阵营即可获胜。 设置 击杀冷却 ：再次击杀前的等待时间。 涂油冷却 ：再次涂油前的等待时间。 击杀已涂油玩家后的冷却 ：击杀已涂油玩家后使用的击杀冷却。 可使用通风口 ：设置焚烧狂能否使用通风口。 内鬼视野 ：开启后拥有内鬼视野；关闭后使用船员视野。
search.en: Pyromaniac Douse and directly kill targets; win under the neutral parity rule after the Impostors are gone. Pyromaniac Against an undoused target, a single click douses them after the trigger window expires; double-clicking kills them normally. A doused target is killed directly with one click and uses the separate burn cooldown. The Pyromaniac does not need to be the last player alive: after all Impostors are gone, the standard neutral end check awards the win when all living counted neutrals share one count type and their total is at least the Crew count. Settings Kill cooldown: Time before killing again. Douse cooldown: Time before dousing another player. Kill cooldown after killing a doused player: Cooldown applied after killing a doused player. Can vent: Whether the Pyromaniac can use vents. Impostor vision: Whether the Pyromaniac has Impostor vision.

summary.zh-CN: 击杀冷却结束后变形可储存子弹并重置冷却；会议开始时子弹会被限制到设定上限。
summary.en: After kill cooldown ends, shapeshifting stores a bullet and resets cooldown; the meeting bullet count is capped by a setting.

search.zh-CN: 快枪手 击杀冷却结束后变形可储存子弹并重置冷却；会议开始时子弹会被限制到设定上限。 技能 击杀冷却结束后，变形可以重置冷却并储存一发子弹；储存成功时会出现护盾动画。击杀后可消耗储存的子弹来抵消后续击杀冷却。每次会议开始时，子弹数会限制到房主设定的上限。 选项 数量上限（Max） ：设置本局最多可有多少名快枪手。 击杀冷却 ：设置击杀冷却。 变形冷却 ：设置变形冷却。 会议保留子弹上限 ：设置每次会议开始时最多可保留的子弹数。
search.en: Quick Shooter After kill cooldown ends, shapeshifting stores a bullet and resets cooldown; the meeting bullet count is capped by a setting. Ability After the kill cooldown ends, shapeshifting resets it and stores one bullet; a shield-like animation confirms a successful storage. After a kill, stored bullets can offset the next kill cooldown. At the start of each meeting, the bullet count is capped at the configured limit. Options Max : Maximum number of Quick Shooters in a match. Kill Cooldown : The Quick Shooter’s kill cooldown. Shapeshift Cooldown : The Quick Shooter’s shapeshift cooldown. Max Bullets Reserved for a Meeting : Maximum number of bullets the Quick Shooter can keep when a meeting starts.

summary.zh-CN: 每轮标记一名玩家，让其在下一次会议正确回答问题；答错或未答会死亡。
summary.en: Mark one player per round to answer a question at the next meeting; a wrong or missing answer kills them.

search.zh-CN: 测验长 每轮标记一名玩家，让其在下一次会议正确回答问题；答错或未答会死亡。 测验长 测验长使用击杀按钮标记一名玩家。下一次会议中，该玩家名字旁会出现「?!」，并需要正确回答问题；答错或未作答都会死亡。如果测验长在会议中被投票放逐，标记会清除，被标记者存活；若测验长在会议中被击杀，标记不会因此清除，被标记者仍可能在会后死亡。被标记者若在会议开始前被击杀，标记会重置。测验长每轮只能标记一人。测验长的中立胜利遵循常规中立结束条件：内鬼全部死亡、存活计数中立玩家属于同一计数类型且人数不少于船员时获胜。 被标记者可使用 /answer [回答字母] 作答，并用 /qmquiz 重新查看问题和答案。 设置 问题难度 ：设置问题难度，范围为 1 至 4，1 最简单，4 最难。 标记后可使用通风口 ：设置测验长标记玩家后能否使用通风口。 标记后可使用击杀 ：开启后，测验长标记后仍可使用击杀按钮；关闭后不能正常使用击杀按钮。界面中的每轮击杀次数选项当前未被代码读取，不会限制击杀次数。 可提问过去对局内容 ：开启后，问题可以涉及之前的回合；关闭后，问题只涉及当前对局。
search.en: Quizmaster Mark one player per round to answer a question at the next meeting; a wrong or missing answer kills them. Quizmaster The Quizmaster uses the kill button to mark one player. At the next meeting, “?!” appears beside the marked player's name, and they must answer the question correctly. A wrong or missing answer kills them. If the Quizmaster is voted out during the meeting, the mark is cleared and the target survives. If the Quizmaster is killed during the meeting, the mark remains and the target may still die after the meeting. If the marked player is killed before the meeting starts, the mark resets. The Quizmaster can mark only one player per round. Its neutral win uses the standard neutral end check: no Impostors remain, all living counted neutrals share one count type, and their total is at least the Crew count. The marked player can answer with /answer [letter] and review the question and answers with /qmquiz . Settings Question difficulty: Set question difficulty from 1 (easiest) to 4 (hardest). Can vent after marking: Whether the Quizmaster can use vents after marking a player. Can kill after marking: When enabled, the Quizmaster can still use the kill button after marking. When disabled, they cannot use it normally after marking. The displayed kills-per-round option is not read by the current code and does not limit the number of kills. Can ask about past games: When enabled, questions may refer to earlier rounds; otherwise, questions refer only to the current game.

summary.zh-CN: 在任务阶段更新指向最近存活玩家的箭头。
summary.en: Updates an arrow to point toward the nearest living player during tasks.

search.zh-CN: 雷达 在任务阶段更新指向最近存活玩家的箭头。 效果 在任务阶段，雷达会更新箭头，指向最近的其他存活玩家。雷达在通风口内时不会更新；若没有其他存活玩家，则不会选择新的目标。 设置 Max（最大数量） ：本局中该附加身份可出现的数量上限。 Spawn Chance（生成概率） ：玩家获得此附加身份的概率。 Eligibility（可分配阵营） ：主持人可分别设置内鬼、船员、中立者是否可以获得此附加身份。
search.en: Radar Updates an arrow to point toward the nearest living player during tasks. Effect During task play, Radar updates an arrow to point toward the nearest other living player. It does not update while the Radar is in a vent, and it does not select a new target when no other living player remains. Settings Max : Maximum number that can appear in one match. Spawn Chance : Chance for a player to receive this add-on. Eligibility : Separate settings control whether Impostors, Crewmates, Neutrals can receive this add-on.

summary.zh-CN: 会持续快速改变颜色，改变频率及伪装期间是否继续变化可设置。
summary.en: Cycles through colors; the interval and behavior during camouflage are configurable.

search.zh-CN: 彩虹 会持续快速改变颜色，改变频率及伪装期间是否继续变化可设置。 效果 彩虹会不断快速改变颜色。 设置 Max（最大数量） ：本局中该附加身份可出现的数量上限。 Spawn Chance（生成概率） ：玩家获得此附加身份的概率。 Eligibility（可分配阵营） ：主持人可分别设置内鬼、船员、中立者是否可以获得此附加身份。 Cooldown for changing colors（换色冷却） ：彩虹改变颜色的间隔。 Rainbow color changes during Camouflage（伪装期间继续换色） ：控制伪装效果生效时彩虹是否继续改变颜色。
search.en: Rainbow Cycles through colors; the interval and behavior during camouflage are configurable. Effect Rainbow changes colors repeatedly. Settings Max : Maximum number that can appear in one match. Spawn Chance : Chance for a player to receive this add-on. Eligibility : Separate settings control whether Impostors, Crewmates, Neutrals can receive this add-on. Cooldown for changing colors : How often Rainbow changes colors. Rainbow color changes during Camouflage : Whether Rainbow continues changing colors while Camouflage is active.

summary.zh-CN: 萧暮死亡时会对凶手随机施加一种效果，包括自动报告、停留在尸体旁、超长击杀冷却或随机复仇。
summary.en: When the Randomizer dies, their killer receives a random effect: self-reporting, staying by the body, a very long kill cooldown, or random revenge.

search.zh-CN: 萧暮 萧暮死亡时会对凶手随机施加一种效果，包括自动报告、停留在尸体旁、超长击杀冷却或随机复仇。 职业能力 萧暮死亡时，其凶手会随机受到以下效果之一： 自动报告萧暮的尸体。 站在尸体旁。 击杀冷却被设为 600 秒。 随机为一名玩家复仇。 设置 数量上限 ：设置一局中萧暮的最大人数。 提前提醒凶手 ：开启时，萧暮的凶手自动报告前会听到一段提示音；关闭时不播放提示音。 最短报告延迟 ：设置凶手自动报告前的最短延迟。 最长报告延迟 ：设置凶手自动报告前的最长延迟。 冻结时间 ：设置凶手杀死萧暮后被定身的时间。
search.en: Randomizer When the Randomizer dies, their killer receives a random effect: self-reporting, staying by the body, a very long kill cooldown, or random revenge. Role When the Randomizer dies, their killer receives one random effect: They self-report the Randomizer's body. They stand next to the body. Their kill cooldown is set to 600 seconds. They randomly avenge a player. Settings Maximum count : Sets the maximum number of Randomizers in a match. Warn the killer in advance : ON plays a short tune for the killer before an automatic report; OFF plays no tune. Minimum report delay : Sets the shortest delay before the killer automatically reports. Maximum report delay : Sets the longest delay before the killer automatically reports. Freeze time : Sets how long the killer is frozen after killing the Randomizer.

summary.zh-CN: 仅船员可获得；警长可以击杀，告密者若能查找叛徒也能找到流氓。
summary.en: Only Crewmates can receive it; Sheriff can kill it, and Snitch can find it when Madmates are searchable.

search.zh-CN: 流氓 仅船员可获得；警长可以击杀，告密者若能查找叛徒也能找到流氓。 效果 流氓只分配给船员。警长可以击杀流氓；若告密者设置为可查找叛徒，也能找到流氓。被驱逐时是否像叛徒一样显示由选项控制。商人可以出售该有害附加身份给符合条件的船员。 设置 Max（最大数量） ：本局中该附加身份可出现的数量上限。 Spawn Chance（生成概率） ：玩家获得此附加身份的概率。 RascalAppearAsMadmate（被驱逐时显示为 Madmate） ：控制流氓被驱逐时是否像叛徒一样显示。
search.en: Rascal Only Crewmates can receive it; Sheriff can kill it, and Snitch can find it when Madmates are searchable. Effect Rascal is assigned only to Crewmates. Sheriff can kill a Rascal, and Snitch can find one if its setting allows it to find Madmates. A setting controls whether Rascal appears as a Madmate when ejected. Merchant can also sell this harmful add-on to an eligible Crewmate. Settings Max : Maximum number that can appear in one match. Spawn Chance : Chance for a player to receive this add-on. RascalAppearAsMadmate : Whether Rascal appears the same way as a Madmate when ejected.

summary.zh-CN: 仅分配给拥有击杀按钮的角色，并赋予游戏中最长的击杀距离。
summary.en: Assigned only to roles with a kill button and grants the longest kill range in the game.

search.zh-CN: 持枪 仅分配给拥有击杀按钮的角色，并赋予游戏中最长的击杀距离。 效果 持枪只会分配给拥有击杀按钮的角色，并使其获得游戏中最长的击杀距离。 设置 Max（最大数量） ：本局中该附加身份可出现的数量上限。 Spawn Chance（生成概率） ：玩家获得此附加身份的概率。
search.en: Reach Assigned only to roles with a kill button and grants the longest kill range in the game. Effect Reach is assigned only to roles with a kill button and gives them the longest kill range possible in the game. Settings Max : Maximum number that can appear in one match. Spawn Chance : Chance for a player to receive this add-on.

summary.zh-CN: 即将被投出时会与一名玩家交换外观并存活，次数耗尽后移除此附加身份。
summary.en: When about to be exiled, swaps skins with a player and survives; removed after its rebirths are exhausted.

search.zh-CN: 重生者 即将被投出时会与一名玩家交换外观并存活，次数耗尽后移除此附加身份。 效果 重生者即将被投出时，会与一名玩家交换外观并继续存活。用尽可重生次数后，会移除重生者附加身份。 设置 Max（最大数量） ：本局中该附加身份可出现的数量上限。 Spawn Chance（生成概率） ：玩家获得此附加身份的概率。 Eligibility（可分配阵营） ：主持人可分别设置内鬼、船员、中立者是否可以获得此附加身份。 Amount of Rebirths（重生次数） ：持有重生者的玩家最多可重生的次数。 Only rebirth to players who voted for them（仅重生为投过自己票的玩家） ：控制重生者是否只能变成投票给自己的玩家。
search.en: Rebirth When about to be exiled, swaps skins with a player and survives; removed after its rebirths are exhausted. Effect When about to be exiled, Rebirth swaps skins with another player and survives. Once all rebirths are used, the Rebirth add-on is removed. Settings Max : Maximum number that can appear in one match. Spawn Chance : Chance for a player to receive this add-on. Eligibility : Separate settings control whether Impostors, Crewmates, Neutrals can receive this add-on. Amount of Rebirths : Maximum number of times the player with Rebirth can rebirth. Only rebirth to players who voted for them : Whether Rebirth can only become a player who voted for them.

summary.zh-CN: 赌怪正确猜中或正义法官成功审判时，攻击者会反而死亡。
summary.en: A Guesser who correctly guesses or a Judge who judges this player dies instead.

search.zh-CN: 回弹者 赌怪正确猜中或正义法官成功审判时，攻击者会反而死亡。 效果 若赌怪成功猜中你，或正义法官成功审判你，实施猜测或审判的玩家会反而死亡。若持有双重猜测的赌怪猜中你，其会立即死亡。 设置 Max（最大数量） ：本局中该附加身份可出现的数量上限。 Spawn Chance（生成概率） ：玩家获得此附加身份的概率。 Eligibility（可分配阵营） ：主持人可分别设置内鬼、船员、中立者是否可以获得此附加身份。
search.en: Rebound A Guesser who correctly guesses or a Judge who judges this player dies instead. Effect If a Guesser correctly guesses you or a Judge successfully judges you, that player dies instead. If a player with Double Shot guesses you correctly, they die instantly. Settings Max : Maximum number that can be in one match. Spawn Chance : Chance for a player to receive this add-on. Eligibility : Separate settings control whether Impostors, Crewmates, Neutrals can receive this add-on.

summary.zh-CN: 由豺狼招募获得；加入豺狼阵营并与豺狼一同获胜。
summary.en: Granted by Jackal recruitment; joins Jackal's team and wins with Jackal.

search.zh-CN: 招募 由豺狼招募获得；加入豺狼阵营并与豺狼一同获胜。 效果 豺狼可将符合条件的非中立玩家招募为招募。招募与豺狼同属豺狼阵营并一同获胜。豺狼可设置为同时使用跟班和招募、只使用跟班或只使用招募。胜负人数设置可让招募计入豺狼、完全不计人数或保留原阵营。此身份不会独立随机分配。 相关设置 Jackal_SidekickCountMode（Recruit 计入阵营） ：豺狼设置，控制招募计入豺狼、不计人数或保留原阵营。 Jackal_SidekickAssignMode（跟班分配模式） ：控制豺狼分配模式为跟班与招募、仅跟班或仅招募。 随机分配 ：不会开局随机分配；由上述赋予者能力转化获得。
search.en: Recruit Granted by Jackal recruitment; joins Jackal's team and wins with Jackal. Effect Jackal can recruit eligible non-Neutral players as Recruit. Recruit joins Jackal's team and wins with Jackal. Jackal can be configured to grant Sidekick and Recruit, Sidekick only, or Recruit only. The sidekick count-mode setting can make Recruit count as Jackal, count as nobody, or retain its original team. This identity is not independently assigned at random. Related settings Jackal_SidekickCountMode : Jackal setting that controls whether Recruit counts as Jackal, nobody, or its original team. Jackal_SidekickAssignMode : Controls whether Jackal can grant Sidekick and Recruit, Sidekick only, or Recruit only. Random assignment : Not assigned at random at game start; it is granted by the conversion ability described above.

summary.zh-CN: 逃亡者属于叛徒阵营，按普通内鬼方式击杀、使用通风口和发动破坏。
summary.en: The Refugee belongs to the Traitor team and can kill, vent, and sabotage like a regular Impostor.

search.zh-CN: 逃亡者 逃亡者属于叛徒阵营，按普通内鬼方式击杀、使用通风口和发动破坏。 技能 逃亡者属于叛徒阵营，行动方式与普通内鬼相同，可击杀、使用通风口并发动破坏。遗忘者回忆内鬼或叛徒身份、模仿者模仿内鬼、房主将教父的转化结果设为逃亡者，或内鬼阵营玩家死亡后其情人转为逃亡者，都可能产生该职业。 选项 击杀冷却 ：设置逃亡者的击杀冷却。
search.en: Refugee The Refugee belongs to the Traitor team and can kill, vent, and sabotage like a regular Impostor. Ability The Refugee belongs to the Traitor team and acts like a normal Impostor: it can kill, vent, and sabotage. It can be created when an Amnesiac remembers an Impostor or Madmate, an Imitator imitates an Impostor, the Godfather’s target is killed while the conversion option is set to Refugee, or a Romantic’s Impostor-team partner dies. Options Refugee Kill Cooldown : Kill cooldown for the Refugee.

summary.zh-CN: 惩罚者死亡后可用 /ret [玩家 ID] 复仇击杀有限数量的玩家，任务完成和存活人数阈值可限制使用。
summary.en: After death, the Retributionist can use /ret [player ID] to kill a limited number of players, subject to task-completion and living-player thresholds.

search.zh-CN: 惩罚者 惩罚者死亡后可用 /ret [玩家 ID] 复仇击杀有限数量的玩家，任务完成和存活人数阈值可限制使用。 职业能力 惩罚者死亡后可使用 /ret [玩家 ID] 复仇击杀有限数量的玩家。单独输入 /ret 可列出存活玩家及其 ID。根据设置，惩罚者必须完成任务才能复仇；存活人数低于或等于设定阈值时也不能使用。 设置 数量上限 ：设置一局中惩罚者的最大人数。 复仇次数上限 ：设置惩罚者最多可击杀的人数。 复仇所需的最低存活人数 ：设置复仇被阻止时的存活人数阈值；存活人数必须高于该值才能使用。 仅完成任务后才能复仇 ：开启时惩罚者必须完成任务才能使用能力；关闭时即使任务未完成也能使用。 自定义惩罚者任务 ：开启时可单独设置任务数量；关闭时与其他玩家任务数量相同。自定义选项包括公共任务、长任务和短任务。
search.en: Retributionist After death, the Retributionist can use /ret [player ID] to kill a limited number of players, subject to task-completion and living-player thresholds. Role After dying, the Retributionist can use /ret [player ID] to kill a limited number of players. Typing /ret alone lists living players and their IDs. Depending on settings, tasks must be complete and the number of living players must be above a configured threshold. Settings Maximum count : Sets the maximum number of Retributionists in a match. Maximum retributions : Sets the maximum number of kills the Retributionist can make. Minimum living players for retribution : Sets the threshold at which retribution is blocked; the living-player count must be above this value to use the ability. Can only retribute on task completion : ON requires the Retributionist to finish tasks before using the ability; OFF allows use before tasks are complete. Override Retributionist tasks : ON allows a separate task setup; OFF gives the role the same task count as everyone else. The custom setup includes common-task availability and the number of long and short tasks.

summary.zh-CN: 遐想者可以击杀，但初始冷却很长；击杀船员会延长冷却，击杀其他目标则会缩短冷却。
summary.en: The Reverie can kill but starts with a long cooldown; killing a Crewmate lengthens it, while killing other targets shortens it.

search.zh-CN: 遐想者 遐想者可以击杀，但初始冷却很长；击杀船员会延长冷却，击杀其他目标则会缩短冷却。 职业能力 遐想者可以击杀，但开局击杀冷却较长。击杀船员会增加击杀冷却，击杀其他目标则会减少冷却；冷却在设置的上下限内变化。可设置达到最高冷却时是否走火自杀、会议后是否重置冷却，以及转换后的遐想者是否能无惩罚地击杀任何人。 设置 数量上限 ：设置一局中遐想者的最大人数。 初始击杀冷却 ：设置遐想者开局时的击杀冷却。 击杀船员时增加的冷却时间 ：设置击杀船员后增加多少冷却。 击杀其他目标时减少的冷却时间 ：设置击杀非船员目标后减少多少冷却。 最低/最高击杀冷却 ：分别设置击杀冷却的上下限。 达到最高冷却时走火自杀 ：开启时遐想者在最高冷却时走火自杀；关闭时不会。 会议后重置冷却 ：开启时会议后恢复初始冷却；关闭时保留当前冷却。 转换后的遐想者可无惩罚击杀 ：开启时非船员阵营遐想者可随意击杀且不受惩罚；关闭时不适用此规则。
search.en: Reverie The Reverie can kill but starts with a long cooldown; killing a Crewmate lengthens it, while killing other targets shortens it. Role The Reverie can kill but starts with a high cooldown. Killing a Crewmate increases the cooldown; killing another kind of target reduces it, within configured limits. Settings control whether reaching the maximum causes a misfire, whether the cooldown resets after meetings, and whether a converted Reverie can kill anyone without repercussions. Settings Maximum count : Sets the maximum number of Reveries in a match. Starting kill cooldown : Sets the Reverie's cooldown at the start of the game. Increase kill cooldown : Sets how much cooldown is added after killing a Crewmate. Reduce kill cooldown by : Sets how much cooldown is removed after killing another kind of target. Minimum / maximum kill cooldown : Sets the lower and upper cooldown limits. Misfire on reaching maximum cooldown : ON makes the Reverie die in a misfire at maximum cooldown; OFF prevents this. Reset cooldown after meeting : ON resets the cooldown to its starting value after a meeting; OFF keeps the current value. Converted Reverie can kill anyone without repercussions : ON grants this to converted Reveries; OFF does not.

summary.zh-CN: 通过跟随玩家将其拉拢入队；达到人数要求后须在倒计时内进入通风口，革命家和被拉拢者一同获胜。
summary.en: Recruit players by following them; after recruiting enough, vent before the timer expires so the Revolutionist and recruits win together.

search.zh-CN: 革命家 通过跟随玩家将其拉拢入队；达到人数要求后须在倒计时内进入通风口，革命家和被拉拢者一同获胜。 革命家 革命家使用击杀按钮开始拉拢一名玩家，并跟随对方直到拉拢动画完成。被拉拢者可能会按房主设置的概率立即死亡，但仍会被计为已拉拢。名字旁的「○」表示正在拉拢，「●」表示已拉拢。 拉拢到设定人数后，革命家必须在倒计时结束前进入通风口，才能和所有招募者立即获胜。超时后革命家和存活的招募者都会死亡。倒计时期间召开会议也会杀死革命家。 设置 人数上限 ：一局中可出现的革命家数量上限。 拉拢持续时间 ：跟随一名玩家多久才能拉拢成功。 拉拢冷却 ：再次开始拉拢前的等待时间。 获胜所需拉拢人数 ：启动通风口倒计时前所需拉拢的人数。 被拉拢者牺牲概率 ：被拉拢者立即死亡的概率；死亡后仍计入招募人数。 进入通风口时限 ：达到拉拢人数后必须进入通风口的时间限制。
search.en: Revolutionist Recruit players by following them; after recruiting enough, vent before the timer expires so the Revolutionist and recruits win together. Revolutionist The Revolutionist uses the kill button to begin recruiting a player, then follows them until the recruitment animation completes. A recruited player has a host-configured chance to die immediately, but still counts as recruited. A hollow circle (○) marks a player being recruited; a filled circle (●) marks a completed recruitment. After recruiting the required number of players, the Revolutionist must enter a vent before the timer expires to win immediately with all recruits. If time runs out, the Revolutionist and living recruits die. A meeting during the countdown also kills the Revolutionist. Settings Maximum number: Maximum number of Revolutionists in a match. Recruit duration: Time the Revolutionist must stay with a player to recruit them. Recruit cooldown: Time before starting another recruitment. Players required: Number of players to recruit before the vent timer starts. Tagged player sacrifice probability: Chance a recruited player dies immediately but still counts as recruited. Time to vent: Time allowed to enter a vent after recruiting enough players.

summary.zh-CN: 变形放置最多两道裂缝；靠近一道裂缝可按冷却传送到另一道，进通风口会摧毁所有裂缝。
summary.en: Shapeshifts to place up to two rifts; approaching one teleports to the other after a cooldown, while venting destroys all rifts.

search.zh-CN: 裂缝制造者 变形放置最多两道裂缝；靠近一道裂缝可按冷却传送到另一道，进通风口会摧毁所有裂缝。 技能 变形可在当前位置放置一道裂缝。最多保留两道；放置第三道时移除最早的一道。两道裂缝之间距离过近时无法放置。玩家进入一道裂缝的设定半径后，会在传送冷却结束时传送到另一道裂缝。尝试进通风口会被弹出并摧毁所有裂缝；会议也会重置传送冷却。 选项 数量上限（Max） ：设置本局最多可有多少名裂缝制造者。 击杀冷却 ：设置击杀冷却。 变形冷却 ：设置再次放置裂缝前的等待时间。 传送冷却 ：设置使用裂缝传送后的等待时间。 裂缝半径 ：设置进入裂缝后触发传送的范围。 显示变形动画 ：开启时显示变形动画；关闭时不显示。
search.en: Rift Maker Shapeshifts to place up to two rifts; approaching one teleports to the other after a cooldown, while venting destroys all rifts. Ability Shapeshifting places a rift at the current location. Up to two rifts can remain; placing a third removes the oldest. Rifts placed too close together are rejected. Entering the configured radius around one rift teleports the player to the other when the teleport cooldown is ready. Trying to enter a vent ejects the Rift Maker and destroys all rifts. Meetings reset the teleport cooldown. Options Max : Maximum number of Rift Makers in a match. Kill Cooldown : The Rift Maker kill cooldown. Shapeshift Cooldown : Time before the Rift Maker can place another rift. Teleport Cooldown : Time between rift teleports. Rift Radius : Distance from a rift required to trigger teleportation. Show Shapeshift Animations : When enabled, shapeshift animations are visible; otherwise they are hidden.

summary.zh-CN: 选择一名恋人并可为其提供临时护盾；恋人死亡后，浪漫者按恋人阵营及凶手转变职业。
summary.en: Choose a partner and grant temporary protection; if they die, the Romantic's role changes based on their team and killer.

search.zh-CN: 浪漫者 选择一名恋人并可为其提供临时护盾；恋人死亡后，浪漫者按恋人阵营及凶手转变职业。 浪漫者 浪漫者使用击杀按钮选择一名恋人；未满18岁的迷你船员或迷你内鬼不能成为恋人。选定恋人后，浪漫者可以再次使用击杀按钮，为恋人提供一段时间的护盾以抵挡攻击。 恋人死亡时，浪漫者会按恋人职业转变： 恋人属于内鬼阵营：浪漫者变为逃亡者。 恋人属于带刀中立：浪漫者变为无情浪漫者。 恋人属于船员或不带刀的中立：若有真实凶手，浪漫者变为复仇浪漫者；若没有真实凶手，则变为无情浪漫者。 复仇浪漫者必须击杀恋人的真实凶手才能获胜；攻击其他玩家会让其自杀。无情浪漫者拥有中立杀手的常规平衡胜利条件。 浪漫者会在恋人获胜时随获胜阵营获胜。若职业发生转变，获胜条件也会相应改变。 设置 选择恋人冷却 ：选择恋人前的等待时间。 保护冷却 ：再次为恋人提供保护前的等待时间。 保护持续时间 ：护盾持续的时间。 知道恋人职业 ：开启后，浪漫者能看到恋人职业；关闭后只知道恋人是谁。 恋人知道浪漫者身份 ：设置恋人是否会知道谁选择了自己。 转变后的复仇浪漫者 / 无情浪漫者设置 ：分别设置对应职业的击杀冷却和通风口权限。
search.en: Romantic Choose a partner and grant temporary protection; if they die, the Romantic's role changes based on their team and killer. Romantic The Romantic uses the kill button to choose a partner; a Nice Mini or Evil Mini under 18 cannot be selected. After choosing, the Romantic can use the kill button again to give their partner a temporary shield against attacks. If the partner dies, the Romantic changes role based on the partner's role: If the partner was an Impostor, the Romantic becomes a Refugee. If the partner was a Neutral Killer, the Romantic becomes a Ruthless Romantic. If the partner was a Crewmate or non-killing Neutral, the Romantic becomes a Vengeful Romantic if the partner has a real killer; otherwise, they become a Ruthless Romantic. The Vengeful Romantic must kill the partner's real killer to win; trying to kill anyone else causes a misfire. The Ruthless Romantic uses the standard Neutral Killing parity win condition. The Romantic wins with the winning team if their partner wins. A role change also changes the Romantic's win condition. Settings Partner selection cooldown: Time before choosing a partner. Protection cooldown: Time before protecting the partner again. Protection duration: How long the shield lasts. Knows partner's role: When enabled, the Romantic sees the partner's role. Partner knows who the Romantic is: Whether the partner is told who chose them. Converted Vengeful / Ruthless Romantic settings: Set the kill cooldown and vent access for each converted role.

summary.zh-CN: 恋人作为带刀中立死亡，或其死亡没有可确认的凶手时，浪漫者会转为无情浪漫者；达到该中立阵营的胜利条件后，已死亡的恋人也会获胜。
summary.en: Become Ruthless Romantic when a Neutral Killer partner dies or a partner dies without a recorded killer; the dead partner also wins when the Ruthless Romantic team meets its neutral parity condition.

search.zh-CN: 无情浪漫者 恋人作为带刀中立死亡，或其死亡没有可确认的凶手时，浪漫者会转为无情浪漫者；达到该中立阵营的胜利条件后，已死亡的恋人也会获胜。 无情浪漫者 当浪漫者的恋人属于带刀中立并死亡时，浪漫者会转变为无情浪漫者。若恋人属于船员或不带刀中立，但死亡时没有可确认的凶手，浪漫者也会转变为无情浪漫者；若恋人属于内鬼，浪漫者会转为 Refugee。 无情浪漫者属于独立的中立阵营。内鬼出局后，若船员人数不多于仍计入胜负的中立玩家，且这些中立玩家都属于同一阵营，无情浪漫者即可获胜；不必成为最后存活的玩家。已死亡的恋人会一同获胜。 设置 击杀冷却 ：再次击杀前的等待时间。 可使用通风口 ：设置无情浪漫者能否使用通风口。
search.en: Ruthless Romantic Become Ruthless Romantic when a Neutral Killer partner dies or a partner dies without a recorded killer; the dead partner also wins when the Ruthless Romantic team meets its neutral parity condition. Ruthless Romantic The Romantic becomes a Ruthless Romantic when their Neutral Killer partner dies. They also become Ruthless Romantic if a Crewmate or non-killing Neutral partner dies without a recorded killer; an Impostor partner instead changes the Romantic into a Refugee. The Ruthless Romantic is a separate Neutral team. After the Impostors are gone, they can win when the living Crew count is no greater than the remaining counted Neutral players and those Neutrals all belong to the same team. They do not have to be the last player alive. Their dead partner wins with them. Settings Kill cooldown: Time before killing again. Can vent: Whether the Ruthless Romantic can use vents.

summary.zh-CN: 只有重大破坏进行期间才能击杀。
summary.en: Can kill only while a critical sabotage is active.

search.zh-CN: 破坏者 只有重大破坏进行期间才能击杀。 技能 只有重大破坏进行期间才能使用击杀键，例如反应堆、实验室、生命维持系统或直升机破坏。 选项 数量上限（Max） ：设置本局最多可有多少名破坏者。 击杀冷却 ：设置击杀冷却。
search.en: Saboteur Can kill only while a critical sabotage is active. Ability The Saboteur can use the kill button only while a critical sabotage is active, such as Reactor, Laboratory, Life Support, or Helicopter sabotage. Options Max : Maximum number of Saboteurs in a match. Kill Cooldown : Time before the Saboteur can kill again.

summary.zh-CN: 击杀不留下尸体；击杀诱饵时不会触发自我报告。
summary.en: Kills leave no bodies; killing a Bait does not trigger a self-report.

search.zh-CN: 清道夫 击杀不留下尸体；击杀诱饵时不会触发自我报告。 技能 清道夫击杀玩家后不会留下尸体。即使击杀的是诱饵，也不会触发清道夫自我报告。 选项 数量上限（Max） ：设置本局最多可有多少名清道夫。 击杀冷却 ：设置再次使用击杀技能前的等待时间。
search.en: Scavenger Kills leave no bodies; killing a Bait does not trigger a self-report. Ability A Scavenger kill leaves no dead body. Killing a Bait does not make the Scavenger self-report. Options Max : Maximum number of Scavengers in a match. Kill Cooldown : Time before the Scavenger can kill again.

summary.zh-CN: 首次普通击杀会被阻止，并记录攻击者；猫仍计为无阵营，攻击者获胜时猫会作为额外获胜者一同获胜。
summary.en: Block the first ordinary kill attempt and record the attacker; the Cat remains on no team and wins as an additional winner if that attacker wins.

search.zh-CN: 薛定谔的猫 首次普通击杀会被阻止，并记录攻击者；猫仍计为无阵营，攻击者获胜时猫会作为额外获胜者一同获胜。 薛定谔的猫 首次有人通过普通击杀按钮攻击薛定谔的猫时，猫会记录攻击者并阻止这次攻击。猫不会变更角色或阵营，仍计为无阵营；若记录的攻击者成为获胜者，猫会作为额外获胜者一同获胜。该保护只会触发一次。 任务执行者的炸弹和杀戮机器的强制击杀会绕过这次保护，因此仍可能杀死猫。 设置 人数上限 ：一局中可出现的薛定谔的猫数量上限。
search.en: Schrodingers Cat Block the first ordinary kill attempt and record the attacker; the Cat remains on no team and wins as an additional winner if that attacker wins. Schrodinger's Cat The first ordinary kill-button attack on the Cat records the attacker and is blocked. The Cat does not change role or team and continues to count as no team. If the recorded attacker wins, the Cat wins alongside them as an additional winner. This protection happens only once. Taskinator bombs and Killing Machine's forced kill bypass this protection and can still kill the Cat. Settings Maximum number: Maximum number of Schrodinger's Cats in a match.

summary.zh-CN: 科学家可以随时查看全体船员的生命状态；生命监测仪冷却和单次使用时长可设置。
summary.en: The Scientist can check Crew vitals at any time, with configurable Vitals cooldown and battery duration.

search.zh-CN: 科学家（TOHE） 科学家可以随时查看全体船员的生命状态；生命监测仪冷却和单次使用时长可设置。 职业能力 科学家可以查看生命体征，了解哪些船员还活着、哪些已经死亡。 设置 数量与生成率 ：由 TOHE 的角色生成选项控制。 生命监测仪冷却 ：设置再次查看生命体征前的等待时间。 电池续航时间 ：设置每次查看生命体征可持续多久。
search.en: Scientist (TOHE) The Scientist can check Crew vitals at any time, with configurable Vitals cooldown and battery duration. Role The Scientist can see Crew vitals at any time to check who is alive and who is dead. Settings Count and spawn chance : Controlled by the TOHE role-spawn options. Vitals cooldown : Sets how long the Scientist must wait before checking Vitals again. Battery duration : Sets how long each Vitals check lasts.

summary.zh-CN: 使用击杀按钮标记玩家，标记正确得分、错误扣分；达到设定分数即可获胜。
summary.en: Tag players with the kill button, gaining points for correct tags and losing points for incorrect ones; reach the required score to win.

search.zh-CN: 探索者 使用击杀按钮标记玩家，标记正确得分、错误扣分；达到设定分数即可获胜。 探索者 探索者使用击杀按钮标记目标。标记正确会增加一分，标记错误会扣除一分。获得新目标后（包括开局和目标死亡后重新选取）以及每次会议结束后，探索者都会有 5 秒无法移动，也不能报告尸体。目标从存活玩家中选择，但不会选择其他探索者或至日者。 达到房主设定的分数后，探索者获胜。 设置 人数上限 ：一局中可出现的探索者数量上限。 获胜所需分数 ：探索者需要收集的分数。 标记冷却 ：标记目标前的等待时间。
search.en: Seeker Tag players with the kill button, gaining points for correct tags and losing points for incorrect ones; reach the required score to win. Seeker The Seeker uses the kill button to tag a target. A correct tag adds one point; an incorrect tag deducts one point. After receiving a new target (including at the start of the game or after a target dies) and after each meeting, the Seeker cannot move or report bodies for five seconds. Targets are chosen from living players, excluding Seekers and Solsticers. Collect the host-configured number of points to win. Settings Maximum number: Maximum number of Seekers in a match. Points needed to win: Score required for victory. Tag cooldown: Time before tagging a player.

summary.zh-CN: 每当有玩家死亡，灵媒都会看到击杀闪光。
summary.en: Sees a kill flash whenever a player dies.

search.zh-CN: 灵媒 每当有玩家死亡，灵媒都会看到击杀闪光。 效果 每当玩家死亡，灵媒都会看到红色击杀闪光；闪光可能伴随类似破坏警报的声音。 设置 Max（最大数量） ：本局中该附加身份可出现的数量上限。 Spawn Chance（生成概率） ：玩家获得此附加身份的概率。 Eligibility（可分配阵营） ：主持人可分别设置内鬼、船员、中立者是否可以获得此附加身份。
search.en: Seer Sees a kill flash whenever a player dies. Effect Whenever a player dies, Seer sees a red kill flash, possibly accompanied by an alarm sound like a sabotage alert. Settings Max : Maximum number that can appear in one match. Spawn Chance : Chance for a player to receive this add-on. Eligibility : Separate settings control whether Impostors, Crewmates, Neutrals can receive this add-on.

summary.zh-CN: 连环杀手属于独立的中立阵营，按中立阵营的计数胜利规则获胜；队友开关目前没有额外效果。
summary.en: The Serial Killer is a separate Neutral team that wins under the counted-neutral endgame rule; the buddy toggle currently has no additional effect.

search.zh-CN: 连环杀手 连环杀手属于独立的中立阵营，按中立阵营的计数胜利规则获胜；队友开关目前没有额外效果。 连环杀手 连环杀手属于独立的中立阵营。内鬼出局后，若船员人数不多于仍计入胜负的中立玩家，且这些中立玩家都属于同一阵营，连环杀手即可获胜；不必成为最后存活的玩家。 设置 击杀冷却 ：再次击杀前的等待时间。 可使用通风口 ：设置连环杀手能否使用通风口。 内鬼视野 ：设置连环杀手是否拥有内鬼视野。 拥有连环杀手队友 ：当前配置中保留此开关；角色代码没有为该选项定义额外行为。
search.en: Serial Killer The Serial Killer is a separate Neutral team that wins under the counted-neutral endgame rule; the buddy toggle currently has no additional effect. Serial Killer The Serial Killer is a separate Neutral team. After the Impostors are gone, they can win when the living Crew count is no greater than the remaining counted Neutral players and those Neutrals all belong to the same team. The Serial Killer does not have to be the last player alive. Settings Kill cooldown: Time before killing again. Can vent: Whether the Serial Killer can use vents. Impostor vision: Whether the Serial Killer has Impostor vision. Has Serial Killer buddy: This toggle exists in the settings, but the current role code does not define a buddy effect.

summary.zh-CN: 每轮选择一名玩家作为巫毒娃娃；选定后，对萨满使用击杀按钮的互动会转移到娃娃。
summary.en: Choose a player as a voodoo doll each round; while one is selected, kill-button attacks directed at the Shaman are redirected to the doll.

search.zh-CN: 萨满 每轮选择一名玩家作为巫毒娃娃；选定后，对萨满使用击杀按钮的互动会转移到娃娃。 萨满 萨满每轮可以使用击杀按钮选择一名玩家作为巫毒娃娃。选定娃娃后，有人使用击杀按钮攻击萨满时，攻击会转移到娃娃身上；尚未选择娃娃时，攻击可以直接击杀萨满。若攻击者无法击杀被选目标，这次击杀会取消；再次尝试时仍可能击杀萨满。 萨满存活到游戏结束后会随获胜阵营获胜。 设置 人数上限 ：一局中可出现的萨满数量上限。 巫毒冷却 ：再次选择巫毒娃娃前的等待时间。
search.en: Shaman Choose a player as a voodoo doll each round; while one is selected, kill-button attacks directed at the Shaman are redirected to the doll. Shaman Once per round, the Shaman can use the kill button to choose a player as a voodoo doll. While a doll is selected, kill-button attacks on the Shaman are redirected to it; before a doll is chosen, an attack can kill the Shaman directly. If the attacker cannot kill the chosen target, the attack is canceled; trying again can still kill the Shaman. The Shaman wins with the winning team if they survive until the end. Settings Maximum number: Maximum number of Shamans in a match. Voodoo cooldown: Time before choosing a voodoo doll again.

summary.zh-CN: 变形冷却为 1 秒，持续时间由房主设置；变形不会留下皮肤痕迹。
summary.en: Has a 1-second shapeshift cooldown and configurable duration; shapeshifting leaves no skin evidence.

search.zh-CN: 千面鬼 变形冷却为 1 秒，持续时间由房主设置；变形不会留下皮肤痕迹。 技能 千面鬼可以使用变形者能力，变形冷却为 1 秒，变形持续时间由房主设置。变形不会留下皮肤痕迹。 选项 数量上限（Max） ：设置本局最多可有多少名千面鬼。 变形持续时间 ：设置每次变形可持续多久。
search.en: Shapemaster Has a 1-second shapeshift cooldown and configurable duration; shapeshifting leaves no skin evidence. Ability The Shapemaster uses the Shapeshifter ability with a 1-second cooldown and a configurable duration. Shapeshifting leaves no skin evidence. Options Max : Maximum number of Shapemasters in a match. Shapeshift Duration : How long the Shapemaster stays shifted.

summary.zh-CN: 变形为其他玩家以伪装或嫁祸；可设置变形痕迹是否留下。
summary.en: Shapeshifts into another player to disguise or frame them; settings control whether shapeshifting evidence is left.

search.zh-CN: 变形者 变形为其他玩家以伪装或嫁祸；可设置变形痕迹是否留下。 技能 变形为其他玩家。变形和解除变形时的效果会很明显；可设置是否留下变形痕迹。 选项 数量上限（Max） ：设置本局最多可有多少名变形者。 变形冷却 ：设置再次变形前的等待时间。 变形持续时间 ：设置变形状态持续多久。 留下变形痕迹 ：开启时会留下变形证据；关闭时不会。
search.en: Shapeshifter Shapeshifts into another player to disguise or frame them; settings control whether shapeshifting evidence is left. Ability Shapeshift into another player. The shapeshift and revert are noticeable; a setting controls whether evidence is left behind. Options Max : Maximum number of Shapeshifters in a match. Shapeshift Cooldown : Time before shapeshifting again. Shapeshift Duration : How long the disguise lasts. Leave Shapeshifting Evidence : When enabled, shapeshifting leaves evidence; otherwise it does not.

summary.zh-CN: 警长没有船员任务，可以击杀内鬼；根据设置也可击杀中立或特定附加职业目标，误杀会导致走火。
summary.en: The Sheriff has no Crewmate tasks and can kill Impostors; settings can also allow Neutral or modifier targets, while an invalid shot causes a misfire.

search.zh-CN: 警长 警长没有船员任务，可以击杀内鬼；根据设置也可击杀中立或特定附加职业目标，误杀会导致走火。 职业能力 警长没有船员任务。警长可以击杀内鬼；根据房主设置，也可以击杀中立玩家。若向不允许击杀的目标开枪，警长会走火并自杀；设置还可决定目标是否也会被误杀。成为叛徒后，警长可以按相应设置攻击其他阵营。 设置 数量上限 ：设置一局中警长的最大人数。 击杀冷却 ：设置警长再次开枪前的等待时间。 走火时击杀目标 ：开启时，走火会同时击杀目标；关闭时警长自杀但目标存活。 射击次数上限 ：设置警长最多可开枪的次数。 在职业名称旁显示射击次数 ：开启时显示剩余子弹数；关闭时隐藏。 所有人存活时也能开枪 ：开启时警长在还没有玩家死亡时也能开枪；关闭时必须等到有人死亡。 可击杀的附加职业 ：分别设置是否可击杀叛徒、魅惑者、恋人、跟班、自我主义者、感染者和传染者。Rascal 始终可被击杀，Admired 始终不可被击杀。 可击杀中立 ：开启时可在“全部”与“逐个设置”模式间选择；关闭时不能击杀中立。逐个设置会为可选中立职业提供独立开关，部分特殊角色不在可选范围内。 跟班警长可以狂暴 ：开启时 Jackal 的跟班警长可攻击任意阵营；关闭时不能。 非船员警长目标设置 ：开启时分别设置拥有叛徒、魅惑者、感染者、传染者或自我主义者附加职业的警长能否击杀内鬼、中立和船员（包括其队友）；关闭时这些警长按常规规则行动。
search.en: Sheriff The Sheriff has no Crewmate tasks and can kill Impostors; settings can also allow Neutral or modifier targets, while an invalid shot causes a misfire. Role The Sheriff has no Crewmate tasks. They can kill Impostors and, depending on host settings, Neutrals. Shooting a target they cannot kill causes a misfire and kills the Sheriff; another setting determines whether the target dies too. A Sheriff who becomes a Madmate can attack other teams according to the relevant settings. Settings Maximum count : Sets the maximum number of Sheriffs in a match. Kill cooldown : Sets how long the Sheriff must wait before shooting again. Misfire kills target : ON kills the target as well as the Sheriff on a misfire; OFF leaves the target alive. Maximum shots : Sets how many times the Sheriff can shoot. Display shot limit beside role name : ON displays the remaining bullets; OFF hides them. Can kill when everyone is alive : ON allows shooting before anyone has died; OFF requires a death first. Can kill modifier targets : Separate settings control Madmates, Charmed, Lovers, Sidekicks, Egoists, Infected, and Contagious. Rascal is always killable; Admired is never killable. Can kill Neutrals : ON enables either an all-Neutrals mode or individual settings; OFF prevents killing Neutrals. Individual mode provides a toggle for each eligible Neutral role, with some special roles excluded. Sidekick Sheriff can go berserk : ON lets a Jackal Sidekick Sheriff attack any team; OFF prevents this. Non-Crew Sheriff configuration : ON exposes separate target-team settings for Sheriffs carrying Madmate, Charmed, Infected, Contagious, or Egoist; they can be configured to target Impostors, Neutrals, and Crewmates, including teammates. OFF leaves them using their normal rules.

summary.zh-CN: 给玩家披上裹尸布后，该玩家会自动尝试击杀附近目标；未消耗的标记会在会议结束时杀死标记玩家，前提是裹尸布仍存活。
summary.en: Shroud a player to make them automatically attempt to kill nearby targets; an unused mark kills its holder after a meeting if the Shroud is alive.

search.zh-CN: 裹尸布 给玩家披上裹尸布后，该玩家会自动尝试击杀附近目标；未消耗的标记会在会议结束时杀死标记玩家，前提是裹尸布仍存活。 裹尸布 裹尸布不会直接击杀目标，而是使用击杀按钮给玩家披上裹尸布。裹尸布存活时，被标记玩家会自动尝试击杀正常击杀范围内最近的存活玩家（不包括裹尸布和已转化的末日阵营角色）；成功击杀后标记会被消耗。裹尸布、被标记玩家或最近目标处于通风口或移动平台上时不会执行这次自动击杀。未消耗的标记会在会议结束时杀死仍存活的标记玩家，前提是裹尸布仍存活。未成年小小船员不能被标记。 裹尸布可以在被披上裹尸布玩家的名字旁看到「◈」标记。会议中，若裹尸布仍存活，带有「◈」标记且尚未造成击杀的玩家会死亡。 设置 裹尸布冷却 ：再次使用能力前的等待时间。 可使用通风口 ：设置裹尸布能否使用通风口。 内鬼视野 ：开启后拥有内鬼视野；关闭后使用船员视野。
search.en: Shroud Shroud a player to make them automatically attempt to kill nearby targets; an unused mark kills its holder after a meeting if the Shroud is alive. Shroud The Shroud does not kill normally. Instead, they use the kill button to shroud a player, causing that player to kill others. A shrouded player who does not make a kill suicides after a meeting. While the Shroud is alive, a marked player automatically tries to kill the nearest living player within normal kill range, excluding Shrouds and transformed Neutral Apocalypse roles. A successful kill consumes the mark. The automatic kill does not happen while the Shroud, marked player, or nearest target is in a vent or on a moving platform. Nice Mini players under 18 cannot be marked. The Shroud sees a “◈” beside shrouded players' names. In meetings, shrouded players marked “◈” who have not made a kill die if the Shroud is still alive when the meeting ends. The Shroud is a separate Neutral team. After the Impostors are gone, it can win when the living Crew count is no greater than the remaining counted Neutral players and those Neutrals all belong to the same team. The Shroud does not have to be the last player alive. Settings Shroud cooldown: Time before using the ability again. Can vent: Whether the Shroud can use vents. Impostor vision: When enabled, the Shroud has Impostor vision; otherwise, they have Crewmate vision.

summary.zh-CN: 跟班属于豺狼阵营，并会在豺狼获胜时一同获胜；豺狼设置可控制跟班如何计入胜负人数。
summary.en: The Sidekick is on the Jackal team and wins with the Jackal; Jackal settings control how Sidekicks count toward the win threshold.

search.zh-CN: 跟班 跟班属于豺狼阵营，并会在豺狼获胜时一同获胜；豺狼设置可控制跟班如何计入胜负人数。 跟班 跟班属于豺狼阵营；豺狼获胜时，跟班会一同获胜。豺狼通常在内鬼出局后按人数优势获胜，也可在没有内鬼存活且开启相应选项时通过破坏获胜。豺狼设置中的“跟班计入方式”决定跟班计为豺狼阵营、无阵营或原阵营。 跟班的击杀冷却、通风口和破坏能力由豺狼设置中的跟班选项决定；跟班视野跟随豺狼的内鬼视野设置。豺狼设置还可决定跟班能否击杀豺狼或其他跟班。
search.en: Sidekick The Sidekick is on the Jackal team and wins with the Jackal; Jackal settings control how Sidekicks count toward the win threshold. Sidekick The Sidekick joins the Jackal team and wins when the Jackal team wins. The Jackal normally wins by reaching the endgame count threshold after the Impostors are gone; with the relevant option enabled, the Jackal team can also win by sabotage when no Impostor is alive. The Jackal's Sidekick count mode determines whether Sidekicks count as Jackals, count as no team, or count as their original team. Jackal settings control the Sidekick's kill cooldown, vent access, and sabotage access; the Sidekick uses the Jackal's Impostor vision setting. Other options determine whether Sidekicks can kill the Jackal or other Sidekicks.

summary.zh-CN: 会议结果界面不显示其投票图标，因此其他玩家不知道它投给了谁。
summary.en: Its vote icon is hidden from the results screen, so others do not know who it voted for.

search.zh-CN: 沉默者 会议结果界面不显示其投票图标，因此其他玩家不知道它投给了谁。 效果 会议结果界面不会显示沉默者的投票图标，因此其他玩家不知道它投给了谁。 设置 Max（最大数量） ：本局中该附加身份可出现的数量上限。 Spawn Chance（生成概率） ：玩家获得此附加身份的概率。 Eligibility（可分配阵营） ：主持人可分别设置内鬼、船员、中立者是否可以获得此附加身份。
search.en: Silent Its vote icon is hidden from the results screen, so others do not know who it voted for. Effect The Silent's vote icon does not appear on the result screen, so nobody knows who they voted for. Settings Max : Maximum number that can appear in one match. Spawn Chance : Chance for a player to receive this add-on. Eligibility : Separate settings control whether Impostors, Crewmates, Neutrals can receive this add-on.

summary.zh-CN: 可从尸体获得信息，并可按设置查明击杀者角色；与胆小鬼、侦探、入殓师、清理工、美杜莎、秃鹫和验尸官不兼容。
summary.en: Can obtain information from bodies and may learn the killer's role; incompatible with several investigation and reporting roles.

search.zh-CN: 侦察员 可从尸体获得信息，并可按设置查明击杀者角色；与胆小鬼、侦探、入殓师、清理工、美杜莎、秃鹫和验尸官不兼容。 效果 侦察员可以从尸体获得信息，并可由设置决定是否查明击杀者的角色。它与胆小鬼、侦探、入殓师、清理工、美杜莎、秃鹫和验尸官不兼容。 设置 Max（最大数量） ：本局中该附加身份可出现的数量上限。 Spawn Chance（生成概率） ：玩家获得此附加身份的概率。 Eligibility（可分配阵营） ：主持人可分别设置内鬼、船员、中立者是否可以获得此附加身份。 Can find the role of the killer（可查明击杀者角色） ：控制侦察员能否查明击杀者的角色。
search.en: Sleuth Can obtain information from bodies and may learn the killer's role; incompatible with several investigation and reporting roles. Effect Sleuth can gain information from dead bodies, and settings can allow it to learn the killer's role. It is incompatible with Oblivious, Detective, Mortician, Cleaner, Medusa, Vulture, and Coroner. Settings Max : Maximum number that can appear in one match. Spawn Chance : Chance for a player to receive this add-on. Eligibility : Separate settings control whether Impostors, Crewmates, Neutrals can receive this add-on. Can find the role of the killer : Whether Sleuth can find the killer's role.

summary.zh-CN: 基础移动速度低于其他玩家，具体速度由主持人设置。
summary.en: Has a slower default movement speed, set by the host.

search.zh-CN: 树懒 基础移动速度低于其他玩家，具体速度由主持人设置。 效果 树懒的基础移动速度比其他玩家慢；实际速度取决于主持人的设置。 设置 Max（最大数量） ：本局中该附加身份可出现的数量上限。 Spawn Chance（生成概率） ：玩家获得此附加身份的概率。 Eligibility（可分配阵营） ：主持人可分别设置内鬼、船员、中立者是否可以获得此附加身份。 Sloth Speed（树懒速度） ：分配给树懒玩家的移动速度。
search.en: Sloth Has a slower default movement speed, set by the host. Effect Sloth's default movement speed is slower than other players'; the speed depends on the host's setting. Settings Max : Maximum number that can appear in one match. Spawn Chance : Chance for a player to receive this add-on. Eligibility : Separate settings control whether Impostors, Crewmates, Neutrals can receive this add-on. Sloth Speed : Movement speed assigned to players with Sloth.

summary.zh-CN: 变形开始到解除变形形成射线，弹道上最符合判定的玩家会被狙杀；弹药耗尽后才能普通击杀。
summary.en: Uses the line from shapeshift to unshift as a shot path; the best match along it is killed, and normal kills are available after ammo runs out.

search.zh-CN: 狙击手 变形开始到解除变形形成射线，弹道上最符合判定的玩家会被狙杀；弹药耗尽后才能普通击杀。 技能 变形开始的位置到解除变形的位置构成射击方向；弹道上符合判定的玩家会被狙杀。每次完成射击消耗一发子弹。会议开始会结束正在进行的瞄准，但不会发射或消耗子弹。弹药耗尽后，默认才可普通击杀；选项可允许在仍有子弹时普通击杀。 选项 弹药数量 ：设置可用子弹数。 精准射击 ：开启时弹道判定范围更窄、更精准；关闭时射线容错范围更宽。 瞄准辅助 ：开启时，保持瞄准约半秒且弹道上存在可命中目标时显示提示；关闭时不提示。 单次提示 ：开启时瞄准提示只短暂闪现；关闭时符合条件期间持续显示。 弹药未用完时可以击杀 ：开启时即使还有子弹也可普通击杀；关闭时需用完子弹才能普通击杀。
search.en: Sniper Uses the line from shapeshift to unshift as a shot path; the best match along it is killed, and normal kills are available after ammo runs out. Ability The line from the Sniper’s shapeshift location to its unshift location sets the shot direction. A player along the path who satisfies the hit check is killed. Each completed shot consumes one bullet. A meeting ends an active aim without firing or consuming a bullet. By default, normal kills become available only after ammunition runs out; a setting can allow normal kills while bullets remain. Options Ammo : Number of bullets available. Precise Shooting : When enabled, the hit corridor is narrower and more precise; when disabled, it is wider. Aim Assist : When enabled, holding aim in place for about half a second shows an indicator if a valid target is in the shot path; otherwise no indicator is shown. One Shot Assist : When enabled, the indicator flashes briefly; otherwise it remains visible while the aim condition is met. Sniper Can Kill with Bullets Remaining : When enabled, normal kills are allowed even with bullets left; otherwise the Sniper must use all bullets first.

summary.zh-CN: 告密者完成任务后可识别符合设置的杀手；剩余任务达到阈值时，杀手会看到警告标记和指向告密者的箭头。
summary.en: The Snitch identifies eligible killers after finishing tasks; when their remaining tasks reach a threshold, killers see a warning mark and an arrow to the Snitch.

search.zh-CN: 告密者 告密者完成任务后可识别符合设置的杀手；剩余任务达到阈值时，杀手会看到警告标记和指向告密者的箭头。 职业能力 告密者剩余任务数达到设定阈值时，符合条件的杀手会看到警告标记及指向告密者的箭头。完成全部任务后，告密者会标记符合设置的杀手；若启用箭头，也能追踪其位置。 设置 数量上限 ：设置一局中告密者的最大人数。 显示指向目标的箭头 ：开启时显示指向杀手的小箭头；关闭时无法得知杀手的位置。 按目标颜色显示箭头 ：开启时箭头使用目标的职业颜色；关闭时所有箭头使用同一颜色。 可以找到中立杀手 ：开启时告密者完成任务后也能找到带刀中立；关闭时只找内鬼。 可以找到灾厄中立 ：开启时告密者完成任务后也能找到灾厄中立；关闭时不查找。 可以找到叛徒 ：开启时也能找到叛徒和流氓；关闭时只找普通内鬼。 暴露所需的剩余任务数 ：设置告密者剩余多少任务时，符合条件的杀手会看到警告标记和指向告密者的箭头。 自定义告密者任务 ：开启时可单独设置任务数量；关闭时任务数量与其他玩家相同。自定义选项包括公共任务、长任务和短任务的设置。
search.en: Snitch The Snitch identifies eligible killers after finishing tasks; when their remaining tasks reach a threshold, killers see a warning mark and an arrow to the Snitch. Role When the Snitch's remaining task count reaches the configured threshold, eligible killers see a warning mark and an arrow pointing to the Snitch. After the Snitch completes all tasks, they mark eligible killers and can track them with arrows if that option is enabled. Settings See arrow toward target : ON shows a small arrow pointing toward killers; OFF hides killer locations from the Snitch. Colored arrows by target : ON colors each arrow using the target's role color; OFF gives all arrows the same color. Can find Neutral Killers : ON lets the Snitch find Neutral Killers after completing tasks; OFF limits the result to Impostors. Can find Neutral Apocalypse : ON also lets the Snitch find Neutral Apocalypse roles; OFF does not. Can find Madmates : ON also lets the Snitch find Madmates and Rascals; OFF limits the result to regular Impostors. Remaining tasks before being revealed : Sets how many tasks the Snitch can have left before eligible killers see a warning mark and an arrow pointing to them. Override Snitch tasks : ON allows a separate task setup; OFF gives the Snitch the same task count as everyone else. The custom setup includes common-task availability and the number of long and short tasks.

summary.zh-CN: 在一轮内完成全部任务即可获胜；每次会议后任务重置，普通击杀和投票会被阻止。
summary.en: Complete all tasks in one round to win; tasks reset after each meeting, and ordinary kill attempts and votes are blocked.

search.zh-CN: 至日者 在一轮内完成全部任务即可获胜；每次会议后任务重置，普通击杀和投票会被阻止。 至日者 普通击杀和投票无法杀死或放逐至日者；Quizmaster 的击杀不会触发这层保护。至日者必须在一轮内完成所有任务才能获胜。每次会议结束后任务重置。有人尝试普通击杀至日者时，至日者会被传送到地图外，直到会议结束；攻击者的击杀冷却重置为 10 秒。至日者在游戏中不计入任何阵营。 当剩余任务数达到设定门槛时，玩家会收到警告；带刀玩家还会看到指向至日者的箭头。房主也可选择公开至日者身份，以及是否让至日者得知攻击者的名字和职业。 设置 所有人知道至日者身份 ：设置至日者身份是否公开。 至日者知道攻击者信息 ：开启后，至日者能看到攻击者的名字和职业。 可使用通风口 ：设置至日者能否使用通风口。 可在猜测模式中猜职业 ：设置至日者能否在猜测模式或作为猜测者附加职业时猜测。 移动速度 ：至日者的移动速度。 剩余任务警告门槛 ：剩余任务达到该数量时触发警告和箭头提示。 玩家死亡时增加短任务数 ：每有玩家死亡，至日者增加的短任务数量。 覆盖任务数 ：开启后，可单独设置普通任务、长任务和短任务；关闭后使用与其他玩家相同的任务数。
search.en: Solsticer Complete all tasks in one round to win; tasks reset after each meeting, and ordinary kill attempts and votes are blocked. Solsticer Ordinary kill attempts and votes cannot kill or exile the Solsticer; a Quizmaster kill bypasses this protection. The Solsticer wins by completing all tasks in a single round. Tasks reset after each meeting. An ordinary kill attempt teleports the Solsticer off the map until the meeting ends and resets the attacker's kill cooldown to 10 seconds. The Solsticer counts as no team during the game. When the remaining task count reaches the configured threshold, players are warned and killing roles receive an arrow pointing to the Solsticer. The host can also reveal the Solsticer's identity and let them see an attacker's name and role. Settings Everyone knows who the Solsticer is: Whether the role is revealed. Solsticer knows attacker: When enabled, the Solsticer sees the attacker's name and role. Can vent: Whether the Solsticer can use vents. Can guess: Whether the Solsticer can guess in Guesser Mode or as a Guesser addon. Movement speed: Solsticer's movement speed. Remaining tasks warning: Remaining task threshold for warnings and arrows. Extra short tasks per player death: Number of short tasks added when a player dies. Override tasks: When enabled, configure custom common, long, and short task counts.

summary.zh-CN: 变形完成后与目标交换位置；目标处于死亡、通风口或被吞等异常状态时不会交换。
summary.en: Swaps places with the target unless that player is dead, vented, swallowed, or otherwise abnormal.

search.zh-CN: 夺魂者 变形完成后与目标交换位置；目标处于死亡、通风口或被吞等异常状态时不会交换。 技能 变形完成后，夺魂者会与变形目标交换位置。若目标死亡、处于通风口、被吞入腹中或处于其他异常状态，则不会发生交换。 选项 数量上限（Max） ：设置本局最多可有多少名夺魂者。 变形持续时间 ：设置变形可持续多久。 变形冷却 ：设置再次变形前的等待时间。
search.en: Soul Catcher Swaps places with the target unless that player is dead, vented, swallowed, or otherwise abnormal. Ability After shapeshifting, the Soul Catcher swaps places with its target. No swap occurs if the target is in an abnormal state, such as being dead, inside a vent, or swallowed. Options Max : Maximum number of Soul Catchers in a match. Shapeshift Duration : How long a shapeshift can last. Shapeshift Cooldown : How long you must wait before shapeshifting again.

summary.zh-CN: 预测玩家在本轮或下次会议死亡以收集灵魂，达到门槛后转变为死亡。
summary.en: Predict a player's death this round or at the next meeting to collect souls and eventually become Death.

search.zh-CN: 灵魂收集者 预测玩家在本轮或下次会议死亡以收集灵魂，达到门槛后转变为死亡。 灵魂收集者 灵魂收集者可以对一名玩家使用击杀按钮，预言其死亡。若目标在选择目标的本轮或之后的会议中死亡，灵魂收集者就会获得一个灵魂。每次会议开始或目标死亡时，当前目标都会重置，以先发生者为准。 达到设定的灵魂数量后，灵魂收集者会转变为死亡。死亡在自己未被放逐且仍存活时，会在会议结束时杀死所有非末日阵营的存活玩家。死亡属于末日阵营。开启被动收集后，每次会议还会额外获得一个灵魂。 设置 转变所需灵魂数量 ：转变为死亡需要的灵魂数量。 每轮被动获得灵魂 ：开启后，每次会议获得一个灵魂；关闭后不会被动获得灵魂。 灵魂收集者可使用通风口 ：设置灵魂收集者能否使用通风口。 死亡存在时延长会议 ：死亡存在时，会议增加的时长。
search.en: Soul Collector Predict a player's death this round or at the next meeting to collect souls and eventually become Death. Soul Collector The Soul Collector can use the kill button on a player to predict their death. If that player dies during the selected round or at the meeting immediately after it, the Soul Collector gains a soul. The target resets at the next meeting or when that player dies, whichever happens first. After collecting the configured number of souls, the Soul Collector transforms into Death. If Death is alive and is not exiled, it kills all living players outside the Neutral Apocalypse team at the end of each meeting. Death belongs to the Neutral Apocalypse team. If passive soul gain is enabled, the Soul Collector also gains a soul at each meeting. Settings Souls required for transformation: Number of souls needed to become Death. Gain a passive soul each round: When enabled, gain one soul at each meeting; otherwise, there is no passive gain. Soul Collector can vent: Whether the Soul Collector can use vents. Meeting time increase while Death exists: Extra meeting time while Death is present.

summary.zh-CN: 由诅咒之人赋予，胜利结算可随原船员、内鬼或启示录队伍获胜，也可计入诅咒之人的胜利。
summary.en: Granted by Cursed Soul; can win with its original Crewmate, Impostor, or Apocalypse team, and can also be included in Cursed Soul's win.

search.zh-CN: 没有灵魂 由诅咒之人赋予，胜利结算可随原船员、内鬼或启示录队伍获胜，也可计入诅咒之人的胜利。 效果 诅咒之人可将符合条件的船员或内鬼转化为没有灵魂，并可设置是否能转化中立者。没有灵魂在存活人数判定中不计入阵营人数。胜利结算时，没有灵魂可随其原船员、内鬼或启示录队伍获胜；若诅咒之人自身胜利，没有灵魂也会列入其胜者。此身份不会独立随机分配。 相关设置 CursedSoulCanCurseNeutral（可诅咒中立者） ：诅咒之人设置，控制中立者能否转化为没有灵魂。 随机分配 ：不会开局随机分配；由诅咒之人的转化能力赋予。
search.en: Soulless Granted by Cursed Soul; can win with its original Crewmate, Impostor, or Apocalypse team, and can also be included in Cursed Soul's win. Effect Cursed Soul can convert eligible Crewmates or Impostors into Soulless, with a setting to allow Neutral targets. Soulless does not count toward team parity. At endgame it can win with its original Crewmate, Impostor, or Apocalypse team; it is also included when Cursed Soul wins. This identity is not independently assigned at random. Related settings CursedSoulCanCurseNeutral : Cursed Soul setting that controls whether Neutral players can become Soulless. Random assignment : Not assigned at random at game start; granted by the Cursed Soul role conversion ability.

summary.zh-CN: 完成所有任务并死亡后随获胜阵营获胜；开启抢夺胜利时可独自获胜。
summary.en: Complete all tasks and die to win with the winning team; when victory stealing is enabled, the Specter can win alone.

search.zh-CN: 幽灵 完成所有任务并死亡后随获胜阵营获胜；开启抢夺胜利时可独自获胜。 幽灵 幽灵必须完成全部任务并死亡，才能随获胜阵营获胜；任务完成与死亡的先后顺序不限。游戏结束时仍存活，或尚未完成全部任务，幽灵都不能获胜。开启抢夺胜利后，完成所有任务并死亡的幽灵可以夺取胜利并单独获胜。 设置 人数上限 ：一局中可出现的幽灵数量上限。 存活时可使用通风口 ：设置幽灵存活时能否使用通风口。 抢夺胜利 ：开启后，已完成任务并死亡的幽灵可以抢夺并单独获得胜利；关闭后按正常条件随获胜阵营获胜。 猜测模式中可猜职业 ：设置幽灵能否在猜测模式中猜测。 覆盖任务数 ：开启后，可单独设置幽灵是否有普通任务，以及长、短任务数量；关闭后使用与其他玩家相同的任务数。
search.en: Specter Complete all tasks and die to win with the winning team; when victory stealing is enabled, the Specter can win alone. Specter The Specter must complete all tasks and die to win with the winning team; the order does not matter. The Specter cannot win if still alive at the end of the game or if any tasks remain. When victory stealing is enabled, a Specter who has completed all tasks and died can steal the win and win alone. Settings Maximum number: Maximum number of Specters in a match. Can vent while alive: Whether the living Specter can use vents. Snatches victory: When enabled, a dead Specter who completed all tasks may steal the win; otherwise, they win normally with the winning team. Can guess in Guesser Mode: Whether the Specter can guess roles in Guesser Mode. Override tasks: When enabled, configure whether the Specter has common tasks and the number of long and short tasks. When disabled, use the same tasks as other players.

summary.zh-CN: 可转化的击杀目标会成为恶灵；恶灵可短暂冻结、致盲玩家或保护灵魂召唤者，并会在灵魂召唤者获胜时一同获胜。
summary.en: Eligible kill victims become Evil Spirits that can briefly freeze or blind players or protect the Spiritcaller; they also win when the Spiritcaller wins.

search.zh-CN: 灵魂召唤者 可转化的击杀目标会成为恶灵；恶灵可短暂冻结、致盲玩家或保护灵魂召唤者，并会在灵魂召唤者获胜时一同获胜。 灵魂召唤者 灵魂召唤者可以击杀玩家。若目标不是内鬼或不能被转化的角色，且恶灵数量未达到上限，目标会变为恶灵；否则击杀按普通方式处理。恶灵可以帮助灵魂召唤者：短暂冻结其他玩家、遮蔽其视野，或给予灵魂召唤者一个可短暂抵挡击杀的护盾。灵魂召唤者按其中立阵营的计数胜利规则获胜；恶灵会在灵魂召唤者获胜时一同获胜。 设置 击杀冷却 ：再次使用能力前的等待时间。 可使用通风口 ：设置灵魂召唤者能否使用通风口。 内鬼视野 ：开启后拥有内鬼视野；关闭后使用默认视野。 恶灵数量上限 ：灵魂召唤者可创造的恶灵数量上限。 恶灵能力冷却 ：恶灵再次使用能力前的等待时间。 恶灵冻结时间 ：恶灵冻结玩家的持续时间。 恶灵保护时间 ：恶灵提供的护盾持续时间。 恶灵致盲程度 ：恶灵能造成的视野遮蔽程度。 恶灵致盲时间 ：玩家被恶灵致盲的持续时间。
search.en: Spiritcaller Eligible kill victims become Evil Spirits that can briefly freeze or blind players or protect the Spiritcaller; they also win when the Spiritcaller wins. Spiritcaller The Spiritcaller can kill players. A target becomes an Evil Spirit if they are not an Impostor, are eligible for conversion, and the Spiritcaller has not reached the spirit limit; otherwise, the kill proceeds normally. Evil Spirits can briefly freeze other players, block their vision, or give the Spiritcaller a shield that blocks an attempted kill. The Spiritcaller wins under its counted Neutral team condition, and Evil Spirits win with the Spiritcaller. Settings Kill cooldown: Time before the Spiritcaller can use their ability again. Can vent: Whether the Spiritcaller can use vents. Impostor vision: When enabled, the Spiritcaller has Impostor vision; otherwise, they have default vision. Maximum number of Evil Spirits: Maximum number of spirits the Spiritcaller can create. Evil Spirit ability cooldown: Time before a spirit can use its ability again. Freeze duration: How long an Evil Spirit can freeze a player. Protection duration: How long an Evil Spirit's shield protects the Spiritcaller. Blinding strength: How much an Evil Spirit can reduce a player's vision. Blinding duration: How long the vision effect lasts.

summary.zh-CN: 死亡后，灵媒可使用原版灵媒能力向存活玩家发送图像消息；通讯破坏会阻止使用。
