summary.en: After death, the Spirit Guide can send image messages to living players with the native ability; communications sabotage blocks it.

search.zh-CN: 灵媒（原版） 死亡后，灵媒可使用原版灵媒能力向存活玩家发送图像消息；通讯破坏会阻止使用。 职业能力 死亡后，灵媒可使用原版灵媒技能向存活玩家发送图像消息；通讯破坏期间无法使用技能。 设置 数量与生成率 ：由 TOHE 的幽灵职业生成设置控制。 技能冷却 ：设置再次发送图像消息前的等待时间。
search.en: Spirit Guide (TOHE) After death, the Spirit Guide can send image messages to living players with the native ability; communications sabotage blocks it. Role After death, the Spirit Guide uses the native Spirit Guide ability to send image messages to living players. Communications sabotage prevents the ability from being used. Settings Count and spawn chance : Controlled by the mod's ghost-role settings. Ability cooldown : Sets how long the Spirit Guide must wait before sending another image message.

summary.zh-CN: 灵魂论者会看到指向最近一次报告的尸体玩家的箭头；会议结束后，该玩家会收到提示。
summary.en: The Spiritualist sees an arrow to the player whose body was most recently reported; after the meeting, that player receives a notice.

search.zh-CN: 灵魂论者 灵魂论者会看到指向最近一次报告的尸体玩家的箭头；会议结束后，该玩家会收到提示。 职业能力 灵魂论者会看到指向最近一次报告的尸体玩家（其鬼魂）的箭头；会议结束后，该玩家会收到提示。箭头按设置的间隔和持续时间显示。实现中不按鬼魂阵营改变目标或引导方向。 设置 数量上限 ：设置一局中灵魂论者的最大人数。 鬼魂箭头间隔 ：设置灵魂论者等待鬼魂箭头出现的时间间隔。 鬼魂箭头持续时间 ：设置箭头每次显示多久。
search.en: Spiritualist The Spiritualist sees an arrow to the player whose body was most recently reported; after the meeting, that player receives a notice. Role The Spiritualist sees an arrow pointing to the ghost of the player whose body was most recently reported. After the meeting, that player receives a notice. The arrow appears according to its configured interval and duration; its direction does not depend on ghost alignment. Settings Maximum count : Sets the maximum number of Spiritualists in a match. Ghost arrow interval : Sets how long the Spiritualist waits between ghost-arrow appearances. Ghost arrow duration : Sets how long each ghost arrow remains visible.

summary.zh-CN: 静止时速度逐渐回升，移动时逐渐下降；最低和最高速度可设置。
summary.en: Speed gradually recovers while still and falls while moving; the minimum and maximum speeds are configurable.

search.zh-CN: 冲刺者 静止时速度逐渐回升，移动时逐渐下降；最低和最高速度可设置。 效果 静止时，冲刺者的速度会逐渐回升至上限；移动时，速度会逐渐下降至下限。速度调节倍率控制回升和下降的速度。 设置 Max（最大数量） ：本局中该附加身份可出现的数量上限。 Spawn Chance（生成概率） ：玩家获得此附加身份的概率。 Eligibility（可分配阵营） ：主持人可分别设置内鬼、船员、中立者是否可以获得此附加身份。 Min Speed（最低速度） ：冲刺者可达到的最低速度。 Max Speed（最高速度） ：冲刺者可达到的最高速度。 Speed Modulator（速度调节倍率） ：数值越高，速度恢复和衰减都越快；数值越低，两者都越慢。 Display the Charge（显示充能状态） ：控制是否显示冲刺者的速度充能状态。
search.en: Spurt Speed gradually recovers while still and falls while moving; the minimum and maximum speeds are configurable. Effect While still, Spurt's speed gradually recovers up to its maximum. Moving gradually reduces it to its minimum. The speed modulator controls how quickly speed recovers and falls. Settings Max : Maximum number that can appear in one match. Spawn Chance : Chance for a player to receive this add-on. Eligibility : Separate settings control whether Impostors, Crewmates, Neutrals can receive this add-on. Min Speed : Minimum speed Spurt can reach. Max Speed : Maximum speed Spurt can reach. Speed Modulator : Higher values regenerate and deteriorate speed faster; lower values do both more slowly. Display the Charge : Whether Spurt's recharge is displayed.

summary.zh-CN: 有人对间谍使用击杀按钮技能时，间谍可短暂看到对方的橙色名字；技能次数耗尽后不再看到提示。
summary.en: When someone uses a kill-button ability on the Spy, the Spy can briefly see their name in orange; this stops when uses run out.

search.zh-CN: 间谍 有人对间谍使用击杀按钮技能时，间谍可短暂看到对方的橙色名字；技能次数耗尽后不再看到提示。 职业能力 每局最多会有一名间谍。有人对间谍使用击杀按钮（包括通过击杀按钮发动的技能）时，间谍会在几秒内看到该玩家的名字变为橙色。船员对间谍使用技能也会触发提示。间谍没有剩余技能次数时不会看到橙名。如果击杀按钮互动被阻止，攻击者的冷却会重置为 10 秒。 设置 初始技能次数 ：设置间谍开局拥有的技能次数。 名字变色持续时间 ：设置目标名字保持变色的时长。 每完成一个任务获得的技能次数 ：设置每完成一个任务增加的次数，按 0.1 为步进。 阻止击杀按钮互动 ：开启时阻止击杀按钮使用者与间谍之间的互动；关闭时不阻止。
search.en: Spy When someone uses a kill-button ability on the Spy, the Spy can briefly see their name in orange; this stops when uses run out. Role Only one Spy can spawn in a match. When someone uses their kill button on the Spy, including an ability activated through that button, the Spy sees that player's name in orange for a few seconds. Crewmate abilities can trigger the same effect. The Spy sees no orange names when they have no ability uses left. If the kill-button interaction is blocked, the attacker's cooldown resets to 10 seconds. Settings Initial ability uses : Sets how many uses the Spy starts with. Colored name duration : Sets how long the target's name stays colored. Ability uses gained per task : Sets the uses gained for each completed task, in 0.1 increments. Block kill-button interaction : ON stops the interaction between the killer and the Spy; OFF allows it.

summary.zh-CN: 在会议外造成击杀会于电力未被破坏时触发电力破坏；存活的潜藏者可按指定阵营和胜利方式夺取胜利。
summary.en: A non-suicide kill outside a meeting triggers electrical sabotage when none is active; a living Stalker can take eligible Impostor or configured Crewmate wins.

search.zh-CN: 潜藏者 在会议外造成击杀会于电力未被破坏时触发电力破坏；存活的潜藏者可按指定阵营和胜利方式夺取胜利。 潜藏者 潜藏者可以击杀任何人；在会议外造成非自杀击杀时，若电力未被破坏就会立即触发电力破坏。潜藏者可按设置使用通风口。 潜藏者存活时，内鬼通过非破坏胜利结束游戏，潜藏者会夺取胜利。开启“抢夺胜利”后，潜藏者会计入船员阵营；若其击杀过内鬼，且船员不是通过完成任务获胜，潜藏者也会夺取船员胜利。再开启“船员击杀中立后可夺取胜利”后，潜藏者击杀特定带刀中立也可满足这项条件；此选项不包括纵火犯和革命家。潜藏者不会夺取破坏胜利或其他阵营的胜利。 关闭“抢夺胜利”时，潜藏者属于独立的中立阵营，也可按中立阵营人数结算规则获胜。 设置 击杀冷却 ：再次击杀前的等待时间。 内鬼视野 ：设置潜藏者是否拥有内鬼视野。 可使用通风口 ：设置潜藏者能否使用通风口。 船员击杀中立后可夺取胜利 ：设置击杀特定带刀中立能否满足夺取船员胜利的条件；此选项需同时开启“抢夺胜利”，且不包括纵火犯和革命家。 抢夺胜利 ：开启后，潜藏者计入船员阵营；击杀过内鬼后可夺取非任务导致的船员胜利。此选项不影响破坏胜利。
search.en: Stalker A non-suicide kill outside a meeting triggers electrical sabotage when none is active; a living Stalker can take eligible Impostor or configured Crewmate wins. Stalker The Stalker can kill anyone. A non-suicide kill outside a meeting immediately triggers electrical sabotage unless one is already active. The Stalker can vent if the setting is enabled. The living Stalker takes a non-sabotage Impostor win. When “Snatches victory” is enabled, the Stalker counts as Crew and can also take a Crewmate win that was not caused by tasks if the Stalker has killed an Impostor. The “Can count Neutral Killer” option also lets a kill on certain Neutral Killers qualify, except Arsonist and Revolutionist. The Stalker does not take sabotage wins or wins for other teams. When “Snatches victory” is disabled, the Stalker counts as its own Neutral team and can also win under the counted-neutral endgame rule. Settings Kill cooldown: Time before the Stalker can kill again. Impostor vision: Whether the Stalker has Impostor vision. Can vent: Whether the Stalker can use vents. Can count Neutral Killer: Whether a kill on an eligible Neutral Killer can qualify the Stalker to take a Crewmate win. This requires “Snatches victory” and excludes Arsonist and Revolutionist. Snatches victory: When enabled, the Stalker counts as Crew and can take qualifying Crewmate wins; it does not steal every type of win.

summary.zh-CN: 附近玩家达到设定人数时会被减速或完全定身。
summary.en: Slows or freezes when enough players are nearby, according to host settings.

search.zh-CN: 雕像 附近玩家达到设定人数时会被减速或完全定身。 效果 当有足够多玩家靠近雕像时，雕像会依主持人设置减速或完全无法移动。 设置 Max（最大数量） ：本局中该附加身份可出现的数量上限。 Spawn Chance（生成概率） ：玩家获得此附加身份的概率。 Eligibility（可分配阵营） ：主持人可分别设置内鬼、船员、中立者是否可以获得此附加身份。 Statue Slowness（雕像减速比例） ：雕像被减速的幅度。 People needed to Slow（触发减速所需人数） ：触发雕像减速所需的附近玩家人数。
search.en: Statue Slows or freezes when enough players are nearby, according to host settings. Effect When enough players are near a Statue, it is slowed or completely frozen depending on host settings. Settings Max : Maximum number that can appear in one match. Spawn Chance : Chance for a player to receive this add-on. Eligibility : Separate settings control whether Impostors, Crewmates, Neutrals can receive this add-on. Statue Slowness : Amount by which the Statue is slowed. People needed to Slow : Number of nearby players required to slow the Statue.

summary.zh-CN: 仅内鬼可获得；每次击杀都会增加额外投票数，票数可设置为隐藏。
summary.en: Only Impostors can receive it; kills add extra votes, which can be hidden by a setting.

search.zh-CN: 窃票者 仅内鬼可获得；每次击杀都会增加额外投票数，票数可设置为隐藏。 效果 窃票者只分配给内鬼。每次击杀都会按设定值增加额外投票数；计算投票时小数部分向下取整。额外投票是否在会议界面显示由设置控制。 设置 Max（最大数量） ：本局中该附加身份可出现的数量上限。 Spawn Chance（生成概率） ：玩家获得此附加身份的概率。 TicketsPerKill（每次击杀增加票数） ：每次击杀增加的额外票数；应用时向下取整。 HideAdditionalVotes（隐藏额外票数） ：控制会议期间是否隐藏额外票数。
search.en: Stealer Only Impostors can receive it; kills add extra votes, which can be hidden by a setting. Effect Stealer is assigned only to Impostors. Each kill adds extra votes based on a configurable amount; fractional votes are rounded down. A setting controls whether the extra votes appear in the meeting display. Settings Max : Maximum number that can appear in one match. Spawn Chance : Chance for a player to receive this add-on. TicketsPerKill : Extra votes granted per kill; fractional votes are rounded down when applied. HideAdditionalVotes : Whether extra votes are hidden during meetings.

summary.zh-CN: 击杀时使同一房间内的玩家短暂失明。
summary.en: Blinds players in the same room briefly when making a kill.

search.zh-CN: 隐形者 击杀时使同一房间内的玩家短暂失明。 技能 击杀时，当前房间内的玩家会短暂失明；会议开始会结束失明效果。 选项 致盲时忽略内鬼 ：开启时，其他内鬼不会被致盲；关闭时，其他内鬼也会失明。 致盲持续时间 ：设置失明效果持续多久。
search.en: Stealth Blinds players in the same room briefly when making a kill. Ability When the Stealth kills, players in the same room are blinded briefly. A meeting ends the blindness effect. Options Ignore Impostors While Blinding : When enabled, other Impostors are not blinded; when disabled, they are blinded too. Blinding Duration : How long players remain blinded.

summary.zh-CN: 抹除者无法抹除其角色，清洗者无法净化，强盗无法窃取，君主无法授勋；商人不能给予其新附加身份。
summary.en: Blocks Eraser, Cleanser, Bandit, Monarch, and Merchant from changing it or its add-ons.

search.zh-CN: 固执者 抹除者无法抹除其角色，清洗者无法净化，强盗无法窃取，君主无法授勋；商人不能给予其新附加身份。 效果 抹除者不能抹除固执者的角色，清洗者不能净化它，强盗不能从它身上窃取，君主不能为它授勋。此外，商人无法向它添加新的附加身份。 设置 Max（最大数量） ：本局中该附加身份可出现的数量上限。 Spawn Chance（生成概率） ：玩家获得此附加身份的概率。 Eligibility（可分配阵营） ：主持人可分别设置内鬼、船员、中立者是否可以获得此附加身份。
search.en: Stubborn Blocks Eraser, Cleanser, Bandit, Monarch, and Merchant from changing it or its add-ons. Effect Eraser cannot erase Stubborn's role, Cleanser cannot cleanse it, Bandit cannot steal from it, and Monarch cannot knight it. Merchant also cannot give it new add-ons. Settings Max : Maximum number that can appear in one match. Spawn Chance : Chance for a player to receive this add-on. Eligibility : Separate settings control whether Impostors, Crewmates, Neutrals can receive this add-on.

summary.zh-CN: 通过生命面板查看玩家状态；只要该角色存在且仍有至少两名玩家存活，人数结算就不会结束游戏；死亡后随获胜阵营获胜。
summary.en: Check player life status through vitals; while the role exists and at least two players remain alive, a numbers-based game end is delayed. A dead Sunnyboy wins with the winning team.

search.zh-CN: 阳光开朗大男孩 通过生命面板查看玩家状态；只要该角色存在且仍有至少两名玩家存活，人数结算就不会结束游戏；死亡后随获胜阵营获胜。 阳光开朗大男孩 阳光开朗大男孩可以通过生命面板查看其他玩家的存活状态。只要该角色存在且至少有两名玩家存活，游戏就不会因存活人数结算而结束；这项检查不要求阳光开朗大男孩本人存活。任务完成或破坏仍可结束游戏。游戏结束时，若阳光开朗大男孩已死亡，就会随获胜阵营获胜。 阳光开朗大男孩是隐藏角色，可按设置替换小丑。要启用这种隐藏角色替换，必须关闭“禁用隐藏角色”设置；小丑的阳光开朗大男孩替换概率决定该替换是否发生。
search.en: Sunnyboy Check player life status through vitals; while the role exists and at least two players remain alive, a numbers-based game end is delayed. A dead Sunnyboy wins with the winning team. Sunnyboy The Sunnyboy can check other players' life status through vitals. While the role exists and at least two players remain alive, the living-player count check cannot end the game; the Sunnyboy does not have to be alive for this to happen. Task and sabotage endings can still occur. If the Sunnyboy is dead when the game ends, they win with the winning team. The Sunnyboy is a hidden role that can replace the Jester. “Disable Hidden Roles” must be turned off, and the Jester's Sunnyboy replacement chance must allow it.

summary.zh-CN: 大明星只有在与杀手单独相处时才能被击杀，是否在名字旁显示黄色星星可设置。
summary.en: The Super Star can be killed only when alone with a killer, and a setting controls whether a yellow star appears by their name.

search.zh-CN: 大明星 大明星只有在与杀手单独相处时才能被击杀，是否在名字旁显示黄色星星可设置。 职业能力 大明星只有在与杀手单独相处时才能被普通击杀，也不能被职业猜测。 设置 数量上限 ：设置一局中大明星的最大人数。 所有人都知道大明星身份 ：开启时在大明星名字旁显示黄色星星；关闭时大明星身份保密。
search.en: Super Star The Super Star can be killed only when alone with a killer, and a setting controls whether a yellow star appears by their name. Role The Super Star can be killed by a regular kill only when alone with a killer. Guessers cannot guess the Super Star. Settings Maximum count : Sets the maximum number of Super Stars in a match. Everyone knows the Super Star : ON shows a yellow star next to the Super Star's name; OFF keeps their role secret.

summary.zh-CN: 死亡原因会随机抽选；已启用角色选项会限制可替换的原因。
summary.en: Gets a randomly selected death reason; an option limits replacements to reasons tied to enabled roles.

search.zh-CN: 易感者 死亡原因会随机抽选；已启用角色选项会限制可替换的原因。 效果 易感者的死亡原因会随机抽选。若开启“仅使用已启用的死亡原因”，只有对应角色已启用时才会替换原死亡原因；若关闭，则可使用不在禁用列表中的死亡原因。 设置 Max（最大数量） ：本局中该附加身份可出现的数量上限。 Spawn Chance（生成概率） ：玩家获得此附加身份的概率。 Eligibility（可分配阵营） ：主持人可分别设置内鬼、船员、中立者是否可以获得此附加身份。 Only Enabled Death Reasons（仅使用已启用的死亡原因） ：开启时，只有对应角色已启用，随机原因才会替换原原因；关闭时，可替换为不在禁用列表中的原因。
search.en: Susceptible Gets a randomly selected death reason; an option limits replacements to reasons tied to enabled roles. Effect Susceptible receives a randomly selected death reason. With "Only Enabled Death Reasons" on, the reason replaces the original only when its associated role is enabled. With it off, any reason outside the banned list can be used. Settings Max : Maximum number that can appear in one match. Spawn Chance : Chance for a player to receive this add-on. Eligibility : Separate settings control whether Impostors, Crewmates, Neutrals can receive this add-on. Only Enabled Death Reasons : ON replaces the original reason only when its associated role is enabled; OFF allows any reason outside the banned list.

summary.zh-CN: 换票师在会议中用 /sw [玩家编号] 选择两名玩家交换票数，且默认不能选择自己。
summary.en: During a meeting, the Swapper selects two players with /sw [player ID] to exchange their votes, and cannot select themself by default.

search.zh-CN: 换票师 换票师在会议中用 /sw [玩家编号] 选择两名玩家交换票数，且默认不能选择自己。 职业能力 换票师在会议中两次使用 /sw [玩家 ID]，分别选择两名玩家以交换他们的票数。玩家 ID 显示在会议名字旁，也可输入 /id 查看。能否交换自己的票由设置决定。 设置 数量上限 ：设置一局中换票师的最大人数。 交换次数上限 ：设置换票师最多可交换票数的次数。 可以交换自己的票 ：开启时允许交换自己的票；关闭时不允许。 可以召开紧急会议 ：开启时可召开紧急会议；关闭时不能。 尝试隐藏换票指令 ：开启时模组会尝试隐藏换票师指令；关闭时不尝试隐藏。
search.en: Swapper During a meeting, the Swapper selects two players with /sw [player ID] to exchange their votes, and cannot select themself by default. Role During a meeting, the Swapper uses /sw [player ID] twice to select two players whose votes will be exchanged. IDs appear next to names during meetings and can also be listed with /id. A setting controls whether the Swapper can exchange their own vote. Settings Maximum count : Sets the maximum number of Swappers in a match. Maximum swaps : Sets how many times the Swapper can exchange votes. Can exchange your own vote : ON allows the Swapper's own vote to be exchanged; OFF does not. Can call emergency meetings : ON allows the Swapper to call emergency meetings; OFF does not. Try to hide Swapper command : ON makes the mod attempt to hide the Swapper's commands; OFF does not.

summary.zh-CN: 仅内鬼可获得；击杀时不会向目标冲刺。
summary.en: Only Impostors can receive it; Swift does not lunge when making kills.

search.zh-CN: 迅捷 仅内鬼可获得；击杀时不会向目标冲刺。 效果 迅捷只分配给内鬼；发动击杀时不会向目标冲刺。 设置 Max（最大数量） ：本局中该附加身份可出现的数量上限。 Spawn Chance（生成概率） ：玩家获得此附加身份的概率。
search.en: Swift Only Impostors can receive it; Swift does not lunge when making kills. Effect Swift is assigned only to Impostors. Its kills do not cause it to lunge. Settings Max : Maximum number that can be in one match. Spawn Chance : Chance for a player to receive this add-on.

summary.zh-CN: 使用通风口进入短暂隐身，再次使用通风口可提前解除。
summary.en: Uses a vent to become temporarily invisible and can use a vent again to end it early.

search.zh-CN: 隐匿者 使用通风口进入短暂隐身，再次使用通风口可提前解除。 技能 使用通风口进入短暂隐身；再次使用通风口可以提前解除隐身。持续时间结束时会强制现形；会议开始会解除隐身，会议结束后隐身冷却重新开始。 选项 数量上限（Max） ：设置本局最多可有多少名隐匿者。 隐身冷却 ：设置再次使用隐身技能前的等待时间。 隐身持续时间 ：设置隐身状态持续多久。 隐身冷却期间可正常使用通风口 ：开启时，隐身技能冷却中仍可正常使用通风口；关闭时，技能冷却期间不能正常使用通风口。
search.en: Swooper Uses a vent to become temporarily invisible and can use a vent again to end it early. Ability Use a vent to become invisible temporarily. Using a vent again ends invisibility early. The Swooper is forced to reappear when the duration expires. A meeting also ends invisibility, and the cooldown starts over after the meeting. Options Max : Maximum number of Swoopers in a match. Swoop Cooldown : Time before the ability can be used again. Swoop Duration : How long invisibility lasts. Swooper Vents Normally When Swooping Is on Cooldown : When enabled, the Swooper can use vents normally while the invisibility ability is on cooldown; when disabled, it cannot.

summary.zh-CN: 完成任务时给任务安装炸弹；其他玩家完成被标记任务时会触发炸弹攻击。船员获胜时任务执行者不能获胜。
summary.en: Bomb tasks as they are completed so another player triggers an attack when completing one; the Taskinator wins only if Crew does not win and they survive.

search.zh-CN: 任务执行者 完成任务时给任务安装炸弹；其他玩家完成被标记任务时会触发炸弹攻击。船员获胜时任务执行者不能获胜。 任务执行者 任务执行者每完成一个任务，该任务就会被安装炸弹。之后其他玩家完成被标记的任务时，炸弹会引爆并尝试杀死该玩家。炸弹会经过目标的击杀检查，因此目标的角色能力或状态可能阻止爆炸击杀。 任务执行者存活到游戏结束且船员未获胜时获胜。 设置 人数上限 ：一局中可出现的任务执行者数量上限。 每轮可轰炸的任务数 ：每轮可安装炸弹的任务数量。 覆盖任务数 ：开启后，可单独设置任务执行者是否有普通任务，以及长任务和短任务数量；关闭后使用与其他玩家相同的任务数。
search.en: Taskinator Bomb tasks as they are completed so another player triggers an attack when completing one; the Taskinator wins only if Crew does not win and they survive. Taskinator Whenever the Taskinator completes a task, that task is bombed. If another player later completes a bombed task, the bomb detonates and attempts to kill them. The bomb still passes through the target's kill checks, so a target's role ability or state can prevent it from killing them. The Taskinator wins if they survive until the end and the Crew does not win. Settings Maximum number: Maximum number of Taskinators in a match. Tasks bombed per round: Number of tasks the Taskinator can bomb in one round. Override tasks: When enabled, configure whether the Taskinator has common tasks and the number of long and short tasks. When disabled, they have the same task count as other players.

summary.zh-CN: 任务管理者会实时看到全体玩家已完成任务的总数，数字显示在职业名称旁。
summary.en: The Task Manager sees the combined number of tasks completed by all players beside their role name, updated in real time.

search.zh-CN: 任务管理者 任务管理者会实时看到全体玩家已完成任务的总数，数字显示在职业名称旁。 职业能力 任务管理者会在职业名称旁看到全体玩家已完成任务的总数，并实时更新。 设置 数量上限 ：设置一局中任务管理者的最大人数。
search.en: Task Manager The Task Manager sees the combined number of tasks completed by all players beside their role name, updated in real time. Role The Task Manager sees the total number of tasks completed by everyone together beside their role name. The count updates in real time. Settings Maximum count : Sets the maximum number of Task Managers in a match.

summary.zh-CN: 存活玩家走近监控、生命监测仪、门禁日志或管理室定位设备时，通信员会收到位置提示；代码检测的是接近设备，不是打开界面。
summary.en: The Telecommunication receives a proximity warning when living players approach cameras, Vitals, door logs, or Admin devices; the source checks proximity, not whether a UI was opened.

search.zh-CN: 通信员 存活玩家走近监控、生命监测仪、门禁日志或管理室定位设备时，通信员会收到位置提示；代码检测的是接近设备，不是打开界面。 职业能力 存活玩家进入监控摄像头、生命监测仪、门禁日志或管理室定位设备的使用范围时，通信员会看到提示标记。当前实现按玩家与设备的距离检测接近状态，不检测玩家是否打开了设备界面。 设置 数量上限 ：设置一局中通信员的最大人数。 可以追踪监控使用 ：开启时可追踪摄像头使用情况；关闭时不能。 可以使用通风口 ：开启时通信员可以使用通风口；关闭时不能。
search.en: Telecommunication The Telecommunication receives a proximity warning when living players approach cameras, Vitals, door logs, or Admin devices; the source checks proximity, not whether a UI was opened. Role The Telecommunication sees a warning when a living player enters the usable range of cameras, Vitals, door logs, or Admin devices. The current implementation checks player distance to each device, not whether the player opened its UI. Settings Maximum count : Sets the maximum number of Telecommunication roles in a match. Can track camera usage : ON allows tracking camera use; OFF disables it. Can vent : ON allows venting; OFF does not.

summary.zh-CN: 完成所有任务后被击杀或放逐即可单独获胜；自杀仅在设置允许时有效。
summary.en: Complete all tasks and then be killed or voted out to win alone; suicide counts only when enabled.

search.zh-CN: 恐怖分子 完成所有任务后被击杀或放逐即可单独获胜；自杀仅在设置允许时有效。 恐怖分子 恐怖分子完成所有任务后死亡即可单独获胜；被击杀或被投票放逐都可获胜。允许自杀获胜的设置开启后，自杀也符合条件；默认为关闭。死因是“Armageddon”的情况不触发此胜利。若有转换类附加职业，结算时会按该转换职业的胜利规则处理。 设置 人数上限 ：一局中可出现的恐怖分子数量上限。 自杀后可获胜 ：开启后，恐怖分子完成任务后自杀也可获胜。 猜测模式中可猜职业 ：设置恐怖分子能否在猜测模式或作为猜测者附加职业时猜测。 覆盖任务数 ：开启后，可单独设置是否有普通任务，以及长、短任务数量；关闭后使用其他玩家的任务数。
search.en: Terrorist Complete all tasks and then be killed or voted out to win alone; suicide counts only when enabled. Terrorist The Terrorist wins alone by completing all tasks and then dying by a kill or vote. Suicide counts only when the option is enabled, which is off by default. An Armageddon death does not trigger the Terrorist win. A converted addon can redirect the win to its team. Settings Maximum number: Maximum number of Terrorists in a match. Can win by suicide: When enabled, the Terrorist can win by suiciding after finishing all tasks. Can guess: Whether the Terrorist can guess in Guesser Mode or as a Guesser addon. Override tasks: When enabled, configure common, long, and short tasks; otherwise, use the normal task setup.

summary.zh-CN: 投票平票时优先淘汰其投票指向的目标；多个破平者指向不同目标时能力不生效。
summary.en: In a tie, gives priority to its chosen target; the effect fails if multiple Tiebreakers choose different targets.

search.zh-CN: 破平者 投票平票时优先淘汰其投票指向的目标；多个破平者指向不同目标时能力不生效。 效果 发生平票时，会优先淘汰破平者投票选择的目标。如果多个破平者同时选择不同的平票目标，则这些能力都不会生效。 设置 Max（最大数量） ：本局中该附加身份可出现的数量上限。 Spawn Chance（生成概率） ：玩家获得此附加身份的概率。 Eligibility（可分配阵营） ：主持人可分别设置内鬼、船员、中立者是否可以获得此附加身份。
search.en: Tiebreaker In a tie, gives priority to its chosen target; the effect fails if multiple Tiebreakers choose different targets. Effect When a vote is tied, priority is given to the target chosen by the Tiebreaker. If multiple Tiebreakers choose different tied targets at the same time, their abilities do not take effect. Settings Max : Maximum number that can appear in one match. Spawn Chance : Chance for a player to receive this add-on. Eligibility : Separate settings control whether Impostors, Crewmates, Neutrals can receive this add-on.

summary.zh-CN: 时间操控者完成任务会延长会议投票时间，成为叛徒时则缩短时间，死亡后所有改动恢复。
summary.en: Tasks increase the Time Manager's meeting voting time, or decrease it as a Mad Time Manager; all changes revert on death.

search.zh-CN: 时间操控者 时间操控者完成任务会延长会议投票时间，成为叛徒时则缩短时间，死亡后所有改动恢复。 职业能力 时间操控者完成的任务越多，会议投票时间越长。成为叛徒时间操控者时，完成任务会反向缩短时间。时间操控者死亡后，之前增加或减少的会议时间全部恢复正常。 设置 数量上限 ：设置一局中时间操控者的最大人数。 每个任务增加的投票时间 ：设置时间操控者每完成一个任务增加的投票时间。 会议时长上限 ：设置会议时长的上限。 叛徒时间操控者的最短投票时间 ：设置叛徒时间操控者减少时间时，投票时间可达到的最低值。 自定义时间操控者任务 ：开启时可单独设置任务数量；关闭时任务数量与其他玩家相同。自定义选项包括公共任务、长任务和短任务的设置。
search.en: Time Manager Tasks increase the Time Manager's meeting voting time, or decrease it as a Mad Time Manager; all changes revert on death. Role The more tasks the Time Manager completes, the longer the meeting voting time becomes. As a Mad Time Manager, completing tasks has the opposite effect and shortens the time. When the Time Manager dies, all meeting-time changes they caused revert to normal. Settings Maximum count : Sets the maximum number of Time Managers in a match. Increase voting time by : Sets how much voting time is added for each task the Time Manager completes. Maximum meeting length : Sets the cap for meeting length. Mad Time Manager minimum voting time : Sets the minimum voting time that can remain as the Mad Time Manager reduces it. Override Time Manager tasks : ON allows a separate task setup; OFF gives the role the same task count as everyone else. The custom setup includes common-task availability and the number of long and short tasks.

summary.zh-CN: 时间之主使用通风口标记所有人的位置，再次发动技能会将存活玩家倒回标记位置，并在技能期间获得免死时间护盾。
summary.en: The Time Master marks everyone's positions through vents, then rewinds living players to those positions and gains a temporary shield.

search.zh-CN: 时间之主 时间之主使用通风口标记所有人的位置，再次发动技能会将存活玩家倒回标记位置，并在技能期间获得免死时间护盾。 职业能力 时间之主使用通风口标记所有玩家的位置。再次使用能力时，所有存活玩家都会回到标记的位置。技能持续期间，时间之主获得可保护自己免于死亡的时间护盾。 设置 数量上限 ：设置一局中时间之主的最大人数。 时间护盾冷却 ：设置再次使用能力前的等待时间。 时间护盾持续时间 ：设置护盾可以维持多久。 初始技能次数上限 ：设置时间之主开局拥有的技能次数。 每完成一个任务获得的技能次数 ：设置每完成一个任务增加的次数，按 0.1 为步进。
search.en: Time Master The Time Master marks everyone's positions through vents, then rewinds living players to those positions and gains a temporary shield. Role The Time Master uses vents to mark everyone's position. When they use the ability again, every living player is rewound to the marked position. During the ability duration, the Time Master gains a time shield that protects them from death. Settings Maximum count : Sets the maximum number of Time Masters in a match. Time shield cooldown : Sets how long the Time Master must wait before using the ability. Time shield duration : Sets how long the shield lasts. Initial maximum ability uses : Sets how many uses the Time Master starts with. Ability uses gained per task : Sets the uses gained for each completed task, in 0.1 increments.

summary.zh-CN: 每次击杀都会缩短会议投票时间；蚀时者死亡后可按设置恢复被偷走的时间。
summary.en: Each kill reduces meeting voting time; the stolen time can be restored when the Time Thief dies.

search.zh-CN: 蚀时者 每次击杀都会缩短会议投票时间；蚀时者死亡后可按设置恢复被偷走的时间。 技能 每次击杀都会缩短会议投票时间。缩短时间按击杀数累计，最低不会低于房主设定的投票时间下限。蚀时者死亡后是否恢复被缩短的时间，由选项决定。 选项 数量上限（Max） ：设置本局最多可有多少名蚀时者。 击杀冷却 ：设置击杀冷却。 每次击杀缩短的会议时间 ：设置每次击杀减少的投票时间。 最低投票时间 ：设置投票时间可缩短到的最低值。 死亡后恢复被偷走的时间 ：开启时，蚀时者死亡后恢复时间；关闭时，减少的时间保留。
search.en: Time Thief Each kill reduces meeting voting time; the stolen time can be restored when the Time Thief dies. Ability Each kill reduces meeting voting time. The reduction accumulates with the kill count, down to the configured minimum voting time. Whether the stolen time is restored when the Time Thief dies is controlled by a setting. Options Max : Maximum number of Time Thieves in a match. Kill Cooldown : Time before the Time Thief can kill again. Lower Meeting Time By : Voting time removed for each kill. Minimum Voting Time : Lowest voting time can be reduced to. Return Stolen Time Upon Death : When enabled, voting time is restored when the Time Thief dies; otherwise the reduction remains.

summary.zh-CN: 尝试击杀或完成任务后会暂时降低视野与移动速度。
summary.en: Temporarily loses vision and movement speed after attempting a kill or completing a task.

search.zh-CN: 疲劳者 尝试击杀或完成任务后会暂时降低视野与移动速度。 效果 疲劳者尝试使用击杀按钮（包括击杀类能力）或完成任务后，会暂时降低视野和移动速度。 设置 Max（最大数量） ：本局中该附加身份可出现的数量上限。 Spawn Chance（生成概率） ：玩家获得此附加身份的概率。 Eligibility（可分配阵营） ：主持人可分别设置内鬼、船员、中立者是否可以获得此附加身份。 Vision when Tired（疲劳时视野） ：疲劳效果生效时的视野倍率。 Speed when Tired（疲劳时速度） ：疲劳效果生效时的移动速度倍率。 Tired Duration（疲劳持续时间） ：视野和速度降低的持续时间。
search.en: Tired Temporarily loses vision and movement speed after attempting a kill or completing a task. Effect Whenever a Tired player attempts to use a kill button or kill ability, or completes a task, their vision and movement speed temporarily decrease. Settings Max : Maximum number that can appear in one match. Spawn Chance : Chance for a player to receive this add-on. Eligibility : Separate settings control whether Impostors, Crewmates, Neutrals can receive this add-on. Vision when Tired : Vision multiplier while the Tired effect is active. Speed when Tired : Movement-speed multiplier while the Tired effect is active. Tired Duration : How long the reduced vision and speed last.

summary.zh-CN: 仅船员可获得；视野倍率可设置，默认不受灯光破坏影响。
summary.en: Only Crewmates can receive it; vision is configurable and is unaffected by Lights sabotage by default.

search.zh-CN: 火炬 仅船员可获得；视野倍率可设置，默认不受灯光破坏影响。 效果 火炬只分配给船员，视野倍率由主持人设置。默认情况下，灯光破坏不会影响火炬的视野；主持人可启用选项让其受灯光破坏影响。 设置 Max（最大数量） ：本局中该附加身份可出现的数量上限。 Spawn Chance（生成概率） ：玩家获得此附加身份的概率。 TorchVision（火炬视野） ：火炬使用的视野倍率。 TorchAffectedByLights（视野受灯光破坏影响） ：控制灯光破坏是否影响火炬的视野。
search.en: Torch Only Crewmates can receive it; vision is configurable and is unaffected by Lights sabotage by default. Effect Torch is assigned only to Crewmates, with a configurable vision multiplier. By default, Lights sabotage does not affect its vision; the host can enable the option to make it affected by Lights sabotage. Settings Max : Maximum number that can appear in one match. Spawn Chance : Chance for a player to receive this add-on. TorchVision : Vision multiplier used by Torch. TorchAffectedByLights : Whether Lights sabotage affects Torch's vision.

summary.zh-CN: 寻迹者可以使用生命监测仪，并会获得指向尸体的箭头；监测仪和箭头的时序均可调整。
summary.en: The Tracefinder can use Vitals and receives arrows pointing to dead bodies, with configurable Vitals and arrow timing.

search.zh-CN: 寻迹者 寻迹者可以使用生命监测仪，并会获得指向尸体的箭头；监测仪和箭头的时序均可调整。 职业能力 寻迹者可以使用便携生命监测仪，并会收到指向尸体的箭头。 设置 数量上限 ：设置一局中寻迹者的最大人数。 生命监测仪冷却 ：设置再次查看生命监测仪前的等待时间。 生命监测仪持续时间 ：设置每次查看生命监测仪可持续多久。 箭头最短出现延迟 ：设置箭头出现前至少等待的时间。 箭头最长出现延迟 ：设置箭头出现前可能等待的最长时间。
search.en: Tracefinder The Tracefinder can use Vitals and receives arrows pointing to dead bodies, with configurable Vitals and arrow timing. Role The Tracefinder can access portable Vitals and receives arrows pointing to dead bodies. Settings Maximum count : Sets the maximum number of Tracefinders in a match. Vitals cooldown : Sets how long the Tracefinder must wait before checking Vitals again. Vitals duration : Sets how long each Vitals check lasts. Minimum arrow show-up delay : Sets the shortest delay before an arrow appears. Maximum arrow show-up delay : Sets the longest possible delay before an arrow appears.

summary.zh-CN: 侦查员选择玩家后可在地图上追踪其位置一段时间，追踪冷却、持续时间和启动延迟可设置。
summary.en: The Tracker can follow a selected player's location on the map for a limited time, with configurable cooldown, duration, and delay.

search.zh-CN: 侦查员（TOHE） 侦查员选择玩家后可在地图上追踪其位置一段时间，追踪冷却、持续时间和启动延迟可设置。 职业能力 侦查员使用追踪按钮选择一名玩家后，可以在地图上追踪其位置一段时间。 设置 数量与生成率 ：由 TOHE 的角色生成选项控制。 追踪冷却 ：设置再次追踪前的等待时间。 追踪持续时间 ：设置每次追踪可持续多久。 追踪延迟 ：设置追踪开始前的等待时间。
search.en: Tracker (TOHE) The Tracker can follow a selected player's location on the map for a limited time, with configurable cooldown, duration, and delay. Role The Tracker presses the tracking button on a player to follow their position on the map for a limited time. Settings Count and spawn chance : Controlled by the TOHE role-spawn options. Tracking cooldown : Sets how long the Tracker must wait before tracking again. Tracking duration : Sets how long the Tracker can follow a player. Tracking delay : Sets the wait before tracking begins.

summary.zh-CN: 背叛者能识别内鬼但不能击杀他们；内鬼出局后，背叛者按独立中立阵营的计数胜利规则获胜。
summary.en: The Traitor can identify but cannot kill Impostors; after they are gone, the Traitor wins under its separate Neutral team count rule.

search.zh-CN: 背叛者 背叛者能识别内鬼但不能击杀他们；内鬼出局后，背叛者按独立中立阵营的计数胜利规则获胜。 背叛者 背叛者曾是内鬼，但背叛了内鬼阵营。背叛者知道内鬼是谁，内鬼却不知道背叛者的身份。内鬼可以击杀背叛者，但背叛者不能击杀内鬼。 背叛者属于独立的中立阵营。内鬼出局后，若船员人数不多于仍计入胜负的中立玩家，且这些中立玩家都属于同一阵营，背叛者即可获胜；不必击杀所有其他玩家。 设置 击杀冷却 ：再次击杀前的等待时间。 可使用通风口 ：设置背叛者能否使用通风口。 内鬼视野 ：开启后拥有内鬼视野；关闭后使用船员视野。 可使用破坏 ：设置背叛者能否发动破坏。 知道叛徒类附加职业 ：设置背叛者能否识别 Madmate 等叛徒类附加职业。
search.en: Traitor The Traitor can identify but cannot kill Impostors; after they are gone, the Traitor wins under its separate Neutral team count rule. Traitor The Traitor was an Impostor who betrayed the Impostors. The Traitor knows who the Impostors are, but they do not know the Traitor. Impostors can kill the Traitor, but the Traitor cannot kill them. The Traitor is a separate Neutral team. After the Impostors are gone, the Traitor team can win when the living Crew count is no greater than the remaining counted Neutral players and those Neutrals all belong to the same team. The Traitor does not have to kill every other player. Settings Kill cooldown: Time before killing again. Can vent: Whether the Traitor can use vents. Impostor vision: When enabled, the Traitor has Impostor vision; otherwise, they have Crewmate vision. Can sabotage: Whether the Traitor can sabotage. Knows Madmates: Whether the Traitor can identify Madmates.

summary.zh-CN: 传送师完成任务时会从可传送的存活玩家中随机交换两人的位置；通风口中的玩家会被排除。
summary.en: When the Transporter completes a task, two eligible living players swap positions; players in vents are excluded.

search.zh-CN: 传送师 传送师完成任务时会从可传送的存活玩家中随机交换两人的位置；通风口中的玩家会被排除。 职业能力 传送师每完成一个任务，会从可传送的存活玩家中随机选择两人交换位置。正在使用通风口的玩家不会被选中；只要还有两名合格玩家，其他玩家仍可交换。 设置 数量上限 ：设置一局中传送师的最大人数。 传送次数上限 ：设置传送师最多可以触发多少次位置交换。 自定义传送师任务 ：开启时可单独设置传送师的任务数量；关闭时与其他玩家任务数量相同。自定义选项包括公共任务、长任务和短任务的设置。
search.en: Transporter When the Transporter completes a task, two eligible living players swap positions; players in vents are excluded. Role Whenever the Transporter completes a task, two eligible living players are chosen at random and swap positions. Players in vents are excluded, and other eligible players can still be swapped if at least two remain. Settings Maximum count : Sets the maximum number of Transporters in a match. Maximum teleports : Sets how many swaps the Transporter can trigger. Override Transporter tasks : ON allows a separate task setup; OFF gives the Transporter the same task count as everyone else. The custom setup includes common-task availability and the number of long and short tasks.

summary.zh-CN: 在会议外被非自杀击杀时会将击杀者定身并阻止其报告尸体一段时间。
summary.en: When killed outside a meeting other than by suicide, immobilizes its killer and prevents reporting for a configured duration.

search.zh-CN: 陷阱师 在会议外被非自杀击杀时会将击杀者定身并阻止其报告尸体一段时间。 效果 陷阱师在会议外被非自杀击杀时，会将击杀者定身，并在设定时长内阻止其报告尸体。若击杀者是杀戮机器，则该效果不会触发。 设置 Max（最大数量） ：本局中该附加身份可出现的数量上限。 Spawn Chance（生成概率） ：玩家获得此附加身份的概率。 Eligibility（可分配阵营） ：主持人可分别设置内鬼、船员、中立者是否可以获得此附加身份。 TrapperBlockMoveTime（定身时长） ：击杀者被定身且无法报告尸体的时长。
search.en: Beartrap When killed outside a meeting other than by suicide, immobilizes its killer and prevents reporting for a configured duration. Effect When Trapper is killed outside a meeting by a method other than suicide, the killer is immobilized and cannot report bodies for a configured duration. The effect does not trigger when the killer is KillingMachine. Settings Max : Maximum number that can appear in one match. Spawn Chance : Chance for a player to receive this add-on. Eligibility : Separate settings control whether Impostors, Crewmates, Neutrals can receive this add-on. TrapperBlockMoveTime : How long the killer is immobilized and unable to report.

summary.zh-CN: 诡雷击杀的尸体会杀死报告者；击杀诱饵会让诡雷立即死亡。
summary.en: Bodies from Trapster kills kill the reporter; killing a Bait immediately kills the Trapster.

search.zh-CN: 诡雷 诡雷击杀的尸体会杀死报告者；击杀诱饵会让诡雷立即死亡。 技能 诡雷击杀玩家后，该尸体会设下陷阱，杀死试图报告它的玩家。击杀诱饵会让诡雷立即死亡。若启用连锁陷阱，报告者死亡后其尸体也会触发下一道陷阱。 选项 数量上限（Max） ：设置本局最多可有多少名诡雷。 击杀冷却 ：设置击杀冷却。 连续尸体触发陷阱 ：开启时，报告陷阱尸体的玩家也会被设为陷阱目标；关闭时不会连锁。 诡雷自己的尸体也设陷阱 ：开启时，报告诡雷尸体也会触发陷阱。 诡雷尸体触发连锁陷阱 ：开启时，报告者尸体继续触发陷阱；关闭时不会。
search.en: Trapster Bodies from Trapster kills kill the reporter; killing a Bait immediately kills the Trapster. Ability A body from a Trapster kill is trapped: anyone who tries to report it dies. Killing a Bait immediately kills the Trapster. If consecutive traps are enabled, the reporter’s body also becomes trapped. Options Max : Maximum number of Trapsters in a match. Kill Cooldown : Time before the Trapster can kill again. Trap Consecutive Bodies : When enabled, the reporter’s body also triggers a trap; otherwise traps do not chain. Trap the Trapster’s Body : When enabled, reporting the Trapster’s own body triggers a trap. Trap Consecutive Trapster Bodies : When enabled, the reporter’s body triggers another trap; otherwise it does not.

summary.zh-CN: 行动方式与内鬼相同，但船员阵营判定会将其视为船员。
summary.en: Acts like an Impostor, but Crewmate-team checks treat it as a Crewmate.

search.zh-CN: 骗术师 行动方式与内鬼相同，但船员阵营判定会将其视为船员。 技能 骗术师按普通内鬼方式行动，但船员阵营判定会将其视为船员。警长不能击杀骗术师，灵媒不会将其视为邪恶，告密者无法找到；法官或邪恶法官审判骗术师时会自杀。 选项 数量上限（Max） ：设置本局最多可有多少名骗术师。
search.en: Trickster Acts like an Impostor, but Crewmate-team checks treat it as a Crewmate. Ability The Trickster otherwise acts like a regular Impostor, but Crewmate-team checks treat it as a Crewmate. Sheriff cannot kill it, Psychic does not see it as evil, and Snitch cannot find it. A Judge or Councillor who trials the Trickster dies. Options Max : Maximum number of Tricksters in a match.

summary.zh-CN: 仅内鬼可获得；击杀会显示随机死亡原因，主持人可限制随机范围。
summary.en: Only Impostors can receive it; kills show a random death reason, with an optional limit to enabled roles.

search.zh-CN: 棘手者 仅内鬼可获得；击杀会显示随机死亡原因，主持人可限制随机范围。 效果 棘手者只分配给内鬼；其击杀会显示随机死亡原因。 设置 Max（最大数量） ：本局中该附加身份可出现的数量上限。 Spawn Chance（生成概率） ：玩家获得此附加身份的概率。 Only Enabled Death Reasons（仅使用已启用的死亡原因） ：开启时，随机死亡原因只从已启用角色中选择；关闭时可从所有角色的死亡原因中选择。
search.en: Tricky Only Impostors can receive it; kills show a random death reason, with an optional limit to enabled roles. Effect Tricky is assigned only to Impostors, and its kills display a random death reason. Settings Max : Maximum number that can appear in one match. Spawn Chance : Chance for a player to receive this add-on. Only Enabled Death Reasons : ON limits random kill reasons to enabled roles; OFF allows death reasons from all roles.

summary.zh-CN: 通过完成任务触发随机事件来干扰玩家，并随获胜阵营获胜。
summary.en: Complete tasks to trigger random events that disrupt players, then win with the winning team.

search.zh-CN: 暴君 通过完成任务触发随机事件来干扰玩家，并随获胜阵营获胜。 暴君 暴君通过完成任务触发随机事件，事件可以影响玩家，例如改变所有玩家的速度、传送玩家或影响破坏行为。暴君会随最终获胜阵营获胜。 设置 人数上限 ：一局中可出现的暴君数量上限。 每轮事件次数 ：暴君一轮最多可触发的事件数量。 事件可开始会议 ：开启后，随机事件可以开始会议；关闭后不能通过事件开始会议。 覆盖任务数 ：开启后，可单独设置暴君是否有普通任务，以及长任务和短任务数量；关闭后使用与其他玩家相同的任务数。
search.en: Troller Complete tasks to trigger random events that disrupt players, then win with the winning team. Troller The Troller completes tasks to trigger random events that affect players. Examples include changing everyone's speed, teleporting players, and affecting sabotage. The Troller wins with the winning team. Settings Maximum number: Maximum number of Trollers in a match. Trolls per round: Maximum number of events the Troller can trigger in one round. Can start meeting by event: Whether an event can start a meeting. Override tasks: When enabled, configure whether the Troller has common tasks and the number of long and short tasks. When disabled, they have the same task count as other players.

summary.zh-CN: 变形开始和解除时各随机交换一次玩家位置；自己和通风口中的玩家不会参与。
summary.en: Randomly swaps player positions once on shapeshift and again on unshift; the Twister and vented players are excluded.

search.zh-CN: 龙卷风 变形开始和解除时各随机交换一次玩家位置；自己和通风口中的玩家不会参与。 技能 变形开始时，其他玩家的位置会随机交换一次；解除变形时再交换一次。龙卷风本人不会参与交换，处于通风口中的玩家也不会被传送。 选项 数量上限（Max） ：设置本局最多可有多少名龙卷风。 交换冷却 ：设置再次发动位置交换前的等待时间。 变形持续时间 ：设置两次交换之间维持变形的时间。 隐藏位置交换对象 ：开启时，玩家看不到自己与谁交换了位置；关闭时会显示交换对象。
search.en: Twister Randomly swaps player positions once on shapeshift and again on unshift; the Twister and vented players are excluded. Ability Player positions are randomly swapped when the Twister begins shapeshifting and again when it unshifts. The Twister does not swap with anyone, and players in vents are not teleported. Options Max : Maximum number of Twisters in a match. Twist Cooldown : Time before the Twister can swap positions again. Shapeshift Duration : How long the Twister stays shifted between the two swaps. Hide Who the Players Swap Places With : When enabled, players cannot see who they swapped with; otherwise the swap partner is visible.

summary.zh-CN: 只有当存活人数不多于房主设置的门槛时，失败者才能击杀。
summary.en: Can kill only when the number of living players is at or below the host-set threshold.

search.zh-CN: 失败者 只有当存活人数不多于房主设置的门槛时，失败者才能击杀。 技能 当存活玩家人数不多于房主设定的门槛时，失败者才能使用击杀键。 选项 数量上限（Max） ：设置本局最多可有多少名失败者。 开始击杀所需的玩家数量上限 ：设置失败者可开始击杀时的存活人数门槛。 击杀冷却 ：设置击杀冷却。
search.en: Underdog Can kill only when the number of living players is at or below the host-set threshold. Ability The Underdog can use the kill button only when the number of living players is at or below the host-set threshold. Options Max : Maximum number of Underdogs in a match. Maximum Players Needed to Start Killing : Living-player threshold at which the Underdog can kill. Kill Cooldown : Time before the Underdog can kill again.

summary.zh-CN: 变形标记尸体传送点；每次击杀或会议会清除标记，传送击杀后会被冻结。
summary.en: Marks a destination for bodies; each kill or meeting clears it, and a teleporting kill briefly freezes the Undertaker.

search.zh-CN: 暗杀者 变形标记尸体传送点；每次击杀或会议会清除标记，传送击杀后会被冻结。 技能 每次变形都会标记当前位置。击杀后，受害者的尸体会传送到标记位置；每次击杀后以及每次会议后，标记都会重置。尸体传送后，暗杀者会按设定时间被冻结。 选项 数量上限（Max） ：设置本局最多可有多少名暗杀者。 击杀冷却 ：设置再次击杀前的等待时间。 变形冷却 ：设置再次变形前的等待时间。 冻结持续时间 ：设置尸体传送后暗杀者无法移动的时间。
search.en: Undertaker Marks a destination for bodies; each kill or meeting clears it, and a teleporting kill briefly freezes the Undertaker. Ability Each shapeshift marks your location. After a kill, the victim’s body is teleported to that location. The mark resets after each kill and after every meeting. The Undertaker is frozen for the configured time after a kill that teleports a body. Options Max : Maximum number of Undertakers in a match. Kill Cooldown : Time before the Undertaker can kill again. Shapeshift Cooldown : Time before the Undertaker can shapeshift again. Freeze Duration : How long the Undertaker is unable to move after teleporting a body.

summary.zh-CN: 执行特定动作时有概率自杀；尝试击杀也可能触发。
summary.en: Can die by suicide when performing certain actions, including attempting a kill.

search.zh-CN: 倒霉蛋 执行特定动作时有概率自杀；尝试击杀也可能触发。 效果 倒霉蛋执行特定动作时可能自杀。主持人可分别设置尝试击杀、完成任务、使用通风口、报告尸体和开门时触发自杀的概率。 设置 Max（最大数量） ：本局中该附加身份可出现的数量上限。 Spawn Chance（生成概率） ：玩家获得此附加身份的概率。 Eligibility（可分配阵营） ：主持人可分别设置内鬼、船员、中立者是否可以获得此附加身份。 Chance to suicide from killing（尝试击杀时自杀概率） ：尝试击杀时自杀的概率。 Chance to suicide from doing tasks（做任务时自杀概率） ：完成任务后自杀的概率。 Chance to suicide from venting（使用通风口时自杀概率） ：使用通风口后自杀的概率。 Chance to suicide from reporting bodies（报告尸体时自杀概率） ：报告尸体后自杀的概率。 Chance to suicide from opening a door（开门时自杀概率） ：开门后自杀的概率。
search.en: Unlucky Can die by suicide when performing certain actions, including attempting a kill. Effect Unlucky can die by suicide when performing certain actions. The host can separately configure the chance for attempting a kill, completing tasks, venting, reporting bodies, and opening doors. Settings Max : Maximum number that can appear in one match. Spawn Chance : Chance for a player to receive this add-on. Eligibility : Separate settings control whether Impostors, Crewmates, Neutrals can receive this add-on. Chance to suicide from killing : Chance to die by suicide when attempting a kill. Chance to suicide from doing tasks : Chance to die by suicide after doing a task. Chance to suicide from venting : Chance to die by suicide after venting. Chance to suicide from reporting bodies : Chance to die by suicide after reporting a body. Chance to suicide from opening a door : Chance to die by suicide after opening a door.

summary.zh-CN: 死亡后尸体无法被报告；与萧暮、至日者和诱饵不兼容。
summary.en: Its corpse cannot be reported after death; incompatible with Randomizer, Solsticer, and Bait.

search.zh-CN: 不受重视 死亡后尸体无法被报告；与萧暮、至日者和诱饵不兼容。 效果 不受重视者死亡后，其尸体无法被报告。它与萧暮、至日者和诱饵不兼容。 设置 Max（最大数量） ：本局中该附加身份可出现的数量上限。 Spawn Chance（生成概率） ：玩家获得此附加身份的概率。 Eligibility（可分配阵营） ：主持人可分别设置内鬼、船员、中立者是否可以获得此附加身份。
search.en: Disregarded Its corpse cannot be reported after death; incompatible with Randomizer, Solsticer, and Bait. Effect A player with Disregarded leaves a corpse that cannot be reported. It is incompatible with Randomizer, Solsticer, and Bait. Settings Max : Maximum number that can appear in one match. Spawn Chance : Chance for a player to receive this add-on. Eligibility : Separate settings control whether Impostors, Crewmates, Neutrals can receive this add-on.

summary.zh-CN: 咬中的玩家延迟死亡；会议开始时会立即死亡，诱饵则被正常击杀并报告。
summary.en: Bitten players die after a delay or immediately when a meeting starts; a Bait is killed and reported normally.

search.zh-CN: 吸血鬼 咬中的玩家延迟死亡；会议开始时会立即死亡，诱饵则被正常击杀并报告。 技能 吸血鬼使用击杀键咬中目标后，目标会在设定延迟后死亡。召开会议时，所有尚未死亡的被咬目标会立即死亡。攻击诱饵时会改为普通击杀并报告尸体。 操作模式可设为只使用咬杀，或使用双击操作：单击咬杀、双击普通击杀。 选项 数量上限（Max） ：设置本局最多可有多少名吸血鬼。 咬杀延迟 ：设置被咬目标延迟死亡的时间。 可以使用通风口 ：开启时可使用通风口；关闭时不能。 操作模式 ：选择只咬杀，或单击咬杀、双击普通击杀。
search.en: Vampire Bitten players die after a delay or immediately when a meeting starts; a Bait is killed and reported normally. Ability A kill-button attack bites the target, who dies after the configured delay. Calling a meeting immediately kills any bitten target who is still alive. Attacking a Bait instead makes a normal kill and reports the body. The action mode can be set to bite-only, or to a double-click mode: single-click to bite and double-click to make a normal kill. Options Max : Maximum number of Vampires in a match. Bite Kill Delay : Delay before a bitten target dies. Can Vent : When enabled, the Vampire can use vents; otherwise it cannot. Action Mode : Choose bite-only or single-click bite / double-click normal kill.

summary.zh-CN: 通过进入通风口达到设定次数即可单独获胜。
summary.en: Vent the configured number of times to win alone.

search.zh-CN: 马里奥 通过进入通风口达到设定次数即可单独获胜。 马里奥（Vector） 马里奥通过进入通风口达到设定次数即可单独获胜。 设置 人数上限 ：一局中可出现的马里奥数量上限。 获胜所需通风次数 ：获胜前需要进入通风口的次数。 通风冷却 ：再次进入通风口前的等待时间。
search.en: Vector Vent the configured number of times to win alone. Vector Vector wins alone by venting the configured number of times. Settings Maximum number: Maximum number of Vectors in a match. Vents required to win: Number of times Vector must vent to win. Vent cooldown: Time before Vector can vent again.

summary.zh-CN: 船员或非带刀中立恋人死亡且有可确认的凶手时，浪漫者转为复仇浪漫者；击杀凶手后两人一同获胜。
summary.en: Become Vengeful Romantic when a Crewmate or non-killing Neutral partner dies with a recorded killer; kill that killer so both partners win.

search.zh-CN: 复仇浪漫者 船员或非带刀中立恋人死亡且有可确认的凶手时，浪漫者转为复仇浪漫者；击杀凶手后两人一同获胜。 复仇浪漫者 当浪漫者的恋人属于船员或不带刀中立并死亡，且能确认凶手时，浪漫者会转变为复仇浪漫者。若无法确认凶手，浪漫者会转为无情浪漫者。复仇浪漫者必须击杀杀死恋人的凶手；成功后击杀按钮会被禁用，两人会在游戏结束时一同获胜。若误杀其他玩家，复仇浪漫者会因误杀而死亡。 设置 击杀冷却 ：再次击杀前的等待时间。 可使用通风口 ：设置复仇浪漫者能否使用通风口。
search.en: Vengeful Romantic Become Vengeful Romantic when a Crewmate or non-killing Neutral partner dies with a recorded killer; kill that killer so both partners win. Vengeful Romantic The Romantic becomes a Vengeful Romantic if their Crewmate or non-killing Neutral partner dies and the killer can be identified. If no killer is recorded, the Romantic becomes a Ruthless Romantic instead. The Vengeful Romantic must kill their partner's killer. After succeeding, the kill button is disabled, and both partners win at the end of the game. Killing anyone else causes a misfire that kills the Vengeful Romantic. Settings Kill cooldown: Time before killing again. Can vent: Whether the Vengeful Romantic can use vents.

summary.zh-CN: 阻碍者进入通风口即可封堵它；封堵期间能否由船员进入以及会议后是否重置均可设置。
summary.en: The Ventguard blocks a vent by entering it, with settings for Crew access to blocked vents and whether blocks reset after meetings.

search.zh-CN: 阻碍者 阻碍者进入通风口即可封堵它；封堵期间能否由船员进入以及会议后是否重置均可设置。 职业能力 阻碍者可进入通风口将其封堵。封堵的通风口不能进入；是否允许船员进入由设置决定。若开启重置选项，封堵会在每次会议后解除。 设置 数量上限 ：设置一局中阻碍者的最大人数。 封堵次数上限 ：设置阻碍者最多可封堵通风口的次数。 封堵冷却 ：设置再次封堵前的等待时间。 船员可使用被封堵的通风口 ：开启时船员仍可使用被封堵的通风口；关闭时船员也不能进入。 每次会议重置封堵 ：开启时会议后解除所有通风口封堵；关闭时封堵保留。
search.en: Ventguard The Ventguard blocks a vent by entering it, with settings for Crew access to blocked vents and whether blocks reset after meetings. Role The Ventguard blocks a vent by entering it. Blocked vents cannot be entered, except by Crewmates when the corresponding setting allows it. If meeting resets are enabled, blocks are cleared after each meeting. Settings Maximum count : Sets the maximum number of Ventguards in a match. Maximum vent blocks : Sets how many times the Ventguard can block vents. Block vent cooldown : Sets how long the Ventguard must wait before using the ability again. Crewmates can use blocked vents : ON lets Crewmates enter blocked vents; OFF blocks Crewmates as well. Reset blocked vents every meeting : ON clears all vent blocks after each meeting; OFF leaves them in place.

summary.zh-CN: 老兵通过通风口进入戒备状态，期间多数击杀者会被反杀；任务执行者、十字军、保镖和捕快例外，瘟疫、战争者和扫把星会触发特殊处理。
summary.en: The Veteran vents to enter Alert and retaliates against most attackers; Taskinator, Crusader, Bodyguard, and Deputy are exempt, while Pestilence, War, and Jinx use special handling.

search.zh-CN: 老兵 老兵通过通风口进入戒备状态，期间多数击杀者会被反杀；任务执行者、十字军、保镖和捕快例外，瘟疫、战争者和扫把星会触发特殊处理。 职业能力 老兵可以通过通风口进入戒备状态。戒备期间，多数玩家尝试击杀老兵时会被反杀；任务执行者、十字军、保镖和捕快不会触发反击。瘟疫与战争者可以在戒备期间击杀老兵；扫把星会按自身“击杀攻击者”选项处理这次交互，开启时可能击杀老兵。进入和退出戒备时还会看到护盾动画及头顶提示。 设置 数量上限 ：设置一局中老兵的最大人数。 戒备冷却 ：设置再次进入戒备前的等待时间。 戒备持续时间 ：设置每次戒备状态持续多久。 戒备次数上限 ：设置老兵最多可进入戒备状态的次数。 每完成一个任务获得的戒备次数 ：设置每完成一个任务增加的次数，按 0.1 为步进。
search.en: Veteran The Veteran vents to enter Alert and retaliates against most attackers; Taskinator, Crusader, Bodyguard, and Deputy are exempt, while Pestilence, War, and Jinx use special handling. Role The Veteran can vent to enter Alert. Most attackers are killed when they try to kill the Veteran during Alert, but Taskinator, Crusader, Bodyguard, and Deputy do not trigger retaliation. Pestilence and War can kill the Veteran during Alert. Jinx follows its own Kill Attacker option and can kill the Veteran when that option is enabled. Shield animations and an overhead notice remind the Veteran when Alert starts and ends. Settings Maximum count : Sets the maximum number of Veterans in a match. Alert cooldown : Sets how long the Veteran must wait before entering Alert again. Alert duration : Sets how long the Veteran remains on Alert. Maximum alerts : Sets how many times the Veteran can enter Alert. Ability uses gained per task : Sets the alerts gained for each completed task, in 0.1 increments.

summary.zh-CN: 义务警员负责清除威胁，但误杀无辜船员会因内疚转变为叛徒；歹徒不能转换义务警员。
summary.en: The Vigilante eliminates threats but becomes a Madmate after mistakenly killing an innocent Crewmate; Gangster cannot convert the Vigilante.

search.zh-CN: 义务警员 义务警员负责清除威胁，但误杀无辜船员会因内疚转变为叛徒；歹徒不能转换义务警员。 职业能力 义务警员负责消灭船员面临的威胁。如果误杀无辜船员，会因内疚和悔恨变成叛徒。歹徒不能将义务警员转换为叛徒。 设置 数量上限 ：设置一局中义务警员的最大人数。 击杀冷却 ：设置义务警员再次击杀前的等待时间。
search.en: Vigilante The Vigilante eliminates threats but becomes a Madmate after mistakenly killing an innocent Crewmate; Gangster cannot convert the Vigilante. Role The Vigilante is tasked with eliminating threats to the Crew. If they mistakenly kill an innocent Crewmate, they become a Madmate out of guilt and remorse. A Gangster cannot convert the Vigilante into a Madmate. Settings Maximum count : Sets the maximum number of Vigilantes in a match. Kill cooldown : Sets how long the Vigilante must wait before killing again.

summary.zh-CN: 投票时拥有额外票数，可设置额外票是否显示。
summary.en: Has extra votes during meetings, which can be hidden by setting.

search.zh-CN: 卫道士 投票时拥有额外票数，可设置额外票是否显示。 技能 卫道士在会议投票时额外投出若干票，效果类似市长。 选项 数量上限（Max） ：设置本局最多可有多少名卫道士。 额外票数 ：设置卫道士额外获得的票数。 隐藏额外票 ：开启时额外票不显示，但仍计入票数；关闭时额外票正常显示。
search.en: Vindicator Has extra votes during meetings, which can be hidden by setting. Ability The Vindicator casts extra votes during meetings, like a Mayor. Options Max : Maximum number of Vindicators in a match. Additional Votes Count : Number of extra votes the Vindicator receives. Hide Additional Votes : When enabled, extra votes are not shown but still count; otherwise they appear as normal votes.

summary.zh-CN: 击杀后尸体会在设定时间后溶解。
summary.en: Bodies from its kills dissolve after a configured delay.

search.zh-CN: 毒蛇 击杀后尸体会在设定时间后溶解。 技能 毒蛇击杀的尸体会在设定时间后溶解，尸体消失后无法报告。 选项 数量上限（Max） ：设置本局最多可有多少名毒蛇。 尸体溶解时间 ：设置击杀尸体多久后溶解。
search.en: Viper Bodies from its kills dissolve after a configured delay. Ability Bodies killed by the Viper dissolve after the configured delay and can no longer be reported once gone. Options Max : Maximum number of Vipers in a match. Body Dissolve Time : Time before a killed body dissolves.

summary.zh-CN: 给击杀目标的尸体标记病毒；合适的报告者会成为感染者，或在病毒存活并通过投票后于会议结束时死亡。病毒按感染者计入方式参与中立阵营人数结算。
summary.en: Mark victims' bodies with infection; an eligible reporter becomes Contagious or dies after the meeting if the Virus survives the vote. The Virus participates in neutral endgame counting, which infected-player settings affect.

search.zh-CN: 病毒 给击杀目标的尸体标记病毒；合适的报告者会成为感染者，或在病毒存活并通过投票后于会议结束时死亡。病毒按感染者计入方式参与中立阵营人数结算。 病毒 病毒击杀的玩家尸体会被标记（感染次数上限未耗尽时）。报告被标记尸体的合适玩家会变为感染者，或在病毒存活并通过投票后于会议结束时死亡，具体取决于设置。已标记的尸体仍可感染报告者；次数上限是在击杀时检查并在合适玩家报告后扣除。 病毒是独立的中立阵营。内鬼出局后，若船员人数不多于计入胜负的病毒阵营玩家，且没有其他计入胜负的中立阵营，病毒即可获胜。“被感染者计入阵营”设置决定感染者计为病毒、原阵营或不计入胜负人数。 设置 人数上限 ：一局中可出现的病毒数量上限。 击杀冷却 ：再次感染或击杀前的等待时间。 可使用通风口 ：设置病毒能否使用通风口。 内鬼视野 ：开启后拥有内鬼视野；关闭后使用默认视野。 感染次数上限 ：击杀时可用于给尸体标记感染的次数；已标记的尸体仍可感染其报告者。 知道被感染玩家职业 ：开启后，病毒可以看到被感染玩家的职业。 被感染者互相认识 ：开启后，被感染者可以看到彼此。 感染者在会议后死亡 ：开启后，若病毒未被放逐，报告者会在会议结束时死亡；关闭后报告者会成为感染者。 被感染者计入阵营 ：设置感染者计为无阵营、原阵营或病毒阵营，影响感染者是否为病毒胜利人数作贡献。
search.en: Virus Mark victims' bodies with infection; an eligible reporter becomes Contagious or dies after the meeting if the Virus survives the vote. The Virus participates in neutral endgame counting, which infected-player settings affect. Virus The Virus marks the bodies of its victims for infection while it has uses remaining. An eligible player who reports a marked body becomes Contagious or dies after the meeting if the Virus survives the vote, depending on the settings. A body already marked can still infect its reporter; the limit is checked when kills mark bodies and spent when an eligible reporter reports one. The Virus is a separate Neutral team. After the Impostors are gone, it can win when the living Crew count is no greater than the counted Virus team and no other counted Neutral team remains. “Infected players count as” determines whether Contagious players count as Virus, their original team, or no team. Settings Maximum number: Maximum number of Viruses in a match. Kill cooldown: Time before the Virus can contaminate or kill again. Can vent: Whether the Virus can use vents. Impostor vision: When enabled, the Virus has Impostor vision; otherwise, they have default vision. Maximum contaminations: Number of kill attempts that can mark bodies for infection; already marked bodies can still infect their reporters. Know contaminated players' roles: Whether the Virus sees the roles of contaminated players. Contaminated players know each other: Whether contaminated players can see each other. Contaminated player dies after meeting: When enabled, the reporter dies after the meeting if the Virus survives the vote; when disabled, the reporter becomes Contagious. Infected players count as: Choose no team, their original team, or the Virus team; this affects the Virus team's win count.

summary.zh-CN: 会议中可查看存活玩家的阵营：红色代表内鬼，青色代表船员，灰色代表中立。
summary.en: During meetings, sees the alignment of living players: red for Impostors, cyan for Crewmates, and gray for Neutrals.

search.zh-CN: 幻想家 会议中可查看存活玩家的阵营：红色代表内鬼，青色代表船员，灰色代表中立。 技能 会议中可查看存活玩家的阵营标记：红色代表内鬼，青色代表船员，灰色代表中立。 选项 数量上限（Max） ：设置本局最多可有多少名幻想家。
search.en: Visionary During meetings, sees the alignment of living players: red for Impostors, cyan for Crewmates, and gray for Neutrals. Ability During meetings, the Visionary sees alignment markers for living players: red for Impostors, cyan for Crewmates, and gray for Neutrals. Options Max : Maximum number of Visionaries in a match.

summary.zh-CN: 投票计数为零。
summary.en: Its vote has a count of zero.

search.zh-CN: 无效投票 投票计数为零。 效果 持有无效投票的玩家投票计数为 0。 设置 Max（最大数量） ：本局中该附加身份可出现的数量上限。 Spawn Chance（生成概率） ：玩家获得此附加身份的概率。 Eligibility（可分配阵营） ：主持人可分别设置内鬼、船员、中立者是否可以获得此附加身份。
search.en: Void Ballot Its vote has a count of zero. Effect A player with Void Ballot has a vote count of zero. Settings Max : Maximum number that can appear in one match. Spawn Chance : Chance for a player to receive this add-on. Eligibility : Separate settings control whether Impostors, Crewmates, Neutrals can receive this add-on.

summary.zh-CN: 通过报告尸体来吞食并阻止他人再次报告；吞食足够尸体即可获胜。
summary.en: Eat bodies by reporting them so they cannot be reported again; eat enough bodies to win.

search.zh-CN: 秃鹫 通过报告尸体来吞食并阻止他人再次报告；吞食足够尸体即可获胜。 秃鹫 秃鹫通过吞食尸体获胜。报告尸体时，若进食冷却结束且本轮还可进食，秃鹫会吞掉尸体，使其无法再次报告；否则尸体会被正常报告。每次会议后，本轮进食次数和冷却重置。 设置 人数上限 ：一局中可出现的秃鹫数量上限。 显示尸体箭头 ：开启后，秃鹫会看到指向尸体的箭头。 获胜所需尸体数 ：秃鹫必须吞食的尸体数量。 可使用通风口 ：设置秃鹫能否使用通风口。 进食冷却 ：再次吞食尸体前的等待时间。 每轮吞食上限 ：每轮可吞食的尸体数量上限。 内鬼视野 ：设置秃鹫是否拥有内鬼视野。
search.en: Vulture Eat bodies by reporting them so they cannot be reported again; eat enough bodies to win. Vulture The Vulture wins by eating enough bodies. When reporting a body, the Vulture eats it if the eat cooldown has ended and they have not reached the per-round limit; the body then cannot be reported again. Otherwise, the body is reported normally. The eat limit and cooldown reset after each meeting. Settings Maximum number: Maximum number of Vultures in a match. Arrows to dead bodies: Whether the Vulture receives arrows pointing to bodies. Bodies needed to win: Number of bodies the Vulture must eat. Can vent: Whether the Vulture can use vents. Eat cooldown: Time before eating another body. Maximum eaten bodies per round: Per-meeting limit on eaten bodies. Impostor vision: Whether the Vulture has Impostor vision.

summary.zh-CN: 狂战士达到设定等级并开启转变后成为战争者；普通击杀检查会被阻止，但战争者仍可被投票放逐。
summary.en: A Berserker becomes War at the configured level when transformation is enabled; ordinary kill checks are blocked, but War can still be voted out.

search.zh-CN: 战争者 狂战士达到设定等级并开启转变后成为战争者；普通击杀检查会被阻止，但战争者仍可被投票放逐。 战争者 狂战士达到房主设定的等级，且开启转变选项后，会转变为战争者。普通击杀检查会被阻止，但战争者仍可被投票放逐；转变后使用战争者的击杀冷却，并保留此前解锁的能力。战争者属于末日阵营，与其他末日角色共同计入胜负。其转变消息会在之后的会议中向所有玩家显示。 冷却、视野、通风口和能力解锁等级等选项位于狂战士设置中。 设置 转变与等级 ：设置是否允许狂战士转变为战争者，以及转变所需的击杀等级。 战争者击杀冷却 ：转变后使用的击杀冷却时间。 战争者视野 ：设置战争者是否拥有内鬼视野。 战争者可使用通风口 ：设置战争者能否使用通风口。 解锁能力 ：狂战士设置可控制战争者是否获得冷却缩短、食腐者击杀和炸弹能力，以及各能力的解锁等级。
search.en: War A Berserker becomes War at the configured level when transformation is enabled; ordinary kill checks are blocked, but War can still be voted out. War The Berserker transforms into War after reaching the host-configured level when the transformation option is enabled. Ordinary kill checks against War are blocked, but it can still be voted out. After transforming, it uses War's configured kill cooldown and keeps abilities unlocked by the Berserker. War is a Neutral Apocalypse role and counts with the other Apocalypse roles for victory. Its transformation message is shown to everyone at later meetings. The Berserker settings control War's cooldown, vision, vent access, and ability unlock levels. Settings Transformation and level: Whether Berserker can become War and the required kill level. War kill cooldown: Cooldown used after transformation. War vision: Whether War has Impostor vision. War can vent: Whether War can use vents. Unlocked abilities: Berserker settings control whether War gains the cooldown reduction, scavenger kill, and bomber abilities and the level required for each.

summary.zh-CN: 典狱长可以提醒玩家附近有危险，并为目标提供临时速度加成。
summary.en: The Warden can alert a player to nearby danger and give that target a temporary speed boost.

search.zh-CN: 典狱长 典狱长可以提醒玩家附近有危险，并为目标提供临时速度加成。 职业能力 典狱长可以提醒一名玩家附近存在危险，并为该目标提供临时速度加成。 设置 技能冷却 ：设置典狱长再次使用技能前的等待时间。 速度增加值 ：设置典狱长与目标互动时，目标获得的速度加成。 警告次数上限 ：设置典狱长最多可使用技能的次数。
search.en: Warden The Warden can alert a player to nearby danger and give that target a temporary speed boost. Role The Warden can alert someone to nearby danger and give that target a temporary speed boost. Settings Ability cooldown : Sets how long the Warden must wait before using the ability again. Speed increase : Sets the speed boost the target receives when the Warden interacts with them. Maximum alerts : Sets the maximum number of ability uses the Warden has.

summary.zh-CN: 未变形时给玩家下咒；随后变形会令被咒者击杀离自己最近的玩家，变形状态下术士仍可正常击杀。
summary.en: Curses a player while unshifted; shifting makes the cursed player kill the nearest player, while the Warlock can still kill normally when shifted.

search.zh-CN: 术士 未变形时给玩家下咒；随后变形会令被咒者击杀离自己最近的玩家，变形状态下术士仍可正常击杀。 技能 未变形时使用击杀键给目标下咒。之后变形时，被咒者会击杀离自己最近的玩家，不受距离限制；术士在变形状态下仍可正常击杀。会议开始会清除尚未触发的咒语。 选项 数量上限（Max） ：设置本局最多可有多少名术士。 被咒者可以击杀内鬼 ：开启时，被咒者若离内鬼队友最近，也会击杀该队友；关闭时不会。 被咒者可以击杀术士本人 ：开启时，若术士是最近目标，被咒者可以击杀术士；关闭时不会。 变形持续时间 ：设置术士保持变形的时间。
search.en: Warlock Curses a player while unshifted; shifting makes the cursed player kill the nearest player, while the Warlock can still kill normally when shifted. Ability While unshifted, use the kill button to curse a target. When the Warlock shapeshifts afterward, the cursed player kills the nearest player regardless of distance. The Warlock can still make normal kills while shifted. A meeting clears any curse that has not yet triggered. Options Max : Maximum number of Warlocks in a match. Can Kill Impostors : When enabled, the cursed target can kill an Impostor teammate if that teammate is nearest; otherwise the target cannot kill Impostors. Can Kill Themself : When enabled, the cursed target can kill the Warlock if the Warlock is nearest; otherwise the target cannot kill the Warlock. Shapeshift Duration : How long the Warlock remains shifted.

summary.zh-CN: 会议期间可以看到所有人的投票。
summary.en: Can see everyone's votes during meetings.

search.zh-CN: 窥视者 会议期间可以看到所有人的投票。 效果 窥视者在会议期间可以看到所有玩家的投票。 设置 Max（最大数量） ：本局中该附加身份可出现的数量上限。 Spawn Chance（生成概率） ：玩家获得此附加身份的概率。 Eligibility（可分配阵营） ：主持人可分别设置内鬼、船员、中立者是否可以获得此附加身份。
search.en: Watcher Can see everyone's votes during meetings. Effect Watcher can see everyone's votes during meetings. Settings Max : Maximum number that can appear in one match. Spawn Chance : Chance for a player to receive this add-on. Eligibility : Separate settings control whether Impostors, Crewmates, Neutrals can receive this add-on.

summary.zh-CN: 击杀目标时会同时杀死狼人附近的玩家；狼人属于独立中立阵营，按中立阵营人数结算规则获胜。
summary.en: Killing a target also kills nearby players around the Werewolf; it is a separate Neutral team that wins under the counted-neutral endgame rule.

search.zh-CN: 月下狼人 击杀目标时会同时杀死狼人附近的玩家；狼人属于独立中立阵营，按中立阵营人数结算规则获胜。 月下狼人 月下狼人可以像其他带刀角色一样击杀目标，但击杀后，狼人附近的其他玩家也会死亡，死因标记为“撕咬”。作为平衡，月下狼人的击杀冷却较长。月下狼人属于独立的中立阵营；内鬼出局后，若船员人数不多于仍计入胜负的中立玩家，且这些中立玩家都属于同一阵营，月下狼人即可获胜，不必成为最后存活的玩家。 设置 击杀冷却 ：月下狼人的击杀冷却时间。 撕咬范围 ：以月下狼人为中心的波及范围。 可使用通风口 ：设置月下狼人能否使用通风口。 内鬼视野 ：开启后拥有内鬼视野；关闭后不拥有内鬼视野。
search.en: Werewolf Killing a target also kills nearby players around the Werewolf; it is a separate Neutral team that wins under the counted-neutral endgame rule. Werewolf The Werewolf can kill like other killing roles, but other living players near it also die after a successful kill. These nearby deaths use the “Mauled” death reason. The Werewolf has a longer kill cooldown to balance this effect. The Werewolf is a separate Neutral team; after the Impostors are gone, it can win when the living Crew count is no greater than the remaining counted Neutral players and those Neutrals all belong to the same team. It does not have to be the last player alive. Settings Kill cooldown: The Werewolf's kill cooldown. Maul radius: Radius around the Werewolf in which other players are also killed. Can vent: Whether the Werewolf can use vents. Impostor vision: When enabled, the Werewolf has Impostor vision.

summary.zh-CN: 可以变形但不能使用通风口；击杀后会获得短暂无敌保护。
summary.en: Can shapeshift but cannot vent; gains temporary invulnerability after a kill.

search.zh-CN: 野人 可以变形但不能使用通风口；击杀后会获得短暂无敌保护。 技能 野人可以变形但不能进入通风口。每次击杀后会获得一段时间的无敌保护。 选项 击杀后保护时间 ：设置击杀后无敌状态持续多久。 变形冷却 ：设置再次变形前的等待时间。 变形持续时间 ：设置每次变形可持续多久。
search.en: Wildling Can shapeshift but cannot vent; gains temporary invulnerability after a kill. Ability The Wildling can shapeshift but cannot vent. After a kill, it gains invulnerability for a limited time. Options Protection Duration : How long invulnerability lasts after a kill. Shapeshift Cooldown : Time before the Wildling can shapeshift again. Shapeshift Duration : How long a shapeshift can last.

summary.zh-CN: 可直接击杀或施咒；若女巫在会议结束前未被放逐或猜中，被施咒者会在会后死亡。
summary.en: Can kill directly or cast spells; if the Witch survives the meeting, all spelled targets die afterward.

search.zh-CN: 女巫 可直接击杀或施咒；若女巫在会议结束前未被放逐或猜中，被施咒者会在会后死亡。 技能 女巫可以直接击杀，也可以施咒。会议中，被施咒目标的名字旁会出现十字标记。若女巫在会议结束前未被放逐或猜中，所有被施咒目标会在会议结束后死亡。 选项 数量上限（Max） ：设置本局最多可有多少名女巫。 切换方式 ：选择击杀与施咒的操作方式： 击杀键 ：对目标操作时，在普通击杀和施咒之间切换。 通风口 ：使用通风口切换普通击杀和施咒。 双击 ：单击施咒，双击普通击杀。
search.en: Witch Can kill directly or cast spells; if the Witch survives the meeting, all spelled targets die afterward. Ability The Witch can make a direct kill or cast a spell. Spelled targets have a cross beside their names during the meeting. If the Witch is not ejected or guessed before the meeting ends, all spelled targets die afterward. Options Max : Maximum number of Witches in a match. Switch Action Via : Choose how to switch between normal kills and spells: Kill : Interacting with a target alternates between a normal kill and casting a spell. Vent : Interacting with a vent switches between a normal kill and casting a spell. Double-Click : Single-click to cast a spell; double-click to make a normal kill.

summary.zh-CN: 目击者对玩家使用击杀按钮后可判断其是否在设定时间内杀过人。
summary.en: After using the kill button on a player, the Witness learns whether that player killed within a configurable time window.

search.zh-CN: 目击者 目击者对玩家使用击杀按钮后可判断其是否在设定时间内杀过人。 职业能力 目击者对玩家使用击杀按钮后，会得知该玩家是否在最近一段时间内杀过人；时间窗口由设置决定。未击杀的目标显示勾号，近期击杀者显示警告符号。 设置 技能冷却 ：设置目击者再次调查前的等待时间。 击杀者显示红名的最长时间 ：设置目标在击杀发生后的多长时间内仍会被判断为近期杀手。
search.en: Witness After using the kill button on a player, the Witness learns whether that player killed within a configurable time window. Role When the Witness uses the kill button on someone, they learn whether that player killed within the recent time window set by the host. A check mark indicates the target has not killed; a warning mark indicates they have. Settings Ability cooldown : Sets how long the Witness must wait before using the ability again. Maximum time after killing where killer appears red : Sets how long after a kill the player is still identified as a recent killer.

summary.zh-CN: 完成所有任务后单独获胜；房主可允许其死亡后继续做幽灵任务并获胜。
summary.en: Complete all tasks to win alone; the host can allow the Workaholic to finish ghost tasks and win after death.

search.zh-CN: 工作狂 完成所有任务后单独获胜；房主可允许其死亡后继续做幽灵任务并获胜。 工作狂 工作狂完成分配给自己的所有任务后单独获胜；是否比其他玩家有更多任务取决于任务设置。根据房主设置，工作狂可能必须存活才能获胜，也可能在死亡后继续完成幽灵任务并获胜。 设置 人数上限 ：一局中可出现的工作狂数量上限。 死亡后不能获胜 ：开启后，工作狂被击杀或放逐后不能获胜；关闭后，若能继续完成任务，死亡后仍可获胜。 通风冷却 ：工作狂再次使用通风口前的等待时间。 所有人知道工作狂身份 ：开启后，每次会议都会向所有人揭示存活工作狂；关闭后工作狂看起来与普通玩家相同。 首次会议提示 ：开启后，若工作狂存活且允许死亡后获胜、幽灵任务也已开启，工作狂会得到相应提示；关闭后不提供提示。 覆盖任务数 ：开启后，可单独设置工作狂是否有普通任务，以及长、短任务数量；关闭后使用与其他玩家相同的任务数。 猜测模式中可猜职业 ：设置工作狂能否在猜测模式中猜测。
search.en: Workaholic Complete all tasks to win alone; the host can allow the Workaholic to finish ghost tasks and win after death. Workaholic The Workaholic wins alone by completing all assigned tasks; whether they have more tasks than other players depends on the task settings. Depending on host settings, they may need to survive or may continue tasks as a ghost and win after death. Settings Maximum number: Maximum number of Workaholics in a match. Cannot win after death: When enabled, the Workaholic cannot win after being killed or voted out. When disabled, they can still win after death if they continue completing tasks. Vent cooldown: Time before the Workaholic can vent again. Everyone knows the Workaholic: When enabled, the Workaholic is revealed at every meeting; otherwise, they appear as a normal player. Advice at the first meeting: When enabled, an alive Workaholic is told whether they can win after death when ghost tasks are enabled. When disabled, no advice is given. Override tasks: When enabled, configure whether the Workaholic has common tasks and the number of long and short tasks. When disabled, use the same tasks as other players. Can guess in Guesser Mode: Whether the Workaholic can guess roles in Guesser Mode.

summary.zh-CN: 完成全部现有任务的合格玩家会转为加班狂并获得额外任务，人数受上限控制。
summary.en: Eligible players who finish all existing tasks become Workhorse and receive extra tasks, up to a configured limit.

search.zh-CN: 加班狂 完成全部现有任务的合格玩家会转为加班狂并获得额外任务，人数受上限控制。 效果 当玩家完成全部现有任务时，若满足条件且加班狂数量未达到上限，系统会将其转为加班狂并增加任务。默认只允许船员；关闭对应选项后，也可由完成任务且拥有可扩展任务集的其他角色成为加班狂。摆烂人、懒人不能成为目标；告密者是否允许成为加班狂单独设置。 设置 Workhorse enabled（启用 Workhorse） ：控制是否启用加班狂分配；没有百分比生成概率。 Maximum（人数上限） ：单局中最多可成为加班狂的玩家数量。 AssignOnlyToCrewmate（仅分配给 Crewmates） ：控制是否只允许船员成为加班狂。 WorkhorseNumLongTasks（额外长任务） ：成为加班狂时增加的长任务数量。 WorkhorseNumShortTasks（额外短任务） ：成为加班狂时增加的短任务数量。 SnitchCanBeWorkhorse（Snitch 可成为 Workhorse） ：控制告密者能否成为加班狂。
search.en: Workhorse Eligible players who finish all existing tasks become Workhorse and receive extra tasks, up to a configured limit. Effect When a player finishes all existing tasks, they become Workhorse and receive more tasks if eligible and below the configured limit. By default only Crewmates can qualify; if that restriction is disabled, other roles can qualify if they have tasks and do not override their task data. Lazy Guy and Lazy are excluded. Snitch eligibility has its own setting. Settings Workhorse enabled : A zero-or-one selector enables or disables Workhorse assignment; there is no percentage spawn chance. Maximum : Maximum number of players who can become Workhorse in one game. AssignOnlyToCrewmate : Whether only Crewmates can become Workhorse. WorkhorseNumLongTasks : Number of additional long tasks assigned when becoming Workhorse. WorkhorseNumShortTasks : Number of additional short tasks assigned when becoming Workhorse. SnitchCanBeWorkhorse : Whether Snitch can become Workhorse.

summary.zh-CN: 通过通风口暂时隐身；冷却期间能否正常使用通风口由设置决定。
summary.en: Use vents to become temporarily invisible; settings control normal vent use during cooldown.

search.zh-CN: 魅影 通过通风口暂时隐身；冷却期间能否正常使用通风口由设置决定。 魅影 魅影可以通过通风口暂时隐身。再次使用通风口会解除隐身；隐身时击杀玩家仍会正常击杀。隐身冷却期间是否可正常使用通风口由设置决定。魅影属于独立的中立阵营；内鬼出局后，若船员人数不多于仍计入胜负的中立玩家，且这些中立玩家都属于同一阵营，魅影即可获胜，不必成为最后存活的玩家。 设置 隐身冷却 ：再次隐身前的等待时间。 隐身持续时间 ：每次隐身持续的时间。 隐身冷却期间可正常使用通风口 ：开启后，隐身能力冷却时可正常使用通风口；关闭后无法进入。 内鬼视野 ：设置魅影是否拥有内鬼视野。
search.en: Wraith Use vents to become temporarily invisible; settings control normal vent use during cooldown. Wraith The Wraith uses vents to become temporarily invisible. Using a vent again ends invisibility. The Wraith can still kill while invisible. Whether they can use vents normally while invisibility is on cooldown depends on a setting. The Wraith is a separate Neutral team; after the Impostors are gone, it can win when the living Crew count is no greater than the remaining counted Neutral players and those Neutrals all belong to the same team. The Wraith does not have to be the last player alive. Settings Vanish cooldown: Time before becoming invisible again. Vanish duration: How long each vanish lasts. Vent normally while invisibility is on cooldown: When enabled, normal vent use is allowed during the invisibility cooldown; otherwise, vent entry is blocked. Impostor vision: Whether the Wraith has Impostor vision.

summary.zh-CN: 先后选择一名阴与一名阳；两人相遇时会互相杀死，选完后可普通击杀。
summary.en: Selects a Yin and a Yang; they kill each other when they meet, and the YinYanger can kill normally after both are chosen.

search.zh-CN: 阴阳命煞人 先后选择一名阴与一名阳；两人相遇时会互相杀死，选完后可普通击杀。 技能 使用击杀键选择一名玩家作为阴，再选择另一名玩家作为阳。两人相遇时会互相击杀。阴阳都选定后，阴阳命煞人可以正常击杀；会议开始会清除已选的阴阳目标。 选项 数量上限（Max） ：设置本局最多可有多少名阴阳命煞人。 击杀冷却 ：设置两次选择或击杀之间的冷却时间。
search.en: YinYanger Selects a Yin and a Yang; they kill each other when they meet, and the YinYanger can kill normally after both are chosen. Ability Use the kill button once to choose a player as Yin and a second time to choose a player as Yang. When the two meet, they kill each other. Once both are selected, the YinYanger can make normal kills; a meeting clears the selected Yin and Yang. Options Max : Maximum number of YinYangers in a match. Kill Cooldown : Time before the YinYanger can select or kill again.

summary.zh-CN: 仅船员可获得；若是游戏中首名被直接击杀的玩家则立刻以 UP主胜利，凶手是否一同获胜可设置。
summary.en: Only Crewmates can receive it; the first direct murder victim wins as YouTuber, and the killer can optionally win too.

search.zh-CN: UP主 仅船员可获得；若是游戏中首名被直接击杀的玩家则立刻以 UP主胜利，凶手是否一同获胜可设置。 效果 UP主只分配给船员。若 UP主是游戏中首名被直接击杀的玩家，会立即触发 UP主胜利；被杀戮机器击杀时不触发。主持人可设置凶手是否也加入 UP主胜利。 设置 Max（最大数量） ：本局中该附加身份可出现的数量上限。 Spawn Chance（生成概率） ：玩家获得此附加身份的概率。 Youtuber_KillerWinsWithYouTuber（凶手与 YouTuber 一同获胜） ：控制击杀 UP主的玩家是否也一同获胜。
search.en: YouTuber Only Crewmates can receive it; the first direct murder victim wins as YouTuber, and the killer can optionally win too. Effect YouTuber is assigned only to Crewmates. If YouTuber is the first player directly murdered in the game, a YouTuber win is triggered immediately; a kill by KillingMachine does not trigger it. The host can choose whether the killer also wins with YouTuber. Settings Max : Maximum number that can appear in one match. Spawn Chance : Chance for a player to receive this add-on. Youtuber_KillerWinsWithYouTuber : Whether the player who kills the YouTuber also wins with them.

summary.zh-CN: 击杀冷却短、移动缓慢且视野极小；只有独裁者能投出僵尸，击杀冷却更新时速度会继续降低。
summary.en: Has a short kill cooldown, slow movement, and low vision; only Dictator can vote it out, and speed drops further when kill cooldown resets.

search.zh-CN: 僵尸 击杀冷却短、移动缓慢且视野极小；只有独裁者能投出僵尸，击杀冷却更新时速度会继续降低。 技能 僵尸的击杀冷却很短，但移动速度和视野都很低。只有独裁者能将僵尸投出。每次击杀冷却更新（包括击杀后）都会按设置进一步降低移动速度。 选项 数量上限（Max） ：设置本局最多可有多少名僵尸。 击杀冷却 ：设置击杀冷却。 移动速度降低量 ：设置每次击杀冷却更新时减少的移动速度。
search.en: Zombie Has a short kill cooldown, slow movement, and low vision; only Dictator can vote it out, and speed drops further when kill cooldown resets. Ability The Zombie has a short kill cooldown, but moves very slowly and has very low vision. Only the Dictator can vote it out. Each time its kill cooldown is set, including after a kill, its speed is reduced by the configured amount. Options Max : Maximum number of Zombies in a match. Kill Cooldown : Time before the Zombie can kill again. Zombie Speed Reduction : Amount removed from movement speed whenever the kill cooldown is set.

summary.zh-CN: 使用一个 Cloud 账号管理游戏账号、免费玩家标签与房间分享。
summary.en: Manage game accounts, free player tags and room sharing with one Cloud account.

documents.source: TOHEE Cloud product guidance; maintainer-authored and reviewed 2026-11-13

search.zh-CN: 云功能入门 使用一个 Cloud 账号管理游戏账号、免费玩家标签与房间分享。 Cloud 能做什么 TOHEE Cloud 是模组的配套玩家服务。一个 Cloud 账号可以绑定多个 Among Us 账号，每个游戏账号分别设置玩家标签和房间分享。阅读模组文档不需要登录。 功能 用途 从哪里开始 游戏账号 验证并管理你拥有的 Among Us 账号 绑定指南 免费玩家标签 配置游戏中显示的文字和颜色 标签指南 分享房间 让符合资格的用户找到你的房间 分享指南 查找房间 筛选房间并复制房间码 匹配指南 第一次使用 完整的 Cloud policy（信息收集协议）未包含在模组内；注册或登录 Cloud 时，在网页阅读并同意后继续。模组面板的提示不替代协议。面板使用方法见 模组内 Cloud 界面 。 在 注册页面 使用邮箱注册，或在 登录页面 使用 Discord 登录。先阅读并接受信息收集协议。 邮箱注册需要接收一次性验证码，并设置至少 10 位的密码。验证码只能使用一次，10 分钟后过期。 如果 Discord 首次登录后提示设置 Cloud 密码，先到“账号设置”完成设置；若管理员重置了密码，则先更改临时密码。 在“绑定 Among Us 账号”中选择从模组绑定或好友请求验证。 绑定完成后，到“玩家标签”设置文字和颜色；需要分享房间时，再分别开启网站和模组的分享开关。 Cloud 账号与游戏账号 Cloud 登录与 Among Us 登录是两件事。登录 Cloud 不会自动证明你拥有某个游戏账号；绑定时还需要在模组或游戏中完成验证。你无需把 Among Us 密码填写到 Cloud。 邮箱、Discord 是 Cloud 的登录方式，绑定的 Among Us 账号是被管理的游戏身份。解绑某个游戏账号不会解除 Cloud 的邮箱或 Discord 登录方式。 遇到问题 安全验证、邮件、Discord 登录或好友验证不可用时，按页面提示稍后重试。服务暂时不可用与账号验证未通过是不同情况，不能靠反复提交解决所有问题。详见 Cloud 常见问题 。
search.en: Getting started with Cloud Manage game accounts, free player tags and room sharing with one Cloud account. What Cloud offers TOHEE Cloud is the mod's companion player service. Link several Among Us accounts to one Cloud account and manage each account's tag and room-sharing preference separately. Reading mod documentation does not require signing in. Feature Purpose Start here Game accounts Verify and manage Among Us accounts you own Linking guide Free player tags Set the text and colour displayed in game Tag guide Room sharing Help eligible users discover your room Sharing guide Find a room Filter rooms and copy a room code Matchmaking guide First-time setup The full Cloud policy is not included in the mod. Read and accept it on the website when registering or signing in to Cloud; the mod panel's notice does not replace the agreement. See the in-mod Cloud interface for panel instructions. Register with email , or use Discord on the sign-in page . Read and accept the information collection policy first. Email registration requires a one-time code and a password of at least 10 characters. The code can be used once and expires after 10 minutes. If your first Discord sign-in asks you to set a Cloud password, complete that step in Account settings. If an administrator reset your password, change the temporary password first. Under Link an Among Us account, choose linking from the mod or friend request verification. After linking, set your text and colour under Player tags. To share a room, enable sharing on both the website and the mod. Cloud accounts and game accounts Cloud sign-in and Among Us sign-in are separate. Signing in to Cloud does not automatically prove ownership of a game account; linking requires verification in the mod or game. You do not need to enter your Among Us password into Cloud. Email and Discord are Cloud sign-in methods. Linked Among Us accounts are the game identities you manage. Unlinking a game account does not unlink your Cloud email or Discord sign-in method. When something goes wrong If security checks, email, Discord sign-in or friend verification are unavailable, follow the page's guidance and try again later. A temporarily unavailable service is different from rejected account verification; repeated submissions cannot solve every problem. See Cloud troubleshooting .

summary.zh-CN: 了解 TOHEE 的房主专属玩法，并从安装、开房和设置开始。
summary.en: Learn how TOHEE's host-only gameplay works and get started with installation, hosting, and settings.

search.zh-CN: TOHEE 入门 了解 TOHEE 的房主专属玩法，并从安装、开房和设置开始。 TOHEE 是什么？ Town of Host: Enhanced-Enhanced（TOHEE）是 Among Us 的房主专属模组。房主在 Windows 电脑上运行模组并控制房间规则；其他玩家通常可以使用未修改的游戏客户端加入。TOHEE 提供角色、阵营、游戏模式和房间选项，具体内容以当前发行版为准。 TOHEE 基于 Town of Host: Enhanced 上游项目发展。上游网站的旧教程可能使用不同的安装包、设置文件和操作步骤；本文档已按当前 TOHEE 行为整理。安装请从 TOHEE GitHub Releases 获取与游戏平台和架构匹配的发行包。 从这里开始 安装模组 ，再查看 更新说明 。 设置房间 ，了解游戏、系统和模组设置。 游戏模式 介绍当前标准模式（Standard）、自由混战（FFA）与 TOHE 躲猫猫模式，以及上游历史模式。 命令与快捷键 、 预设 和 聊天模板 可帮助你管理房间。 若要使用 Cloud 账号、绑定游戏账号或设置 Cloud 玩家标签，请看 TOHEE Cloud 指南 。 在客户端调整内置技能音效，详见 自定义音效管理界面 ；模组内的 Cloud 按钮详见 Cloud 界面使用方法 。 只有房主需要安装模组。加入房间的玩家仍须使用与房主兼容的 Among Us 游戏版本；手机、平板和主机玩家不能安装此 Windows 模组，但可按游戏支持情况加入房间。 文档范围 部分内容参考了旧版 TOHE 上游指南。遇到旧的下载链接、Discord 标签、 TOHE-DATA 路径或旧版预设步骤时，请以当前发行包、TOHEE 菜单和本指南的更新说明为准。旧上游指南曾介绍 Speedrun；当前 TOHEE 游戏模式列表不同，详见 游戏模式 。
search.en: Welcome to TOHEE Learn how TOHEE's host-only gameplay works and get started with installation, hosting, and settings. What is TOHEE? Town of Host: Enhanced-Enhanced (TOHEE) is a host-only Among Us mod. The host runs the mod on a Windows PC and controls the room rules; other players can usually join with unmodified game clients. TOHEE adds roles, factions, game modes, and room options. The current release determines what is available. TOHEE builds on the upstream Town of Host: Enhanced project. Older upstream pages may describe different packages, settings files, and procedures; this documentation has been updated for current TOHEE behavior. Get the release that matches your game platform and architecture from TOHEE GitHub Releases . Start here Install the mod , then read how to update it . Set up a room with the game, system, and mod settings. Game modes covers current Standard, FFA, and TOHE Hide & Seek, plus a historical upstream mode. Use commands and hotkeys , presets , and chat templates to manage your room. For Cloud accounts, linked game accounts, or Cloud player tags, see the TOHEE Cloud guide . Adjust built-in ability effects in the Custom Sound Manager , and learn the mod's Cloud buttons in the in-mod Cloud interface guide . Only the host needs to install the mod. Joining players still need an Among Us game version compatible with the host; mobile, tablet, and console players cannot install this Windows mod, but may join a room where the game supports it. Scope and freshness Some material is based on older upstream TOHE guides. When you encounter old download links, Discord tags, TOHE-DATA paths, or legacy preset steps, follow the current release package, TOHEE menus, and this guide instead. Older upstream pages described Speedrun; the current TOHEE game-mode list is different. See game modes .

summary.zh-CN: 认识客户端 TOHEE Cloud 面板的按钮、状态、分享控制与网页协议流程。
summary.en: Use the TOHEE Cloud panel's buttons, status messages, sharing controls and website policy flow.
