search.zh-CN: 模组内 Cloud 界面 认识客户端 TOHEE Cloud 面板的按钮、状态、分享控制与网页协议流程。 从哪里打开 在模组客户端选项中选择“ TOHEE Cloud… ”，或点击主菜单的 Cloud 入口。主菜单入口会等待游戏登录流程完成后显示；入口显示不代表账号已经绑定，仍需查看面板的账户状态。 面板顶部显示当前房间的分享状态，并提示房间码的可见范围；下方显示游戏账号的绑定或资格状态，以及最近一次操作结果。关闭面板可点击返回或按 Esc 。 注册与 policy 完整的 Cloud policy（信息收集协议）未包含在模组内。 模组面板中的房间码分享提示不替代网页协议。注册或登录到 Cloud 时，在网页打开的 信息收集协议 中阅读完整内容，并同意后继续。 首次注册时，通过模组“绑定账号”打开网页，先完成 Cloud 注册及协议同意流程，再完成游戏账号绑定。注册/登录页面在当前浏览器尚未记录同意时会先跳转到协议页。模组内不重复要求点击同意；打开 Cloud 面板也不会替你完成网页的同意操作。 按钮说明 按钮 实际作用 绑定账号 为当前游戏账号发起绑定并打开浏览器，按网页步骤完成验证。已绑定或正在请求时可能不可用。 刷新账户状态 重新检查当前游戏账号的绑定及分享资格。网页改了账号设置后可使用。 前往网站管理 在浏览器打开“游戏账号”，管理标签、分享开关和解绑。 开启分享 / 关闭分享 切换当前客户端的分享总开关。开启仍需要网站端允许分享，并满足账户资格。 分享当前房间 / 停止分享房间 对当前在线房间执行操作，需要房主身份。当前私人房间的分享确认也通过这里完成。 使用云标签 允许此客户端使用缓存的云端玩家标签；与分享房间独立。 刷新云标签 从 Cloud 重新获取标签。先开启“使用云标签”。 使用系统代理 为模组发往 Cloud 的 HTTP 请求选择系统代理或直接连接，默认开启。 “使用系统代理”只控制模组的 Cloud 网络请求，不会为浏览器、Among Us 游戏服务器或其他应用设置代理。根据自己的网络环境选择；相关请求进行中时暂时不能更改。 分享总开关与当前房间 “开启分享”是客户端偏好，“分享当前房间”是对这一个房间的操作。网站上的游戏账号分享开关也需要开启。私人房间需要明确确认当前房间，不能因为以前分享过另一个私人房间就认为新房间已经展示。 停止当前房间分享会保留本地分享总开关；关闭分享总开关则同时请求撤下房间。状态显示“正在停止分享”或“等待停止或过期”时，不能认为已立即撤下。等到显示已撤下或未分享，再按需要核对网页列表。详见 分享你的房间 。 按钮变灰或操作失败 面板会在账户、标签或房间请求进行中暂时禁用部分按钮。未完成游戏在线登录、尚未绑定、账户不具备资格、非房主、没有当前在线房间等，也会限制对应操作。 先读账户与房间状态，以及最近一次操作提示，再尝试刷新账户状态。网页 Cloud 登录、游戏账号登录、游戏账号绑定是不同步骤。具体排查见 Cloud 常见问题 。
search.en: The in-mod Cloud interface Use the TOHEE Cloud panel's buttons, status messages, sharing controls and website policy flow. Open the panel Choose TOHEE Cloud… in the mod's client options, or use the Cloud entry on the main menu. The main-menu entry waits for the game's login flow to finish. Its presence does not establish that the account is linked; check the panel's account status. The panel shows room-sharing status and room-code visibility guidance at the top, followed by account linking or eligibility status and the latest operation result. Close it with Back or Esc . Registration and policy The full Cloud policy is not included in the mod. The room-code sharing notice in the panel does not replace the website agreement. When registering or signing in to Cloud, read the full information collection policy on the website and agree before continuing. For first-time registration, use Link account in the mod to open the website, complete Cloud registration and policy consent, then finish linking the game account. Registration and sign-in redirect to the policy page if this browser has not recorded consent. The mod does not repeat that agreement step, and opening its Cloud panel does not accept the website policy for you. Buttons Button What it does Link account Start linking the current game account and open the browser for verification. It may be unavailable when already linked or a request is running. Refresh account status Recheck the current account's linking status and sharing eligibility; useful after changing website settings. Manage on website Open Game accounts in the browser to manage tags, sharing preferences and unlinking. Enable / Disable sharing Toggle sharing for this client. Website permission and account eligibility are still required. Share / Stop sharing current room Act on the current online room as its host. This also provides confirmation for sharing a private room. Use cloud tags Allow this client to apply cached cloud player tags, independently of room sharing. Refresh cloud tags Fetch tags again from Cloud. Enable Use cloud tags first. Use system proxy Select the system proxy or a direct connection for mod-to-Cloud HTTP requests; enabled by default. Use system proxy affects only the mod's Cloud HTTP requests. It does not configure the browser, Among Us game-server connection or other applications. Choose according to your network. It cannot be changed while related requests are running. Sharing preference and the current room Enable sharing is a client preference; Share current room acts on this particular room. Account sharing must also be enabled on the website. A private room needs explicit confirmation for that room; confirmation for an earlier private room does not publish every new private room. Stopping the current room keeps the local sharing preference. Disabling the sharing preference also requests removal. Stopping or Waiting for stop or expiry does not mean removal is complete. Wait for a removed/not-shared result and check the website list as needed. See Share your room . Disabled buttons or failed actions Account, tag or room requests temporarily disable some buttons. Incomplete online game sign-in, an unlinked or ineligible account, non-host status or no current online room also restrict the relevant actions. Read account status, room status and the latest operation message before refreshing account status. Cloud website sign-in, game sign-in and game-account linking are separate steps. See Cloud troubleshooting .

summary.zh-CN: 从模组或好友请求验证所有权，并了解解绑后的限制。
summary.en: Verify ownership through the mod or a friend request, and understand unlinking restrictions.

documents.source: TOHEE Cloud product guidance; maintainer-authored and reviewed 2026-11-13

search.zh-CN: 绑定与管理游戏账号 从模组或好友请求验证所有权，并了解解绑后的限制。 绑定前准备 先登录 Cloud 并按提示设置或更改 Cloud 密码。Among Us 账号需要有效好友代码，以及 Steam、Epic 等受支持的正式账号来源。仅使用 Device ID 的游客账号暂不支持。不同正式账号来源的支持情况以验证页面结果为准。 方法一：从 TOHEE 模组绑定 在 Among Us 中完成账号登录，然后打开 TOHEE 的 Cloud 菜单。 选择绑定账号，或使用 /cloud bind ，通过模组打开浏览器中的绑定页面。 在浏览器登录自己的 Cloud 账号，完成页面上的安全验证。 等待显示绑定成功，再进入“游戏账号”核对好友代码。 网页提示没有待处理链接时，请回到模组重新发起。链接无效或已过期时也需要重新发起；不要手工拼接链接。不要把带有绑定信息的链接转发给其他人。 方法二：好友请求验证 打开 好友请求验证 ，填写 你自己的 Among Us 好友代码。 完成安全验证，点击创建好友请求验证。 页面会给出一个 验证账号 的好友代码。在 Among Us 中，用待绑定账号向它发送好友请求。 保持页面打开，等待自动查询。必要时点击“立即查询状态”。 显示“游戏账号已绑定”后，到“游戏账号”确认结果。 注意区分输入的自己的好友代码与页面返回的验证账号好友代码。“正在检查资格”“正在完成绑定”是中间状态；只有完成状态才表示已经绑定。过期、取消或未通过后，可以检查原因并开始新的验证。 管理与解绑 在 游戏账号 中，每张卡片对应一个游戏账号，可以编辑标签、开关该账号的房间分享，以及解除绑定。 解绑需要当前 Cloud 密码和安全验证。解绑会删除该游戏账号的标签和配置，并撤下分享房间；标签修改日志会保留，Cloud 的邮箱和 Discord 登录方式不受影响。 解绑后前 1 小时不能重新绑定；1 小时后执行解绑的原 Cloud 用户可以重新绑定；24 小时后其他 Cloud 用户才可以尝试绑定。请确认解绑的账号和后果后再操作。
search.en: Link and manage game accounts Verify ownership through the mod or a friend request, and understand unlinking restrictions. Before you link Sign in to Cloud and set or change your Cloud password when prompted. The Among Us account needs a valid friend code and a supported full-account provider, such as Steam or Epic. Device ID-only guest accounts are currently unsupported. The verification result determines whether a particular provider is supported. Option 1: Link from the TOHEE mod Finish signing in to Among Us, then open the TOHEE Cloud menu. Choose account linking, or use /cloud bind , to open the binding page in your browser. Sign in to your own Cloud account and complete the security check. Wait for successful linking, then check the friend code under Game accounts. If the website says no link is pending, start again from the mod. Invalid or expired links also require a new flow; do not construct links manually. Do not forward a link containing binding information to another person. Option 2: Friend request verification Open Friend request verification and enter your own Among Us friend code. Complete the security check and start verification. The page supplies a verification account's friend code. In Among Us, send that account a friend request using the account you want to link. Keep the page open for automatic checks. Use Check status now when necessary. Once the page confirms that the game account is linked, review it under Game accounts. Do not confuse your own friend code with the verification account's code. Checking eligibility and Linking account are intermediate states; only Completed confirms linking. After expiry, cancellation or rejection, review the reason and start a new verification if appropriate. Manage and unlink Each card under Game accounts represents one game account. You can edit its tag, toggle sharing for that account or unlink it. Unlinking requires your current Cloud password and a security check. It deletes that game account's tag and configuration and removes its shared room. Tag edit logs are retained. Your Cloud email and Discord sign-in methods remain linked. The account cannot be linked for the first hour after unlinking. After one hour, the Cloud user who unlinked it can relink it. Other Cloud users can attempt linking after 24 hours. Check the account and consequences before confirming.

summary.zh-CN: 下载正确的发行包，并将模组文件安装到 Among Us 游戏目录。
summary.en: Download the correct release package and install its files beside Among Us.

search.zh-CN: 安装 TOHEE 下载正确的发行包，并将模组文件安装到 Among Us 游戏目录。 准备工作 需要 Windows 电脑、已安装的正版 Among Us，以及对应商店版本的游戏目录。TOHEE 是房主专属模组：房主需在电脑上安装，其他玩家不需要安装。 从 TOHEE GitHub Releases 下载最新发行包。不要下载源码 ZIP；源码包不是可直接运行的模组。 关闭 Among Us 后再安装或更新。若游戏目录已经装有其他模组或加载器，建议先准备一份干净的游戏副本，避免混用插件和 BepInEx 文件。 选择发行包架构 当前发行说明规定：Steam、Epic Games 和 Microsoft Store / Xbox App 版本使用 x64 包；Windows itch.io 版本使用 x86 包。itch.io 购买通常会提供 Steam Key；若你实际从 Steam 启动，请按 Steam 版本选择 x64 包。每次下载前都应查看该版本的发行说明，以确认架构与游戏版本要求。 安装步骤 在 Steam、Epic Games、Xbox App 或 itch.io 客户端中找到 Among Us 的安装目录。目录内应有 Among Us.exe 。 关闭游戏，将发行压缩包中的 全部文件 解压到 Among Us.exe 所在目录。确认 BepInEx 等文件夹与游戏可执行文件处于同一层级；不要只复制 TOHE.dll 来首次安装。 按下方商店差异选择启动方式，并等待首次加载完成。BepInEx 首次启动会为这份游戏安装生成 interop 文件，可能需要联网下载组件，首次启动会比平常更久。 某些加载器或插件版本在首次初始化时可能需要重新启动；按你下载的发行包说明操作。 检查主菜单或模组版本提示，确认 TOHEE 已加载；然后按 房间设置指南 创建房间。 发行包包含模组和加载器，不包含 Among Us 本体。不要把其他商店安装生成的 interop 目录复制到此目录；不同游戏安装应各自生成自己的文件。 商店差异 Steam： 将文件放入 Steam 库中 Among Us 的游戏目录。可以从 Steam 启动，也可以直接运行该目录中的 Among Us.exe ；登录时需要保持已登录的 Steam 客户端在后台运行。包内的 steam_appid.txt 供 Steam 使用。 Epic Games： 使用 Epic 安装目录，并通过 Epic Games Launcher 启动游戏才能登录；直接运行 Among Us.exe 无法完成登录。 Xbox App / Microsoft Store： 使用游戏目录中的 Among Us.exe 所在位置，选择 x64 发行包。此说明针对 Windows PC 游戏版本，不适用于 Xbox 主机。 itch.io： 仅 Windows itch.io 客户端使用 x86 包。若 itch.io 提供的是 Steam Key 并通过 Steam 安装游戏，则改用 Steam 的 x64 包。 手机、平板和游戏主机不能安装这个 Windows 模组，但可以在版本兼容时加入由 TOHEE 房主创建的房间。旧版上游页面中提到的第三方 Mod Manager 安装步骤不属于当前推荐安装流程；请以 GitHub Releases 中的当前发行包及发行说明为准。 如果模组没有加载，请先核对游戏目录、架构和首次启动日志，再看 故障排查 。
search.en: Install TOHEE Download the correct release package and install its files beside Among Us. Before you start You need a Windows PC, a legitimate installation of Among Us, and the game directory for the store version you use. TOHEE is host-only: the host installs it on a PC; other players do not need to install the mod. Download the latest release package from TOHEE GitHub Releases . Do not download the source ZIP; it is not a runnable mod package. Close Among Us before installing or updating. If the game directory already contains another mod or loader, prepare a clean game copy to avoid mixing plugins and BepInEx files. Choose the package architecture The current release instructions specify x64 packages for Steam, Epic Games, and Microsoft Store / Xbox App. The Windows itch.io client uses x86. An itch.io purchase may provide a Steam key; if you actually install and launch the Steam version, choose the x64 Steam package. Check each release's notes for its game-version and architecture requirements. Install Find Among Us in Steam, Epic Games, Xbox App, or itch.io and open its installation directory. It should contain Among Us.exe . Close the game and extract all files from the release archive into the directory containing Among Us.exe . Keep folders such as BepInEx beside the game executable; do not install for the first time by copying only TOHE.dll . Launch the game using the method described in the store-specific notes below, then wait for the first load to finish. BepInEx generates interop files for this particular game installation on first launch and may need an internet connection to download components. Some loader or plugin versions may require a restart during first initialization; follow the instructions for the release package you downloaded. Check the main menu or mod version notice to confirm TOHEE loaded, then follow the room setup guide . The release package contains the mod and loader, not the Among Us game. Do not copy an interop directory generated by another store installation; each game installation must generate its own files. Store-specific notes Steam: Put the files in Among Us's Steam library directory. You can launch through Steam or run Among Us.exe directly, but the signed-in Steam client must remain running in the background for game sign-in. The package includes steam_appid.txt for Steam. Epic Games: Use the Epic installation directory and launch the game through Epic Games Launcher to sign in. Running Among Us.exe directly does not complete sign-in. Xbox App / Microsoft Store: Use the directory containing that PC game's Among Us.exe and choose the x64 release package. This applies to the Windows PC game, not an Xbox console. itch.io: Use the x86 package only for the Windows itch.io client. If itch.io supplied a Steam key and you installed through Steam, use the Steam x64 package instead. Phones, tablets, and consoles cannot install this Windows mod, but may join a TOHE-hosted room when the game versions are compatible. Third-party Mod Manager installation steps on old upstream pages are not the current recommended installation flow; follow the current GitHub release package and its notes. If the mod does not load, first check the game directory, architecture, and first-launch log, then see troubleshooting .

summary.zh-CN: 为绑定的账号设置纯文本标签与颜色，并在模组中刷新显示。
summary.en: Choose plain tag text and a colour for a linked account, then refresh it in the mod.

documents.source: TOHEE Cloud product guidance; maintainer-authored and reviewed 2026-11-13

search.zh-CN: 免费玩家标签 为绑定的账号设置纯文本标签与颜色，并在模组中刷新显示。 设置标签 先完成 游戏账号绑定 。 打开 玩家标签 ，选择需要编辑的好友代码。 输入标签文字，并使用选色器或 #RRGGBB 设置颜色。 查看本地预览，完成安全验证后保存。 自助标签免费使用。默认限制为 1–12 个 Unicode 码点，支持字母（包括汉字）、数字、组合字符和普通空格，不能只有空格。组合字符可能占用多个码点；以编辑器显示的计数和当前长度限制为准。自助标签不支持富文本标签、换行或特殊符号，不能用颜色代码代替文字。 修改冷却 首次保存后，每次自助修改之间需要间隔 1 小时。编辑器显示上次修改时间、下次可修改时间和剩余冷却。文字和颜色共用此次修改，不是各有一次独立机会；保存前请一起核对。 已经设置标签时，可以在编辑器中完成安全验证后清空文字和颜色。清空同样受 1 小时冷却限制，也会开始下一次冷却；管理员设置的其他字段不会被清除。 管理员停用该账号的 Cloud 标签配置、关闭本人编辑，或账号被冻结或封禁时，可能无法自行保存。按页面显示的原因处理；反复刷新不会解除限制。 在游戏中显示 在 TOHEE 的 Cloud 菜单启用“使用云端标签”，必要时点击刷新云标签，或使用 /cloud tags refresh 。标签使用与房间分享相互独立，不需要为了显示标签而公开房间码。 网页预览用于检查文字与颜色，实际位置和效果以游戏为准。房主的标签加载设置与缓存也会影响显示；网页保存成功不等于每个房间已经立即刷新。 管理字段与本地标签 编辑器中的游戏管理字段是只读信息，普通玩家无法通过自助标签修改开发者、管理员等权限。标签文字本身不会授予管理权限。 Cloud 标签与房主本地维护的 tags.txt 是不同来源。 /tags reload 重载本地标签； /cloud tags refresh 刷新云端标签。检查来源时不要混用这两个命令。
search.en: Free player tags Choose plain tag text and a colour for a linked account, then refresh it in the mod. Set a tag Link your game account first. Open Player tags and select the friend code you want to edit. Enter tag text and choose a colour with the picker or a #RRGGBB value. Review the local preview, complete the security check and save. Self-service tags are free. The default limit is 1–12 Unicode code points, accepting letters (including Chinese characters), numbers, combining marks and ordinary spaces. A tag cannot contain only spaces. A combining sequence may use multiple code points; use the count and current limit displayed in the editor. Self-service tags do not support rich-text tags, line breaks or special symbols; colour codes are not a substitute for text. Edit cooldown After your first save, allow one hour between self-service edits. The editor shows your last edit, next available edit and remaining cooldown. Text and colour share the same edit; they are not separate edit allowances. Review both before saving. Once a tag is set, you can complete the security check and clear its text and colour in the editor. Clearing follows the same one-hour cooldown and starts a new cooldown; other fields set by an administrator are preserved. You may be unable to save if an administrator disabled the account's Cloud tag profile or owner editing, or the account is frozen or banned. Follow the displayed reason; refreshing repeatedly does not remove a restriction. Display in game Enable Use cloud tags in the TOHEE Cloud menu. Refresh cloud tags there when needed, or use /cloud tags refresh . Tag display is independent of room sharing: you do not need to publish your room code to use a tag. The website preview helps check text and colour; the game determines the actual placement and appearance. The host's tag-loading settings and cache also affect display. Saving successfully does not mean every room has refreshed immediately. Management fields and local tags Game management fields in the editor are read-only information. Self-service tags cannot change developer, administrator or similar permissions. Tag text itself grants no management permission. Cloud tags and the host's local tags.txt are separate sources. /tags reload reloads local tags; /cloud tags refresh refreshes cloud tags. Use the command for the source you are checking.

summary.zh-CN: 安全替换发行文件，并保留本地设置和模板。
summary.en: Replace release files safely while keeping local settings and templates.

search.zh-CN: 更新 TOHEE 安全替换发行文件，并保留本地设置和模板。 更新前 先关闭 Among Us 和启动器中正在运行的游戏进程。备份游戏目录里的 TOHEE-DATA 文件夹；它保存预设、模板和本地标签。不要把旧版模组 DLL 与新版本加载器或其他商店的 interop 文件混在一起。 安装新版本 打开 TOHEE GitHub Releases ，查看最新版本的发行说明和支持的 Among Us 版本。 下载与当前商店及架构相符的发行包。Steam、Epic Games、Microsoft Store / Xbox App 通常使用 x64；Windows itch.io 客户端使用 x86。若游戏本体升级了，优先使用该游戏版本对应的完整发行包。 在游戏关闭时将发行包中的文件解压到 Among Us.exe 所在目录，并按提示覆盖模组文件。保留 TOHEE-DATA ，不要用旧备份整个覆盖新安装目录。 从较早的整合包升级时，请查看随当前发行包提供的说明，确认是否还需替换 patcher 或其他加载器文件。若首次初始化要求重启，按发行说明重新启动游戏。 启动游戏并确认主菜单显示当前 TOHEE 版本。若加载失败，检查 BepInEx/LogOutput.log 并查看 故障排查 。 对于相同 Among Us 版本、相同架构和相同 BepInEx 6 be.755 环境的常规小版本更新，发行包说明允许只替换 BepInEx/plugins/TOHE.dll 。若发行说明要求更新加载器或 patcher，或你不确定当前环境，则使用完整发行包更新。 设置文件 TOHEE 当前把游戏选项保存为 TOHEE-DATA/SaveData/GlobalOptions.jsonc 和 Preset1.jsonc 至 Preset8.jsonc 。这些本地文件和 TOHEE-DATA/Presets/ 中用于分享的 JSON 文件用途不同。更新后不要把旧版网站下载流程中的 Options.json 当成当前预设格式；旧 Options.json 只在程序迁移旧数据时使用。更多信息见 预设指南 。 上游旧教程曾介绍内置更新器和 Discord 测试版下载。当前建议通过 GitHub Releases 获取 TOHEE 发行包；不要依赖旧版频道名称或旧下载地址。
search.en: Update TOHEE Replace release files safely while keeping local settings and templates. Before updating Close Among Us and any running game process from the launcher. Back up the TOHEE-DATA folder in the game directory; it holds presets, templates, and local tags. Do not mix an old mod DLL with a new loader or interop files from another store installation. Install the new version Open TOHEE GitHub Releases and read the newest release notes and supported Among Us version. Download the package for your store and architecture. Steam, Epic Games, and Microsoft Store / Xbox App normally use x64; the Windows itch.io client uses x86. If the game itself was updated, prefer the full release package for that game version. With the game closed, extract the package into the directory containing Among Us.exe and allow it to replace mod files as prompted. Keep TOHEE-DATA ; do not replace the entire new installation directory with an old backup. When upgrading an older bundled release, check the current package instructions for any patcher or loader files that must also be replaced. If first initialization requires a restart, follow the release notes and relaunch the game. Launch the game and confirm the main menu shows the current TOHEE version. If loading fails, inspect BepInEx/LogOutput.log and see troubleshooting . For a routine mod-only update on the same Among Us version, architecture, and BepInEx 6 be.755 environment, the release instructions allow replacing only BepInEx/plugins/TOHE.dll . Use the full release package if the notes require a loader or patcher update, or if you are unsure about the current setup. Settings files Current TOHEE saves game options in TOHEE-DATA/SaveData/GlobalOptions.jsonc and Preset1.jsonc through Preset8.jsonc . These local files differ from the JSON files used for sharing presets in TOHEE-DATA/Presets/ . Do not treat Options.json from an old website download flow as the current preset format; the old Options.json is read only when the program migrates legacy data. See the preset guide . Older upstream instructions described a built-in updater and Discord beta downloads. The current recommendation is to get TOHEE release packages from GitHub Releases; do not rely on old channel names or download links.

summary.zh-CN: 房主在网站与模组两端开启分享，让玩家发现当前房间。
summary.en: Enable sharing on the website and in the mod to help players discover your room.

search.zh-CN: 分享你的房间 房主在网站与模组两端开启分享，让玩家发现当前房间。 分享前需要什么 你需要已绑定且具备分享资格的 Among Us 账号、有效的游戏在线登录，以及当前在线房间的房主身份。离线本地游戏、非房主玩家或不受支持的模组版本不会正常上报共享房间。 分享后，房间码会向符合资格的 Cloud 用户和获授权的 API 调用方可见。请仅在愿意让这些玩家加入时开启。 开启分享 在网站 游戏账号 中，找到房主正在使用的好友代码，开启“房间分享”。 在 TOHEE 的 Cloud 菜单开启本地分享，也可以使用 /cloud share on 。 作为房主进入在线房间。查看 Cloud 菜单的账号资格、房间分享状态和提示信息。 如果当前房间之前手动停止了分享，在菜单中重新选择分享当前房间。 网站开关是账号层面的许可，模组开关决定当前客户端是否发送房间信息，两端都需要开启。修改网站设置后，可以在模组中刷新账户状态，或使用 /cloud account refresh 。 私人房间 私人房间需要明确确认分享当前房间。在模组 Cloud 菜单选择分享当前私人房间，或使用 /cloud private confirm 。确认的是当前房间，不代表以后所有私人房间都自动公开。 Among Us 的“私人”状态不等于 Cloud 已停止展示房间码。请核对 Cloud 的分享状态；不愿继续展示时，明确停止当前房间分享或关闭分享开关。 停止分享 在 Cloud 菜单停止当前房间分享，可以保留本地分享总开关；使用 /cloud share off 则关闭本地分享并请求撤下房间。在网站关闭账号的房间分享也会阻止继续分享。 列表更新存在刷新间隔。查看者已复制的房间码不能通过关闭分享撤回。房主离开、断线或服务不可用时，列表中的状态也可能暂时落后；不能把列表记录当作实时在线保证。 房间没有出现 先检查是否为房主、是否完成游戏登录、是否绑定了正确账号、两端开关是否开启，以及私人房间是否确认。账号资格、服务器信息和模组版本也会影响上报。按照 Cloud 菜单的具体原因处理，详见 常见问题 。
search.en: Share your room Enable sharing on the website and in the mod to help players discover your room. Requirements You need a linked Among Us account eligible to share, a valid online game login and host authority in the current online room. Offline local games, non-host players and unsupported mod versions cannot report a shared room normally. Sharing makes your room code visible to eligible Cloud users and authorised API clients. Enable it when you want those players to discover and join your room. Enable sharing Under Game accounts , find the friend code currently used by the host and enable room sharing. Enable local sharing in the TOHEE Cloud menu, or use /cloud share on . Host an online room. Check account eligibility, room-sharing status and messages in the Cloud menu. If you manually stopped sharing this room earlier, choose to share the current room again. The website switch permits sharing for the account. The mod switch controls whether this client sends room information. Both must be enabled. After changing website settings, refresh account status in the mod or use /cloud account refresh . Private rooms A private room requires explicit confirmation for the current room. Choose to share the current private room in the mod's Cloud menu, or use /cloud private confirm . This confirms the current room, not all future private rooms. The game's Private status does not mean Cloud has stopped showing its code. Check Cloud's sharing status. Explicitly stop sharing the current room or disable sharing when you no longer want the code displayed. Stop sharing Stopping the current room in the Cloud menu preserves the local sharing preference. /cloud share off disables local sharing and requests room removal. Turning off account sharing on the website also prevents continued sharing. The room list has a refresh interval. Stopping sharing cannot recall codes that viewers have already copied. After host departure, disconnection or a service outage, listed status may briefly lag behind. A listing does not guarantee a host is online now. If your room is missing Check that you are the host, have finished signing in to the game, linked the right account, enabled both switches and confirmed any private room. Account eligibility, server information and mod version also affect reporting. Follow the specific Cloud menu message; see troubleshooting .

summary.zh-CN: 从基础游戏规则开始，再逐步配置模式、角色和其他模组设置。
summary.en: Start with the base game rules, then configure the mode, roles, and other mod options.

search.zh-CN: 设置房间 从基础游戏规则开始，再逐步配置模式、角色和其他模组设置。 创建房间 确认游戏主菜单已显示 TOHEE 版本信息，再创建或加入房间。房主的模组控制自定义角色、规则与模式；其他玩家可以使用未修改客户端加入。开局前告诉玩家房间使用的模式，以及角色介绍和聊天命令如何查看。 推荐的首次设置流程 在**游戏设置（Game Settings）**中设置地图、玩家数、会议时间、移动速度、视野、击杀距离和任务数量等基础规则。这些设置会影响所有模式。 在**模组设置（Mod Settings）**中选择模式。首次体验建议选标准模式（Standard）；切换模式后，可见设置项会随模式变化。 在**系统设置（System Settings）**中检查开房、玩家加入、信息显示和反作弊保护相关设置。初次开房建议保留默认值，逐项调整并观察效果。 使用标准模式时，再调整船员（Crewmate）、内鬼（Impostor）、中立（Neutral）角色和附加职业（Add-ons）。先少量启用熟悉的角色，确认每个角色的最大数量和出现几率，避免随机分配超出预期。 先开一局短测试，确认玩家人数、角色数量、击杀冷却和胜利条件都合适，再保存到 预设槽 。 菜单分组说明见 游戏设置 、 系统设置 、 模组设置 和 设置索引 。旧版上游教程中的选项名称可能与当前客户端不同；具体名称和可用范围以游戏内当前菜单为准。 Cloud 可选功能 TOHEE Cloud 的账号、绑定游戏账号、玩家标签和房间浏览是独立于本地房间设置的网页功能。使用 Cloud 需要按页面流程登录并绑定账号；开始普通房间游戏不要求 Cloud 账号。详情见 TOHEE Cloud 指南 。
search.en: Set Up a Room Start with the base game rules, then configure the mode, roles, and other mod options. Create a room Confirm that the TOHEE version appears on the main menu, then create or join a room. The host's mod controls custom roles, rules, and modes; other players can join with unmodified clients. Before starting, tell players which mode the room uses and how to check role descriptions and chat commands. A good first setup In Game Settings , set the basic rules such as map, player count, meeting timers, movement speed, vision, kill distance, and task counts. These settings affect every mode. Choose a mode in Mod Settings . Standard is a good place to start; the available settings change when you switch modes. Review System Settings for room access, player joining, information display, and anti-blackout protection. Keep the defaults for a first room, then change one setting at a time and observe the result. In Standard, configure Crewmate, Impostor, and Neutral roles plus Add-ons. Start with a small set of familiar roles, and check each role's maximum count and spawn chance so random assignment stays predictable. Play a short test round to check player count, role count, kill cooldown, and win conditions. Save a suitable setup to a preset slot . See game settings , system settings , mod settings , and the settings index for the menu groups. Option names in older upstream guides may differ from the current client; use the labels and choices shown in your in-game menu. Optional Cloud features TOHEE Cloud accounts, linked game accounts, player tags, and room browsing are web features separate from local room settings. Follow the Cloud pages to sign in and link an account; a Cloud account is not required to host a regular game. See the TOHEE Cloud guide .

summary.zh-CN: 按地区、状态和空位筛选共享房间，在 Among Us 中输入房间码加入。
summary.en: Filter shared rooms by region, status and open slots, then join using the room code in Among Us.

documents.source: TOHEE Cloud product guidance; maintainer-authored and reviewed 2026-11-13

search.zh-CN: 查找房间与加入游戏 按地区、状态和空位筛选共享房间，在 Among Us 中输入房间码加入。 使用房间列表 登录 Cloud，并绑定至少一个已通过验证的游戏账号；按提示完成密码设置等账号准备步骤。 打开 房间匹配 。默认显示所有地区、等待中且有空位的房间。 根据需要选择地区、状态和“有空位”。自定义服务器也可以从自定义地区中查找。 核对房间的游戏版本、服务器、地图、聊天语言与人数。列表按模组版本分组，避免混淆不同版本。 点击房间码复制。在 Among Us 中选择同一服务器，输入房间码加入。 Cloud 展示的是房主主动分享的房间，不是全部在线房间。房间匹配提供查找和复制功能，不会替你启动游戏或自动选择服务器。 服务器与版本 房间码必须与对应服务器配合使用。卡片中若提供服务器地址，可以点击打开或复制；未提供地址时，需要向房主确认连接方式。 先匹配 Among Us 游戏版本。房主使用 TOHEE 时，普通玩家通常可以使用原版加入；特殊服务器、人数或模式是否支持该客户端，以房主规则与当前模组版本为准。列表显示的模组版本说明房主环境，不是要求所有玩家都安装同一模组。 刷新与状态 页面可见时通常每 10 秒自动刷新，也可以点击“立即更新”。切到后台时自动查询会暂停；获取失败时会退避重试。页面显示数据时间，以便判断信息是否新鲜。 如果刷新失败但仍有上次成功的数据，页面会保留它并提示“无法获取最新状态”。此时人数、空位和房间状态可能已经变化。“等待中”不保证加入时仍然开放。 找不到或进不去 清除筛选条件，检查是否选错地区；确认游戏版本和服务器相同。房间可能已满、已开始、关闭或停止分享。空列表也可能只是没有房主分享，不能据此判断游戏服务器是否故障。
search.en: Find and join a room Filter shared rooms by region, status and open slots, then join using the room code in Among Us. Use the room list Sign in to Cloud and link at least one verified game account. Complete any required password or account setup. Open Find a room . The default view shows Lobby rooms from all regions with available slots. Select a region, status and Available slots as needed. Custom regions can include custom servers. Check the game version, server, map, chat language and player count. Rooms are grouped by mod version to distinguish host environments. Click the room code to copy it. Select the same server in Among Us and enter the code to join. Cloud lists rooms their hosts choose to share, not every online room. Matchmaking helps you find and copy codes; it does not launch the game or select a server for you. Servers and versions A room code must be used on its matching server. If the card provides an address, open or copy it as offered. If no address is available, ask the host how to connect. Match the Among Us game version first. Ordinary players can generally join a TOHEE host using unmodded Among Us. Support for particular servers, player counts and modes depends on the host's rules and current mod version. A listed mod version describes the host; it does not mean every player must install that mod. Refresh and status While visible, the page normally refreshes every 10 seconds. You can also use Refresh now. Automatic checks pause in the background and retry with a delay after failures. The displayed data time helps you judge freshness. If a refresh fails after an earlier success, the page retains those results and warns that it could not get the latest status. Counts, open slots and room status may have changed. Lobby status does not guarantee that a room will still be open when you join. Missing rooms or failed joins Clear filters and check the region. Confirm that your game version and server match. A room may be full, started, closed or no longer shared. An empty list may simply mean no hosts are sharing; it does not establish that the game server is down.

summary.zh-CN: 查看常用聊天命令、房主功能和键盘快捷键。
summary.en: Find common chat commands, host tools, and keyboard shortcuts.

search.zh-CN: 命令与快捷键 查看常用聊天命令、房主功能和键盘快捷键。 聊天命令 在游戏聊天框中输入命令。输入 /help 可查看当前版本的帮助信息；命令、别名和权限可能随角色、模式、设置或客户端版本变化。 命令 用途 /m 或 /myrole 查看自己的角色说明；通常在游戏中使用。 /d 或 /death 查看自己的死亡信息；只在死亡后有完整信息。 /l 或 /lastresult 查看上一局击杀记录、角色和结果。 /gr 查看上一局结果。 /kh 查看上一局击杀记录。 /rs 查看上一局角色摘要。 /dump 导出模组日志，便于提交故障报告。 /t <名称> 发送 TOHEE-DATA/template.txt 中对应名称的聊天模板。 /id 查看房间内玩家编号；可能受当前设置或命令规则限制。 /kcount 查看存活击杀阵营数量；房主必须开启对应系统选项。 房主还可以在大厅用 /save <名称> 保存当前设置，或用 /load <名称> 将本机文件夹中的预设载入当前槽位。更详细的文件位置和版本限制见 预设指南 。这些命令是本地文件操作，不是从旧上游网站下载预设。 /tags reload 用于房主重载模组的本地标签文件。TOHEE Cloud 的网页玩家标签使用 Cloud 账号和绑定的游戏账号管理，和此命令不是同一功能；详情见 Cloud 指南 。 管理命令（例如开始游戏、踢人或封禁）由房主权限、玩家权限和目标保护共同限制。不要假设每个玩家或每个房间都能使用相同命令。 常用键盘快捷键 快捷键 用途 Ctrl + F1 导出日志。 F1 标准模式（Standard）中显示自己的角色说明。 F2 标准模式中依次查看附加职业（Add-ons）说明。 F3 标准模式中显示自己的角色设置。 F4 标准模式中依次查看附加职业设置。 Alt + C 复制当前房间设置。 Alt + F11 循环切换几种窗口分辨率。 F5 + T 重新载入自定义翻译文件。 F5 + X 导出自定义翻译和角色颜色文件。 某些快捷键只在标准模式或游戏中可用。旧版上游 Features 页面列出了大量开发调试热键；它们不一定存在于当前 TOHEE 发行版，以上清单以当前代码中的常用功能为准。
search.en: Commands and Hotkeys Find common chat commands, host tools, and keyboard shortcuts. Chat commands Enter commands in the in-game chat box. Type /help to see the current build's help. Commands, aliases, and permissions can depend on your role, mode, settings, or client version. Command Use /m or /myrole Read your role description; normally used during a game. /d or /death Read your death information; full details are available after you die. /l or /lastresult Show the previous round's kill log, roles, and result. /gr Show the previous round's result. /kh Show the previous round's kill log. /rs Show the previous round's role summary. /dump Export the mod log for a bug report. /t <name> Send the chat template with that name from TOHEE-DATA/template.txt . /id List player IDs in the room; current settings or command rules may restrict it. /kcount Show the number of living killer factions; the host must enable the related system option. In the lobby, the host can use /save <name> to save the current settings or /load <name> to load a local file into the current slot. See the preset guide for paths and version restrictions. These commands use local files; they do not download presets from an old upstream site. The host uses /tags reload to reload the mod's local tag files. TOHEE Cloud player tags are managed on the website with a Cloud account and linked game account; this is a separate feature. See the Cloud guide . Management commands such as starting a game, kicking, or banning are controlled by host permissions, player permissions, and target protections. Do not assume every player or room can use the same commands. Common keyboard shortcuts Shortcut Use Ctrl + F1 Export the log. F1 Show your role description in Standard mode. F2 Cycle through your Add-on descriptions in Standard mode. F3 Show your role settings in Standard mode. F4 Cycle through your Add-on settings in Standard mode. Alt + C Copy the current room settings. Alt + F11 Cycle through several window resolutions. F5 + T Reload custom translation files. F5 + X Export custom translations and role colors. Some shortcuts work only in Standard or during a game. The old upstream Features page listed many developer and debug hotkeys that may not exist in current TOHEE releases; this list reflects common functions in the current source.

summary.zh-CN: 排查登录、绑定、标签显示和房间分享问题。
summary.en: Resolve sign-in, linking, tag display and room-sharing problems.

documents.source: TOHEE Cloud product guidance; maintainer-authored and reviewed 2026-11-13

search.zh-CN: Cloud 常见问题 排查登录、绑定、标签显示和房间分享问题。 无法登录或忘记密码 邮箱登录请确认邮箱和 Cloud 密码；忘记密码可以使用 重置密码 。Discord 登录失败时返回登录页重试，确认浏览器允许所需跳转。若系统要求首次设置密码或更改临时密码，先在“账号设置”完成。 安全验证尚未完成时，提交按钮会保持不可用。等待组件加载并完成验证；验证码发送后检查垃圾邮件和页面的有效期。上游邮件或验证服务不可用时，需要等待服务恢复。 绑定未通过，或服务暂时不可用 账号未通过可能因为缺少有效好友代码、仅使用游客 Device ID、账号来源不受支持、账号已绑定或处于解绑冷却。检查页面显示的具体原因。 “验证服务暂时不可用”表示这次未能完成验证，不等于账号已被判定无效。好友请求流程过期后，应创建新流程，并向新页面指定的验证账号发送请求。 从模组绑定或分享提示游戏登录失效时，回到 Among Us 完成登录后重试。Cloud 网站已登录不代表游戏的在线登录仍有效。 标签保存成功却没有显示 核对编辑的好友代码是否正确；在房主的 TOHEE Cloud 菜单启用云端标签并刷新。确认正在排查的是云端标签而非本地 tags.txt 。游戏显示受到房主设置、缓存和当前场景影响，网页预览不是实时游戏画面。 若不能编辑，查看下次可修改时间、本人编辑是否关闭，以及账号是否被冻结或封禁。 分享开启了，房间仍不在列表 依次检查： 网站开关属于当前房主正在使用的游戏账号。 模组本地分享开关已开启，并且当前房间未手动停止分享。 你是当前在线房间的房主，已完成游戏账号登录。 私人房间已明确确认分享。 Cloud 菜单未提示账号资格、模组版本或服务器信息方面的问题。 然后在房间列表清除地区和状态筛选，等待刷新。只启用云标签不会自动分享房间。 联系支持时提供什么 记录错误提示、发生时间、使用的游戏与模组版本，以及发生问题的步骤。可以提供好友代码帮助定位游戏身份，但不要公开密码、邮箱验证码、会话信息或完整绑定链接。 账号封禁、管理限制等需要联系管理员处理。阅读 信息收集协议 了解数据用途，或到 联系与项目 查找联系方式。
search.en: Cloud troubleshooting Resolve sign-in, linking, tag display and room-sharing problems. Sign-in or password problems For email sign-in, check your email address and Cloud password. Use Reset password if you forgot it. If Discord sign-in fails, return to sign-in and retry, allowing required browser redirects. Complete any first-time password setup or temporary password change in Account settings. Submit buttons remain unavailable until security verification is complete. Let the component load and complete the check. After requesting an email code, check spam and the displayed expiry time. An unavailable email or verification provider requires waiting for service recovery. Rejected verification or an unavailable service Rejection can result from a missing valid friend code, Device ID-only guest access, an unsupported account provider, an existing link or an unlinking cooldown. Follow the specific reason shown on the page. Verification unavailable means the service could not complete this attempt; it does not establish that your account is invalid. After a friend request challenge expires, create a new flow and send a request to the verification account named by the new page. If linking from the mod or sharing reports an expired game login, finish signing in to Among Us and retry. Being signed in on the Cloud website does not mean your game's online login is still valid. A saved tag does not appear Check that you edited the right friend code. Enable and refresh cloud tags in the host's TOHEE Cloud menu. Make sure you are checking cloud tags rather than local tags.txt entries. Display depends on host settings, cached data and the current scene; the website preview is not a live game view. If editing is unavailable, check the next edit time, whether owner editing is disabled and whether the account is frozen or banned. Sharing is enabled but the room is missing Check these in order: The website switch belongs to the game account the host is currently using. Local mod sharing is enabled and sharing for this room was not manually stopped. You are the host of the current online room and have completed game sign-in. You explicitly confirmed sharing for a private room. The Cloud menu reports no account eligibility, mod version or server-information problem. Then clear region and status filters in the room list and allow a refresh. Enabling cloud tags alone does not share a room. Information for support Record the error message, time, game and mod versions, and steps that produced the issue. You can supply a friend code to identify a game account, but do not publish passwords, email codes, session information or complete binding links. Bans and administrative restrictions require administrator assistance. Read the information collection policy for data usage, or see Contact and projects for contact information.

summary.zh-CN: 使用预设槽、备份当前配置，并了解当前 JSONC 与本地分享文件。
summary.en: Use preset slots, back up settings, and understand current JSONC and local share files.

search.zh-CN: 预设与设置文件 使用预设槽、备份当前配置，并了解当前 JSONC 与本地分享文件。 预设槽 房间设置按预设槽保存。你可以在游戏设置界面选择槽位，为不同人数或玩法保留多套规则。切换槽位后，确认游戏内显示的是想使用的那一套设置，再开始游戏。 TOHEE 将设置写入 TOHEE-DATA/SaveData/ ： GlobalOptions.jsonc 保存全局设置， Preset1.jsonc 至 Preset8.jsonc 保存各槽位选项。JSONC 允许注释和末尾逗号；文件中的数字 ID 对应模组内部选项索引，不是屏幕上显示的设置值。建议通过游戏菜单编辑，不要直接手工修改这些文件。 导出和载入可分享预设 房主可在大厅使用以下命令： /save 休闲标准局 /load 休闲标准局 /save 会把当前选项写入 TOHEE-DATA/Presets/<名称>.json ；将文件发给朋友后，对方把它放入自己同一目录，再在房间大厅运行 /load <名称> ，即可把选项导入 当前预设槽 。命令仅限房主在大厅中使用，文件名可包含字母、数字、空格、连字符和下划线。 分享文件带有游戏、模组和选项格式版本信息。载入时会检查版本和选项兼容性；版本不匹配或内容无效时不会应用。加载成功后检查菜单中的选项，再开始游戏。不要从不可信来源运行或修改未知预设文件。 游戏设置菜单里的 Copy 按钮还可在本地槽位之间复制，或复制上一位房主同步给房间的预设；该按钮仅供房主在大厅使用。复制会覆盖目标槽位，确认提示后再继续。 旧版数据 旧上游教程要求把下载的 Options.json 放入 TOHE-DATA/SaveData ，并改名后选择。当前 TOHEE 已改用 GlobalOptions.jsonc 与各槽位的 PresetN.jsonc ，本地分享文件则由 /save 和 /load 管理。旧 Options.json 只用于程序迁移旧配置，不是当前推荐的分享格式。 更新模组前备份整个 TOHEE-DATA 文件夹。升级说明见 更新 TOHEE 。
search.en: Presets and Settings Files Use preset slots, back up settings, and understand current JSONC and local share files. Preset slots Room settings are stored in preset slots. Choose a slot in the game settings menu to keep separate rule sets for different group sizes or play styles. After switching, confirm the game shows the settings you intend to use before starting. TOHEE stores settings in TOHEE-DATA/SaveData/ : GlobalOptions.jsonc contains global settings and Preset1.jsonc through Preset8.jsonc contain slot options. JSONC permits comments and trailing commas. The numeric IDs in the files map to internal option indexes, not the values shown in the menu. Edit settings through the game menu instead of changing these files by hand. Export and load a shareable preset The host can use these commands in the lobby: /save Casual Standard /load Casual Standard /save writes the current options to TOHEE-DATA/Presets/<name>.json . After sending that file to a friend, they put it in the same directory and run /load <name> in their own lobby to import the options into the current preset slot . Only the host can use these commands in the lobby. File names may contain letters, digits, spaces, hyphens, and underscores. Share files include game, mod, and option-format versions. Loading checks version and option compatibility; incompatible versions or invalid content are not applied. Review the resulting menu settings before starting. Do not use or edit preset files from sources you do not trust. The Copy button in the game settings menu can also copy between local slots or copy the previous host's preset shared with the room. Only the host can use this button in the lobby. Copying overwrites the target slot, so review the confirmation before proceeding. Legacy data Old upstream instructions told players to download Options.json , place it in TOHE-DATA/SaveData , and select it. Current TOHEE uses GlobalOptions.jsonc and one PresetN.jsonc per slot; /save and /load manage local share files. The old Options.json is read only to migrate legacy settings and is not the recommended sharing format. Back up the entire TOHEE-DATA folder before updating. See updating TOHEE .

summary.zh-CN: 编辑房间欢迎词和自定义聊天消息。
summary.en: Edit the lobby welcome message and custom chat messages.

search.zh-CN: 聊天模板 编辑房间欢迎词和自定义聊天消息。 模板文件 TOHEE 在游戏目录的 TOHEE-DATA/template.txt 中保存聊天模板。首次运行会根据游戏语言生成默认模板；旧位置的 template.txt 可能会被复制到新目录。编辑前先备份文件，使用纯文本编辑器保存为 UTF-8。 每行使用 名称:消息 格式，冒号是分隔符。例如： welcome:欢迎来到房间，{{PlayerName}}！房主是 {{HostName}}。 onMeeting:请讨论并投票。房间代码：{{RoomCode}} example:第一行\n第二行 在聊天框输入 /t welcome 或 /t example ，即可发送匹配名称的消息。 \n 会换行；消息正文中的额外冒号会保留。名称不区分大小写。相同名称可以出现多次，模组会分别发送匹配的消息。不存在的名称不会发送内容，可用 /help 查看当前帮助。 当前默认模板通常包含 welcome 、 onMeeting 等触发名称；更新或修改模板时，请以你本机 template.txt 的内容为准，不要假定每个版本都有相同默认模板。 可替换变量 模板可以包含 {{...}} 变量，模组发送时会用当前信息替换，例如： 变量 含义 {{PlayerName}} 接收模板的玩家名称；在大厅广播时可能为空。 {{HostName}} 房主游戏昵称。 {{RoomCode}} 房间代码。 {{AmongUsVersion}} 当前游戏版本。 {{ModVersion}} TOHEE 显示版本。 {{Map}} 当前地图名称。 {{LobbyTimer}} 大厅开始倒计时；不在大厅时为空。 普通模式还支持游戏时间、讨论/投票时长、速度、视野和任务数量等模板变量；Hide & Seek 使用的可替换选项较少。变量名称需完全匹配，包括大括号。 格式注意事项 聊天消息支持模组采用的 Among Us 富文本标记。改动后保存文件并重新发送模板；如果没有输出或显示异常，检查是否缺少冒号、变量拼写错误或文本中存在格式未闭合。 TOHE-DATA 是旧版目录名；当前默认目录为 TOHEE-DATA 。
search.en: Chat Templates Edit the lobby welcome message and custom chat messages. Template file TOHEE stores chat templates in TOHEE-DATA/template.txt in the game directory. On first run it creates a default file for the game language; an old template.txt in the previous location may be copied into the new directory. Back up the file before editing, use a plain-text editor, and save it as UTF-8. Each line uses name:message , with a colon as the separator. For example: welcome:Welcome to the room, {{PlayerName}}! Your host is {{HostName}}. onMeeting:Discuss and vote. Room code: {{RoomCode}} example:First line\nSecond line Enter /t welcome or /t example in chat to send a matching message. \n creates a line break; extra colons in the message body are preserved. Names are case-insensitive. Duplicate names send each matching message separately. An unknown name produces no template content; use /help for current command help. The default file commonly includes names such as welcome and onMeeting . Use the names in your own template.txt when editing or updating it; do not assume every release has the same default templates. Replacement variables Templates can include {{...}} variables that TOHEE replaces when it sends the message: Variable Meaning {{PlayerName}} Name of the player receiving the template; it may be empty in a lobby broadcast. {{HostName}} Host's in-game name. {{RoomCode}} Room code. {{AmongUsVersion}} Current game version. {{ModVersion}} TOHEE display version. {{Map}} Current map name. {{LobbyTimer}} Lobby start countdown; empty outside the lobby. Standard mode also supports variables for game time, discussion and voting time, speed, vision, and task counts. Hide & Seek exposes fewer option variables. Variable names must match exactly, including braces. Formatting tips Chat messages support the Among Us rich-text markup used by the mod. After editing, save the file and send the template again. If it sends nothing or appears incorrectly, check for a missing colon, a misspelled variable, or unclosed formatting. TOHE-DATA is the old directory name; the current default directory is TOHEE-DATA .

summary.zh-CN: 比较标准模式、自由混战和 TOHE 躲猫猫，并说明旧上游指南中的竞速模式。
summary.en: Compare Standard, FFA, and TOHE Hide & Seek, and identify Speedrun from older upstream guides.

search.zh-CN: 游戏模式 比较标准模式、自由混战和 TOHE 躲猫猫，并说明旧上游指南中的竞速模式。 当前 TOHEE 模式 在大厅的**模组设置（Mod Settings）**中选择模式。TOHEE 当前代码提供标准模式（Standard）、自由混战（FFA）和躲猫猫（Hide & Seek TOHE）；选择模式后，可用的选项页和角色设置会相应变化。 标准模式（Standard） 标准模式是经典的 TOHE 玩法。玩家可以获得船员（Crewmate）、内鬼（Impostor）或中立（Neutral）阵营角色，也可能获得附加职业（Add-ons）修饰。每种角色有自己的技能和胜利条件，房主通过角色数量、出现几率和其他规则决定本局组合。初次开房建议少量启用角色，再查看 模组设置 和 命令与快捷键 。旧版上游指南中出现的女巫阵营（Coven）并不在当前 TOHEE 角色/设置菜单中。 自由混战（FFA） 自由混战中，每名玩家都要击杀其他玩家。房主可调整对局时长、击杀冷却、速度或视野效果，以及随机能力和随机变化。部分效果会在击杀后触发，例如短暂护盾或速度/视野变化；具体取决于当前模式设置。此模式使用自己的选项，不按标准模式的角色阵营分配玩法。 躲猫猫（Hide & Seek TOHE） 这是 TOHEE 根据 Among Us 躲猫猫规则提供的模式，房主可调整追捕方数量（当前代码允许 1 至 3 名）。追捕方寻找并击杀躲藏者；躲藏者应完成任务并尽量存活。该模式会隐藏标准模式专用的许多模组选项，因此请在大厅检查躲猫猫页面中的设置。 旧上游指南中的竞速模式（Speedrun） 固定版本的 TOHE 上游指南曾介绍竞速模式：玩家先完成任务，完成后转为猎杀者并尝试击杀其他人，房间设置还可能提供完成任务奖励。这个模式 不在当前 TOHEE 代码的模式列表中 ，因此不要把旧说明当成当前版本可选模式。若某个未来发行版重新加入该模式，请以该发行版菜单和说明为准。
search.en: Game Modes Compare Standard, FFA, and TOHE Hide & Seek, and identify Speedrun from older upstream guides. Modes in current TOHEE Choose a mode in Mod Settings in the lobby. Current TOHEE source provides Standard, FFA, and Hide & Seek TOHE. The available option tabs and role settings change with the selected mode. Standard Standard is the classic TOHE experience. Players can receive Crewmate, Impostor, or Neutral faction roles and may also receive Add-on modifiers. Roles have their own abilities and win conditions; the host controls each round's lineup through role counts, spawn chances, and other rules. For a first room, enable a small set of roles and review mod settings and commands and hotkeys . The Coven faction shown in older upstream guides is not in the current TOHEE role or settings menus. FFA (Free For All) FFA is a free-for-all mode where each player tries to kill everyone else. The host can adjust the match duration, kill cooldown, speed or vision effects, and random abilities or twists. Some effects can trigger after a kill, such as a temporary shield or a change to speed or vision; the exact behavior depends on the current mode settings. FFA uses its own options rather than Standard faction-role play. Hide & Seek TOHE This is TOHEE's mode based on Among Us Hide and Seek rules. The host can set the number of hunters (current source allows one to three). Hunters search for and eliminate hiders; hiders complete tasks and try to survive. The mode hides many options used only by Standard, so review the Hide & Seek settings in the lobby. Speedrun in older upstream guides An older, fixed-version TOHE upstream guide described Speedrun: players complete tasks first, then become killers and try to eliminate everyone else. The room might also grant perks for completing tasks. This mode is not in the current TOHEE mode list , so do not treat the old description as an option in current releases. If a future release restores it, follow that release's menu and notes.

summary.zh-CN: 了解 TOHEE Cloud 网页标签与模组本地标签的区别。
summary.en: Understand the difference between TOHEE Cloud tags and mod-local tags.

search.zh-CN: 玩家标签 了解 TOHEE Cloud 网页标签与模组本地标签的区别。 TOHEE Cloud 网页标签 TOHEE Cloud 玩家标签与旧版上游模组标签文件是两种不同功能。Cloud 标签通过网站为已绑定的 Among Us 游戏账号设置纯文本标签和颜色；是否能自行编辑、冷却时间和账号状态由 Cloud 页面显示。标签不是模组管理权限，也不会因为文字看起来像管理员就授予模组权限。 登录并绑定游戏账号后，前往 Cloud 的账号或标签页面编辑标签。玩家标签设置、绑定和其他 Cloud 功能见 TOHEE Cloud 指南 。 房主本地标签 TOHEE 模组本身还支持房主本地标签、权限配置和 GM 身份。这些设置保存在房主电脑的 TOHEE-DATA/Tags ，不会与 Cloud 网页标签自动同步。房主可以输入 /tags reload 让模组重新读取本地标签。关于当前本地 TXT 格式、权限级别和旧配置变化，请查阅 TOHEE 本地玩家标签说明 。 旧版上游教程提到的 MOD_TAGS 、 VIP_TAGS 目录和旧 MOD/VIP 名单不再代表当前 TOHEE 权限系统；不要按旧教程复制标签文件或授予权限。Cloud 标签和模组本地标签各自维护，使用场景不同。
search.en: Player Tags Understand the difference between TOHEE Cloud tags and mod-local tags. TOHEE Cloud web tags TOHEE Cloud player tags and the old upstream mod tag files are different features. Cloud tags let a linked Among Us account set plain-text tag content and a colour on the website. The Cloud page shows whether self-editing is allowed, the cooldown, and account status. A tag is not a mod permission, and text that looks like an administrator label does not grant mod access. Sign in, link a game account, and open the Cloud account or tag page to edit the tag. See the TOHEE Cloud guide for tags, account linking, and other Cloud features. Host-local mod tags The TOHEE mod also supports host-local tags, permission settings, and GM status. These are stored on the host's computer under TOHEE-DATA/Tags and do not sync automatically with Cloud web tags. The host can enter /tags reload to make the mod read local tags again. For the current local TXT format, permission levels, and legacy changes, see TOHEE host-local player tags . The MOD_TAGS and VIP_TAGS folders and old MOD/VIP lists mentioned in upstream instructions no longer describe the current TOHEE permission system. Do not copy old tag files or grant permissions using those instructions. Cloud tags and host-local mod tags are maintained separately and serve different purposes.

summary.zh-CN: 认识 TOHEE-DATA 中的设置、模板、预设和标签文件。
summary.en: Find settings, templates, presets, and tag files under TOHEE-DATA.

search.zh-CN: 本地数据文件 认识 TOHEE-DATA 中的设置、模板、预设和标签文件。 TOHEE-DATA 当前 TOHEE 将本地数据保存在游戏目录的 TOHEE-DATA 文件夹。首次启动可能会创建缺少的文件。旧版数据目录名为 TOHE-DATA ；模组会在适用时迁移已有文件，但更新前仍建议先备份。 路径 内容 TOHEE-DATA/SaveData/GlobalOptions.jsonc 全局选项及当前预设选择。 TOHEE-DATA/SaveData/Preset1.jsonc 至 Preset8.jsonc 本地预设槽的选项。 TOHEE-DATA/Presets/ /save 导出的、可分享的 JSON 预设文件。 TOHEE-DATA/template.txt 欢迎消息和自定义聊天模板。 TOHEE-DATA/CustomSoundsVolumeConfig.json 自定义音效的总音量、单项音量和开关，由 音效管理界面 自动保存。 TOHEE-DATA/Tags/ 与 TOHEE-DATA/tags.txt 房主本地玩家标签与外观后备标签；不等于 Cloud 网页标签。 TOHEE-DATA/BanList.txt 、 DenyName.txt 、 WhiteList.txt 房间使用的封禁、名称过滤与允许列表数据。 不要把 GlobalOptions.jsonc 或 PresetN.jsonc 改成旧版 Options.json 格式；使用游戏菜单修改设置。分享预设的命令和版本校验见 预设指南 ，模板格式见 聊天模板 ，本地标签见 玩家标签 。 备份和迁移 关闭游戏后，复制整个 TOHEE-DATA 文件夹到安全位置。若从旧安装恢复设置，只恢复需要的配置文件，不要把旧的加载器、插件或 interop 文件复制到新游戏目录。遇到文件丢失或格式错误时，保留副本并检查日志；不要删除原始数据后再尝试恢复。
search.en: Local Data Files Find settings, templates, presets, and tag files under TOHEE-DATA. TOHEE-DATA Current TOHEE stores local data in the TOHEE-DATA folder beside the game. The mod may create missing files on first launch. Older releases used the TOHE-DATA directory name; the mod migrates existing files when applicable, but back up the folder before updating. Path Contents TOHEE-DATA/SaveData/GlobalOptions.jsonc Global options and the current preset selection. TOHEE-DATA/SaveData/Preset1.jsonc through Preset8.jsonc Settings for local preset slots. TOHEE-DATA/Presets/ Shareable JSON preset files exported with /save . TOHEE-DATA/template.txt Welcome messages and custom chat templates. TOHEE-DATA/CustomSoundsVolumeConfig.json Master/per-effect volumes and switches, saved automatically by the sound manager . TOHEE-DATA/Tags/ and TOHEE-DATA/tags.txt Host-local player tags and cosmetic fallback tags; these are not Cloud web tags. TOHEE-DATA/BanList.txt , DenyName.txt , WhiteList.txt Ban, name-filter, and allow-list data used by the room. Do not convert GlobalOptions.jsonc or PresetN.jsonc to the old Options.json format; change settings in the game menu. See the preset guide for sharing commands and version checks, chat templates for template syntax, and player tags for the local tag system. Back up and migrate Close the game and copy the whole TOHEE-DATA folder to a safe location. When restoring settings from an older installation, restore only the configuration files you need; do not copy old loader, plugin, or interop files into the new game directory. If files are missing or invalid, keep a backup and inspect the log before making changes.

summary.zh-CN: 了解房主专属模组、兼容客户端、角色显示和日志获取。
summary.en: Learn about host-only mods, client compatibility, role display, and logs.

search.zh-CN: 常见问题 了解房主专属模组、兼容客户端、角色显示和日志获取。 什么是房主专属模组？ 房主专属（host-only）模组由房主运行，其他玩家通常无需安装同一模组即可加入。房主仍需使用兼容的 Among Us 游戏版本；TOHEE 的实际兼容范围以当前发行说明为准。 所有人都需要安装 TOHEE 吗？ 不需要。只有房主需要在支持的 Windows PC 游戏版本上安装 TOHEE。手机、平板、主机玩家不能安装此 Windows 模组，但可在游戏版本兼容时加入房间。 为什么普通玩家看到的基础角色和模组角色不一样？ 为兼容原版客户端，房主专属模组可能借用 Among Us 的基础角色能力；基础角色不一定等于 TOHEE 阵营或自定义角色。TOHEE 客户端可通过角色介绍和游戏界面显示更多模组信息。玩家可用 /m 查看自己的角色说明，或按 F1 （标准模式）查看信息。具体显示会依客户端和角色而不同。 Cloud 标签会授予房主权限吗？ 不会。Cloud 网页标签是绑定账号的文字和颜色设置；模组本地权限配置是另一套功能。请见 玩家标签说明 和 Cloud 指南 。 Game Master（GM）是什么？ 旧上游 FAQ 将 GM 描述为自动分配给房主的旁观者角色。当前 TOHEE 的 GM 身份通过房主本地玩家配置中的 AssignGameMaster 字段设置；它只设置 GM 身份，不会自动授予管理命令权限。详见 玩家标签说明 。 如何获取日志？ 在游戏中输入 /dump ，或按 Ctrl + F1 导出模组日志。如果游戏未能导出，请在 Among Us 目录中查看 BepInEx/LogOutput.log 。提交问题时描述复现步骤和游戏/模组版本；不要公开分享账号密码或令牌。 为什么会出现重复角色？ 检查该角色的最大数量和出现几率。若最大数量高于 1，或多个玩家都满足分配条件，重复分配可能是选项结果而非错误。 为什么加入房间后提示版本不兼容？ 房主与加入者必须使用兼容的 Among Us 版本；房主还要使用支持该游戏版本的 TOHEE 发行包。更新游戏后，请从 发行页 查看适配版本。 哪里可以找到更具体的帮助？ 先查看 故障排查 。若问题仍存在，请在 TOHEE 社区反馈并附上相关日志；旧上游 Discord 频道或邀请链接不一定仍有效，请从当前 TOHEE 项目页面查找社区入口。
search.en: Frequently Asked Questions Learn about host-only mods, client compatibility, role display, and logs. What is a host-only mod? A host-only mod runs on the host's client; other players can usually join without installing the same mod. The host still needs an Among Us game version that is compatible with the room. Check current TOHEE release notes for the supported range. Does everyone need to install TOHEE? No. Only the host installs TOHEE on a supported Windows PC version of the game. Players on phones, tablets, and consoles cannot install this Windows mod, but may join when their game version is compatible. Why does a vanilla client show a different base role from a TOHEE role? To work with unmodified clients, a host-only mod may use an Among Us base role for its abilities. The base role is not necessarily the same as the TOHEE faction or custom role. TOHEE clients can show more mod information through role descriptions and the game interface. Players can type /m to read their role description or press F1 in Standard mode. The exact display depends on the client and role. Do Cloud tags grant host permissions? No. A Cloud web tag is a text and colour setting for a linked account; mod-local permission files are a separate system. See player tags and the Cloud guide . What is Game Master (GM)? The old upstream FAQ described GM as an observer role automatically assigned to the host. Current TOHEE configures GM status with the AssignGameMaster field in a host-local player file; it sets GM status only and does not grant management commands. See player tags . How do I get a log? Enter /dump in game or press Ctrl + F1 to export a mod log. If the export does not work, check BepInEx/LogOutput.log in the Among Us directory. Include reproduction steps and game/mod versions when reporting an issue; do not share account passwords or tokens publicly. Why did the same role appear more than once? Check the role's maximum count and spawn chance. If the maximum is greater than one or several players meet the assignment rules, duplicates can be the result of the configured options rather than a bug. Why does the room say that our versions are incompatible? The host and joining players need compatible Among Us versions, and the host needs a TOHEE release that supports that game version. After a game update, check the release page for a compatible build. Where can I get more help? Start with troubleshooting . If the problem persists, report it to the TOHEE community with relevant logs. Old upstream Discord channels or invite links may no longer work; use the current TOHEE project page to find community links.

summary.zh-CN: 按安装、登录、版本和游戏运行问题检查常见原因。
summary.en: Check common installation, sign-in, version, and gameplay problems.

search.zh-CN: 故障排查 按安装、登录、版本和游戏运行问题检查常见原因。 模组没有加载，游戏仍像原版 确认你启动的是装有 TOHEE 文件的 Among Us 安装目录，而不是另一个商店目录或原版副本。 检查发行包是否完整解压到 Among Us.exe 所在目录，并确认选对架构：Steam、Epic、Microsoft Store / Xbox App 用 x64，Windows itch.io 用 x86。 让首次启动完成；BepInEx 需要为当前游戏安装生成 interop 文件，初始化可能比平常更久。具体联网要求和首次启动步骤以当前发行包说明为准。 若目录内曾安装其他模组，尝试使用干净副本重新安装当前完整发行包。不要直接从其他安装复制 interop 文件夹。 查看 BepInEx/LogOutput.log 。如需重新安装，请先备份 TOHEE-DATA 。 无法登录或登录一直等待 Steam 版可以直接运行游戏目录中的 Among Us.exe ，但登录时需要保持已登录的 Steam 客户端在后台运行；Epic 版必须通过 Epic Games Launcher 启动才能登录。确认网络连接稳定；Xbox App / Microsoft Store 版本也应先从商店客户端启动一次。若只有模组副本无法登录，确认启动参数、商店目录及包内 steam_appid.txt （仅 Steam 适用）没有被删改。第三方登录服务故障时，重启游戏不能修复服务端问题；稍后重试并查看游戏服务状态。 提示 Among Us 版本不匹配 确认游戏本体已更新，房主使用支持该版本的 TOHEE 完整发行包，加入者也运行兼容的游戏版本。Steam 玩家应检查是否意外加入公开测试分支。可在 发行页 核对当前版本说明；旧上游 Discord notice 链接可能已经变更。 启动时黑屏、卡住或崩溃 首次启动需要初始化 interop，可能比平时慢；先等待加载完成，再启动一次。若每次都失败，记录错误发生的时机，检查 BepInEx/LogOutput.log ，并尝试在干净游戏副本中安装匹配架构的完整发行包。重装前备份 TOHEE-DATA 。如果黑屏发生在对局内，退出该局并保留日志；在当前版本的帮助中检查是否提供黑屏修复命令，不要盲目使用旧版快捷键。 被踢出房间或连接中断 检查房间代码、服务器地区、网络连接和客户端游戏版本。若只有某一房间出现问题，请确认房主是否设置了等级、名单或平台限制，或主动踢出了玩家。若多个房间同时无法连接，可能是 Among Us 官方服务或网络暂时异常；稍后重试。不要把单次断线直接判断为模组故障。 一局游戏意外结束或无法结束 胜利条件取决于当前模式、存活阵营、任务和角色目标。检查标准模式的角色胜利条件、任务结束条件、“禁止正常结束游戏”（ No Game End ）一类系统选项，以及当前模式自己的计时规则。若会议无法正常结束，使用当前版本 /help 中提供的房主功能；旧上游快捷键不一定适用于当前版本。 收集日志并反馈 如果仍能进入游戏，运行 /dump 或按 Ctrl + F1 导出日志；否则复制 BepInEx/LogOutput.log 。记录 Among Us 和 TOHEE 版本、商店、架构、复现步骤，以及是否能在干净安装中复现。公开反馈前请移除账号凭据、访问令牌或其他私人信息。
search.en: Troubleshooting Check common installation, sign-in, version, and gameplay problems. TOHEE did not load and the game still looks vanilla Confirm that you launched the Among Us installation containing TOHEE files, not a different store directory or an unmodded copy. Check that the entire release package was extracted beside Among Us.exe and that you chose the right architecture: x64 for Steam, Epic, and Microsoft Store / Xbox App; x86 for Windows itch.io. Let first launch finish. BepInEx must generate interop files for this game installation, and initialization may take longer than usual. Follow the current release notes for any first-launch or network requirements. If other mods were installed in that directory, try a clean game copy with the current full release package. Do not copy an interop folder from another installation. Inspect BepInEx/LogOutput.log . Back up TOHEE-DATA before reinstalling. Sign-in failed or is taking a long time The Steam version can be launched directly from Among Us.exe in the game directory, but the signed-in Steam client must remain running in the background for game sign-in. The Epic version must be launched through Epic Games Launcher to sign in. Make sure the network is stable, and start an Xbox App / Microsoft Store game once from its store client as well. If only the modded copy cannot sign in, check the launch method, store directory, and the bundled steam_appid.txt (Steam only). Restarting the game will not fix a third-party sign-in outage; retry later and check the game service status. The game reports a version mismatch Make sure Among Us itself is updated, the host uses a full TOHEE release that supports that game version, and joining players use a compatible version too. Steam players should check that they are not on a public beta branch by mistake. Compare the current notes on the release page ; old upstream Discord notice links may have changed. Black screen, hang, or crash on startup First launch initializes interop and can take longer than usual. Wait for it to finish, then launch once more. If it fails every time, note when the error occurs, inspect BepInEx/LogOutput.log , and try the full release package for the matching architecture in a clean game copy. Back up TOHEE-DATA before reinstalling. If a black screen occurs during a round, leave the game and keep the log; check the current build's help for a black-screen fix command rather than relying on an old shortcut. Kicked from a room or disconnected Check the room code, server region, network connection, and client game version. If the problem occurs in only one room, ask whether the host configured level, allow-list, or platform limits, or removed the player. If several rooms fail at once, Among Us services or the network may be temporarily unavailable; retry later. Do not assume one disconnect proves a mod bug. A round ended unexpectedly or will not end Win conditions depend on the mode, living factions, tasks, and role objectives. Check Standard role victory conditions, task completion, system options such as No Game End, and the selected mode's own timer rules. If a meeting does not finish, use a host feature listed in the current /help ; old upstream shortcuts may not apply to the current build. Collect logs and report the problem If the game still opens, run /dump or press Ctrl + F1 to export the log. Otherwise, copy BepInEx/LogOutput.log . Include the Among Us and TOHEE versions, store, architecture, reproduction steps, and whether the issue happens in a clean installation. Remove account credentials, access tokens, and other private information before sharing a report publicly.

summary.zh-CN: 在模组客户端中开关内置音效、调整总音量与单独音量，并试听效果。
summary.en: Enable built-in effects, adjust master and individual volumes, and preview sounds in the mod client.

search.zh-CN: 自定义音效管理界面 在模组客户端中开关内置音效、调整总音量与单独音量，并试听效果。 打开界面 在模组的客户端选项中找到“ 自定义音效设置… ”。主菜单右下角也有扬声器图标；该入口在“开启模组技能音效”关闭时不可点击。主菜单中打开其他设置窗口后，扬声器入口会暂时隐藏。 管理界面列出模组内置的 19 个音效，例如 Teleport、Shield、Bite 和 Gunfire。拖动列表或使用“向上”“向下”按钮查看其他音效。点击右上角 X 或按 Esc 关闭界面。 开关与音量 控件 用法 开启模组技能音效 客户端总开关。关闭时停止正在播放的模组音效与试听。 总音量 调整所有自定义音效的整体音量。 每行“开启 / 关闭” 控制该音效在正常游戏事件触发时是否播放。 每行音量 单独调整该音效的音量。 数字输入框 输入整数百分比，按回车或移开焦点提交。界面接受 0–500；无效输入会恢复原值。 拖动滑块或提交一个不同的音量数值时，会保存设置并触发试听。调整某个音效时，该音效成为当前试听对象；调整总音量则试听当前选中的音效。右上角“试听：…”显示当前对象，首次默认是 Teleport。 试听可以播放在列表中关闭的单个音效，以便调整其音量；客户端总开关仍然生效。关闭面板会停止试听，已保存的开关和音量会保留。 总音量与单项音量如何叠加 播放音量按“总音量百分比 × 单项音量百分比”计算。例如总音量 50%、Teleport 80%，该音效得到默认音量的 40%。任意一项为 0 时，该音效静音。输入大于 100 的百分比可以提高增益，调整时可先使用较小数值试听。 这些是当前客户端自己的播放偏好，不会把音量设置同步给房间中的其他玩家。普通原版客户端不具备 TOHEE 的自定义音效播放模块。 保存位置与排查 设置保存在游戏工作目录下的 TOHEE-DATA/CustomSoundsVolumeConfig.json ，默认总音量和单项音量均为 100，各音效默认开启。界面操作会自动保存，不需要额外点击保存按钮。 没有声音时，先检查客户端总开关、总音量和对应音效音量。仅关闭某一行影响正常事件播放，不阻止该音效的本地试听。声音资源缺失或配置文件无法读写时，可以查看模组日志；重装时记得保留 TOHEE-DATA 中需要的个人设置。
search.en: Custom Sound Manager GUI Enable built-in effects, adjust master and individual volumes, and preview sounds in the mod client. Open the interface Find Custom sound settings… in the mod's client options. A speaker icon also appears at the bottom right of the main menu. That entry is disabled when Enable custom sound effects is off and temporarily hidden while another settings window is open on the main menu. The manager lists 19 effects bundled with the mod, including Teleport, Shield, Bite and Gunfire. Scroll the list or use Up and Down to find more effects. Close it with the top-right X or Esc . Switches and volume controls Control Use Enable custom sound effects Client-wide switch. Turning it off stops mod sound playback and previews. Master volume Adjust the overall volume of all custom effects. Per-effect On / Off Control whether that effect plays during normal gameplay events. Per-effect volume Adjust that effect separately. Numeric input Enter an integer percentage and press Enter or move focus away. The interface accepts 0–500 and restores the previous value for invalid input. Moving a slider or committing a different volume saves the setting and triggers a preview. Adjusting an effect selects it as the preview target; changing master volume previews the current selection. The top-right Preview label shows the selected effect, initially Teleport. A preview can play an individually disabled effect so that you can adjust it. The client-wide switch still applies. Closing the panel stops the preview while retaining saved settings. How the volumes combine Playback gain is master percentage multiplied by effect percentage. For example, 50% master and 80% Teleport produces 40% of default gain. Either value at zero mutes that effect. A value above 100 can increase gain; start with a small value when previewing changes. These are playback preferences for your client and are not synchronised to other players. An unmodded client does not contain TOHEE's custom sound playback module. Saving and troubleshooting Settings are stored in TOHEE-DATA/CustomSoundsVolumeConfig.json under the game's working directory. Master and per-effect volumes default to 100, with all effects enabled. Interface changes save automatically; there is no separate save step. If nothing plays, check the client-wide switch, master volume and the selected effect's volume. Disabling one row suppresses normal event playback but still permits a local preview. Check mod logs for missing sound resources or configuration read/write failures. Preserve personal settings under TOHEE-DATA when reinstalling.

summary.zh-CN: 按游戏、系统、模组和阵营设置分类查找选项说明。
summary.en: Find options by game, system, mod, and faction setting groups.

search.zh-CN: 设置索引 按游戏、系统、模组和阵营设置分类查找选项说明。 按菜单查找 游戏设置 ：Among Us 基础规则，例如地图、会议、移动和任务。 系统设置 ：房间控制、保护、显示和其他全局模组行为。 模组设置 ：模式、分配规则、地图、会议、任务和破坏设置。 附加职业设置 ：附加职业的显示方式和分配数量。 内鬼设置 ：内鬼和 Madmate 的阵营信息与互动。 中立设置 ：中立角色数量范围与共同胜利规则。 当前 TOHEE 菜单将角色选项分到内鬼角色页（Impostor Roles）、船员角色页（Crewmate Roles）、中立角色页（Neutral Roles）等页面。角色名称下展开的项目是该角色专属选项，不属于通用角色说明。选择模式后，菜单会隐藏不适用的选项；详见 游戏模式 。 上游设置页面说明 旧 TOHE 上游的八个 options/Settings 页面大多是角色目录 HTML，而不是八个独立设置页面。本目录仅整理有实际通用设置内容的部分；旧女巫阵营（Coven）页面列出的通用角色配额、通风和视野选项不在当前 TOHEE 设置标签中，船员页面也没有单独的通用设置段落。不要将旧页面里的角色名单或旧选项直接当作当前客户端行为。 设置名称与范围会随模组版本变化。请以当前游戏中的设置菜单和当前发行说明为准；本文用于解释各组的用途，而非替代游戏内选项。
search.en: Settings Index Find options by game, system, mod, and faction setting groups. Browse by menu Game Settings : base Among Us rules such as maps, meetings, movement, and tasks. System Settings : room controls, protections, display, and other global mod behavior. Mod Settings : mode, assignment, map, meeting, task, and sabotage rules. Add-on Settings : Add-on display and assignment limits. Impostor Settings : Impostor and Madmate information and interactions. Neutral Settings : Neutral counts and faction win-together rules. Current TOHEE places role options under pages such as Impostor Roles, Crewmate Roles, and Neutral Roles. Items nested under a role name are specific to that role, not general role documentation. The menu hides options that do not apply to the selected mode; see game modes . About the upstream settings pages Most of the eight old upstream options/Settings pages are role-directory HTML, not separate settings pages. This section extracts only the parts that contain general settings. The old Coven page listed global Coven quotas, venting, and vision controls that are not present in current TOHEE settings tabs; the Crewmate page has no separate general settings section. Do not treat old role lists or options as current client behavior. Names and ranges change between mod versions. Use the settings menu in the current game and the current release notes as the source of truth; these pages explain the purpose of groups rather than replace the in-game options.

summary.zh-CN: 调整 Among Us 的基础规则，如地图、速度、视野、会议和任务。
summary.en: Adjust base Among Us rules such as maps, speed, vision, meetings, and tasks.

search.zh-CN: 游戏设置 调整 Among Us 的基础规则，如地图、速度、视野、会议和任务。 这些设置控制什么？ 游戏设置（Game Settings） 页面控制 Among Us 本身的基础规则。更改后会影响该槽位中的整局游戏，而不只影响某个角色。 设置组 常见用途 地图和内鬼数量 选择地图，并指定房间基础的内鬼（Impostor）数量。 会议和投票 调整紧急会议次数、冷却、讨论时间、投票时间和匿名投票。 移动与视野 调整玩家速度、船员（Crewmate）/内鬼（Impostor）视野、基础击杀冷却和击杀距离。 任务 调整视觉任务、任务栏更新方式，以及普通、长、短任务的数量。 此页列出的名称基于上游历史设置文档；不同 Among Us 版本可能调整控件或选项。当前游戏内显示的选项和值域优先。 设置建议 首次开房时先用熟悉的地图、速度和会议时长。一次只改少数选项，便于确认效果。再按人数和角色配置调整任务总量及击杀冷却。选择躲猫猫（Hide & Seek TOHE）时，标准模式的部分设置会被隐藏，改用该模式对应的选项页。 模组角色、获胜条件和专属规则位于 模组设置 与相应角色菜单，而不是本页。
search.en: Game Settings Adjust base Among Us rules such as maps, speed, vision, meetings, and tasks. What do these settings control? The Game Settings page controls the base rules of Among Us. A change affects the round in the selected preset slot, not just one role. Setting group Common use Map and Impostor count Choose a map and set the room's base Impostor count. Meetings and voting Adjust emergency meetings, cooldown, discussion and voting time, and anonymous voting. Movement and vision Set player speed, Crewmate / Impostor vision, base kill cooldown, and kill distance. Tasks Configure visual tasks, task-bar updates, and common, long, and short task counts. These names are based on the historical upstream settings reference; different Among Us versions may change controls or choices. The options and ranges shown in the current game take precedence. Tuning tips For a first room, use a familiar map, speed, and meeting length. Change only a few options at a time so you can see the result. Adjust total tasks and kill cooldown for the player count and role mix. When you select Hide & Seek TOHE, some Standard options are hidden and the mode's own settings apply. Mod roles, win conditions, and role-specific rules are in Mod Settings and their role menus, not on this page.

summary.zh-CN: 了解房间保护、加入限制、信息显示和模组全局行为。
summary.en: Review room protections, join restrictions, information display, and global mod behavior.

search.zh-CN: 系统设置 了解房间保护、加入限制、信息显示和模组全局行为。 用途 系统设置（System Settings） 控制房间级或模组级行为，不是 Among Us 的基础速度、任务或地图设置。当前版本的项目会随发行版变化；修改前请阅读选项说明，尤其是会限制加入、改变胜利或降低保护的设置。 此分组通常涵盖以下方面： 房间进入规则： 等级或名单限制、玩家平台限制等。启用前确认允许名单和房间规则不会误踢朋友。 游戏保护与性能： 防黑屏保护（Anti-Blackout）、低负载选项和调试行为。测试专用选项可能使正式对局更容易异常。 结果与信息显示： 是否显示击杀记录、上一局角色、阵营人数或投票/逐出信息。 命令与显示偏好： 是否允许部分命令、名称显示方式、主机标签和控制台行为。 随机分配行为： 角色随机分配算法等会影响如何从可用角色中选人，但不会改变单个角色技能。 菜单可能包含特定管理或调试选项。不要因为旧上游页面标注了推荐状态，就关闭当前版本的保护。遇到异常黑屏或分配问题时，优先保持保护启用并收集日志。 可选的测试设置 当前代码包含“禁止正常结束游戏”（ No Game End ）、控制台显示、防黑屏缓冲模式（Anti-Blackout buffer）和角色分配算法一类全局选项。 No Game End 会改变正常胜利流程；关闭保护或改变调试行为可能导致对局状态异常。仅在你清楚结果时修改，并在普通房间中恢复合适的值。 玩家标签权限、名单和 Cloud 玩家标签是不同功能。Cloud 网页标签不会自动授予系统设置中的模组权限；查看 玩家标签 。
search.en: System Settings Review room protections, join restrictions, information display, and global mod behavior. Purpose System Settings control room-wide or mod-wide behavior rather than base Among Us speed, task, or map settings. The exact set changes between releases. Read each option's description before changing it, especially settings that restrict joining, alter victory, or reduce protection. This group commonly covers: Room access: Level or list restrictions and platform restrictions. Before enabling them, check that the allow-list and room rules will not remove friends by mistake. Game protection and performance: Anti-Blackout protection, low-load options, and debug behavior. A testing-only option can make ordinary matches less reliable. Results and information: Whether to display kill logs, previous roles, faction counts, or voting/ejection information. Commands and display preferences: Access to some commands, name display, host labels, and console behavior. Random assignment: Role-assignment algorithms affect how available roles are selected, not the abilities of an individual role. Some releases may include management or debug options. Do not disable current protections just because an old upstream page marked a setting as recommended. If you encounter a black screen or assignment problem, keep protections enabled and collect a log first. Testing options Current source includes global options such as No Game End , console display, Anti-Blackout buffer mode, and role-assignment algorithm. No Game End changes normal victory flow; disabling protections or changing debug behavior can leave a round in an unexpected state. Change these only when you understand the effect, and restore suitable values for normal rooms. Player-tag permissions, local lists, and Cloud player tags are separate features. A Cloud web tag does not automatically grant mod permissions in System Settings; see player tags .

summary.zh-CN: 选择 TOHEE 游戏模式，并配置角色、胜利规则和模组玩法选项。
summary.en: Choose a TOHEE game mode and configure roles, win rules, and mod gameplay options.

search.zh-CN: 模组设置 选择 TOHEE 游戏模式，并配置角色、胜利规则和模组玩法选项。 选择模式 **模组设置（Mod Settings）**中的模式选择会改变一局游戏的规则和菜单内容。当前 TOHEE 提供标准模式（Standard）、自由混战（FFA）和躲猫猫（Hide & Seek TOHE）。先选模式，再设置本模式显示的选项；详见 游戏模式说明 。旧上游页面中的竞速模式（Speedrun）不在当前模式列表中。 标准模式（Standard）设置 标准模式可在角色页配置内鬼（Impostor）、船员（Crewmate）、中立（Neutral）角色及附加职业（Add-ons）。常见操作包括： 设置角色最大数量和出现概率，控制角色是否有机会进入本局。 查看各角色展开选项，配置冷却、技能次数、胜利条件和特殊限制。 设置逐出信息、阵营剩余人数，以及地图、破坏和任务变化。 检查附加职业的数量和可分配对象，避免同一玩家叠加过多相互冲突的效果。 角色设置页只显示当前版本存在的角色。旧版 TOHE 上游的女巫阵营（Coven）及其通用控制不在当前 TOHEE 角色菜单中。 自由混战与躲猫猫 自由混战设置包括对局时长、击杀冷却，以及可选的随机能力和变化。躲猫猫模式使用独立的追捕方数量和基础设置；标准模式的角色选项与部分通用选项会隐藏。切换模式后确认当前预设中需要的选项，避免把另一种模式的习惯配置误认为仍然生效。 地图、基础速度、会议或任务设置属于 游戏设置 。房间保护和访问控制见 系统设置 。
search.en: Mod Settings Choose a TOHEE game mode and configure roles, win rules, and mod gameplay options. Choose a mode The mode selector in Mod Settings changes both round rules and the menu contents. Current TOHEE provides Standard, FFA, and Hide & Seek TOHE. Choose the mode first, then configure the options shown for it. See game modes . Speedrun from the old upstream page is not in the current mode list. Standard gameplay options Standard lets you configure Impostor, Crewmate, and Neutral roles and Add-ons in their respective pages. Common tasks include: Set each role's maximum count and spawn chance to control whether it can enter a round. Expand role options to configure cooldowns, ability uses, win conditions, and special limits. Set ejection information, remaining faction counts, and map, sabotage, or task changes. Review Add-on counts and eligible players so one player does not receive too many conflicting effects. The role pages show roles available in the current build. The Coven faction and its general controls from the old upstream TOHE pages are not in the current TOHEE role menu. FFA and Hide & Seek FFA options cover match duration, kill cooldown, and optional random abilities or twists. Hide & Seek TOHE has its own hunter count and base settings; Standard roles and some general options are hidden. After switching modes, review the active preset so you do not assume settings from another mode are still in effect. Map, base speed, meeting, and task settings from Game Settings are covered in game settings . Room protection and access controls from System Settings are covered in system settings .

summary.zh-CN: 调整附加职业的名字显示、样式和分配数量。
summary.en: Adjust Add-on name display, formatting, and assignment counts.

search.zh-CN: 附加职业设置 调整附加职业的名字显示、样式和分配数量。 通用附加职业（Add-ons）选项 附加职业（Add-ons）是叠加在角色上的修饰效果。打开 Addons 菜单后，可以查看每项附加职业的数量、出现几率和角色限制。当前通用选项包括： 在名字旁显示附加职业： 控制玩家名字旁是否显示附加职业。关闭后不会取消效果，只是隐藏显示。 括号和短名称： 调整显示样式，便于将多个角色修饰与角色名称区分开。 附加职业数量上限： 默认限制较低；增大数量后玩家可能获得多个修饰。先考虑效果冲突和信息负担，再提高上限。 部分附加职业只允许特定阵营或角色获得，部分会与其他附加职业冲突。每项附加职业下的选项说明决定它的具体效果；旧上游页面的分类或总数可能与当前版本不同。
search.en: Add-on Settings Adjust Add-on name display, formatting, and assignment counts. General Add-on options Add-ons are modifiers layered on top of roles. Open the Addons menu to see each Add-on's count, spawn chance, and role restrictions. Current general options include: Display Add-ons by the name: Controls whether Add-ons appear beside player names. Turning this off hides the display; it does not remove the effect. Brackets and short names: Adjust the display style so multiple modifiers are easier to distinguish from the role name. Maximum Add-on count: The default limit is low; raising it can give players multiple modifiers. Consider conflicting effects and information load before increasing the limit. Some Add-ons are limited to certain factions or roles, and some conflict with other Add-ons. The description under each Add-on controls its specific behavior; categories and total counts on old upstream pages may differ from the current release.

summary.zh-CN: 配置内鬼队友信息、Madmate 互动和基础变身规则。
summary.en: Configure Impostor teammate information, Madmate interactions, and base shapeshift rules.

search.zh-CN: 内鬼设置 配置内鬼队友信息、Madmate 互动和基础变身规则。 内鬼（Impostor）阵营选项 标准模式（Standard）的内鬼角色页（Impostor Roles）包含阵营级选项以及单个角色配置。当前通用选项包括： 是否让内鬼互相看到彼此的角色及附加职业（Add-ons）。 内鬼是否能识别和击杀 Madmate。 Madmate 是否互相识别、识别内鬼、使用内鬼视野或击杀内鬼。 内鬼的默认变身冷却，以及死亡后是否仍可破坏。 这些设置会改变队友信息和阵营互动，可能明显改变平衡。调整时先区分“能看到谁”和“能否击杀谁”；单独角色页还会显示各角色的技能选项。具体组合以当前菜单为准。
search.en: Impostor Settings Configure Impostor teammate information, Madmate interactions, and base shapeshift rules. Impostor faction options The Impostor Roles page in Standard contains faction-wide settings and individual role options. Current general options include: Whether Impostors see each other's roles and Add-ons. Whether Impostors can identify and kill Madmates. Whether Madmates identify one another or Impostors, use Impostor vision, or kill Impostors. The default shapeshift cooldown and whether dead Impostors may still sabotage. These settings change teammate information and faction interactions, so they can significantly affect balance. When tuning them, distinguish “who can be seen” from “who can be killed.” Individual role entries also show each role's ability options. Use the combinations shown in the current menu.

summary.zh-CN: 控制中立击杀角色、末日中立角色数量范围和共同胜利。
summary.en: Control Neutral killer and Apocalypse role ranges and shared wins.

search.zh-CN: 中立设置 控制中立击杀角色、末日中立角色数量范围和共同胜利。 数量范围 标准模式（Standard）的中立角色页（Neutral Roles）包含中立（Neutral）分配规则。当前通用设置可以限制以下角色的最小和最大数量： 非中立阵营的击杀角色。 中立击杀角色。 末日中立（Apocalypse）角色。 这些范围会约束分配器在本局可选角色中的数量。通常将最小数量设为不高于最大数量；若角色数量、出现几率、玩家数和阵营上下限互相冲突，某些角色可能无法出现。旧上游页面曾将其中一个最大值的说明写错；请以当前游戏菜单中精确的选项名称为准。 中立角色共同胜利 中立选项还可控制同类型中立角色是否共同胜利，以及是否让所有中立角色一同获胜。开启的范围越广，中立玩家之间的竞争越少，但也可能让独立胜利目标更容易一起达成。更改后检查每个角色自己的胜利条件，避免与房间规则冲突。 角色的能力和个人胜利条件位于中立角色页下各角色的展开项。这里只说明通用分配和胜利组选项。
search.en: Neutral Settings Control Neutral killer and Apocalypse role ranges and shared wins. Count ranges The Neutral Roles page in Standard contains Neutral assignment rules. Current general settings can set minimum and maximum counts for: Killing roles from non-Neutral factions. Neutral killing roles. Apocalypse roles. These ranges constrain how many roles the assignment system can select for a round. Keep the minimum at or below the maximum. If role counts, spawn chances, player count, and faction limits conflict, some roles may not appear. An old upstream page misstated one maximum's description; use the exact option label in the current game. Neutral win-together rules Neutral options can make Neutrals of the same type win together, and can also allow every Neutral to win together. A broader shared-win rule reduces competition among Neutral players, but can also make separate victory goals easier to satisfy at once. After changing it, check each role's win condition so it does not conflict with the room rules. Abilities and individual victory goals are under each role in the Neutral Roles menu. This page covers only the general assignment and shared-win options.
